༄༅/ /rab gnas don gsal gyi gsal byed dngos grub 'byung ba'i bstan bcos chen po'i dgongs don rnam par bshad pa rab gnas bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rab gnas don gsal gyi gsal byed dngos grub 'byung ba'i bstan bcos chen po'i dgongs don rnam par bshad pa rab gnas bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba bzhugs// rgya gar skad du/ sa de wa dza gargu tu bhaṭṭa ra ka kirti dhwa dza shtsa dwai ya maṇḍa dha ra dharmā rā dza wa gind+ra a nanda ratna shrī tsakra shwa ra na ya ka wa ra gu ru tri ṇi ye na maḥ bod skad du/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba'i bla ma rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan dang gnyis su med pa'i sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen dang dpal 'khor lo'i dbang phyug 'dren mchog bla ma gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rmad byung rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang la/ /brten nas grangs med bskal pa'i sngon rol tu/ /byang chub brnyes kyang mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi/ /rnam 'phrul ston mkhas zas gtsang sras po rgyal/ /de gsung lung rtogs bdag nyid dam pa'i chos/ /zab dang rgya che'i bstan pa'i srol chen po/ /rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /ngo mtshar paṇa grub dbang po mchog rnams rgyal/ /kha ba ri pa'i bsod nams las byon pa'i/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal blon por bcas rnams dang / /bka' dang bstan bcos sgra bsgyur la mkhas pa'i/ /lo paṇa 'jig rten mig rnams phyag byar 'os/ /khyad par yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag che/ /sa skya'i bla chen kun dga' snying po'i zhabs/ /brgyud par bcas dang rab gnas cho ga yi/ /chos sgo 'byed mdzad grags pas bdag la skyongs/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir spyi dang bye brag gi /bstan pa yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas mdzad cing / /lhag par rje btsun gsung rab don gsal gyis/ /padmo'i gnyen gyur sngags 'chang chos rjer 'dud/ /de 'dra'i skyes mchog ngag dbang kun rin zhes/ /sprul pa'i gang zag de yi thugs kyi sras/ /grub mchog dbang po'i mtshan dang yab rje mchog /sbas pa'i sangs rgyas zhabs zung spyi bos mchod/

/brtan g.yo kun khyab rang rig bla ma yi/ /rang zhal ston mdzad rgyal ba kun gyi dngos/ /'khor 'das bdag po rje btsun mus pa che/ /buddha'i mtshan gyis byang chub bar du srungs/ /gzhan yang dngos grub mchog stsol yi dam lha/ /bar chad kun sel chos skyong srung ma dang / /dgos 'dod char ltar 'bebs pa'i nor sbyin dbang / /'khor dang bcas la gus pas btud byas nas/ /'jig rten khams 'dir bde skyid 'byung ba dang / /rgyal ba'i bstan pa gnas pa'i thabs kyi gtso/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchog bgrang yas la/ /rnam dag cho gas rab tu gnas pa yi/ /don 'grel legs bshad sngon med nyi ma 'di/ /sngags 'chang kho bos skyes dang sbyangs pa yis/ /blo mig dag pa'i mkha' las legs bgrod de/ /skal bzang blo gros padmo'i gnyen du sbyin/ /'di ni rje btsun gsung gi don 'grel te/ /sngags 'chang gsung rab gsal ba'i sgron me yin/ /de phyir rab gnas cho ga ma lus pa'i/ /rnam bshad mchog 'di spro bas 'dir spel lo/ /bdag gi rjes 'jug chos dang rigs kyi bu/ /khyed rnams snyoms las ma byed bstan bcos 'di/ /ri mo bris te thos bsam mthar phyin pa/ /mdzod la legs bshad gtam gyis kun dga' byos/ /'dir gangs ri'i khrod kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan mchog tu gyur pa dpal ldan sa skya'i rig 'dzin gyi dbang po 'khon ston grags pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i rab tu gnas pa don gsal zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos mchog gi gsal byed snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma chen po sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi gsung rab rab gnas dngos grub 'byung ba'i dgongs pa'i don rnams legs par bshad pa rab gnas bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba 'di 'chad pa la don gnyis te/ rab gnas kyi rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa dang / skabs su babs pa'i don dngos la 'jug pa'o/ /dang po ni/

spyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud sde rin po che rnams kyi brjod don dag mngon rtogs kyi rim par bsdebs nas 'chad cing nyams su len pa'i tshul la dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ rdo rje phreng ba'i rgyud shes byed du mdzad nas gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa la bskyed rim lus dben dang bcas pa sngon du song ba'i dbang du byas te/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa la rim pa lngar mdzad cing / de nyid la slob dpon 'phags pa lhas nyams len gyi rim pa'i dbang du mdzad nas/ thog mar sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa'i bsam pa la bslab pa/ de nas theg pa gsar pa dran pa gcig pa'i mngon rtogs la bslab pa/ de nas rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la bslab pa/ de nas dben pa gsum dang / bden pa gnyis dang / zung 'jug la bslab pa'i rim pa ste rim pa dgu'i rnam gzhag bzhed la/ dpal ldan zla bas ni bskyed rim la rim pa dang po dang / rdzogs rim la rim pa bzhir mdzad nas rgyud don ma lus pa rim pa lngar 'du bar gsungs so/ /yang rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan birwa pas ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ rgyud ni rgyun chags zhes bya ste/ /rgyud de rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /gzhi dang de yi rang bzhin dang / /mi 'phrogs pa yi rab phye ba'o/ /rang bzhin rnam pa rgyu yin te/ /gzhi ni thabs zhes bya bar brjod/ /de bzhin mi 'phrogs 'bras bu ste/ /gsum gyis rgyud kyi don bsdus pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs par mdzad nas/ rgyud don thams cad rgyu rgyud/ thabs rgyud/ 'bras rgyud gsum du bsdus/ thabs rgyud la smin byed kyi dbang dang / grol byed kyi lam gnyis/ phyi ma la mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i mngon rtogs lnga/ dngos grub gnyis ka bsgrub pa'i gtso bo thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i mngon par rtogs pa la lnga/ gnyis ka la dgos pa grogs dam tshig dang sdom pa ste gcig tu bsdoms te mngon par rtogs pa bcu gcig tu mdzad la/

gzhan yang rgyud don dag pa gsum du bsdus pa dang / bdag nyid can gsum du bsdus pa dang / gnas pa bzhir bsdus pa dang / smin grol gnyis su bsdus pa sogs grub pa brnyes pa'i slob dpon so so'i bzhed pa mi 'dra ba mang du yod pa las/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa pa'i bzhed pa ltar rgyu rgyud/ thabs rgyud/ 'bras rgyud gsum du ma 'dus pa'i rgyud don mngon rtogs kyi rim par bsdu rgyu gzhan med pas/ 'phags pa yab sras sogs kyi bzhed pa yang 'di nyid du gnas pa yin zhing / de dag gi nang nas thabs rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa bcu gcig ni/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing gi don bsdus mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ de rjes sngags lam thog mar smin byed dbang / /lam la rtogs pa'i lta ba bskyed rdzogs gnyis/ /spyod dang nye rgyu mchog gi mngon rtogs lnga/ /bzlas dang gtor ma sbyin sreg rab gnas dang / /las tshogs rab 'byams zhes bya yan lag lnga/ /gnyis ka'i thun mong dam tshig sdom pa ste/ /thabs rgyud mngon par rtogs pa bcu gcig go /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ smin byed kyi dbang / bskyed rim/ rdzogs rim/ spyod pa/ nye rgyu ste mchog gtso bo bsgrub pa'i mngon par rtogs pa lnga/ bzlas pa/ gtor ma/ sbyin sreg rab tu gnas pa ste gtso bor thun mong dngosagrub bsgrub pa'i mngon par rtogs pa lnga/ de dag thams cad la thun mong du dgos pa dam tshig dang sdom pa'i rnam gzhag dang bcu gcig la bshad do/ /de rnams kyi nang nas rab tu gnas pa ni/ mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa la mngon rtogs dang po lnga'i yan lag lta bur bshad kyang / gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu 'jig rten du bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba sogs dge legs kun gyi gzhi yin zhing /

mthar thug bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i rgyu yang 'di nyid kyis byed pas na/ phan yon gyi sgo nas mngon rtogs gzhan thams cad las khyad par 'phags pa zhig go /des na yul dang sa phyogs gang na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gnas pa de yang bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab gnas can bzhugs pa de dang de'i mthu yin par gsungs pas na/ rab gnas byed pa'i slob dpon dag gis rab gnas kyi cho ga la mkhas shing byang chub pa'i sgo nas rab tu gnas pa bya dgos pa yin la/ ci'i phyir rab gnas pa zhes bya zhe na/ slob dpon nag po pas/ mchog tu rab tu gnas pas rab gnas zhes gsungs pas/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten de nyid ye shes sems dpa'i bdag nyid du bsgrub pas na mchog gi rab ces bya la/ gnas pa ni 'khor ba ji srid du bzhugs pa'i don yin pas na ye shes sems dpa' ji srid bzhugs pa de srid du lha mi'i mchod pa'i gnas zla med pa yin pa'i phyir na rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba'am/ yang chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis/ sku gzugs la ye shes pa gnas pa'i phyir rab tu gnas pa zhes bya'o zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'og min nas spyan 'dren pa'i rten de dang rigs 'dra'i ye shes pa dang rang bzhin gyi gnas nas spyan 'dren pa'i de dang rigs mi 'dra ba'i ye shes pa ni mchog gi rab/ de nyid sku gzugs la bstims te yun ring gnas par byed pas na rab gnas so/ /de la ming gi sgo nas nang gi rab gnas dang / phyi'i rab gnas gnyis las/ snga ma ni bdag nyid lhar bsgom pa la ye shes pa bcug ste dbang bskur nas mchod bstod bzlas pa sogs byed pa de nyid do/ /phyi ma ni yongs su dag pa bzang po drug tshang ba'i sgo nas sku gzugs la ye shes pa gnas par byed ste/ de la bzang po drug ni/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten yongs su dag pa bzang po/ rab tu gnas pa byed pa po slob dpon yongs su dag pa bzang po/

nam bya ba'i dus yongs su dag pa bzang po/ gang du bya ba'i gnas yongs su dag pa bzang po/ gang gi sgo nas bya ba'i yo byad yongs su dag pa bzang po/ ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga yongs su dag pa bzang po rnams so/ /de dag kyang rim pa ltar/ tshad kyis tshad la phab cing shis/ /de 'dra rab tu gnas par bsngags/ /zhes pa ltar gyi rten dang / dbang thob cing dam tshig sdom pa ldan pa/ lha'i rnal 'byor brtan pa/ bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs pa/ sngags kyi theg pa'i pha rol son pa/ rab gnas kyi cho ga la mkhas pa/ de nyid bcu shes pa sogs kyi mtshan nyid tshang ba'i slob dpon dang ldan pa dang / dbang bskur dang ni rab gnas dang / /yar gyi ngo la brtag par bya/ /gza' dang skar ma 'dzoms gyur na/ /mar gyi ngo la'ang nyes pa med/ /ces pa ltar gyi dus dang / yid 'phrog pa yi rab gnas sar/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi gnas dang / rab gnas dang 'brel ba'i yo byad ji snyed tshogs pa dang / sbyor dngos rjes kyi cho ga lhag chad med cing ma 'khrugs pa'i rnam par bzhag pa'o/ /yang rab tu gnas bya'i sgo nas/ rten gsum/ gnas/ rgyan gyi rab gnas dang gsum du yang bshad cing / cho ga'i lugs srol gyi sgo nas rab gnas kyi sgra tsam 'jug pa la/ mdo nas bshad pa dang / sngags nas bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la yang nyan thos pa'i lugs dang / theg chen pa'i lugs gnyis kyi snga ma ni/ ston pa'i sku gzugs la sogs pa bzhengs te dus ston gyi tshe khri'i steng du bzhugs su gsol/ rten de nyid ni ston pa sogs su mos nas skye bo rnams bsod nams spel ba'i phyir mchod pa rgya chen po bshams par/ gso sbyongs byas ste so so thar pa'i mdo 'don pa dang / 'dul ba lung sogs nas 'byung ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad rnams brjod pa de nyid yin la/ tshul de ni mnga' dbul lta bu zhig yin gyis rab gnas mtshan nyid pa ni ma yin te/ mdo nas rab gnas mtshan nyid pa ma bshad pas so/

/de ltar yang sdom gsum rab dbye las/ 'di yang brtag par bya bas nyon/ /mdo nas rab gnas bshad pa med/ /ces pa dang / lha bsgom pa dang sngags bzlas dang / /bum pa lha yi sta gon dang / /dngos gzhi dam tshig sems dpa' dang / /ye shes 'khor lo dgug gzhug dang / /spyan dbye brtan par bzhugs pa dang / /sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yi/ /me tog dor nas legs mchod pa'i/ /bkra shis rgyas par byed pa yis/ /cho ga gsang sngags rgyud sde las/ /gsung gi pha rol phyin las min/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /des na nyos pa dag de ltar byed pa de nyid rab gnas mtshan nyid pa ma yin kyang / de ltar byas pa la phan yon mang du bshad cing rab gnas kyi ming tsam gdags su mi rung ba yang ma yin te/ rab dbye las/ 'on kyang mchod bstod bkra shis sogs/ /rgyal po'i mnga' dbul lta bu la/ /rab gnas yin zhes smra na smos/ /zhes pa dang / de nyid kyi rang mchan du/ rgya gar na khron pa dang skyed mo'i tshal la sogs pa la mchod pa byed pa la yang rab gnas su ming 'dogs pa yod ces gsungs pas 'di dag gi ming tsam gdags su rung bar bstan par snang bas so/ /gnyis pa theg pa chen po pa'i lugs ni sngags nas 'byung ba las logs su med do/ /gsum pa sngags nas bshad pa la yang / bya rgyud nas bshad pa dang / rnal 'byor rgyud nas bshad pa dang / bla med nas bshad pa rnams las/ dang po ni/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten de'i thugs khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du lha de nyid kyi snying po bris pa ltar bsgoms la/ des sangs rgyas byang sems rnams spyan drangs te rten de la bstims nas/ mchod bstod bkra shis mnga' dbul bsdus pa tsam byed pa ste/ paṇḍi ta su ma ti kirtis mdzad pa'i bya rgyud kyi rab gnas las de ltar du bshad pas so/ /spyod rgyud rang rkang nas bshad pa'i rab gnas byed tshul gyi rgyud dang rgya gzhung med par bshad la/ 'on kyang bya rgyud nas bshad pa ltar la/

slar yang sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med nam mkhar spyan drangs nas de dag gis rten la byin gyis rlob bzhin par mos nas mnga' dbul sogs bsdus pa byas na rung bar ngor chen kun dga' bzang po'i gsung rgyun zin bris 'ga' zhig las 'byung bas de ltar byas kyang nyes pa med par sems so/ /'on kyang 'chad par 'gyur ba'i mtshan nyid can gyi rab gnas ni rnal 'byor rgyud yan chad nas bshad kyi/ mdo lugs dang rgyud sde 'og ma gnyis rang rkang la med par shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa rnal 'byor rgyud nas bshad pa ni/ slob dpon rab 'byor bskyangs kyis mdzad pa'i sku gzugs spyan dbye ba'i cho ga zhes bya ba dang / slob dpon kun snying gis mdzad pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga dang / pradzña wa mi tas mdzad pa'i spyan dbye ba'i cho ga dang / slob dpon zhi ba snying pos mdzad pa'i mchod rten bsgrub pa'i cho ga dang / slob dpon dge mtshan bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i khrus kyi cho ga zhes pa rnams nas 'byung ba ltar rten dam tshig par bskyed pa la sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te bstims nas til gyi gang bu til gyis gang ba bzhin du rten gyi nang de nyid sangs rgyas byang sems kyis gang bar byas te brtan bzhugs sogs byed pa yin la/ rnal 'byor bla med nas bshad pa'i rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi la yang tshul de nyid las khyad par ha cang / che ba ma bshad cing / de ltar du yod pas na rnal 'byor rgyud yan chad du rang rkang la rab gnas mtshan nyid pa yod cing / rgyud de 'og ma rang rkang la med pa'i gnad de yin no/ /gsum pa bla med nas bshad pa ni/ thog mar rang nyid lhar bsgom zhing sngags bzla ba dang / rab tu gnas bya'i rten la dbang bskur ba'i phyir bum pa sta gon dang / dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i cho ga bya ba'i phyir snyan gsan 'bebs pa lha sta gon dang / rab tu gnas bya'i rten la bgegs sbyang ba dang /

dri ma bkru ba la sogs pa'i rab gnas kyi sta gon sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhi la bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing mchod pa dang / rten dam tshig sems dpar bskyed pa dang / de la ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug bya ba dang / de la dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa dang / spyan dbye dang / brtan par bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pa dang / spyi dang bye brag so so'i mnga' dbul dang / sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i me tog dor nas legs par mchod de/ rjes dga' ston dang bkra shis kyi tshig rgyas par brjod pa'i sgo nas bya ba ste 'og gzhung don gyi skabs su zhib tu 'chad pa ltar ro/ /de lta bu'i rab gnas la/ kyai rdo rje'i rtsa rgyud las/ rab gnas mtshan nyid bzang po nyid/ /ces gsungs pa la brten nas grub chen mi thub zla bas rab gnas bzang po drug pa zhes bya ba mdzad/ slob dpon nag po shanta bha dras de dang mthun pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga mdzad cing / yang gsang 'dus 'jam rdor la brten nas paṇḍi ta stong nyid snying rje'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga dang / gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje la brten nas 'gos lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i bla ma nag po dam tshig rdo rjes mdzad pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga dang / bde mchog sdom 'byung la brten nas/ mai tri pas mdzad pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga dang / grub chen dpal 'dzin gyis gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud la brten nas mdzad pa'i rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga dang / slob dpon a bha ya ka ras dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje phreng ba'i nang du yang rab gnas kyi cho ga bshad pa dang / lugs de nyid kyi rjes su 'brangs nas paṇḍi ta bhi su ta tsant+ras bde mchog dkyil chog tu bshad pa'i rab gnas dang / ratna rakṣi tas sdom 'byung gi 'grel pa la brten pa'i rab gnas dang / paṇḍi ta sa mantas bris pa'i mgon po mngon 'byung gi rgyud la brten pa'i rab gnas dang /

sa tu pu tras dus kyi 'khor lo la brten pa'i rab gnas dang / yo ga skor la paṇḍi ta rigs kyi byin pas kri ya saṃ tra ha/ darpan ā tsaryas kṛ ya sa mun tsa la brten pa'i rab gnas la sogs pa rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du rab gnas kyi cho ga'i rnam gzhag mang du byung ba yin no/ /bod kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir ni bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos bsam yas su rten gsum bzhugs gnas dang bcas pa la rab gnas mdzad pas deng sang gi bar du yang byang chub chen po bzhugs gnas kyi gtsug lag khang dbu rtse chen mo sogs phal cher ma nyams par bzhugs so/ /slob dpon des rab gnas de gzhung gang la brten nas mdzad lo rgyus dag las gsal bar mi 'byung yang / 'di nyid mdo sngags gnyis la mkhas shing rnal 'byor bla med la thugs dam gyi mthil mdzad par snang bas/ bla med la brten nas mdzad par gsal lo zhes rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gsung rgyun las 'byung la/ bstan pa phyi dar la ni/ slob dpon shra ta ka ra warmas bod du byon nas rab gnas kyi rgyud dang rgya gzhung mang po yang spyan drangs tho ling gser khang gi gtsug lag khang gi rab gnas mdzad/ de dus kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod ni grub chen kun snying gi lugs yin yang / thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud kyi dngos bstan la brten nas slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / shākya bshes gnyen gyi lugs ltar rdor dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor sgo rkyang la brten nas mdzad par bshad do/ /de'i stobs kyis mnga' ris stod du rdor dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor sgo rkyang gi ras bris mang du byung zhing / sgo rkyang ni tshegs chung zhing cho ga myur ba zhig yin par bshad do/ /slob dpon des rab gnas bsdus pa byed pa'i tshe sems dpa' 'byung chen 'byung chung gang rung la brten nas mdzad par grags la/ de dus kyi mnga' ris stod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams nas/

rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi bar la rab gnas kyi rgyud dang gzhung bzhi la 'chad nyan mdzad cing / rab gnas kyang de'i steng nas mdzad/ cho ga'i go rim mi 'chol ba'i phyir lo chen gyis sdom tshig kyang mdzad do/ /slob dpon shra ta sogs kyis mdzad pa de dag phal cher rnal 'byor rgyud ltar gyi rab gnas yin la/ bya spyod la brten pa ni/ paṇḍi ta su ma ti kirtis mnga' ris kyi bar thang du bde mchog gi lha khang gcig la gzungs grwa la brten nas rab gnas mdzad cing / bo dong gi phu spangs khang gser ma zhes pa spangs kha mdar stod kyi rdor dbyings kyi lha khang bzhengs pa la/ snur nyi ma 'od zer gyis rnam 'joms la brten nas rab gnas mdzad de de ni rnam 'joms spyod rgyud du bkral ba'i lugs yin la/ de dag kyang bya spyod kyi lha so so la brten pa ma gtogs cho ga gong ma'i rgyas skabs yin na rab gnas mtshan nyid par 'chad dgos la/ yang bya spyod rang rkang gi cho ga sbyar ba yin na rab gnas mtshan nyid pa ma yin par shes par bya dgos sam snyam mo/ /rnal 'byor bla med la bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su byung ba ni/ 'gos lo tsā bas/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje'i gsang 'dus la brten nas mdzad pa'i gzhung la brten nas gtsug lag khang gi rab gnas mdzad cing / gnyos lo tsā bas/ paṇḍi ta stong nyid ting nge 'dzin bzang po'i gzhung dang / bla ma ba liṃ ta ā tsarya'i lag len la brten nas bod kyi gtsug lag khang mang po'i rab gnas mdzad la/ de dag gi rjes su rje btsun rin po ches lo chen rin chen bzang po'i sdom tshig dang mthun zhing rab gnas kyi cho ga'i phyag len khrigs chags su bsdebs pa rab gnas kyi gzhung bzhi dang / rgyud kyi don gsal bar byed pa rab gnas don gsal mdzad cing / chos rje sa paṇa yan gyi bla ma rnams 'di nyid kyi steng nas rab gnas mdzad pa sha stag byung la/ bla ma chen po 'phags pas hor yul du rab gnas mang po mdzad/

yig cha yang yu gur gyi bandhe sam̐ gha mi tras bskul ba'i ngor don gsal gyi rab gnas bsdus pa de gzhir bzhag pa la/ mnga' dbul gyi cho ga cung zad yod pa'i rab gnas nyin gcig ma'i cho ga sam̐ gha ma zhes bya ba mdzad/ bla chen de'i slob ma spro lung pa kun dga' smon lam gyis don gsal gyi gong 'og rnams kyang ci rigs par bsnol ngo bo saṃ gha ma gzhir bzhag pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga mthong ba don yod ces bya ba mdzad la/ gzhan yang de dag gi rjes su bu ston rin po ches yo ga la brten pa'i rab gnas bkra shis rab rgyas dang / dus 'khor gyi rab gnas sa dhu pu tra'i gzhung la brten nas bkra shis dpal 'bar zhes bya ba gnyis mdzad/ cho ga de ni lo chen gyi sdom tshig la brten kyang dbang bskur ba sogs slob dpon a bha ya'i lugs de gzhir bzhag pas sdom tshig gi go rim yang dkrugs pa/ gang la ser sna sogs kyi dod du stong chen rab 'joms dang / rma bya chen mo sogs nas 'byung ba'i tshigs bcad rnams bcug pa dang / oṃ badzra a yu ṣe swāhā/ sems can thams cad shes pa bcu dang ldan par gyur cig ces pa la/ slob dpon padma lcags kyus de nyid tshigs bcad du byas pa de blangs te gnyis ka byas pa/ cho ga'i dngos gzhi dang yan lag thams cad kyi skabs su mi 'dra ba mang du byas pa zhig yod par bshad do/ /de'i rjes su brag nag pa dpal ldan legs dbang bya bas rab gnas don gsal rgyas su btang / bu ston rin po che'i de gnyis po bsdus su btang ba lta bu'i rab gnas kyi cho ga tshogs gnyis chu rgyun zhes bya ba mdzad la/ khyad par sa lugs la rtsa ba lta bu rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi don gsal dang / de'i dgongs 'grel ngor lugs la rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gsang ba 'dus pa la brten pa'i rab gnas bkra shis rgya mtsho zhes bya ba dang / kun mkhyen chen po'i kyai rdo rje la brten pa'i rab gnas dge legs rgya mtsho dang /

phyis su ngor mkhan po dkon mchog dpal ldan pas rab gnas kyi cho ga dpal 'byor rgya mtsho zhes bya ba sogs pa cho ga'i rigs mang po dang / ngor chen gyi gsung la rjes 'jug gis zin bris byas pa'i rab gnas kyi rnam bshad 'ga' re mthong la/ rdzongs lugs la yang sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal bas mdzad pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga nges par dge legs 'byung ba'i phreng mdzes zhes bya ba la sogs pa mang du yod par snang ngo / /de lta bu'i rab gnas gsung rab gong ma dag dang mi 'gal zhing don gsal gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dgongs pa ltar sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rab gnas dngos grub 'byung ba zhes bya ba mdzad de/ 'di ni cho ga rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum kun tshang zhing / yi dam gang la sbyar yang nyams su len bde bas blo dman pa dag gis ches rtogs sla ba/ rab gnas kyi rgyud dang rgya gzhung tshad ldan thams cad mthun zhing / khyad par rje btsun chen po'i don gsal gyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par 'grel pas na mkhas pa dag la yang legs par bshad pa'i dga' ston du 'os pa zhig go /gnyis pa skabs su babs pa'i don dngos la 'jug pa ni/ de ltar rgya bod du rab gnas kyi cho ga'i rnam gzhag mang du byung ba rnams kyi nang nas 'dir sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i rab gnas dngos grub 'byung ba nyid kyi tshig don rnams zhib tu bshad par bya ste/ rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir na/ spyir rgya bod kyi mkhas grub dag gis mdzad pa'i brtag gnyis la gtso bor brten pa'i rab gnas dang / gsang 'dus la gtso bor brten pa'i rab gnas rnams kyang rnam par dag pa yin mod/ 'on kyang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyis rab tu gnas pa ston pa'i rgyud zur pa zhig gsungs pa yin pas na de'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin bshad pa'i cho ga dag ni ches khyad par du 'phags par shes dgos pa las/

gong ma de dag ni rgyud 'di la gtso bor brten pa'i cho ga ma yin la/ rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i don gsal 'di ni rab gnas nyid kyi rgyud la gtso bor brten nas mdzad pa'i phyir na gzhan thams cad las 'di khyad par du 'phags pas so/ /de bas na 'di nyid kyi dgongs don gtan la 'bebs par 'dod pas/ sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i dngos grub 'byung ba 'di nyid zhib tu bstan na don gsal gyi dgongs don ma lus ma shes par 'gyur zhing dpyod ldan dag gis phyin ci ma log par khong du chud par yang 'gyur ba'i phyir na gzhung 'di 'chad 'os par grub pa yin no/ /des na 'di 'chad pa la yang bstan bcos 'di'i mchod brjod dang / rtsom par dam bca' sogs klad don/ mdzad byang sogs mjug don rnams ni go sla bas bshad mi dgos mod/ 'on kyang rtsom pa po de nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang gnyis su med pas/ de'i gsung tshig 'bru gcig tsam thos pa la yang phan yon dpag tu med na tshig don zhib tu bshad na lta smos kyang ci dgos pas/ de lta bu'i phan yon rang rgyud la 'byung ba dang / blo gsal don gnyer can brgya lam na re re tsam 'byung ba dag la phan par bsam ste bri ba la gsum ste/ rtsom pa la 'jug pa'i yan lag klad don bshad pa/ rtsom par bya ba gzhung don dngos bshad pa/ rtsom pa mthar phyin pa mjug don bshad pa'o/ /dang po la phyag 'tshal ba/ rtsom par dam bca' ba/ tshul ji ltar du rtsom pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ gzhung don 'di nyid las/ oṃ swa sti sidhaṃ/ na mo gu ru zhes pa nas/ phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i bar te/ de yang oṃ ni mchog dang bkra shis pa sogs don mang po zhig la sbyar nas bshad du rung yang 'dir ni mgo 'dren pa yin la/ swa sti sidhaṃ zhes pa ni dge legs su gyur cig na mo ni phyag 'tshal ba/ gu ru ni bla ma/ ā nanda ni kun dga'/ pu ṇya bsod nams/ ya ni gong ma dag dang 'brel bas la la 'jug pa yin la/

des na phyag 'tshal lo bla ma kun dga' bsod nams la zhes pa'i don no/ /'o na bla ma kho na la phyag 'tshal zhe na/ yi dam lha dang bla ma gnyis po tha mal pa'i blo ngor tha dad du snang yang / don la de gnyis kyi ngo bor dbyer med yin pas/ de bas 'dir yang bshad ma thag pa'i bla ma de nyid gdul bya'i snang ngor byang sems chen po'i tshul bzung yang nges don du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi mnga' bdag tu gnas pa'i lhag pa'i lha 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' ste/ mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang dbyer mi phyed pa'am/ dbyer med la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i don yin la/ gnyis pa rtsom par dam bca' ba ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ don dam mi 'gyur spros pa kun bral yang / /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis te/ de yang cung zad phye ste bshad na/ rab gnas cho ga bri/ /zhes pa gzhir bzung nas/ 'o na don dam par chos thams cad 'gyur med dam spros bral yin pas rab gnas byas kyang bzang bar mi 'gyur/ ma byas kyang ngan par mi 'gyur bas rab gnas kyi cho ga yang rtsom mi dgos snyam na/ don dam par de ltar yin yang kun rdzob tu sgyu ma mkhan gyis 'phrul 'khor sna tshogs pa sprul pa dang 'dra bar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de nyid kyis sku gsung thugs kyi sku brnyan te rten rnams bzhengs dgos par gsungs shing ji ltar bzhengs pa'i tshul yang rgyal ba nyid kyis legs par gsungs pa dang / phyag tshad kyang de nyid kyis gsungs pa dang mthun pa ji lta ba bzhin du bzhengs pa yongs su rdzogs pa grub pa de dag la rab gnas cho ga bya bar sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa bzhin byas na bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa dang 'gro ba sems can la dge legs 'phel zhing mchog gi dngos grub dang thun mong gi dngos grub kyang stsol bas na/ de lta bu ji ltar bya ba'i tshul rdo rje slob dpon mkhas rmongs mang po dag gis bde blag tu rtogs pa'i phyir rab gnas kyi cho ga dngos grub 'byung ba 'di bri bar bya ba yin no zhes pa'i don yin la/

'di ni don gsal las/ des na don dam par rab tu gnas pa bya mi dgos kyang / kun rdzob tu sems can gyi don rgya chen po bya ba'i phyir rab tu gnas par bya'o/ /zhes pa dang / rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ sangs rgyas kun la rab tu bzhugs/ /rab tu gnas pa gang yang med/ /kun tu mkha' ltar gnas pa la/ /cig shos kyis ni rab tu brtag /'jig rten kun rdzob la brten nas/ /rab tu gnas pa rab tu brtag /dam pa'i don du dpyad pas na/ /gang zhig gang gis rab tu brlabs/ /gzod ma nas zhi skye med la/ /ci 'dras ci ltar rab tu gnas/ /dang po'i las can sems can rnams/ /rtog pa'i rgyu ru mdzad par zad/ /ces gsungs pa'i don dang mthun pa yin no/ /gsum pa tshul ji ltar du brtsams pa ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ 'dir rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga zhes pa nas/ kyai rdo rje'i cho ga dang sbyar nas bshad par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i bar te/ de yang 'o na rab gnas kyi cho ga rtsom na rang blos sbyar ba lta bu'am/ tshad ldan gyi gzhung gzhan la brten nas brtsam zhes na/ 'dir gang brtsam par bya ba'i rab gnas kyi cho ga 'di ni rang dgar brtsams pa ma yin te/ 'di ni rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i rab gnas don gsal nas ji skad bshad pa bzhin la der mi gsal ba blo dman dag gis rtogs dka' ba rnams sa lo chen po'i gsung rgyun khyad par can dag gsal byed du byas shing / de nyid kyis rab gnas mdzad pa'i skabs kyi phyag len rnam par dag pa rnams kyis kyang legs par brgyan te brtsams pas so/ /tshul de nyid bde kyai gsang gsum kun rig sogs gang la sbyar kyang rung ba bzhin 'dir kyai rdo rje dang sbyar te/ thog mar bshad nas de'i zhar la kun rig la rten pa'i nyin gang ma'i cho ga byed tshul kyang 'chad par 'gyur bas skal ldan blo gsal dag nyan par rigs so zhes pa'i don te de dag ni slad don cung zad bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa gzhung don dngos ni/

gzhung 'di nyid las/ de la rten gyi bya ba yongs rdzogs nas/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid gnas dang dus/ /yo byad yongs su tshang nas ni/ /cho ga dag la 'jug par bya/ /zhes dngos bstan drug las ma gsungs kyang / rje btsun rin po ches de ltar rab tu gnas pa byas pa'i dgos pa ste bdun du gsungs pa ltar/ dang po gang la rab tu gnas par bya ba'i rten yongs su dag pa bzang po ni zhes gsungs pa bzhin spyi don bdun te/ gang rab tu gnas par bya ba'i rten gyi bya ba/ gang gis rab tu gnas par byed pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid/ gang du rab tu gnas par bya ba'i gnas/ nam rab tu gnas par bya ba'i dus/ gang la brten nas rab tu gnas par bya ba'i yo byad/ tshul ji ltar rab tu gnas par bya ba'i cho ga'i rnam gzhag de ltar rab tu gnas par byas pa'i dgos pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po la spyir rten gyi dbye ba dang so so'i ngos 'dzin bstan pa/ de dag 'jig rten gyi khams su thog mar ji ltar byon pa'i tshul/ rjes su dad ldan dag rten bzhengs ji ltar bya ba'i tshul/ de ltar legs par bzhengs pa'i phan yon bstan pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten lugs ma dang / sman sku dang / bris sku dang / tsha tsha dang / gtsug lag khang la sogs pa bzo'i bya ba rnams tshad dang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa mthar phyin par rdzogs par bya/ rgyas par ni don gsal du blta'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ don gsal las/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang / chos dang dge 'dun gyi rten ci ltar bya ba'i cho ga dang / zhes sogs gsungs pas na/ sangs rgyas kyi rten/ chos kyi rten/ dge 'dun gyi rten te dkon mchog gsum gyi rten gsum mam/ yang / sku'i rten/ gsung gi rten/ thugs kyi rten dang gsum du yang dbye bar bshad pa las/ thog mar sangs rgyas kyi rten la/ chos sku'i rten/ longs sku'i rten/ sprul sku'i rten gsum gyi/

dang po ni mchod rten rnams te/ mchod rten la yang rang bzhin lhun grub kyi mchod rten/ bla na med pa'i mchod rten/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod rten/ dngos grub 'byung gnas kyi mchod rten/ theg pa so so'i mchod rten dang rnam grangs lnga tsam zhig bshad pa'i/ dang po ni/ lung mchog bla ma las/ gling gzhi rgyas pa'i rmang btings nas/ /ri brgyad dag gis bang rim brtsigs/ /shing chen bum pas yongs mdzes pa/ /ston pa'i sku gdung 'byung ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gling bzhi rmang dang / gser gyi ri bdun ri rab dang bcas pa bang rim/ yongs 'du'i ljon shing bum pa ste de dag 'dus pa la phyi snod kyi mchod rten du bshad pa dang / yang lung de nyid las/ kun gzhi khyab gdal rmang chen la/ /rnam shes brgyad kyis ka ba btsugs/ /rig pa phyi yi bang rim lnga/ /bdag nyid che yid bum pa dril/ /rang bzhin g.yo ba'i sku gdung yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ kun gzhi rmang dang / rnam shes tshogs brgyad ka ba/ dbang po lnga bang rim/ gtso sems yid kyi rnam shes bum pa ste de rnams bsdoms pa la nang bcud kyi mchod rten du gsungs pa dang / yang rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud las/ 'dod khams sa yi ri bo la/ /gzugs khams bang rim khri 'phang can/ /gzugs med bum gdan bum par bcas/ /sku gdung chen po rgyun du gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'dod khams rmang dang / gzugs khams gnas rigs ma bcu bdun bang rim/ gzugs med khams bum pa ste de gsum bsdoms pa la mchod rten du bshad pa dang / de dang phal cher mtshungs pa a smri tis de kho na drug pa zhes bya ba las/ sa yi khri 'phang zur bcu gnyis/ /gling gzhi gling phran brgyad yin no/ /bang rim bdun du brtsegs pa ni/ /gser gyi ri bdun shes par bya/ /dril bu dbyibs kyi bum pa ni/ /lha gnas ri rab zhes bya ba/ /bum rten 'khor lo gdu bu'i dbyibs/ /klu yi rgyal po nor rgyas yin/

/kha khyer rim pa drug ldan pa/ /'dod khams lha rigs drug tu grags/ /dbus su srog shing yar bsgrengs pa/ /chos nyid zag med spros bral yin/ /'khor lo bcu bdun gyis brgyan pa/ /gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun brtag /char khebs gzugs med khams yin te/ /chos dbyings tog tu shes par bya/ /zhes snod bcud gnyis ka tshogs pa mchod rten du gsungs pa sogs ni rang bzhin lhun grub kyi mchod rten du yongs su grags pa yin la/ gnyis pa bla na med pa'i mchod rten ni/ thig le dbang gi rgyud las/ tshad med bsam yas las byung 'bras/ /shar du byams pa rdo rje brtsegs/ /lho ru snying rje rin chen brtsegs/ /nub tu dga' ba padma brtsegs/ /byang du btang snyoms rgya ram brtsegs/ /rang byung re re snang ba 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shar lus 'phags gling na byams pa tshad med pa'i ngo bo rdo rje du ma brtsegs pa'i mchod rten dang / lho gling na snying rje tshad med pa'i ngo bo rin chen du ma brtsegs pa'i mchod rten dang / nub gling na dga' ba tshad med pa'i ngo bo padma du ma brtsegs pa'i mchod rten/ byang phyogs kyi gling sgra mi snyan na btang snyoms tshad med pa'i ngo bo rgya ram du ma brtsegs pa'i mchod rten dang bzhi yod par bshad pa rnams so/ /gsum pa byin gyis brlab pa'i mchod rten ni/ 'khor lo 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ byin rlabs sku gdung cha brgyad gling bzhir snang / /zhes pa'i 'grel par/ shar lus 'phags gling na byams ldan bsod nams gter gyi mchod rten dang / mthar legs g.yung drung rtog pa'i mchod rten gnyis/ lho 'dzam bu gling na thugs rje'i sprul pa'i mchod rten dang / yid bzhin lhun grub kyi mchod rten gnyis/ nub ba glang spyod na dpe med bsam 'das kyi mchod rten dang / smad grags chos kyi dbyings kyi mchod rten gnyis/ byang sgra mi snyan na yon tan rin chen brtsegs dang /

khams gsum bde rgyas sgron ma'i mchod rten gnyis te/ brgyad bzhugs par bshad pa rnams so/ /bzhi pa dngos grub 'byung gnas kyi mchod rten ni/ bdud rtsi mchog gi rgyud las/ ro yi srung ma chen po ni/ /ma mo chen mo brgyad bzhag go /de dag rten gnas chen mo yang / /mchod rten brgyad du rnam par bzhag /ces pa'i 'grel par bshad pa ltar/ ma ga dhar bde byed/ siṅga lar ri bo ta la/ bal yul du bya khri kha shor/ saing gling du gi hu dho shan/ li yul du ga ma la gandha/ kha cher ka na ka za hor du bde spyod gzhon nu'i mchod rten te sngon he ru kas drag po btul pa'i tshe yul brgyad kyi dur khrod du ma mo brgyad kyi rten dngos grub 'byung ba'i gnas kyi mchod rten brgyad byung ba rnams so/ /lnga pa theg pa so so'i mchod rten la/ nyan thos kyi mchod rten/ rang rgyal gyi mchod rten/ theg chen gyi mchod rten dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ chos gos bzhi bltabs kyi steng lhung bzed kha sbubs pa la 'khar gsil btsugs pa lta bu'o/ /rang rgyal mchod rten ni/ rmang gru bzhi pa/ dngos gzhi zlum po bang rim bcu gnyis pa 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa can no/ /theg pa chen po'i mchod rten ni/ dkyil 'khor chen po bkod pa'i rgyud la brten nas dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i mchod rten gyi rtog pa las/ thub pa'i mchod rten lhung bzed kha phub pa lta bu zhes dbyibs zlum po'i mchod rten dang / khang bu lta bu zhes dbyibs gru bzhi pa dang / rgyal mtshan ltar grags pa zhes dbyibs rgyal mtshan lta bu'i mchod rten dang rnam grangs gsum du bshad la/ 'dul ba lung las ni/ 'khor lo la gdugs dang / gdugs la char khebs kyi ming mdzad nas/ rang rgyal gyi mchod rten gdugs bcu gsum pa char khebs med pa/ nyan thos kyi mchod rten ni/ 'bras bu'i grangs las gdugs kyi grangs re res lhag pa char khebs med pa dang /

so so skye bo'i mchod rten ni/ byi bo ste gdugs med par bum pa'i steng du bre tsam zhig yod pa de nyid la bshad cing / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten la gdugs bcu gsum char khebs dang bcas pa sogs rnam pa kun tshang bar gsungs la/ sgra pa shes rin pas rig gnas kun shes su/ thugs kyi rten ni mchod rten zhes bya ba/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la rnam kun yongs rdzogs te/ /shāka thub mchod rten brgyad du grags pa'o/ /rang sangs rgyas la char khebs med pa dang / /nyan thos 'bras bu bzhi la 'bras bu'i grangs/ /so so'i gdugs kyi rim pa bya ba dang / /so skye la ni byi bo zhes bya ba/ /gdugs med bum pa'i steng du bre ldan te/ /zhes gsungs/ tshwa rong pa bsod nams 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i rten gsum bzhengs tshul yon tan 'byung gnas su rang rgyal gyi mchod rten la gdugs bcu gsum dang / nyan thos mchod rten la 'bras bu bzhi'i grangs las gdugs kyi grangs re res lhag par bshad pas/ nyan thos kyi 'bras bu la rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu/ phyir 'ong gi 'bras bu/ phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu/ dgra bcom gyi 'bras bu bzhir 'byung ba de dag gis mtshon pa'i 'bras bu'i grangs kyi steng du re re lhag pa bsnan pas gdugs kyi rim pa 'byung la/ sgra pa shes rab rin chen gyi rig gnas kun shes sngar drangs pa de nyid ltar rten gsum bzhengs tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtshor yang nyan thos mchod rten la 'bras bu'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i gdugs kyi rim pa yod par bshad pas tshwa rong pa dang cung zad ma mthun zhing / rang rgyal la dpal 'byor rgya mtshor gdugs bdun du bshad nas/ rig gnas kun shes su/ rang sangs rgyas la char khebs med pa dang / /zhes char khebs med pa'i don dngos su bstan nas/ gdugs kyi grangs dngos su mi gsal yang / rdzogs sangs rgyas la rnam kun yongs te/ /zhes gsungs pa des rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten la gdugs bcu gsum du bstan pa/

des 'phros su tshig snga ma de byung bas de nyid kyis rang sangs rgyas la char khebs med pa ma gtogs gdugs sangs rgyas kyi de dang 'dra bar gsungs pa 'dra ba zhig byung bas/ de ltar na stag tshang lo tsā ba nyid kyi gsung gnyis cung zad 'gal bar yang snang bas gong du bkod pa'i tshwa rong pa'i dgongs pa ltar tshad mar bya'o/ /gzhan yang rgyud sde bzhi las kyang so so'i lugs kyi mchod rten gyi rnam grangs yod par bshad pa ni/ bya spyod kyi mchod rten la/ bang rim nang du bcag pa dang / phyir gyad pa/ dbus ma 'bur ba la mtha' gnyis nang du rub pa/ 'khor lo bcu gnyis pa can gsungs pa dang / yo ga'i mchod rten sngar bshad pa'i rdo brtsegs pa la sogs pa dang / bla med kyi mchod rten dus kyi 'khor lo nas 'byung ba'i bdud 'dul la sogs pa rnams so/ /de ltar mchod rten la grub mtha' so so'i bzhed tshul mang yang / theg pa chen po'i lugs gtso zhing / der yang so skye nyan rang sangs rgyas sogs gang zag so so'i mchod rten so sor bshad kyang / spyir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten nyid khyad par 'phags la/ de la yang lhung bzed ltar yongs su grags pa dang / khang bu ltar yongs su grags pa dang / rgyal mtshan ltar yongs su grags pa gsum du yod par 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa ltar rje btsun rin po che'i don gsal las bshad pa'i snga mas ni chos kyi sku mtshan ma'i spros pa thams cad dang bral bar mtshon la/ gnyis pas ni chos kyi sku yon tan thams cad rdzogs shing mnyam pa nyid mtshon zhing / gsum pa 'di'i mtshon tshul rgyas par 'byung ste/ de yang las kyi mtha' brjod pa'i mdo las/ sprul pa mdzad pa mngon bstan phyir/ /mchod rten brgyad du sku gdung bzhag /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad du grags pa rnams te/ 'di dag thams cad kyi gdan khri ni/ gru bzhi'am zlum po'am/ padma'am/

zla ba la sogs pa ci ltar mdzes pa bzhin bya ba las gcig tu ma nges la/ 'on kyang mchod rten ni dngos gzhi gru bzhi la gdan khri'ang gru bzhi/ dngos gzhi zlum po la gdan khri'ang zlum por byas na dbyibs mthun zhing mdzes par 'byung zhing / de'i steng du pad gdan/ de'i steng du ri rab ces kyang grags/ seng khri zhes kyang bya/ mchod rten gyi mtsho zhes su yang grags pa'i dbyibs gru bzhi pa byas pa dang / de med par gdan khri'i steng du bang rim yan chad dam/ bum gdan yan chad bzhugs pa'i mchod rten yang bzhed do/ /bum pa yan chad nas phal cher mthun zhing / cung zad mi mthun pa yod pa dag dang / bang rim gyi khyad par rnams ni brgyad po so so'i skabs su 'chad cing de dag gi mtshon byed mi 'dra ba dag kyang so so'i skabs su 'byung la/ des na brgyad po'i thun mong du mtshon byed ni/ gdan nam rmang gi dge ba bcu mtshon/ bang rim grangs ci rigs su yod pa rnams kyi/ dang po ni dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ gnyis pa yang dag par spong ba bzhi/ gsum pa rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ bzhi pa dbang po lnga/ bum gdan 'gur chu ni stobs lnga/ bum pa ni byang chub kyi yan lag bdun/ pu shu ste bre ni 'phags lam yan lag brgyad/ srog shing ni shes pa bcu/ 'khor lo brtsegs pa'i dang po bcu ni stobs bcu/ lhag ma gsum ni dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gsum/ char khebs ni thugs rje chen po/ tog ni chos sku'i rang bzhin mtshon byed yin par don gsal las bshad la/ mtshon byed de lta bu dang ldan zhing 'o skol gyi ston pa 'di'i mdzad pa khyad par can bstan pa'i yul ljongs de dang de'i skye bo spro ba skyes te dus ston bya ba'i phyir du bzhengs pa bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad ni shāka thub mchod rten brgyad du grags pa las/ dang po ni/ gnas grong khyer ser skyar dus ston pa sku bltams pa'i tshe byung ba/

dbyibs kyi khyad par gzhan rnams gong du bshad pa ltar la zlum po padma'i 'dab ma can gyi bang rim bzhi'am bdun brtsegs pa'o/ /'di la sgra pa shes rin gyi dpal 'byor rgya mtshor/ bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad du grags pa dbyibs bla ma dag zlum po padma'i 'dab ma can gyi bang rim bzhi'am bdun pa bltams pa'i mchod rten nam padma can zhes gsungs pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo la gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa sgo bzhi'am brgyad la sogs pa gsungs kyang / snga ma la bkra shis 'byung ba'i mchod rten du 'phags pas gsungs pas kho bo ni de gnyis zlog par 'dod de/ gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa blo 'bur dang bcas pa sgo rab brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ 'bring nga drug pa/ tha ma bcu drug pa'o/ /zhes gsungs nas sngar bshad pa'i mchod rten de nyid chos 'khor mchod rten nam ye shes mchod rten du ngos bzung / sgo bzhi'am brgyad la sogs pa yod pa'i mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang du grags pa ni bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad kyi dang po bltams pa'i mchod rten zhes bya ba yin par bshad/ de bzhin du sgra pa de nyid kyis bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad la bstod pa zhig mdzad 'dug par yang / thub pa bltams tshe ser skya'i grong khyer du/ /legs sbyangs gru bzhi glo 'bur dang bcas pa/ /bang rim bzhi ldan sgo mang gis spras pa'i/ /bkra shis 'byung ba'i mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa dang / wa ra na sir chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe/ /legs sbyangs gru bzhi glo 'bur dang bcas pa/ /bang rim bzhi ldan sgo mang gis dben pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sku bltams pa'i mchod rten la sgo mang gis spras pa zhes pa dang / chos 'khor mchod rten la sgo mang gis dben pa zhes pa'i tshig gi khyad par yang sbyor bar mdzad la/ don gsal las ni/ bar gyi bang rim thog ma padma brtsegs pa ni/ zlum po padma'i 'dab ma can bzhi'am bdun brtsegs pa'o/

/'di ni ser skya'i grong khyer du bltams pa bstan pa'i mchod rten te/ bde gshegs mchod rten zhes bya ba yin zhes sku bltams pa'i mchod rten la sgo mang ma bshad par/ gsum pa bkra shis sgo mang chos kyi 'khor lo'i mchod rten ni/ phyogs re na sgo bzhi'am brgyad dam/ bcu gnyis sam/ bcu drug yod pa ste bden pa bzhi'am/ rnam par thar pa brgyad dam/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis sam/ stong pa nyid bcu drug ste/ mdor na chos kyi sgo du ma ston pa'i mtshon byed de/ wa ra na sir ye shes kyi mchod rten zhes bya ba yin no zhes bkra shis sgo mang mchod rten bde gshegs mchod rten gsum par gsungs la/ de nyid kyi dgongs pa dang mthun par 'phags pa rin po che'i dngos slob tshwa rong pa bsod nams 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i rten gsum bzhengs tshul yon tan 'byung gnas las kyang 'byung zhing / 'dir yang de nyid ltar bkod pa yin no/ /spyir sgra pa shes rab rin chen gsungs pa ltar 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis bshad yod tshe rje btsun gyi gsung dang klu sgrub kyis gsungs pa gnyis cung zad ma mthun pas dpyad pa'i gzhir snang ba tsam yin mod kyang / 'di dag nyams len gyi gnad 'chos par 'gro ba'i rigs su mi snang bas gang ltar bshad kyang skyon med dam snyam zhing / khyad par rje btsun rin po che 'khrul zad kyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir na de nyid kyi dgongs pa bzhin khas blang bar bya ba yin gyi de las ldog pa ni mi rigs so/ /bde gshegs mchod rten gnyis pa ni/ gnas rgyal po'i khab tu/ dus ston pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshe byung ba dbyibs gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa/ dbu bum thabs su 'dug pa ste 'di la ni byang chub chen po'i mchod rten zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa ni gnas wa ra na sir/ dus ston pas chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe byung ba dbyibs phyogs bzhi na sgo bzhi'am/ brgyad dam/

bcu gnyis sam/ bcu drug tu yod pa'i mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang ngam/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i mchod rten nam/ ye shes kyi mchod rten sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs du ma dang ldan pa'o/ /sgo rnams kyis don gsal las byung ba ltar bden pa bzhi'am/ rnam thar brgyad/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis sam/ stong nyid bcu drug mtshon par byed pa dang / yang sgra pa shes rab rin chen pas bzhed pa ltar sgo brgya la sogs pa yod kyang chos kyi sgo de snyed mtshon byed du sbyar bar bya ba yin no/ /bzhi pa ni gnas mnyan yod mdzes ta'i tshul du/ dus ston pas cho 'phrul bstan pa'i tshe byung ba dbyibs gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa'i ngos bzhi na glo 'bur re yod pa ni cho 'phrul chen po'i mchod rten nam/ mu stegs pham mdzad kyi mchod rten zhes bya ba yin/ lnga pa ni gnas yangs pa can nam/ grong khyer gsal ldan du/ dus ston pas lha yul du dbyar gnas mdzad/ yum la chos gsungs/ snga dro dgag dbye mdzad/ phyi dro nam mkha' las babs nas 'dzam bu'i gling du phebs pa'i tshe byung ba/ dbyibs bang rim bzhi'am brgyad pa/ ngos re na them skas bcu drug la sogs pa yod pa ni/ dpal lha las babs pa'i mchod rten nam/ cho 'phrul chung ngu'i mchod rten zhes kyang grags shing / sum cu'i lha'i mchod rten zhes kyang bya'o/ skas gdong rnams kyis ni bde bar gshegs pa rnams sems can gyi don la 'byon pa mtshon par bshad do/ /drug pa ni gnas rgyal po'i khab tu lhas byin gyis dge 'dun gyi dbyen byas pa nyan thos mchog zung gis bsdums pa'i dus su byung ba dbyibs gru bzhi/ bang rim bzhi pa'i zur bzhi mnyam par bcad pa ste dben sdum mchod rten nam/ 'od zer can gyi mchod rten du yang grags/ byams ngos zhes kyang bya zhing / 'di la logs dang zur mang du yod pas ni bde bar gshegs pa rnams rnam par 'phrul ba du mas don mdzad pa mtshon par gsungs so/

/bdun pa ni gnas yangs pa can du dus ston pas sku tshe zla ba gsum byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe byung ba/ dbyibs zlum po bang rim gsum pa ste rnam rgyal mchod rten nam/ byin brlabs mchod rten zhes bya la/ bang rim gsum gyis ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum mtshon pa yin no/ /bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad pa ni gnas grong khyer rtswa mchog tu/ dus ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa'i tshe byung ba/ dbyibs bang rim med pa gdan khri gang yang rung ba'i steng du bum gdan yan chad bzhugs pa ste/ chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi mchod rten nam/ myang 'das mchod rten zhes grags pa'o/ /bang rim med pa ni spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba mtshon byed do/ /'di dag la phye na ston pa'i sku gdung cha brgyad du bgos pa'i mchod rten brgyad/ ras tshig pa bzhugs su gsol ba'i mchod rten/ ma tshig pa'i mchod rten/ sol ba'i mchod rten te bcu gcig lha rnams kyis ston pa'i mche ba khyer nas bzhengs pa'i mchod rten dang / srin po gnyis kyis mche ba brkus te bzhengs pa'i mchod rten/ chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis 'dzam bu'i gling du de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel bzhugs pa'i mchod rten bya ba bzhengs pa sogs dang / mya ngan las ma 'das gong du yang dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten sogs dpag tu med pa byung ba rnams kyang brgyad po ci rigs par 'du zhing / deng sang gi gnas skabs su yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel bzhugs pa ni gang zag su'i ched du bzhengs kyang brgyad po gang rung gi rnam pa can mtshan nyid kyi rnam pa thams cad tshang ba can bya dgos par bshad pa yin no/ /gnyis pa longs sku'i rten la/ rang bzhin lhun grub snod bcud thams cad lha dang gzhal yas khang du bshad pa la sogs sngar mchod rten gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar 'di dag la yang shes par bya ba yin yang de'i tshul gsang sngags bla med nas 'byung ba'i gsang chen yin pas gsal bar 'chad mi rigs so/

/de las gzhan pa'i longs sku'i rten thun mong ba rnal 'byor rgyud man chad la grags pa'i rgyal ba rigs lnga dang / rigs gsum mgon po la sogs pa dbu skra lcang lo can dang / rgyan du mas brgyan pa mtshan dpe 'bar ba zhi ba dang sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ rab tu mdzes shing dang ba 'dren pa/ byang chub sems dpa' du mas bskor ba dag dang / thun mong ma yin pa gsang sngags brda'i sku la sogs pa rnams so/ /gsum pa sprul sku'i rten ni/ sprul pa'i sku la mchog dang mchog ma yin pa gnyis la sogs pa mang du yod pas de'i rten yang de snyed du yod pa las/ mchog ni 'khor lo bde mchog dang / kyai rdo rje la sogs pa'i 'bras bu'i he ru ka rnams la bshad pas de dag gi sku brnyan dag ni sprul sku mchog gi rten dang / sprul sku yongs grags rab byung gi cha byad can ni mchog ma yin pa'i sprul pa'i skur gsungs pas de'i rten ni/ dbu reg zhabs rjen gtsug tor dang ldan pa/ zhi zhing dul la mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba na bza' chos gos gsum pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung dang / sku mdog ser po gtso che ba dang / sngon po dang dmar po sogs kyang yod par bshad cing / zhabs bzhugs pa la/ phyag g.yon mnyam bzhag g.yas sa gnon dang / mchog sbyin/ skyabs sbyin/ chos 'chad sogs dang / zhabs bzhengs stabs la g.yon chos gos kyi grwa 'dzin zhing / g.yas mchog sbyin dang skyabs sbyin gang rung dang / glang po chen po nor skyong 'dul ba dang / byin len gyi phyag rgya can la sogs pa dpag tu med pa 'byung ba dag dang / de dag las gzhan pa'i sprul pa'i sku sman bla la sogs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sprul pa'i sku'i rnam pa can gyi sprul sku'i rten yang mang du bshad do/ /yang sku gzugs la yul phyogs kyi rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na/ rgya gar gyi lha rigs/ bod kyi lha rigs/ hor gyi lha rigs/

rgya nag gi lha rigs dang bzhi'o/ /hor la stod hor dang smad hor gnyis/ rgya nag la gsar rnying gnyis te drug tu yod par bshad de/ sku gzugs brtag thabs kyi yi ge dag las/ rgya gar hor dang rgya nag bzhi/ /zhes pa dang / rigs la rgya gar stod hor hor dang bod/ /rgya nag gsar rnying rnam pa drug tu 'dod/ /ces 'byung ba ltar/ rgya gar ma la dbus kyi lha rigs dang / shar phyogs/ lho phyogs/ nub phyogs/ bye brag pa'i lha rigs dang lnga yod pa yin te/ sku gzugs brtag thabs kyi yi ge 'ga' zhig las/ rgya gar lha la dbus dang shar lho nub/ /bye brag pa dang rnam pa lnga ru 'dod/ /ces 'byung ba ltar yin la/ yang rgya gar ma la sngar gyi dang po bzhi'i steng du byang phyogs kyi lha rigs dang lngar yang bshad de/ brtag thabs kha cigalas/ rgya gar dbus 'gyur tshal dang shar dang lho/ /nub dang byang phyogs bal yul lha bzo'i khyun/ /zhes pa dang / rgya gar la yang dbus 'gyur shar nub dang / /lho byang re re spyi dang bye brag dbye/ /ces 'byung ba ltar ro/ /bod kyi lha rigs la chos rgyal li ma thog mtha' bar gsum dang / bod rnying gi rigs dang bzhi yod de/ brtag thabs dag las/ gangs can ljongs 'dir 'phags yul bzos byas pa'i/ /chos li thog mtha' bar dang bod rnying dang / /zhes pa dang / bod la chos rgyal li ma snga phyi gsum/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar ro/ /hor gyi lha rigs la/ gong du bstan pa bzhin/ stod hor li ma dang / hor gyi lha rigs gnyis dang / yang na stod hor/ yu gur/ kha sha smad hor gyi lha rigs dang bzhi yang bshad de/ brtag thabs dag las/ hor la stod hor yu gur kha sha dang / /smad hor rnam pa bzhir dbye/ zhes 'byung ba ltar ro/ /rgya nag lha rigs la/ rgya nag rnying ma dang / gsar ma gnyis su yod de/ brtag thabs dag las/ rgya nag la yang gsar rnying dbye ba'i tshogs/ /zhes pa dang / rgya nag rnying ma dang ni gsar ma gnyis/ /zhes pa ltar ro/

/rgya nag gsar ma 'di la/ thugs dam ma dang sku rim ma gnyis su yod de/ brtag thabs las/ rgya nag gsar ma'i lha la thugs dam ma/ /sku rim ma gnyis snga ma cung zad legs/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de lta bu'i sku gzugs rnams kyi rgyu ni gtso cher li las grub pa shas che zhing / li'i rigs la yang / rgya gar gyi li/ bstod hor gyi li/ yu gur gyi/ bod kyi/ rgya nag rnying ma'i/ hor gyi li dang bdun du 'byung ste/ brtag thabs las/ rgyu la rgya gar stod hor yu gur bod/ /rgya nag rnying ma hor dang rgya nag bdun/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /rgya gar gyi li la yang / li khra dang / li dkar dang / li dmar gsum du yod par bshad cing / li khra ni dzhai kṣim mchog la ngos 'dzin la/ li dkar ni dkar po shin tu dwangs pa cung zad ser nyams yod pa'i li dang / li dmar ni dmar po shin tu dwangs pa cung zad ser nyams yod pa'i li dag yin te/ brtag thabs dag las/ dang po rgya gar yul du li khra dang / /li dkar li dmar gsum du dbye ba las/ /li khra rin chen sna tshogs 'dus pa ste/ /ngo bo li dmar rtsod med las cung dkar/ /legs par brtags na 'ja' 'od lta bu yod/ /'di la dzhai kṣim mchog tu bshad pa yin/ /lha sa'i jo bo rin chen sku rgyu bzhin/ /li dkar dkar dwangs cung zad ser nyams yod/ /li dmar dmar dwangs cung zad ser nyams yod/ /ces pa ltar dang / phyi ma drug po yang ngos 'dzin rim pa ltar/ stod hor li ni khro li cung zad nag /yu gur li ni khro li dkar po ste/ /'di la dngul dkar bsres ma yod par grags/ /bod kyi chos li snga ma rgya gar gyi/ /li dmar rtsod med yin pas gong dang 'dra/ /chos li phyi la zangs bsres yod pa'i phyir/ /snga ma dag las cung zad smug pa yin/ /bod li rnying ma zangs dang gsha' dkar 'dres/ /dwangs shing mdog nag snum bag che ba'o/ /rag sku rnying ma de bas cung zad ser/ /da lta'i ra gan rnams las skya ba ste/

/gser zangs las grub brtag par sla ba yin/ /rgya nag rnying ma phal cher khro li smug /hor gyi lha rnams phal cher khro dkar ram/ /shing las grub pa mang bar mngon sum grub/ /rgya nag lha rnams ljang ser phal che ste/ /rag skya dag las grub pa srid tsam yin no/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar yin no/ sku rgyu thams cad de dag tu nges pa ni ma yin te/ sher shing dang / byang chub kyi shing dang / gzhan yang bsil ba'i tshal gyi rdo brnyan nag po dang / rgya gar ka ma ru'i rdo dkar dang / klu'i 'jim pa sogs las grub pa mang du 'byung bas so/ /de ltar yang brtag thabs dag las/ de ltar lha rigs nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi/ /rgyu la shing dang rdo dang 'jim pa sogs/ /ma nges sna tshogs du ma srid pa yin/ /khyad par ka ma ru yi rdo dkar la/ /yul dbus lha rigs mdzad pa brgyad pa yi/ /gtso bo thub dbang nyid kyi mdzad pa dang / /rdo rje klu yi 'jim pa las grub pa'i/ /gong dang 'dra ba'i mdzad pa brgyad pa dang / /yul dbus lha rigs rje btsun sgrol ma sogs/ /'ga' zhig 'byung ba rgyu la brtag pa med/ /ces pa dang / bsil ba tshal gyi rdo nag las grub pa'i/ /mgon po phyag bzhi pa yi sku yang snang / /zhes pa dang / de yang rgyu khyad dbye ba zangs rnying dang / /lha klu mi yi nor bu sna tshogs pa/ /gcig tu byas pa'i rin chen phung po dang / /dzhai kṣim rang byung bcos bu rnam pa gnyis/ /li rigs dkar dmar ser dang khro li smug /rdo rigs rin chen sna tshogs gar bu dang / /ma na ho dang brdar shel gzi mchong sogs/ /bsil tshal rdo nag ka ma ru yi rdo/ /klu yi 'jim pa dag las byas pa'ang yod/ /shing rigs byang chub shing dang shi ri sha /tsandan sogs dang dri bzang sbrang rtsi'i rkyen/ /sbyar ba'i lde gu las kyis 'byung zhes bya/ /zhes bkod pa ltar yin zhing / dbus 'gyur gyi lha rnams ni dzhai kṣim dang / li dkar dmar/ zangs dmar/ byang chub shing /

rdo ba/ klu 'jim rnams shas che ste/ brtag thabs las/ dbus 'gyur yul du dzhai kṣim li dmar dang / /li dkar zangs dmar byang chub shing dang ni/ /klu 'jim rdo ba dag las bsgrubs pa ste/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de lta bu'i sku gzugs kyi rgyu rnams kyi nang nas dzhai kṣim nyid khyad par du 'phags par bshad cing / dzhai kṣim la yang rang byung gi dzhai kṣim dang / bcos bu'i dzhai kṣim gnyis bshad pa'i snga ma ni chu bo sindhu'i 'gram du gser bzhin du chags pa klu'i rin chen sna bdun po ma lus par 'dus pa'i rin po che'i gong bu gser dmar du grags pa de nyid yin te/ 'di la zhib tu brtags nas bltas na 'ja' 'od snang zhing / dug chu bskus na 'ja' tshon sna lnga gsal por ston pa bshad la/ bcos bu'i dzhai kṣim ni/ gser/ dngul/ zangs/ lcags/ zha nye dkar nag rdo shel/ dngul chu ste brgyad po bzhu btul byas pa de nyid yin pas 'di la dzhai kṣim rjes mthun pa zhes bya zhing / snga ma dang ming tsam mthun pa ma gtogs khyad par shin tu nas che ba yin la/ de ltar yang / brtag thabs las/ dzhai kṣim sindhu'i chu klung dag gi 'gram/ /gser bzhin chags pa ser dmar yin par grags/ /'di la klu yi rin chen sna bdun po/ /ma lus 'dus pa yid bzhin nor bu bzhin/ /kha dog ches dmar zhib brtags 'ja' 'od snang / /dug chus reg na dbang po'i gzhu nyid ston/ /zhes pa dang / chu klung sindhu'i 'gram na rang byung gi /dzhai kṣiṃ byung zhing de nyid bcos bu ni/ /gser dngul zangs lcags zha nye dkar nag dang / /rdo shel dngul chu rnam brgyad bzhu btul gyi/ /las kyi dzhai kṣiṃ rjes mthun nyid yin te/ /'phags pa'i yul na aṣṭa dha tur brjod/ /ces bkod pa ltar ro/ /ka ma ru yi rdo ni kha dog shin tu dkar zhing mkhrig pa zhig 'byung la/ klu 'jim ni dwangs shing khong 'bol ba/ cung zad ser mdangs yod pa yin te/ dkar zhing mkhrig pa ka ma ru yi rdo/

/dwangs shing 'bol ba klu yi 'jim pa yin/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar ro/ /gong du bstan pa'i li dkar dang li dmar ni li yul du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sogs kyis ri bo chen po bzhi lir byin gyis brlabs pa las byung ba yin pas sku rgyu nyid byin rlabs mchog dang ldan pa yin te/ brtag thabs kyi yi ge las/ 'di gnyis li yul ri la thub dbang bzhis/ /byin gyis brlabs pa las byung mchog tu bsngags/ /zhes bkod pa ltar yin no/ /sku rgyu de dag las grub pa'i lha rigs de dag kyang / 'phags yul gyi lha rigs rnams la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sku brnyan gtso bor 'byung la/ gsang sngags yi dam bde kye dus 'khor sogs kyi sku brnyan dang / bla ma'i sku brnyan nyung zhing / rgya gar shar phyogs pa la spungs sku yang 'ga' re 'byung la/ gzhan rnams la spungs sku mi 'byung zhing / rgya hor gnyis la sangs rgyas byang sems/ khro bo khro mo rnams mang ba dang / bla ma'i sku ni shin tu nyung la/ hor sku la chos rgyal mes dbon gyi sku brnyan 'ga' re 'byung zhing / spungs sku ni rgya nag tu dar che bas rgya nag gsar ma'i spungs sku shin tu mang bar 'byung ba yin te/ brtag thabs dag las/ lha yi ngo bo rgya gar 'phags yul du/ /sangs rgyas byang sems sku nyid gtso bor dang / /sngags sku bla ma'i sku yang re re srid/ /rgya gar shar phyogs lha rigs spangs sku'ang snang / /rgya nag gsar rnying hor sogs phal che ba/ /sangs rgyas byang sems khro bo khro mo mang / /bla ma'i sku yang re re srid pa tsam/ /hor du chos rgyal mes dbon sku yang srid/ /rgya nag yul du spungs sku dar bar snang / /zhes 'byung ba bzhin yin no/ /'o na lha rigs de dag la 'dra ba'i khyad par ji ltar yod snyam na/ spyir lha rigs la gong du bstan pa ltar nang gses kyis phye na mang du yod kyang / bsdu na rtsa ba'i dbye ba drug gam lnga'am bzhir yod pa'i/

rgya gar ma la yang lngar yod pa'i nang nas rgya gar lha rigs dang dbus 'gyur gyi lha rigs ni/ sku gzugs kyi brtag thabs dag las/ sku ni gar bu brjid che khri pad dag /ji ltar byung yang shas 'thug lugs gtsang ma/ /sku yi tshugs bzang gtsug tor drang por gsal/ /shangs drang spyan dkyus ring ba utpal 'dab/ /mchu sgros dod cing ma mchu gsal dod pa/ /lkos ko cung zad btegs nyams bzhugs stangs ni/ /mdun bltas gug nyams rgyab bltas drang por gnas/ /sor mo'i tshigs drang ring zhing gzhon sha chags/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i thal gong shin tu rgyas/ /sha tshugs mi sgrib gos 'khyud sul nyung ba/ /mdzes pa rgyas pas mig sngar ngoms pa med/ /khri gdan gru bzhi rdo rjes mtshan pa dang / /yang na pad 'dab khyon yang ldem mo nyid/ /'ga' zhig dpral ba dbyes che spyan 'jug mtho/ /shangs rtser gzigs shing zhal gdong dud pa snyam/ /snyan shal ring 'phyang sha tshugs yid tsam sbom/ /gos 'khyud sul nyung khri gdan shar phyogs dang / /rjes mthun seng ge gyad dang lag ldan gyis/ /btegs pa'i khri'am yang na pa ṭa 'khor/ /khyad chos mchod sbyin gzhu yis spangs gyur pa/ /sa yi lha dang lus med kyis btegs pa'i/ /bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa re re tsam/ /li dkar sku la chos gos zangs rnying gis/ /bgyis pa'i zangs tha ma zhes bod pa dang / /bzo yi rigs shig zhal gdong sgong gzugs dod/ /drang por gzigs stangs mtho tsam sha tshugs mnyen/ /phyag rigs tshangs thig steng du sa mgon dang / /chos 'chad skyabs sbyin mdzad pa la sogs 'byung / /srab 'jam lha yi gos gzugs sul ran pa/ /ci yang 'byung ba shes ldan rig pas dpyad/ /khri dang pad 'dab 'bol gzugs rnams brtsegs pa'i/ /khyad chos gsum ldan zhes pa 'byung ba yin/ /bzhengs sku phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin cig shos kyis/ /chos gos grwa bzung dbugs dbyung ma zhes brjod/ /sor mo gdengs pa yid tsam dpa' snyam pa/

/g.yon pas bla gos sne bzung gshegs pa'i stabs/ /glang po nor skyong 'dul ba'i skur gyur te/ /lhung bzed bzung ba'i bzhengs sku grong bzhud nyid/ /khyel bzhugs chos 'chad 'khor lo'i phyag rgya can/ /bla gos sul med lhub gon gyong snyam la/ /mthing gos srab snyam sha tshugs sgrib min pa/ /gdan khri gru chags 'bur can shas che ba/ /chig pad ze'u 'bru mtho ba re re tsam/ /yang na zla gam bang rim gyis spras shing / /rgyab yol sgor gzugs nor bu pa ṭa dang / /'od zer 'phro ba'i tshul dag bzor rigs can/ /yang na byang chub shing la rgyab brten zhing / /rtse la mtho ba'i tog can gzugs kyis mdzes/ /sna drug rgyan dang ngang pa chu lug dang / /chu srin pa ṭas mtshan pa'i rgyab yol sogs/ /sna tshogs du ma 'byung bas mdzes pa la/ /brtags tshe ngoms pa med pa'i ya mtshan mthong / /zhes pa dang / yang brtag thabs 'ga' zhig las/ yul dbus lha la li khra dkar dmar gnyis/ /ci rigs 'byung zhing sku sha li dkar la/ /na bza' li dmar byas pa ste/ /'di la zangs thang ma zhes 'bod par snang / /lha rigs sku yi tshugs bzang zhal ras mdzes/ /skem bag snyoms shing gtsug tor drang por gnas/ /shangs dkyus mtho zhing gtsang la shangs rtse rno/ /mdzod spu shangs rtser thig btab bzhin du drang / /spyan bar dog cing mchu sgros gtsang ba dang / /na bza' phal cher sha mi sgrib par mang / /gos 'khyud nyung bas sku sha sgrib pa'ang srid/ /khri yod gyad dang seng ge la sogs la/ /rgyan dang bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa 'byung / /gdong gsum la sogs 'ga' re 'byung ba'ang srid/ /pad gdan shas cher pad kha rgyas zhum snyam/ /pad 'dab nyis brtsegs ma pad ya pad 'grigs/ /padmar mu tig che snyam bsgrigs legs pa/ /sgros gtsang mthong bas ngo mtshar skye ba yin/ /zhes pa ltar yin zhing / yang dbus kyi byang chub sems dpa'i sku brnyan rnams ni/ brtag thabs kha cig las/ byang chub sems dpa'i sku rnams tshugs bzang zhing /

/'khyog chung gtsug tor cung zad lhag par nye/ /dbu skra'i lan bu 'phyang zhing zur phud can/ /rin chen gzugs bkod legs la mdzes sdug 'char/ /pad 'dab gyon dang cig shos ldem mo can/ /zla dkyil yangs pa'i steng du 'gying bag ldan/ /rgyal sras sku brnyan che phra ji snyed 'byung / /yul gru dbus las 'byung ba'i khro bo dkon/ /de dag dzhikṣiṃ zangs rnying shas che ba/ /phal cher tsha zer gyis byugs gad brdar legs/ /'ga' zhig zangs rnying mdog tu bzhag pa la/ /legs par phyis tshe kha dog sna tshogs 'char/ /zhes 'byung la/ 'ga' zhig las/ byang sems sku la 'gying bag cung zad yod/ /ral pa'i thor gtsug drang por rgyan gyis spras/ /nor bu gnyis pa'ang re re srid pa tsam/ /zhes 'byung bas thor gtsug ltag par cung zad yo ba dang / drang por yod pa'i bshad tshul cung zad mi 'dra ba gnyis byung bas gang 'thad brtag par bya'o/ /rgya gar gyi lha rigs gnyis pa shar phyogs kyi lha rigs ni/ brtag thabs las/ shar phyogs lha rnams phal cher li dkar te/ /lugs gtsang rgyan gyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs/ /zhal gyi bkod mdzes spyan bar cung zad dog /shangs stod dpang dma' shangs smad cung zad mtho/ /dbus phyogs pa las shangs sgros cung zad brdal/ /skem zhing tshul bzang 'gying bag lhu tshigs ran/ /gos 'khyud sku la 'khril zhing zhib rtsing ran/ /khri sogs dbus kyi lha dang mtshungs pa la/ /pad 'dab nyis brtsegs pad kha cung zad zhum/ /ya pad ma pad 'grigs par nges pa med/ /yas kyi mu tig zhib snyam mas phyogs kyi/ /mu tig rags snyam dbus las cung mi gtsang / /khri gdan gdong gsum rgyab yol yod pa'ang srid/ /li dmar las grub re tsam srid kyang zer/ /dbus 'gyur shar gyi lha rigs khyad par gzhan/ /dbus kyi lha rnams dpral mtshams dbyes che zhing / /sku stod rgyas pa ri dwags rgyal po 'dra/ /zhal dkyus cung ring phyag sor dra bas 'brel/

/shar phyogs lha rnams gtsug tor rgyab tu nye/ /zhes bkod pa ltar yin zhing / yul phyogs de'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku brnyan rnams ni/ brtag thabs las/ yul der bzos pa'i de bzhin gshegs sku rnams/ /tshugs bzang sha rgyud grim zhing gzhon sha chags/ /spyan yangs gzhu yi dbyibs can kho na ste/ /mkhur tshos mtho snyoms shangs drang smin mtshams dog /zur nas bltas na shangs dang spyan bar mtshams/ /cung zad nyag shas che ba 'ba' zhig 'byung / /na bza' sul med sha tshugs mi sgrib pa/ /gtsug tor drang zhing rtse la nor bu'i tog /pad 'dab brtsegs pa sgros gtsang gad brdar legs/ /gser zangs dngul gyi phra yis mdzes pa can/ /mu tig bkod legs blta pas yid 'phrog cing / /yang na khri gdan bang rim gyis bkra ba/ /seng ge glang po rta dang rma bya dang / /shang shang te'u gyad dang klu yis btegs/ /pa ṭa 'khor zhing mu tig phreng bas mdzes/ /'ga' zhig pad sdong steng du bzhugs pa'i tshul/ /zhes pa ltar yin la/ yang shar phyogs kyi sngags sku rnams ni/ brtag thabs las/ sngags sku drang srong khros pa'i rnam 'gyur can/ /bde kyai dus kyi 'khor lo yang phur sogs/ /sha rgyud grims shing tshugs bzang 'khyog 'dod pa/ /shangs rtse rno zhing tshems kyis ma mchu mnan/ /phyag zhabs sgros dod sor mo mnyen zhing bde/ /dbu skra'i thor gtsug lu gu rgyud du bcings/ /'phar mtho rtse la yid bzhin nor bu 'bar/ /phyag rgya lnga yi rgyan spras lta na sdug /rin chen gar bu'i phra ldan re re tsam/ /gdags pa'i rgyan rnams sgros gtsang dngos nyams che/ /bgo ba'i gos rnams mnyen chags lhod nyams ldan/ /byug pa'i rdzas rnams 'bur gsum tshom bu gsal/ /utpal 'dab ma nyis brtsegs 'khor ba'i gdan/ /kha khyer mu tig snyoms legs bkra ba nyid/ /ces 'byung ba ltar yin no/ /yang shar phyogs kyi khro bo'i sku brnyan rnams ni/ brtag thabs las/ gnod sbyin las byung khro chags sha nyams che/

/zhal gdong tsho zhing dkyus thung mig 'bur mtho/ /lhu tshigs rags shing sbom thung sku gel ba/ /skra tshogs bcings pa ltag pa'i phyogs na gnas/ /de yang sgeg cing mdzes pa yid chags pas/ /tshangs sogs mnan pa'i dor stabs dpa' ba nyid/ /smin mtshams khro gnyer bsdus pas mdzes pa 'gog /bdud la khrel bas rgod dang gshe ba'i nyams/ /dud khrod chas kyis brgyan pas 'jigs su rung / /brtags tshe zhi ba'i rjes chags 'gro la brtse/ /gdan pad shar phyogs lha kun rjes su mthun/ /rgyab yol thod ra rdo rjes bskor ba'i rtser/ /me 'od rab tu 'phro ba'i rnam pa dang / /yang na 'od zer pa ṭas khor yug mdzes/ /rdul bral gzugs sku'i brda don rtogs bya'i ched/ /'khyogs dang phyag mtshan mdun steng go brjes pa/ /snying khar bzung ste me long la bltas pas/ /rnyog bral sku 'char 'gying log ces su bshad/ /ces 'byung ba ltar dang / yul phyogs de'i lha rigs byang sems kyi sku brnyan rnams ni/ brtag thabs las/ rgyal sras sku ni 'gying bag 'khyog nyams can/ /sha rgyud grim legs sor mo ring zhing mdzes/ /gzhu spyan sbom snyoms dngul gyis mjug byas pa/ /mchu sgros zangs mas brgyan pas bandhu'i mdangs/ /rang rang phyag mtshan me tog chun po la/ /'dren pa'i rnam 'gyur bkod pa'i khyad par can/ /dbu skra zur phud ldan pa'i thor gtsug ni/ /rgyab nye de mdun rigs bdag sku yis spras/ /bzhugs stangs ngal bso mang ba tsam nyid la/ /skyil krung rol stabs dbye ba sna tshogs 'byung / /prog zhu rin chen 'bar ba'i rnam pa dang / /me tog phreng dang lha yi gos bzang dang / /yug gon tshul dang dngul zangs 'jug gi bkra /rol stabs rnams ni pad sdong gis 'dren pa'i/ /gtso 'khor gsum mam lnga sogs byas pa dang / /bzhengs sku la yang de bzhin 'byung zhes bya/ /zhes pa ltar yin zhing / yul phyogs de'i lha rigs lha mo'i sku brnyan dag ni/

brtag thabs las/ lha mo'i rigs rnams 'khyog legs sha rgyud gtsang / /zhal dkyil zla ba gang ba zlum pa'i dbyibs/ /spyan gyi gzigs stangs snyan gong utpal la/ /zur gyis blta ba sgeg pa'i nyams 'gyur can/ /nu 'bur gling ngam spyi bo ltar mtho zhing / /lte ba'i khung zab sta zur mdzes shing dod/ /phyag zhabs sor mo pad rtsa ltar mnyen ma/ /'dug stangs lhod cing des pa'i ngang tshul can/ /ltag par nye ba'i ral pa'i khur mtho ba/ /der mdun rigs bdag gsal gnas rin po che/ /dbu rgyan me tog gis 'brel phreng ba dang / /'khyud legs rin chen gdu bu phra gzugs can/ /sha tshugs sgrib mi thub pa'i na bza' bgos/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar yin la/ yang rgya gar shar phyogs za hor u ḍi bi sha'i lha rigs ni/ brtag thabs las/ shar phyogs bye brag za hor yul gyi lha/ /li dkar shar phyogs lha rigs gtsang ma la/ /gser dngul zangs kyi go gu sha bzhin bzos/ /dngul zangs spyan 'byed byas dang kha cig la/ /mu tig shel sogs rin chen phang phung spras/ /mchog tu yi gar 'ong pa 'ba' zhig 'byung / /zhes 'byung ba ltar yin no/ /rgya gar gyi lha rigs gsum pa lho phyogs kyi sku gzugs ni/ brtag thabs las/ lho phyogs lha rnams phal cher li dmar te/ /zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkyus thung sog kha can/ /sha nyams lhod cing spyan bar cung zad yangs/ /shangs kyi gzengs dma' dpral mtshams dbyes mi phyed/ /'gying bag bde nyams yod pa re re tsam/ /na bza' sku la 'khril zhing gzong ris med/ /khri pad yangs shing padma'i 'dab ma che/ /chig rkyang pad mgo cung zad zhum pa la/ /kha ser ze'u 'bru gzong ris mdzes pa yod/ /kha sbyar pad rkyang ci rigs yong ba yin/ /tsha gser mdog dmar shin tu 'thug pa la/ /gar bu rgyu bzang li dkar srid pa tsam/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams ni/ brtag thabs las/ khyad par bzo bos las bgyis rgyal ba'i sku/

/rgyu khyad dzhai kṣiṃ zangs rnying shas che ba/ /tshugs drang ya yo med cing yangs pa'i spyan/ /zhal dkyus thung tsam gzigs phyogs mtho ba nyid/ /phyag zhabs ring zhing gyong nyams lhun chags pa/ /na bza' sul can sha rgyud gsal zhing mdzes/ /pad gdan ldem mo khri gdan rgyab yol rnams/ /yul dbus bzo yi 'khyun dang rjes su mthun/ /li rigs dkar ser las grub re re tsam/ /zhes pa ltar dang / rgyal ba rigs lnga ni/ rigs lnga rgyan can dang ni rgyan spangs pa/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar yin la/ yang yul phyogs de'i byang sems kyi sku gzugs dag ni/ brtag thabs las/ byang chub sems dpa' rgyan spras ji snyed pa'i/ /sku rnams 'gying bag chung zhing sku drang ba/ /zhal khyim sgong gzugs cung zad stod rgyas pa/ /gtsug tor rgyab nye prog zhu gsum mam lnga/ /khyon che ha cang mdzes min rtse mo rno/ /sha nyams grim zhing rus tshugs srog snyam pa/ /yug gon mdud pa lhod pa'i rnam pas klub/ /ces pa ltar dang / yul phyogs de'i lha rigs sgrol ma sogs sems ma'i tshogs kyi sku brnyan ni/ brtag thabs las/ sgrol ma la sogs sgong zhal sgeg pa'i nyams/ /zur gyis blta phyogs utpal nas 'dra'i spyan/ /nu 'bur gsal dod sked skabs phra ba nyid/ /sha tshugs sgrib min na bza' gzong ris can/ /dbu rgyan rin chen 'od 'phro'i gzugs can dang / /phyag mtshan utpal sdong bu'i steng gnas pa/ /padma zla ba'i gdan rnams 'dzib mo ste/ /gser dngul phra 'jug lha rigs 'di la min/ /zhes 'byung ba bzhin yin zhing / lho phyogs kyi lha rigs la khro bo'i sku brnyan li las grub pa shin tu nyung zhing / rdo dang shing sogs las brkos su byas pa mang du 'byung ba yin te/ brtag thabs las/ sngags sku khro bo'i rigs rnams lho phyogs bzo/ /li rigs las bgyis nyung zad tsam du rtogs/ /rdo dang shing las brkos byas khro bo'i sku/ /bzhengs sku'i rigs dang mdzad pa brgyad pa sogs/

/byang chub shing la brten pa'i thub sku dang / /khyad par rdo rje gdan gyi bkod pa'i dbyibs/ /na drug rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i gandho la/ /be ta'i yul du bzo byas ji snyed 'byung / /zhes bshad pas so/ /lho phyogs kyi nang gses be ta'i lha rigs ni/ bye brag be ta'i yul gyi lha rigs la/ /gzhan rnams lho phyogs spyi dang 'dra ba la/ /zhal ras sog kha cung zad chung ba tsam/ /na bza'i rgyan la gzong ris byas pa yod/ /gzhan yang zhal khyim lho phyogs lha rigs la/ /cung zad dkyus thung spyan che shangs gong nyag /zhal khung skyong zhing mchu sgros cung zad btsong / /rgyan gtsang dar dpyangs na bza' lhub ma rags/ /phyag zhabs sor mo padma'i sgros mi gtsang / /padma nyis brtsegs ya mar gnyis ka ldan/ /steng gi mu tig med pa shas cher 'byung / /zhes 'byung ba ltar ro/ /rgya gar gyi lha rigs bzhi pa nub phyogs kha che'i yul gyi sku gzugs ni/ brtag pa'i yi ge las/ nub phyogs lha ni kha che'i lha yin te/ /rgyu la li dkar li dmar gnyis ka srid/ /zhal gyi dkyus ring tsho la stod smad chung / /spyan bar dog cing shangs kyi sgang zlum bzang / /zhal mchu'i sgros 'thug dngul lam zangs spyan can/ /'gying bag bde nyams chung zhing lhu tshigs thung / /na bza' sku la 'khril zhing gos 'khyud ring / /rags zhib 'tshams la gtsug tor nor bu nub/ /mu tig thod bcings mu tig do shal dang / /me tog rgyan gyis spras pa'ang srid pa yin/ /padma dbyig mo chig rkyang 'dab ma che/ /pad mgo cung rgyas kha sbyar rkyang pa'ang srid/ /gdan khri la sogs ci rigs yong ba yin/ /zhes pa ltar las/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs rnams ni/ li ma brtag pa'i yi ge las/ kha che'i bye brag ji snyed nub phyogs te/ /yul de'i bzo bos bsgrubs pa'i sku yi rten/ /lugs kyis blugs stabs srab pas ljid chung tsam/ /sku stod rgyas shing thugs kha'i thad mtho ba/

/phrag pa'i thal gong mtshams nas dpung pa'i bar/ /rim gyis smad pa sha rgyud shin tu grims/ /zhal khyim sgong gzugs shangs bzang spyan gyi dbyibs/ /padma'i 'dab 'dra 'bor chags gtsug tor ni/ /byil gzugs tog can snyan shal ring 'phyang ba/ /snyan 'jug sbags 'dra phyag zhabs shin tu mdzes/ /na bza' gos 'khyud sul ran rtsing zhib snyoms/ /rgya mtsho'i rlabs 'dra'i gos kyi sul mang bar/ /bgyis pa 'ga' zhig 'byung zhing khri pad rnams/ /nas 'dra'i pad 'dab khyon yang ldem mo dang / /khri la seng ge glang chen sogs 'byung ba/ /gdong bstan 'degs pa'i nyams dod khri pad mthar/ /kha che'i yi ge'i gzugs dang yang de yi/ /mtshan gyi nges pa gzong ris byas pa 'byung / /zhes pa ltar yin zhing / yul phyogs de'i byang sems kyi sku gzugs dag ni/ sems dpa' rtse rnams 'khyog cing zhal sgo ni/ /stod smad cha mnyam zhal mchu 'thug cing spam/ /shangs dang mkhur tshos mtho snyam mdzes pa'i gdong / /gtsug tor ha cang mtho min nor bus spras/ /me tog phreng dang dbu rgyan utpal 'dab/ /dkyus su bcad pa'i gzugs 'dra rigs bdag mtshan/ /'khor los mdzes pa'i phyag zhabs dra bas 'brel/ /rin chen gdu bu rim pa mang ba can/ /na bza' sul ran rol stabs ngal bso rnams/ /pad 'dab khyon che'i steng na sgeg pa'i nyams/ /g.yas rnams phyag mtshan bzung stabs bde min tsam/ /cig shos pad sdong la brten mang ba nyid/ /de dag gtso 'khor gsum rnams dpag med cing / /klu dang shang shang te'u pa ṭa yis/ /'khor mor pad sdong byas pa'i tshul lta bus/ /btegs pa'i khri dang rgyab yol 'bur chags kyi/ /bzo bkod can dang ldem mo gzong ris can/ /rnam pa gnyis 'byung zhes pa ltar dang / yul phyogs de'i khro bo'i sku brnyan ni/ gzhan yang khro bo'i sku/ sha rgyud grim zhing zhal khyim stod rgyas pa/ /khro gnyer ring ba rtsub nyams shangs dkyus thung / /zhal bgrad mche ba ring zhing mchu 'phyang ba/

/mi mgo'i cod pan dag dang do shal dang / /dur khrod rgyan rnams gad brdar gtsang min pa/ /dbu skra bcings pa'i ngos la gzong ris can/ /chig pad brtsegs par mdun nyid rgyab leb chags/ /ro gdan la sogs gzong ris gting zab pas/ /rtsub nyams che zhing rgyab yol ther mo la/ /chol ston me lces rtse gzugs byas pa 'byung / /zhes 'byung ba ltar yin no/ /rgya gar gyi lha rigs lnga pa bye brag pa'i lha ni/ brtag thabs kyi yi ge 'ga' zhig las/ dbus 'gyur/ shar/ lho/ nub dang bzhi'i lha rigs byings dang mi 'dra ba'i lha la 'jog pa yin te/ bye brag pa zhes pa'i don yang / dbus 'gyur 'chang dang shar lho nub rnams su/ /de de'i yul gyi bzo bos ma bgyis pa'i/ /sku yi tshugs dang zhal gdong na bza'i khyun/ /bzo rigs 'dres pa bye brag lha zhes brjod/ /ces pa ltar/ dbus 'gyur sogs yul de dang der/ yul phyogs gzhan gyi bzo bos bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis lha'i bzo rigs 'dres pa rnams la bshad la/ yang brtag thabs kha cig las/ dbus 'gyur bye brag pa'i sku gzugs ni/ bye brag dbus 'gyur 'chang gi bye brag yul/ /wa ra na si'i yul gyi khyad par ni/ /li dmar dbus kyi lha rigs gtsang ma la/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi srab 'thug ran/ /kha dog mchog tu legs par gsol ba yod/ /ces pa dang / shar phyogs bye brag pa ni/ shar phyogs bye brag bri li bal po'i lha/ /li dkar shar phyogs lha rigs gtsang ma la/ /rgyan gyi khyad par gser dngul zangs gsum spras/ /dngul bzang spyan 'byed spras pa yod pa yin/ /kha cig mu tig do shal spras pa dang / /rin chen phra phung spras pa'ang srid ces zer/ /zhes pa ltar dang / nub phyogs kha che bye brag pa ni/ nub phyogs bye brag kha che'i yul gyi lha/ /zhal dkyus thung zhing zhal gyi dkyil 'khor zlum/ /shangs kyi mtho dma' 'tshams shing cung zad 'dal/ /na bza' sku la 'khril zhing gos 'khyud nyung /

/sku yi tshugs bzang 'gying bag cung zad gyong / /phyag zhabs sor mo cung zad sgros mi gtsang / /rgyan yang ha cang mi mang cung zad dbyig /shas cher pad gdan bzhugs khri med pa mang / /yod rnams kha che'i lha dang mtshungs pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar dang / lho phyogs bye brag pa ni/ lho phyogs bye brag bal po'i yul gyi lha/ /zhal khyim lho phyogs lha rigs 'dra ba la/ /cung zad dkyus thung spyan che shang gong nyag /shangs khung skyong zhing mchu sgros cung zad btsong / /rgyan gtsang dar dpyangs na bza' lhug la rags/ /phyag zhabs sor mo padma'i sgros mi gtsang / /padma nyis brtsegs ya mar gnyis ka ldan/ /steng gi mu tig med pa shas cher 'byung / /sku yi 'gying bag bde nyams dod pa ste/ /shas cher 'debs kyi tshul du bzhugs pa mang / /rdo rje skyil krung phyed skyil la sogs yod/ /'di dag rgyu la li dkar la sogs 'dres/ /zhes pa ltar du bkod nas/ bye brag pa la yul phyogs de dang de'i bzo bos byas pa'am ma yin yang rung / yul de dang de'i lha rigs gtsang ma yin pa dang ma yin pa'i rigs yod kyang yul phyogs de nyid kyi lha rigs byings las sku'i dbyibs dang / rgyan/ bzhugs stabs/ khri gdan sogs phal cher 'dra ba la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa'i sku gzugs rnams la 'di rang gi lugs kyi bye brag pa'i ngos 'dzin du bshad pas gtso cher yul phyogs spyi dang bye brag gi sgo nas dbye ba dang / yang bzo rigs kyi sgo nas kyang cung zad phye bar mdzad cing / yang dpyad don kha cig las/ gong du drangs pa ltar/ rgya gar la yang dbus 'gyur shar nub dang / /lho byang re rer spyi dang bye brag dbye/ /zhes rgya gar dbus shar lho nub bzhi la yul phyogs de dang de'i lha rigs la de dang de'i lha rigs spyi dang / yul phyogs de'i bye brag gam nang gses kyi lha khyad par ba 'ga' zhig la bye brag pa'i lha zhes bshad de/

dbus 'gyur gyi bye brag pa ni/ bye brag rdo rje gdan pas bzhengs pa yis/ /gdan chung mar grags li dkar 'ba' zhig ste/ /cung zad dbu chung zhal nas mkhur tshos rgyags/ /zhes pa ltar dang / shar phyogs kyi bye brag pa ni/ shar phyogs bye brag za hor yul gyi lha/ /zhes sogs gong du drangs pa ltar dang / lho phyogs pa'i bye brag pa ni/ bye brag be ta'i yul gyi lha rigs la/ /zhes sogs gong ltar dang / nub phyogs kyi bye brag pa ni/ bye brag tshugs bzang dbus 'gyur lha 'dra la/ /mgul phra zhal ras sog kha dod pa dang / /phyag zhabs skye 'tshams phra zhing zhabs mthil rgyags/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /byang phyogs bye brag pa ni/ bye brag bal po'i lha yin rtogs par sla/ /zhes bal po'i lha la bshad do/ /des na bye brag pa'i lha rigs 'di la dpyad don rnams cung zad mi mthun yang / bzo rigs 'dres pa la bye brag par bshad par 'di 'thad par sems te/ stod hor gyi yul lta bur kha che'i bzo bos bsgrubs pa'i sku gzugs rnams stod hor kha che bye brag pa'i lha rigs su 'jog rigs kyi/ de las gzhan du bsdu dka' bas so/ /gnas dang bzo bo de bzhin gyis bsgrubs pa'i sku gzugs rnams la dpyad don la la las/ nub phyogs lha rigs dag las 'phros pa'i lha/ /rgyu ni li dkar ser shas che ba la/ /zhal ras dkyus ring sgong gzugs cung zad dod/ /shangs dkyus ring zhing sgang zlum bzang ba ste/ /spyan yang cung che sku yi tshugs bzang ba/ /'gying bag bde cha chung zhing phyag zhabs mnyen/ /sha 'gyur rags shing sha tshogs 'tshams pa dang / /na bza' sku la 'khril zhing gos 'khyud cing / /dngul lam zangs kyis spyan dang zhal mchu brgyan/ /utpal me tog la sogs rgyan mdzes pas/ /gdu bu'i rgyan du byas pa'ang srid pa yin/ /padma kha sbyar sked nyag 'ba' zhig la/ /padma'i 'dab ma sbug cing che ba'am/ /klu yis btegs pa'i khri gdan gru bzhi'am/

/zlum po la sogs ci rigs 'byung ba yin/ /khri pad rgyab yol can yang srid pa tsam/ /'di ni kha che'i yul gyi lha bzo bas/ /stod hor gnas su bsgrubs par shes par bya/ /'di la kha che'i lha rigs ji bzhin pa/ /khro li nag dang dmar ba srid pas na/ /de dag gnas dang bzo bo snga ma bzhin/ /zhes nub phyogs lha rigs las 'phros pa'i sku gzugs su bshad pas nub phyogs kyi lha rigs rang du bsdu yang ma nus/ gzhan rgya bod kyi lha rigs gang du yang ma bsdus la/ des na nub phyogs las 'phros pa'i lha rigs zhes pa'i lha rigs zur pa dpyad don gzhan gang las kyang ma bshad cing / nub phyogs kyi lha rigs las 'phros pa'i lha rigs su 'dod pa po rang gi dpyad don las/ rigs la rgya gar stod hor hor dang bod/ /rgya nag gsar rnying rnam pa drug tu 'dod/ /ces rtsa ba'i lha rigs drug tu bshad pa gang du ma 'dus pas bye brag par bsdus na legs pas so/ /gong du bshad pa'i rgya gar gyi lha rigs la dbus dang phyogs bzhi'i lha rigs bzhir bshad pa'i/ byang phyogs kyi lha rigs ni/ brtag thabs las/ rgya gar byang phyogs li dkar ra gan dang / /cung zad bsres pas rag skya 'dra ba la/ /tshugs mnyen 'gying bag bde la zhal ras ni/ /dkyus thung sgros gtsang shangs bzang spyan bar dog /khri dang rgyan mdzes li dmar srid pa tsam/ /rgyu 'dra ldem gyi tshul du bzhugs pa yod/ /ces pa ltar ram/ yang dpyad don kha cig las/ yang le shod sogs gnas chen de dag tu/ /lha rigs thog mtha' gnyis su shes bya ste/ /zhes rgya gar byang phyogs kyi lha bal po'i lha la bshad nas/ de la yang bal rnying dang / de'i rjes su byung ba'i lha rigs gnyis su phye ba'i snga ma ni/ rgyu ni rag rkyang lugs su byas pa la/ /bzhengs sku shas che bzhugs sku re re tsam/ /tshugs ni bub snyam zhal gdong stod smad che/ /shangs zur rno snyam drang zhing spyan bar dog
