/rgyan spyod legs shing na bza'i sul 'tshams pa/ /phyag zhabs sor mo'i rtse la sbom pa tsam/ /mdun ngos pad gdan sgros gtsang gad brdar legs/ /gser chus byugs pa bal rnying lha yin te/ /zhes pa ltar dang / phyi ma ni/ der rjes 'phul dang brdung ma cher dar bas/ /skye mched gtsang zhing tho ba'i thar legs pa/ /tshugs la 'gying bag bde zhing zhal gyi khyon/ /gcig tu nges dka' ngag gi gang dgos nyid/ /'on kyang shangs dkyus zur cag sgros dod cing / gzhung can nang zur phra zhing phyi mtha' sbom/ /zhal mchu mdzes chags cung zad dud nyams sku/ /rgyan rnams 'khor lo pa ṭa cher legs pa/ /phra 'jug srub shel nal dang g.yu rigs rnams/ /brdar legs bzo bkod mdzes pa'i rnam 'gyur dang / /na bza' sul ldan mtha' cag gzong ris la/ /'jam par byas dang shun 'dab pa ṭa 'khor/ /khri la srog chags sna tshogs gang byung yang / /gdong bzhin dngos nyams chung tsam sha tshugs can/ /pa ṭa'i khrol seng me tog ldum tshigs gsal/ /gad brdar 'jam pa bal po'i lha zhes bya/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar yin no/ /bod kyi lha rigs chos rgyal li la thog ma ni/ brtag thabs las/ snga ma chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus/ /dzhai kṣiṃ li dkar li dmar gtsang ma la/ /dkar dmar sho sgrigs byas dang gser dngul dang / /shel dang rdo 'jim sogs las bsgrubs pa ste/ /zhal gyi dkyil 'khor khyon yangs sha nyams 'bol/ /zhal ras stod smad rgyas zhum med pa la/ /cung zad dkyus ring shangs bzang spyan dkyus ring / /mchu sgros gtsang zhing tshugs legs sha nyams che/ /phyag zhabs mnyen cing gos 'khyud nyung ba ste/ /phal skad lug gdong shin tu mtshar ba 'dra/ /lho phyogs pa dang 'dra ba'i pad gdan dang / /khri dang 'bol gdan ci yang med pa'ang srid/ /na bza' ber dang zhabs la chags gsol ba/ /dbu rgyan gsum pa rtse mo nang du bub/ /phal cher na bza' gzong ris yod pa mang / /chos rgyal sku la na bza' la thod med/

/chags yod gzong ris can te tsha gser dang / /byu tshe byugs sam ci yang ma byugs pa/ /ra gan khro las grub na 'dra cog yin/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar dang / dbu rgyan lnga'am gsum pa mang ba tsam/ /zhes dpyad don kha cig las 'byung bas dbu rgyan gsum pa mang zhing lnga pa yang 'byung ba yin la/ chos rgyal li ma thog ma 'di gar gtso cher dbus 'gyur gyi bzo bos bsgrubs pas dbus lha dang dbye 'byed dka' zhing / kha che'i bzo bos bsgrubs pa 'ga' zhig kyang 'byung bar bshad la/ 'di nyid rgya gar lho phyogs pa dang shar phyogs pa'i bzo bos bsgrubs pa med pa lta bur bshad pa yin te/ zangs rnying rgyu byas ma ga dha yi bzo'i/ /tshugs dang na bza' khri pad la sogs pa/ /dbye ba'i khyad par phal gyis shes dka' zhing / /'ga' zhig kha che'i bzo bo'i sor rtse'i 'phrul/ /de dag rnams kyang nub phyogs bzo 'khyud bzhin/ /lho shar bzo bos bsgrubs pa der skabs dkon/ /zhes 'byung ba yin pas so/ /'di ni 'phags yul gyi li ma dang khyad par med par yang grags pa yin te/ chos li thog ma 'phags yul lha'i do zlar/ /paṇa grub lo chen rnams kyis bsgrags zhes thos/ /zhes kyang brtag thabs kyi yi ge las 'byung ba yin no/ /gzhan yang chos li thog ma 'di la rgya bza' kong jos rgya nag gi bzo bo mkhas pa dag rgya gar gyi bzo rigs la dpe len du bcug nas sku brnyan li ma mang du bzhengs pas/ bzo bo rnams rgya nag gi bag chags 'thas pa'i stobs kyis ji lta ba bzhin ma longs kyang chos rgyal li ma thog ma'i khongs su bgrang bar bya ba yin te/ li ma brtag pa'i yi ge las/ dam tshig sgrol ma ming gzhan rgya mo bzas/ /rgya nag bzo bo'i tshogs rnams der bos nas/ /tshugs dang phyag tshad 'phags yul bzang shes te/ /dper byas bzo bkod rjes mthun nyid byas kyang / /bag chags brtas pa'i rang gzugs sgrib ma thub/ /zhal gdong leb snyam skra mtshams thad du bcad/

/gtsug tor rgyab nye sha che lhug nyams can/ /gad brdar cher legs gser chu'i mdangs 'tsher ba/ /de dag rnams kyang chos li thog ma nyid/ /ces 'byung bas so/ /chos rgyal li ma bar ma ni/ brtag thabs dag las/ bar pa chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan dus/ /gzhan rnams snga ma dag dang mtshungs pa la/ /zhal dkyus cung thung sor mo'i sgros mi gtsang / /jo tshe byugs shing phra rnams tshon khra 'gyed/ /sham gyi lugs kha cung zad mi gtsang zhing / /phal cher dbu rgyan gsum pa mang ba yin/ /chos rgyal sku la la thod med pa la/ /dbu skra lan bu g.yas g.yon gnyis su 'phyang / /dbu rgyan gsum pas mdzes par brgyan par yong / /grang gser byugs dang ci yang ma byugs pa/ /zhes pa dang / rgyal sras zhi 'tsho padma'i ngang tshul dang / /sde brgyad srin po mngag gzhug tu 'khol ba/ /grub pa'i mthu ldan padma sam bha sogs/ /'jam dbyangs zhal skyin khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/ /spyan drangs bsam yas la sogs gtsang khang du/ /'phags yul bzo bos g.ya' chags las grub pa'i/ /lugs bzang tshugs bzang dbus lha ji lta ba/ /brtags tshe zhal khyon thung tsam gdong bzang ba/ /dbu skra'i chun po khyun che tog gis spras/ /dbu rgyan gsum ldan rtse rno rgyab tu gel/ /gos 'khyud sul nyung gzong ris me tog can/ /pad gdan 'dab ma khyon che ldem mo nyid/ /bzhengs sku'i rgyab yol 'od 'phro'i rnam pa dang / /de steng dbu 'od 'khor mor brtsegs pa ste/ /gser dmar gyis byugs gser sbyangs gar bu bzhin/ /zhes 'byung ba bzhin yin no/ /chos rgyal li ma tha ma ni/ brtag thabs las/ phyi ma mnga' bdag khri ral dus su byung / /'phags pa'i yul gyi bzo bos bsgrubs pa'i lha/ /li dkar rtsod med las grub yul dbus kyi/ /lha dang rigs 'dra khyad par 'byed pa la/ /zhal ras cung tsho 'gying bag bde cha che/ /dngul zangs spyan 'byed phul du byung ba yod/ /zangs thang ma 'byung zangs mchu dngul spyan yin/

/ra gan las grub de bas sgros mi gtsang / /li dmar las grub phyi ma dag dang mtshungs/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar yin zhing / yang chos li phyi ma 'di'i khongs su 'du ba ma tshe ma'am/ thon thing ma zhes pa ni/ brtag thabs 'ga' zhig las/ bye brag lha btsun khu dbon rnam gnyis dus/ /zangs dmar dzhai kṣiṃ bsres la zhang zhung gser/ /'thug por byugs pa shangs bzang sha tshugs rgyags/ /'gying bag bde nyams bal po'i lha 'dra zhig /'byung ba 'di la thon thing ma ru grags/ /zhes 'byung ba yin no/ /yang bod kyi li ma'i rigs la bka' gdams li ma ni/ dī paṃ ka ra gangs can bsod nams kyi/ /mgron du byon nas chos dkar snang ba bkye/ /de yi phyag bzo'i lugs sku mdzes pa'i rigs/ /shar phyogs lha yi skye mched gsal rdzogs dang / /lcags rtse yod pa'i mchod rten 'ga' zhig kyang / /'di dus byung ste gong du smos pa dang / /khyad par shar phyogs bzo khyud dag gis dbye/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar dang / bod rnying gi sku gzugs ni/ rgyu ni li ser 'dra cog las byas pa'i/ /rigs lnga la sogs rgyan can sku yi rigs/ /tshugs gyong dbu rgyan rtse rnams rim bzhin sbrel/ /gad brdar 'jam pa bod sku rnying ma nyid/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /stod hor gyi lha rigs ni/ brtag thabs las/ stod hor lha ni zhal dkyus cung thung zhing / /sha tshugs tsho la zhal khyim zlum pa yin/ /na bza' sku la 'khril zhing gos 'khyud ring / /sul zhib chu yi gnyer ma dang mtshungs te/ /shangs spyan la sogs kha che'i lha dang mtshungs/ /pad 'dab che zhing sul can chig rkyang la/ /ya pad ma pad ldan zhing sked nyag gam/ /'byig mo 'dab ma sbub mo che ba'am/ /klu yis btegs pa'i khri gdan gru bzhi'am/ /zlum po brag ri gdan du byas pa yod/ /ces pa ltar dang / yang stod hor gyi yul phyogs su rgya nag rnying ma'i bzo bos bsgrubs pa'i li ma'i sku gzugs 'ga' zhig snang ba dag la ni/

dpyad don kha cig las/ de las 'phros pa stod hor de nyid du/ /rgya nag rnying ma'i bzo bos bsgrubs pa'i lha/ /dkar dmar 'dres pa'i khro li smug po la/ /zhal gyi dkyil 'khor khyon dog sha tshugs ldig /spyan dang mchu sgros chung zhing zhal lko kong / /na bza' lhug cing gos 'khyud lteb sul mang / /pad gdan la sogs snga ma dang 'dra la/ /khri gdan yod pa rgya yig rgya mi dang / /mchod rdzas gzong ris dag gis bris pa 'byung / /rgyab yol bzo khyad phun sum tshogs pa yod/ /ces stod hor las 'phros pa'i lhar bshad cing / 'ga' zhig las ni/ bye brag yul der rgya nag rnying ma'i bzos/ /khro li smug por zhal ras khyun dog cing / /sha tshugs ldig la zhal lko cung zad kong / /spyan dang mchu sgros chung zhing gos 'khyud kyi/ /lteb sul mang la khri gdan rgya yig dang / /rgya mi mchod rdzas gzong ris bris pa 'byung / /kha che'i bzo bos li smug la sogs la/ /bzos pas kha che'i lha dang mtshungs pa 'byung / /zhes bye brag pa'i lhar bshad pa yang snang ngo / /yang hor gyi lha rigs la stod hor dang hor gyi lha rigs gnyis su phye ba'i hor gyi lha rigs ni/ rgyal po go dan nas bzung ye sun the mur gyi bar rgyal rabs drug gi bar la byung ba'i lha rnams te/ de dag gi bzo dbyibs sogs ni/ brtag thabs las/ hor gyi lha ni zhal ras smad rgyas shing / /spyan dang mchu sgros chung la zhal khung ldem/ /phyag zhabs gzhon sha chags shing sor mo thung / /na bza' lhub cing gos 'khyud rtsing zhib ran/ /khri dang brag ri'i steng du bzhugs pa mang / /zhes pa ltar dang / yang dpyad don kha cig las/ rgya gar bzos bsgrubs dper bstan rjes mthun bzos/ /rgya nag hor gyis 'dzin dus byas pa'i lha/ /tshugs drangs sha rgyud cung skem skye mched gsal/ /spyan dkyus gzhu yi dbyibs can phra zhing ring / /dbu yi thod leb gtsug tor rim gyis mtho/

/phyag zhabs gzhon sha chags shing sor mo mdzes/ /pad gdan skyed nyag stod smad kha yel ba/ /me tog phreng snyoms 'ga' zhig pa ṭas mdzes/ /btso ma gser gyi chus byugs gad brdar 'jam/ /zhes kyang 'byung ba yin zhing / yang 'di la dpyad don 'ga' zhig las/ bye brag hor gyis rgya nag 'dzin pa'i dus/ /cong li dang ni de dang li dmar bsres/ /tsha gser gyis byugs tshugs sogs rgya nag bzhin/ /tsandan shar shing phal pa'i shing dang ni/ /shel rigs ma na ho dang dang g.yang kri sogs/ /rdo rigs dag las byas dang bse ru dang / /gser dngul dzhai kṣiṃ dag kyang srid pa yin/ /zhes smad hor bye brag pa'i lhar yang bshad do/ /yang hor gyi lha rigs la/ stod hor sogs bzhir phye ba'i stod hor ni gong du bkod pa ltar dang / yu gur gyi lha rigs ni/ dpyad don 'ga' zhig las/ tsha gser byugs dang pher ma byugs pa la/ /yu gur yul du li dkar dngul dkar dang / /bsres pa'i dkar shas dngul gyi dbyibs 'dra dang / /khro li smug po dag las bsgrubs pa'i lha/ /zhal dkyus thung zhing zhal zlum shangs rgyud ran/ /cung zad rdal zhing skra tshogs shin tu 'thug /na bza' sku la 'khril zhing gos 'khyud nyung / /sku yi tshugs bzang 'gying bag cung zad gyong / /phyag zhabs sor mo cung zad sgros mi gtsang / /rgyan yang ha cang mi mang cung zad 'byig /shas cher pad gdan bzhugs khri med pa mang / /yod rnams stod hor lha dang mtshungs pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar dang / kha sha'i lha rigs ni/ dpyad don las/ kha sha zhes pa li yul dag gi ming / /lha rigs chos li snga ma dag dang mtshungs/ /zhes chos rgyal li ma thog ma dang 'dra ba bsam yas kyi jo mo gling gsum gyi dge rgyas li ma'i gling gi sku brnyan rnams dang g.yo ru khra 'brug gi lha lta bu rnams la bshad la/ smad hor gyi lha rigs ni/ smad hor lha ni zhal ras smad rgyas shing / /spyan dang mchu sgros chung ba zhal khung ldem/

/phyag zhabs gzhon sha chags shing sor mo thung / /na bza' lhub cing gos 'khyud rtsing zhib ran/ /khri dang brag ri'i steng du bzhugs pa mang / /khro li smug dang khro dkar shing las byas/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar yin no/ /gong du rgya nag ma la gnyis su phye ba'i rnying ma'i lha rigs ni/ brtag thabs las/ rgya nag rnying ma'i lha ni sha sbeg cing / /shangs leb zhal skyong mchu sgros shin tu gtsang / /zhal dkyus cung ring spyan ni phra ba dang / /na bza' dar dpyangs lhub la gos 'khyud gtsang / /rgyan sprod mang zhing gtsang sha thon pa yod/ /phyag ni cung thung sor mo dod pa yod/ /'ga' zhig lha dang rgyal po'i dbyibs dod tsam/ /zhal spyan gzong gis brad tsam byas pa'ang 'byung / /rgyu ni khro li nag smug gnyis su nges/ /zhes pa ltar yin zhing / rgya nag gsar ma la thugs dam ma dang / sku rim ma gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ta ming rgyal brgyud kyis rgya nag 'dzin pa'i dus kyi sku brnyan te/ dbyibs sogs ni brtag thabs las/ rgya nag gsar ma'i lha la thugs dam ma/ /sku rim ma gnyis snga ma cung zad legs/ /gser mdog dwangs shing phyag zhabs cung zad kong / /zhal khyim zur gnyis cung zad dod pa snyam/ /padma kha sbyar nyis brtsegs rgyab mdun 'khor/ /yar mar rtse gnyis cung zad phyir gyad pa/ /gong 'og mu tig phra zhib ltar brgyus snyam/ /zhabs sdom legs shing rdo rje rgya gram spras/ /de la byu rtsi nges par byugs pa yin/ /rgyu ni ljang gser dag las grub pa nyid/ /pad steng dbus su rgyal po'i mtshan gyis brgyan/ /'di ni rgyal po'i thugs dam du bzhengs pas/ /gzungs bzhugs rab gnas phun sum tshogs par grags/ /rgyab mdun med par shin tu gtsang ba yin/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar dang / khyad par gzhan yang / sha nyams rgyas shing nyin lag sen ris gsal/ /tshugs bzang dbu yi thod dang zhal gdong yangs/ /cung zad leb snyam shangs drang mchu sgros 'tshams/

/gzhu spyan phra zhing snyan bug la gtad pa/ /gtsug tor 'bur chags rin chen tog can te/ /dbu skra la snag rtsis byugs bung ba bzhin/ /zhes pa rnams dang yang ldan par shes par bya'o/ /rgya nag thugs dam ma 'di la byin las cung zad chung zhing byon gtsang ba zhig 'byung ba de la/ dpyad don kha cig las/ bye brag cung zad gtsang ba chung ba dang / /zhes rgya nag gsar ma'i sku brnyan bye brag par bshad pa yang snang ngo / /rgya nag gsar ma sku rim ma ni/ brtag thabs las/ sku rim ma ni gong dang 'dra ba la/ /de bas cung zad gtsang sha chung ba dang / /rdo rje rgya gram la mtshal yi ge med/ /rgyu la'ang ljang ser rag skya ci rigs yod/ /'di dag rgyal po'i sku rim la dmigs nas/ /grangs can bzhengs pas gzungs gzhug gzhan med par/ /gos dar las grub nang cha'i rnam pa bzhugs/ /rab gnas sogs kyang dpyis phyin med par grags/ /zhes pa ltar yin zhing / rgya nag gi byang chub sems dpa'i sku brnyan ni/ sems dpa' pho mo tshugs mnyen 'gying bag 'tshams/ /spyan gyi gzigs stangs bsgyur stabs sna tshogs pa/ /rgyan sprod rin chen phra gzugs 'od ris can/ /dbu skra'i chun po bcings stabs 'khyil ba'i gzugs/ /'od 'bar nor bu'i tog dang de mdun du/ /rigs kyi bdag po sku brnyan gsal rdzogs pa/ /stod g.yogs srab legs sham thabs yug gon kyang / /sul can 'phyang thabs mdzes pa'i rnam 'gyur can/ /phyag mtshan 'dren byed padma chun po dang / /zhes pa ltar dang / khyad par du zhabs btegs kyi pad sdong la 'dus byas kyi skye ba mtshon byed me tog kha 'bus pa dang / lang tsho rgyas pa'i gnas skabs mtshon byed pad 'dab gsar pa dang / dar babs kyi gnas skabs mtshon byed 'dab ma stong ldan pa'i me tog ge sar bzhad pa dang / rgas pa mtshon byed pad 'dab rnying pa dang / rgud pa mtshon byed me tog yal ba'i skam po rnams te 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa mtshon byed kyi 'dab ma dang me tog yod pa dang /

sku brnyan dngos kyis tshogs gnyis kyi rgyu las byung ba'i sku 'di lta bu'o zhes gdul bya skal ldan rnams kyis sku de lta bu thob pa'i thabs mtshon byed lta bur yod par bshad pa yin te/ brtag thabs kha cig las/ zhabs btegs pad sdong rnams kyi me tog tshogs/ /brda thabs kyis ston skye ba kha 'bus gzugs/ /gzhon nu lang tsho gsar pa'i 'dab ma can/ /dar babs 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i ge sar rgod/ /dur snyam pad 'dab rnying pas rgas mtshon zhing / /lnga par gyur pa yongs snyam rgud pa ste/ /de lta'i dpe yis 'dus byas tshul bstan nas/ /tshogs gnyis rgyu las byung ba 'di yin zhes/ /gsal stong ngo mtshar mtshan dpes spras pa'i sku/ /skal ba bzang po'i lus can mtha' dag kyang / /de lta thob pa'i thabs su ngom pa bzhin/ /zhes 'byung bas so/ /yang rgya nag gsar ma'i khro bo'i sku brnyan dag ni/ khro bo'i sku rnams sha rgyas zhal gdong ni/ /leb chags ha cang rngam pa ma yin pa/ /rgyan sprod zab cing lhab lhub dar dpyangs can/ /gad brdar 'jam zhing pad sgros legs pa'i phul/ /rnam thos 'od zer can sogs bzhon pa can/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar/ rgya nag gsar ma'i lha rigs la tsandan sher shing sogs brkos byas pa dang / dri bzang gi lde gu sogs dang / rgya mtsho'i lbu ba las grub pa sogs rgyu rigs mi 'dra ba yang mang du 'byung ste/ ji skad du/ tsandan sher shing brkos su byas pa yi/ /bde kyai 'jigs byed legs ldan lcam dral dang / /khro bcu phur pa la sogs mtha' yas shing / /dri bzang lde gu las byas sku dag dang / /rgya mtsho'i lbu ba dag las byas pa'ang 'byung / /zhes pa ltar ro/ /chos sku'i rten nam thugs kyi mchod rten la yang rigs kyi sgo nas/ thugs rten rgya gar bod dang rgya nag gsum/ /zhes pa ltar rgya gar gyi mchod rten/ rgya nag gi mchod rten/ bod kyi mchod rten dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rgya gar dbus kyi ma ga dhar byang chen/

/wa ra na sir sgo mang mchod rten dang / /mnyan yod cho 'phrul chen po'i mchod rten te/ /gsal ldan lha las babs pa'i mchod rten dang / /ser skyar sku bltams padma spungs pa nyid/ /dmar bu can du sku tshe byin brlabs pa/ /rgyal po'i khab dang mnyan yod la sogs pa/ /dge 'dun dbyen sdum mchod rten chen po dang / /rtswa mchog grong du myang 'das mchod rten rnams/ /dkar dmar li las grub pa dar mod kyis/ /kha ba can du lha babs mchod rten dang / /sku tshe byin brlabs rnam rgyal mchod rten gnyis/ /rgya gar yul nas cho le tsam zhig thon/ /khyad par gar lugs bcu gsum gdugs ring yin/ /lha babs rnams la seng khri med pa mang / /rtse yi gdugs la kha 'phyang za rog med/ /khyad par pad spungs rgya gar mar grags pa/ /shas cher dbus dang shar phyogs dar ba las/ /bod kyi yul du 'ga' zung dar bar snang / /padma kha sbyar cig rkyang pad kha zhum/ /bum stod zhum zhing bum smad rgyas pa dang / /bum pa dpang mtho bre yang cung zad krong / /bre yi ya mtha' kha yu 'byig mo ste/ /bcu gsum chos 'khor dpang mtho cung zad phra/ /rtse gdugs theb cing kha sbyar ze rog med/ /de steng nor bu padma'i bum bum dang / /nyi zla gang rung yod pa 'gyur med rtags/ /gandho la zhes byang chub ljon shing dang / /ka ma ru yi rdo dkar rdo nag las/ /grub pa'i rdo rje gdan gyi bkod pa yod/ /ra gan las grub 'dra cog bod du bzhengs/ /zhes pa ltar dang / rgya nag gi mchod rten ni/ rgya nag yul du ljang gser gyis g.yogs pa/ /las grub bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad ka snang / /zhes pa ltar yin zhing / bod kyi mchod rten ni/ bod yul 'phags pa'i yul dang mtshungs pa yi/ /thugs rten thams cad dar bar snang na yang / /gzhan dag rtogs par sla phyir mi spro bar/ /pad spungs rnying ma'i khyad par bshad par bya/ /dpal ldan mar me mdzad dpal bzhugs pa'i dus/

/bod kyi ra gan rnying ma'am li las grub/ /padma kha sbyar chig rkyang brtsegs gnyis gyad/ /mas mthar mu tig che chung snyoms pas spras/ /rgya gar ma las bum stod cung tsam rgyas/ /chos 'khor bcu gsum thung zhing cung zad sbom/ /rtse gdugs cung sbub kha 'gyang yod med gnyis/ /rtse mor nyi zla'am padma'i bum bum spras/ /bre dpang cung dma' ya mthar mdzes byed la/ /ze rog lta bu bcu drug dag gis brgyan/ /'di dag med pa'ang 'ga' re 'byung bar snang / /'di dag rigs la lcags lte ma dang ni/ /me zhabs la mtshal ma gsum yod par grags/ /lcags lte ma ni rtse mor pad bum nyid/ /srog shing tshul du lcags lte mdzub gang tsam/ /yod pa'i rtse mo pad bum gseb tu thon/ /me zhabs ma ni me long zhabs can yin/ /la mtshal ma ni zhabs gzungs rgya gram ris/ /de steng la mtshal dag gis byugs pa yin/ /mdun gyi rtags su bre ngos spyan mig gam/ /bre steng sho mig gsor mig gru bzhi pa/ /gang rung byas pa'ang yod med ci rigs 'byung / /'di dag gsar nyams yod pa 'byung ba ni/ /de yi 'dra cog yin par shes par bya/ /rnying ma rtsod med rnams kyi nang bzhugs la/ /sangs rgyas ring bsrel yod cing jo bo rjes/ /rab gnas me tog 'thor bar nges pa yin/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar yin no/ /gnyis pa chos kyi rten ni/ spyir chos zhes bya ba sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa nyid la gtso bor 'jog cing / de yang gdul bya'i bsam pa'i bye brag dang bstun nas gsungs pa'i mdo sde chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong sogs sde snod gsum mam phyi mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang / nang rdo rje theg pas bsdus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod de/ rgyud sde spyi rnam kyi don bsdus tshul gsum gsal rgyan las/ chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong zhes bshad pa/ /nyan thos mos pa dman rnams drang phyir te/ /theg chen lugs la dbye ba bsam mi khyab/

/ces gsungs pa ltar/ dpal sdom pa 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ rnal 'byor rgyud rnams kyi ni grangs/ /bye ba phrag ni drug nges te/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor ma rgyud grangs/ /bye ba phrag ni bcu drug grags/ /theg chen las gzhan mdo sde rnams/ /dung phyur phrag brgyad gsungs pa yin/ /de bzhin pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung / /dung phyur lnga dang sa ya lnga/ /'di dag thams cad thub dbang po/ /sku gsum bdag nyid can gyis gsungs/ /zhes pha rgyud bye ba phrag drug ma rgyud bye ba phrag bcu drug theg pa thun mong gi mdo sde dung phyur brgyad/ sher phyin dung phyur lnga dang sa ya lngar gsungs shing / de dag kyang shlau ka'i grangs ma yin gyis mdo rgyud kyi ming gi rnam grangs su bshad pa sogs bka' yang mtha' yas shing / de dag gi dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos kyang tshad med pas chos kyi grangs dang tshad 'di tsam du bshad du med la/ de'i phyir na chos de dag gi rten glegs bam yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod par shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa dge 'dun gyi rten ni/ spyir dge 'dun zhes pa nyan thos ltar na/ dge slong bzhi yan chad tshogs pa la bshad kyi dge slong re re ba gang zag tsam yin kyang dge 'dun ma yin par gsungs la/ theg pa chen po ltar na theg chen gyi sbyor mthong sgom gsum la gnas pa'i byang sems re re yang tshogs sam dge 'dun du bzhed pa yin pas/ theg chen gyi dge 'dun la sar gnas kyi byang sems nas/ sa bcu rgyun gyi tha ma la gnas pa'i bar gyis bsdus pa du ma dang / sangs rgyas zin nas byang sems kyi rnam par bstan pa'ang sems dpa' chen po bcu drug dang nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la sogs pa la mang du yod cing / de dag gi rten byang sems spyi'i rnam pa ni rin po che'i rgyan dang / dar gyi na bza' du mas brgyan pa longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rten dang rjes su mthun par 'byung ba dag yin pas/

byang sems so so'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan sogs mdo las gsal bar mi 'byung zhing / rgyud sde las 'ga' zhig gsal bar gsungs mod kyang / la la ji lta ba bzhin bshad du mi rung la/ bshad du rung ba rnams ni/ sgrub thabs so so nas 'byung ba ltar yin no/ /rang rgyal gyi rten ni/ spyir rang rgyal la tshogs na spyod pa'i rang sangs rgyas dang / bse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas gnyis dang / sprul pa'i rang sangs rgyas la sogs pa mang du yod kyang / rten tha dad pa med la/ nyan thos la zung bzhi ya brgyad kyis bsdus pa dang / byang sems nyan thos kyi tshul bzung ba nyan thos chen po bcu drug la sogs pa tha dad pa du ma yod kyang rten tha dad pa ma bshad la/ des na theg dman gyi dge 'dun gyi rten ni/ nyan rang spyir rab byung gi cha byad shin tu mdzes pa 'khar bsil dang lhung bzed bsnams pa dang / po ti 'dzin pa'ang 'byung zhing / bye brag rang rgyal gyi rten ni/ gtsug tor cung zad yo ba dang bcas pa'i rnam pa can te/ de dag ni dkon mchog gsum gyi rten gyi rnam gzhag go /yang sku gsung thugs kyi rten gsum du phye na/ lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can dang / gtsug lag khang dang / mchod rten la sogs pa sku'i rten/ po ti dang / bgrang phreng dang / gzhan yang dril bu la sogs pa rol mo'i bye brag rnams gsung gi rten/ rdo rje dang / gri gug dang / bum pa dang / rdo rje dbyug pa la sogs pa phyag mtshan gyi rigs phal cher thugs kyi rten yin zhing / yon tan 'phrin las kyi rten dag ni gsum po ci rigs par 'du ba la dgongs nas logs su ma bshad do/ /de rnams kyi sgo nas spyir rten gyi dbye ba dang so so'i ngos 'dzin legs par bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa de dag 'jig rten gyi khams su thog mar ji ltar byon pa'i tshul ni/ gong du bstan pa'i rten gsum rnams kyi nang nas thub pa'i bstan pa 'di la 'jig rten du byon pa snga ba ni chos sku'i rten mchod rten nyid yin te/

de yang sngon ston pa 'di nyid grong khyer ser skyar lum bi ni'i tshal du sku bltams pa'i dus su phyogs bzhir gom pa bdun bdun bor ba'i sar padma bdun bdun byung ba'i tshe rang 'khrungs su dpal padma can gyi mchod rten zhes bya ba bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad kyi dang po de nyid byon la/ de'i rjes su ston pas mchod rten rnam dag gi drung du nyid kyi dbu skra nyid kyis bcad de rab tu byung nas gtsug phud phul ba'i tshe gtsug phud kyi mchod rten la sogs pa dus der mchod rten mang du byon zhing / de nas ma ga dhar ston pa dgung lo sum cu pa la mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshe byang chub chen po'i mchod rten zhes bya ba byon pa dang / de'i rjes su ston pas wa ra na sir chos 'khor dang po bskor ba'i tshe ye shes mchod rten nam/ chos 'khor chos rten zhes kyang bya/ bkra shis 'byung ba'i mchod rten zhes bya ba byon pa yin la/ gzhan yang ston pas cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i tshe mu stegs pham mdzad kyi mchod rten la sogs pa gong du bstan pa'i bde gshegs mchod rten gzhan rnams rim pa bzhin byon par bshad pa yin no/ /de'i rjes su sku'i rten bris sku snga ba yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs pa'i dus su yul sgra sgrogs kyi rgyal po u tra ya na dang / yul dbus kyi rgyal po gzugs can snying po gnyis mthong ma myong 'phrad ma myong yang 'phrin gyi sgo nas yid shin tu mdza' ba'i grogs su gyur pa nas phan tshun skyes bskur res byas pa na/ rgyal po u tra ya nas rin po che'i khrab rin gyis gzhal du med pa zhig bskur ba'i tshe/ ma ga dha'i rgyal po gzugs can snying pos de'i lan du 'os pa ma rnyed par sems shin tu zhum par gyur nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di'i lan du ji ltar rigs gsol pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku ri mor bris pa dang /

bka'i tshigs su bcad pa dang bcas skur cig ces gsungs pa ltar u tra ya na de ltar bsams te/ lha bzo dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la lta zhing 'bri bar brtsams pa na/ sku nyi ma'i 'od ltar 'bar bas 'bri ma nus par/ bcom ldan 'das kyis khrus kyi rdzing bu'i steng du bzhugs/ de'i gzugs brnyan rdzing bur shar ba ltar bris pas thub pa chu lon mar grags shing / rten de dang / rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs 'byung lugs ldog gi tshigs bcad/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshigs bcad/ bslab gzhi lnga'i tshigs bcad/ de dag gi phan yon dang bcas pa bris te gser gyi za ma tog tu bcug nas bkur/ 'di 'jig rten gsum las 'das pa'i skyes yin pas rgyal po khyod dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi dang bcas pas gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / me tog dang / bdug spos la sogs pa'i mchod pa dang bcas bsus/ go skabs yangs par seng ge'i khri'i steng du bzhugs su gsol te dad cing gus pa'i sgo nas zhal phye zhig ces pa'i spring yig dang bcas pa brdzangs/ sgra sgrogs kyi rgyal pos kyang de bzhin du byas te zhal phye ba na/ tshogs pa rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo zhes brjod pa thos pas spu thams cad gyen du langs shing mchi ma rang dbang med par g.yos/ tshigs bcad rnams bklags pas skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen du gyur te bden pa mthong bar bshad pa yin no/ /yang ston pas chos gsungs pa'i tshe khyim bdag shākya'i ming can gyi chung mas mu tig gi do shal khyim du lus pas bran mo len du btang pa na bran mo'i bsam pa la 'di lta bu'i chos zab mo nyan pa'i dbang med par 'gro dgos pa shin tu skal ba dman snyam pa'i tshe/ ston pas de'i bsam pa mkhyen nas chos tshigs su bcad pa gcig bris te gnang ba 'don zhing phyin pa na lam du ba grus ma zhig gis brdungs te shi

de ma thag siṅga la'i gling gi rgyal po'i bu mor skyes/ skyes ma thag tu yul der mu tig gi char babs pas mu tig can nam/ mu tig 'khri shing can du btags/ de nas re zhig na yul dbus kyi tshong pa mang pos siṅga la'i gling du phyin/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' tshigs su bcad pa 'ga' zhig bton pa thos pas bu mo'i yid 'phrogs te/ bzang po'i glu de da dung longs shig zer ba na/ 'di glu min sangs rgyas kyi bka' yin zhes bshad pas/ bu mo mu tig can sangs rgyas kyi mtshan thos pa tsam gyis lus kyi ba spu langs/ mig mchi mas gang bzhin du sangs rgyas zhes bya ba ci 'dra zhig yod ces dris pa na/ tshong pa rnams kyis yon tan brjod pa na bu mo shin tu dad par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la bdag 'khor ba'i gnas las drang du gsol zhes pa'i 'phrin yig phul ba ston pas bzhes te/ de'i lan du ras bris kyi ngos la ston pa'i sku las 'od zer btang pa ltar rig byed pa dag gis bris te bka'i tshigs bcad 'ga' dang bcas pa bskur ba mthong ba'i mod la bu mos bden pa mthong ste/ yul de'i mi kun bstan pa'i sgor btsud/ drin lan du dkon mchog gsum la mu tig mchog ma ga ddha'i bre re re phul/ sku de la thub pa 'od zer mar grags so/ /yang sku'i rten 'bur sku ni/ grong khyer ba dag gis dge 'dun gdugs tshod la spyan drangs pa'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gshegs par dge 'dun kho na byon pa na gral gyi dbus mi brjid par mthong nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bdag gis ston pa'i sku rin po che las grub pa zhig bzhengs nas dge 'dun gyi thog mar bzhugs su gsol na rung ngam zhes zhus pa na ston pas gnang ste/ mgon med zas sbyin gyis glang po mchog la bzhon/ gdugs rgyal mtshan rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te dbul po'i srang la sogs pa grong khyer kun tu zhugs nas 'gro ba kun la dmigs pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa bzang pos de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs kyi rgyu blangs te rgyal ba'i sku gzugs mang du bzhengs pa rnams so/

/gzhan yang sngon gyi dus bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ma bstan pa'i gong rol tu/ 'jam dpal gyis bcom ldan 'das la/ kyai bcom ldan 'das 'gro ba sems can rnams skyabs gnas kyang khyed la zhu/ chos kyang khyed la nyan/ bsod nams kyi tshogs kyang khyed la bsten nas bsog pas khyed nyid mya ngan las 'das nas/ drug sde sus 'dul/ the tshom su zhig gis sel/ yon sus sbyong / mu stegs su zhig gis zil gyis gnon zhes gsol pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ ston pa so sor thar pa la gyis/ gnad mkhan po dang slob dpon la tshol/ drug sde sprul pa yin pas rang thul la 'gro /nga mya ngan las 'das nas ring por ma lon par nga'i nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis nga'i gsung rab bsdu bar 'gyur bas the tshom des gcod do/ /yon nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpas sbyong ngo / /mu stegs zil gyis gnon pa dang / bstan pa yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir nga'i sku tshad bzhengs shig ces gsungs/ de nas 'khor rnams kyis/ de ji ltar bzhengs zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis zhal 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i sgo nas 'od zer bzhi 'phros te/ gcig lha tshangs pa la phog gcig sgra gcan ra hu la la phog gcig lha'i dbang po brgya byin la phog gcig lha'i bzo bo bi shwa karma la phog pas khong rnams spobs pa skyes te/ tshangs pa na re/ bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi chos sku'i rten bzhengs pa'i sbyin bdag bgyid zer/ ra hu la na re/ bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rten bzhengs pa'i yon bdag bgyid zer/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin na re/ bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi sprul sku'i rten bzhengs pa'i yon bdag bgyid zer/ bi shwa karma na re/ bdag gis rten rnams bzhengs pa'i bzo bo bgyid zer/ gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lngas rten rnams kyi srung ma dang / zhabs tog bgyid par zhus/

phyag na rdo rjes rten gyi srung ba po bgyid zhus/ byams pas bdag gis rten rnams kyi gnyer bdag bgyid zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das cang ma gsungs pa'i tshul gyis gnang / de nas phyis rten de dag bzhengs pa'i dus la babs pa'i tshe/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis chos sku'i rten gyi rgyur lha'i rin po che du ma'i phung po zhig bi shwa karma'i mdun du spungs so/ /de nas bi shwa karmas/ dbyibs zlum po/ kha dog dkar ser/ tshad lha tshangs pa'i 'dom gang yod pa'i chos sku'i rten zhig bzhengs te bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis rab gnas mdzad de dpal du ba lta bu'i mchod rten du grags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis lha tshangs pa la khyed kyis bzhengs pa'i rten 'di u rgyan gyi yul du bzhugs su gsol cig gsungs pa bzhin tshangs pas byas te nub phyogs u rgyan na bzhugs/ phyis su sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas ring bsrel snying po can gyis bkang nas sa la ma reg par bar snang la bzhugs pas/ dpal ma reg pa'i mchod rten du yang grags shing / chos sku nam mkha' dang 'dra ba mtshon pa'i phyir dbyibs zlum por yod pas lhung bzed kha sbub pa ltar du yang grags so/ /de la lha srin ma mo dang mkha' 'gro sogs kyis kyang bsod nams bsog pa'i rten byed cing / mi dag gis kyang zhag bdun tsam phyag dang skor ba byas na tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub thob par yang bshad do/ /yang ra hu las longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rten bzhengs pa'i phyir lha'i rin po che mandha ra ba dang / zi'u smug po la sogs pa'i phung po bi shwa karmar gtad pas/ des rin po che de dag lugs su blugs nas tshad dpag tshad brgyad cur yod pa/ kha dog mthing kha/ phyag mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can gyi longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rten zhig bzhengs pa la bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis rab gnas mdzad nas/ tshangs pa la khyed kyis bzhengs pa'i rten 'di sa phyogs yangs pa zhig tu bzhugs su gsol cig gsungs pa bzhin lho phyogs kyi phyi'i rgya mtsho'i nang du bzhugs te lte ba man chad chu nang du nub/

yan chad ma nub pa'i steng du chu bya mang po chags te bya thal gyis sku'i mdangs sgrib 'gro ba la/ tshes bco lnga'i nub mo zla ba nya ba'i 'od zer dang / dbu'i gtsug tor rtse na nor bu chu shel yod pa de la phog pas nam langs kyi bar du chu shel las yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu babs pas sku khrus gsol bas bya thal rnams dag ste nyi ma shar ba dang / nyi ma'i 'od zer dang / rin po che in dha nyil gyi 'od gnyis 'dzoms pas nam mkha'i khams thams cad 'ja' tshon du bkra lam me 'gro zhing / de'i tshe 'od kyi dbang gis sku mi gsal/ yang zhag bdun tsam na sngar bzhin bya thal chags pas 'od nyams pa na sku de je gsal je gsal la 'gro ste/ ded dpon skal ldan dag gis nor bu lon nas yong dus sku de'i gru mo khugs kyi thad nas gzings bton te sku de'i mdun du gtad nas mchod pa rgya chen po phul gsol ba btab pas/ 'dzam bu'i gling du slebs tsa na rin po che re res kyang rgyang grags bdun bdun gyi bar du 'bras kyi char 'bebs pa 'byung zhing / klu'i tshogs dang chur gnas pa'i sems can mang po dag dang / gza' skar la sogs pa'i bar snang la gnas pa'i 'gro ba mang po'i bsod nams bsog pa'i rten du bzhugs so/ /de nas yang lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis mi'i rin po che sna lnga dang / lha'i rin po che indha snyil dang / ind+ra ni la dang / asma gar pa dang / margad dang / thon ka chen po dang / padma rā ga dang / gzhan yang mi'i rin po che las bzang ba/ lha'i rin po che las ngan pa'i nor bu rin po che 'ching bu mang po dang bcas pa/ bi shwa karma'i mdun du spungs nas sprul pa'i sku'i rten bzhengs par bsgos so/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi sku tshad la ma mthun te/ gzugs khams kyi lha rnams na re/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i tshad ni 'dzam bu gling gi mi 'bring gi khru sum cu so gnyis yin zer/

'dod khams kyi lha rnams mi'i khru bcu drug yin zer/ mi dag ni gcung mdzes dga' bo dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tor mtho dman mnyam zer ba la/ bcom ldan 'das nyid cang mi gsung bar bzhugs so/ /de ma thag bi shwa karmas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i tshad rin po che'i thig skud kyis lan gsum gyi bar du gzhal bas/ gtsug tor gyi rtse ma bsnyogs par je mtho je mthor song ba na/ bi shwa karmas gzhal du re nas steng phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams mdang dga' bar phyin pas/ der zhing de'i sangs rgyas dga' ba'i dpal la/ 'khor byang sems dga' ba'i dpal gyis 'di mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams nas yong gis/ 'di nas mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa bzhugs pa'i zhing dang thag ci tsam mchis gsol pas/ bka' stsal pa/ zhing khams re re'i rdul phra rab re re gzhal bas zhing de'i zhing mi zad pa yod de lha'i bu khyed kyis sangs rgyas kyi sku la tshad mi mnga' ba rtogs pa'i phyir ston pas byin gyis brlabs kyis/ gzhan du khyed kyi tshe ma gir zad nas 'dir mi brtol bar 'chi ba'i dus byed par 'gyur du mchis/ da mar 'gro bar 'dod na ston pa'i yon tan dran par gyis shig gsungs pa na/ bi shwa karmas rang gi ston pa shākya thub pa yid la byas pas rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du brtol pa na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bi shwa karma la bka' stsal pa/ khyod pas nyan thos dang rang rgyal dgra bcom pa dang byang chub sems dpas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul zil gyis gnon par mi nus zhes gsungs nas/ nga'i lo bcu gnyis pa'i tshad cig byas na des bstan pa'i bya ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /ces gsungs pa na/ des tshad ma shes pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis pang du 'tsho ba'i ma ma la gzigs pas/ ma ma de na re/ dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes pa'i tshe ngas ser skya'i khang thog na phar ded pas/

rgyal po'i ser skya'i yangs thog gi gzim khang gi them khar bzhengs song bas/ dbu'i gtsug tor sgo'i ya them la thug la khad pas kho mo rngam pa zhig byung / des na sgo de dang mnyam mo zer bas de la tshad byas/ dgung lo brgyad pa'i tshad ni lumbi ni'i khri dang mnyam mo zer/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'i tshad ni bcom ldan 'das nyid dang mnyam mo zer bas/ tshad de ltar du byas te bi shwa karmas sku gsum legs par bzhengs nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar phul bas/ der nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa dang / lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang dri za la sogs pa dang / lha srin sde brgyad thams cad sku de dag la blta bar 'tshogs te/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis zhal gyi sgo nas 'od zer bkye ste/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad khyab par byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi yon tan dang byin rlabs thams cad 'od kyis bskul nas sku gsum po la lan gsum du skor ba byas te thim/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor rnams la sku 'di dag gang du yod pa'i sa der/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs nyi zer gyi rdul tsam 'dus te mchod bstod dang / bkur bstir byed/ ri mor byed/ brjed par byed cing / theg pa chen po'i chos rnams 'bad pa med par 'byung zhing / bstan pa'i tha ma la kha ba can gyi yul sku gnyis dang spyan ras gzigs kyis 'dul bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes bka' bstsal te/ de dag gi rjes su ston pa mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston khar rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i don du bcom ldan 'das kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis tshang ba'i sku bris sku byon te rgyal po'i thugs dam du mdzad cing / dus phyis su yang bcom ldan 'das mi bzhugs par rgyal po mya ngan skyes dus sku de la brten nas mya ngan bsal lo/ /de nas ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i phyi de'i dbyar 'phags pa drug sdes gzugs bsam pa'i snang ba dang bstun nas khru sum cu so gnyis pa dang /

'dod khams pa'i snang ba dang bstun nas khru bcu drug pa'i sku tshad bzhengs par bshad do/ /de nas ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas 'phags yul du grags che ba ni bram ze spun gyis bzhengs pa rnams te/ de yang de bzhin gshegs pa dgongs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya tsam na/ rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po'i bram ze mahā la bya ba'i khyim bdag cig la bu gsum yod pa las/ gsum char dad pa che zhing chos la mos pa zhig yin pas/ nyin re bzhin khong rang rnams 'thab nas mig mchi ma tsar re yong pa na/ pha mas khyed ci la rtsod smras pas/ bu chung pa na re/ nged rnams phyi nang gnyis grub mtha' gang bzang la mi mthun te/ kho bos lha dkon mchog gsum/ chos lugs sangs rgyas pa bzang byas pa yin/ phu bo gnyis lha mahā de ba chos lugs mu stegs bzang zer bas ji ltar yin dris pas/ pha mas khyed rnams 'di nas byang du ri nag po dgu 'das pa na ri bo gangs can yod/ de la lha mahā de ba yab yum bzhugs pas der song la lha chen po la dris shig smras nas/ bu gsum gyi rkang pa la rkang mgyogs kyi rdzas byugs nas nam mkha' la btang ngo / /de nas khong gsum gyis der phyin pas/ lha'i bu mo mang po rin po che'i snod mdzes pa thogs nas me tog mang po 'thu bzhin 'dug pa la/ khyed rnams su yin me tog btus nas ci byed dris pas/ nged rnams lha mahā de wa'i 'khor g.yog yin/ me tog 'di rnams 'phags pa dgra bcom pa la mchod pa yin zer/ 'o na nged rnams mahā de wa de'i zhal blta ba yin pas khyed rnams kyis zhus sna gyis smras nas/ lha mo de dag dang 'grogs te phyin pas/ pho brang nang na gdan mang po bshams 'dug pa la 'phags pa dgra bcom pa mang po rdzu 'phrul gyis byon nasabazhugs te/ de dag la mahā de wa 'khor dang bcas pa phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul gyin 'dug pas/ der bram ze spun gyi yid la mahā de wa sangs rgyas kyi dge 'dun la mchod pa byed kyin 'dug pas chos lugs nang pa sangs rgyas pa bzang gi yod 'dug snyam du sems pa na/

dgra bcom pa rnams slar nam mkha' la gshegs song bas/ bram ze spun gyis lha dbang phyug chen po la/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa dang / phyi pa mu stegs gnyis chos lugs gang bzang dris pas/ de na re/ nga mu stegs rnams kyi mthar thug gi lha yin/ mthu dang / rdzu 'phrul dang / nus pa dang / tshe 'di'i 'dod yon rnams 'byung / gnod pa zhi bar byed/ nus pa mu stegs byed myur ba yin/ tshe phyi ma'i thar pa byang chub bsgrub pa'i chos ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa yin/ nga yang thar pa'i bde ba 'dod nas dgra bcom pa rnams mchod pa yin pas thar pa 'dod na chos lugs nang pa sangs rgyas pa bzang zer bas/ khong gsum gyis de ltar shes nas pha ma'i drung du 'ong pas/ pha mas khyed dag dbang phyug chen po dang mjal lam ji skad gsungs dris pa na/ sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams bsnyad/ chos lugs nang pa sangs rgyas pa bzang ba 'dug pas/ nged rnams chos byed pa la yi dam re dgos pas/ yi dam gang bzhengs/ lha khang gang du brtsig smras pas/ ma bram ze ma gsal 'od na re/ chos lugs nang pa sangs rgyas pa bzang ba nged kyis kyang shes mod/ khyed rnams yid ma ches dogs 'drir btang pa yin/ da khyed rnams rten bzhengs pa ngas bstan gyis zer nas/ bu che ba mahā sa me la/ khyed kyis ri bo gangs can gyi rgyud/ skal ldan shing rta'i 'gram/ yul wa ra na si drang srong lhung ba'i sa/ ri dwags rgyu ba'i tshal/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi 'khor lo thog mar bskor ba'i gnas de na rin po che'i rdo zhig yod pas de la rgyu gyis la rten bzhengs shig zer bas/ des bcom ldan 'das kyi sku shin tu che ba chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ gandho la chen po yod pa zhig bzhengs pas de la dharmā tsakra zhes grags so/ /bu bar pa ni ba sa me la/ khyed kyis rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal bya ka landha ka skad 'byin pa'i gnas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mtshan ma med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i sar/

gnas chen brgyad kyi sa la rgyu gyis la rten bzhengs shig ces zer bas/ des kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi sku tshad dang / gandho la 'dom nyi shu yod pa zhig bzhengs so/ /de nas bu chung bas ma la/ khong phu bo gnyis la yi dam gyi rten bzhengs sa legs pa re bstan na/ kho bo sangs rgyas la mos pa snga bas rten bzhengs pa'i sa ji ltar byed smras pas/ ma na re/ khyod kyi lha bzhengs sa de dag las dga' ba zhig yod de/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ma ga dha rdo rje'i gdan gyi mchog byang chub kyi shing gi shar ngos la sku rgyab bstan pa yang dag pa'i ye shes brnyes pa'i sa der/ chu bo ne rañdza na'i 'gram na ma he nyal ba'i 'og na khrus kyi rdzing bu zhig yod pa de'i 'gram na/ tsandan gor shi sha'i sdong bu 'gyel nas yod pas/ de nas shing dum blangs pa bram ze'i bu mo bzhi bcu zhe dgus brdar ba de la rin po che sna tshogs dang / spos sna tshogs bsres pa srang sum stong dang / na spos zan ma'i 'o ma dang sbyar ba'i gong bu bdun phrag bdun stong gi so phag gi rgyu gyis la gandho la phyi mchod rten du byas nang du bcom ldan 'das kyi sku bzhengs shig de yang zla ba drug dang zhag bdun du sgo ma 'byed cig khyed kyi yi dam ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes zer/ de'i dus su yul dbus nas phyi'i rgya mtshor rin po che len pa'i ded dpon zhig yod pa la/ rang gi pha na re/ bu khyod kyis mi mi nyo ba'i zong nyos shig ces zer bas/ de nas ded dpon des 'khor tshong pa mang po dang bcas nor bu lon nas log yong ba'i gzings nang du sngar med pa'i mi mdog sngo lhang pa zhig byung bas/ gzhan rnams na re/ 'di rang re la gnod pa byed par 'dug pas bsad do zer nas bcings so/ /der ded dpon gyi bsam pa la nga la phas mis mi nyo ba'i zong nyos shig zer ba de 'di yin nges snyam nas/ 'di la gnod pa ma byed cig ces bsgos te mi de rin bcal te nyos/

bcings pa las bkrol bas mi de rgya mtshor mchongs nas song bas/ de klu'i bu yin pas cung zhig na des rin po che andha snyil khyad par du 'phags pa khru gang tsam pa zhig khyer byung nas/ ded dpon la drin lan du phul lo/ /ded dpon gyis kyang rdo rje gdan du da lta yon bdag tsakra sa me de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bzhengs pa des spyan 'bras bya snyam nas brdabs pas cha gnyis su gas chag go /de khyer nas yon bdag tsakra sa me bya ba sngar gyi bram ze mo'i bu gzhon pa la phul lo/ /de nas bu des kyang mas ji skad zer ba bzhin byas pas/ zla ba drug dang zhag drug song ba na ma 'ongs te/ bu khyed kyis sgo phyes shig rten de la nga blta'o zer ba la/ bus zhag gcig ma thim pas nangs par sgo phye yi byas pas/ ma na re/ nga do nub tshe'i dus byed pas zhag grangs ma thim kyang sgo phyes shig ngas rten de de bzhin gshegs pa 'dra mi 'dra blta yis/ nga 'das nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'dra mi 'dra'i shan mi phyed de/ ci'i phyir na/ 'dzam bu'i gling na de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba'i mi da lta nga min pa med pas zer bas/ bus kyang sgo phye bas de ma thag lha bzo ba yang rtsig phug la thal nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas bram ze mo des rten de la legs par brtags te/ lha 'di bcom ldan 'das dgung lo sum cu lon pa dang sku tshad mnyam zhing shin tu yang 'dra ste legs/ 'on kyang khyad par bdun gyi ngos dang mi 'dra ste/ sangs rgyas la 'od 'dom gang yod pa dang / dbu'i gtsug tor bltar mi mngon pa dang / dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag cing tshom bur 'khyil ba dang / smin mtshams na mdzod spu khru gang pa g.yas su 'khyil ba dang / gsung gis chos 'chad/ sku la na bza' gsol ba sor bzhi tsam mi reg pa dang / spyod lam gshegs pa bzhugs pa/ 'chag pa/ gzim pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas kyang sems can gyi don mdzad pa de 'di la med/ gzhan byin rlabs sogs la khyad par med ces sogs sku'i che ba mang du brjod nas bram ze ma rgan mo de nub 'das pa'i gdung ring bsrel gyi snying po can du gyur te/

bus rdo rje gdan du mchod rten bzhengs pas mchod rten ring bsrel gyi snying po can du grags so/ /de lta bu'i bram ze mo de dpal ldan lha mo'i sprul pa yin par bshad do/ /de ltar ma yong pa zhag gcig gi sngas pas sku de'i zhabs ya gcig gi mthe'u chung ma tshang zhes kyang grag go /sku de la mahā bo de zhes mtshan grags la/ de lta bu'i bram ze spun gsum gyis bzhengs pa'i sku brnyan gsum ni rgya gar gyi gnas chen po de dag na 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi zhing du da lta bzhugs par bshad do/ /gong du bstan pa'i bcom ldan 'das dgung lo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'i sku tshad ni sum cu rtsa gsum na lha rnams kyi don mdzad cing bzhugs so/ /dgung lo brgyad pa dang / bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad ni rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi mchod pa'i rten sogs mdzad de lo lnga bcu 'gro don rgya gar nyid du mdzad/ dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad 'dis u rgyan du lo lnga/ de nas srin yul du yang bzhugs par bshad/ de nas kha cher lo lnga brgya bzhugs/ de nas klus spyan drangs te klu rgyal btang bzung gi mchod gnas lo brgyad mdzad/ de nas ma ga dha'i rgyal po he man dha'i mchod gnas shi lan ta bya ba phyag rdor gyi sprul pa zhig dang / mkhan po skar rgyal bya ba byams pa'i sprul pa zhig dang gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi sku tshad de klu yul na yod pa shes nas/ skar rgyal gyis byams par sprul te/ phyag gi klu shing 'gun dha las bdud rtsi'i char phab nas klu rnams brid par mdzad/ shi lan tas phyag na rdo rjer sprul te/ klu rnams sdigs gzir nas de las byams pas bskyabs te/ sku gzugs spyan drangs nas slar yang ma ga dhar lo lnga brgya'i bar du bzhugs so/ /de yang na lend+ra na sku tshad bzhugs pa'i dus su gnas der gtsug lag khang che ba bcu bzhi/ chung ba dgu bcu go bzhi la sogs pa gtsug lag khang yang shin tu mang zhing /

dge slong paṇḍi ta lnga brgya dge tshul paṇḍi ta lnga brgya/ gtor ma'i slob dpon ku sa li lnga brgya la sogs pa chos smra ba'i gang zag kyang mang du bzhugs pas bstan pa rin po che bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas dar bar yod pa'i tshe/ phyi rol pas ma ga dhar dmag drangs nas bstan pa nyams dmas par byas te/ de nas ring zhig na yul dbus su rnal 'byor pa zhig gis lha mo 'od zer can ma bsgrubs pas 'grub nas dngos grub ci 'dod zer/ bdag rgyal po 'dod byas pas/ khyod shar phyogs su song zer nas phyin pas/ ba glang rdzi'i grong zhig na ma smad gsum ngu ba mthong ste/ khyed ma smad ci la ngu byas pas/ ma de na re/ nga'i bu la rgyal po'i re mos babs zer/ de la ngu ci dgos zer/ do nub ka 'chi dgos zer/ 'o na ngas bu'i tshab bya'am byas pas/ des na rung zer te grong khyer ba rnams kyis rnal 'byor pa de rgyal por dbang bskur bas/ nub mo yul de'i sngar gyi rgyal po'i btsun mo klu ru skyes pa de sbrul zhig tu sprul nas bza' bar byung pa na/ rnal 'byor pa des lha mo 'od zer can ma 'grub pa'i stobs kyis lha mo'i phyag mtshan rdo rje dbyug pas de'i mgo bo bcom ste bsad do/ /nangs par grong khyer ba rnams rol mo dang bcas rgyal po'i spur 'byin du byung ba na/ rgyal po cang ma nyes par mthong nas/ nged kyi rgyal po re mos babs na nub re la 'chi ba yin na/ khyed 'di ltar gyur pa ci yin zer bas/ sngar khyed kyi rgyal po rnams klus bsad 'dug de nged kyis mdang nub btul grub pas/ da khyed rnams rgyal po su 'os pa byas pas skyon med do byas pas/ da khyed rang rgyal por zhu'o zer te/ des kyang btsun mo brgya khab tu bzhes nas rgyal po byas pas mtshan dge ba pha la zhes grags shing / de'i btsun mo zhig gi rmi lam du dge slong zhig gnas g.yar zer ba byung / de'i dus su yul de na dge slong mkhas grub dang ldan pa skye ba la dbang thob pa sa lu bya ba zhig yod pa de'i thugs dgongs la/

dbus 'gyur tshal 'dir sde pa bzhi las gyes pa bco brgyad/ theg pa chen po'i sde zhig bsam gtan gyi sde zhig ste nyi shu yod pa zhig byung ste/ theg pa chen po dar bar bya ste/ de yang da lta nga la nus pa med rgyal po 'di'i sras su gyur na nus pa 'dug dgongs te/ mu tig hab rtse zhig yod pa rgyal po de'i btsun mo sngar gyi rmi lam byung ba de la bcol bas/ rgyal po la zhu yi zer zhus pas bzung zer te bzung / de nas dge slong des dkon mchog mchod rgyal po'i sras su skye ba dang gtsug lag khang 'debs par smon lam btab pas/ re zhig na btsun mo de la sras shig btsas/ cher skyes pa na mu tig gi hab rtse dgos zer bas/ rgyal po dang btsun mo ngo mtshar skyes te sngar gyi dge slong mu tig bcol ba po de'i skye ba yin par yid ches/ rgyal bu de blo sbyong sogs tshegs med du mkhyen te yon tan dang ldan pa zhig byung / de nas des sngar gyi smon lam btab pa bzhin gtsug lag khang brtsigs pas gnod sbyin zhig gis bshig pa na rgyal pos dmag srung bzhag kyang ma thub par slar brtsigs grub pa dang rgyal po rang gis bsrung bar bsdad pas/ gnod sbyin de bshig tu byung ba dang 'thab pas rgyal po rgyal te/ gdon sbyin de na re/ nga'i gnas khyed kyis 'phrogs pas bshig pa yin kyang da ngas khyed mi thub par 'dug pas bdag gis khyod kyi grogs bya yis gtsug lag khang gi ming nga'i ming dang mthun pa thogs zer bas/ rgyal pos kyang ming bi ka ma shi la bya ba gtsug lag khang gi ming du btags te tshul khrims kyi dri dang ldan pa bya ba yin la/ de la rab gnas slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad/ gtsug lag khang der yang ston pa'i dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad de yun ring du bzhugs/ rgyal po de la sras de wa pha la bya ba byung / de'i sras dharmā pha la'i ring la phyi rol pas yul dbus su dmag drangs te gtsug lag khang rnams bshigs/

glegs bam rnams bsregs/ paṇḍi ta rnams bsad de bstan pa nyams dmas pa na/ rgyal po dharmā pha la thugs ma bde nas/ rgya nag rgyal po la yul dbus kyi bstan pa phyi rol mu stegs byed kyis nyams dmas par byas pas/ khyed rgya nag rgyal po thabs mkhas la stobs che bas/ nga'i bstan pa gso ba'i grogs su dmag gtong dgos pa'i 'phrin springs pa na/ rgya nag rgyal pos gos srub med pa gon pa na thugs khar dpal be'u bung bung yod pa zhig gis thog drangs zang zing skyel rgya dpang che ba lan gsum du byung bas/ rgyal po dharmā pha las skyes de dag la brten nas phyi rol pa pham par byas/ gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa sogs bstan pa rin po che sngar bzhin du dar rgyas su gyur pa na/ 'di bzhin 'byung ba rgya nag rgyal po'i drin yin pas/ skyes lan bzang po 'dod du 'ong snyam tsa na/ re zhig nas rgya nag rgyal pos pho nya ba mngags te/ rgya nag rgyal po'i yul 'di na bsod nams bsog pa'i zhing mchod pa 'bul ba'i rten khyad par can med pas/ khyod kyi mchod yul sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs de dge slong bzhi dang bcas te bsring dgos pa'i springs yig dang bcas slebs pas/ rgya nag rgyal po drin che bas da mi bskur ba'i thabs med snyam/ o danta pu ri'i gtsug lag khang nas jo bo shākya mu ne zhes bya ba ston pa dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad dang / dge slong mngon pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa gcig mdo sde'i sde snod 'dzin pa gcig 'dul ba'i sde snod 'dzin pa gcig theg chen gyi sde snod 'dzin pa gcig ste bzhi dang bcas pa sngar gyi skyel lan du brdzangs te rgya nag tu lo lnga brgya bzhugs so/ /dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad ni nyang ban chos 'byung las gong du bkod pa ltar/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis rgyu bshams bi shwa karmas dgung lo nyer lnga pa'i sku tshad dang / bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad dang gsum po lhan cig tu bzhengs pa la bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis phyag nas mdzad par bshad/

yang lo rgyus gzhan las/ brgyad pa'i sku tshad 'di rgyal po kri kris bzhengs pa sangs rgyas 'od srung gis rab gnas mdzad par yang bshad la/ de lta bu'i sku tshad de rgya gar rgyal po dharmā pha la dang / bal po'i rgyal po dharmā a shwa bya ba gnyis skyel bskur res byas pa'i sgo nas grogs su gyur nas bal po'i rgyal pos rgya gar rgyal por rin po che glang po che'i rgyab cig skyel du btang ba'i lan du/ rgya gar rgyal pos sangs rgyas dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje btang ste sku 'di nyid yang bal yul du lo lnga brgya bzhugs nas 'gro don mdzad par grags so/ /yang gsung rten gyi thog ma ni/ ston pas chos kyi 'khor lo bar pa bskor ba'i tshe/ brgya byin gyis gser gyi shog bu la baiḍurya'i zhun mas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo bris te lha'i gnas su mchod cing bkur bsti byas par bshad pa dang / rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan sogs gzungs mang po glegs bam du byas te rgyal mtshan gyi rtser btags pas lha ma yin gyi g.yul las rgyal bar gsungs pa rnams yin la/ thugs kyi rten ni sku'i rten rnams dang lhan cig tu byon pa'i lha'i phyag mtshan sogs te/ de lta bu'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams bod yul du thog mar byon pa ni/ bod kyi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa bdun pa lha tho tho ri snyan btsan gyi ring la dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes zhes pa ltar/ rgyal po'i pho brang yum bu glang mkhar gyi steng du rin po che'i sgrom bu zhig babs pa kha phye ba na gser gyi mchod rten khru gang pa zhig byung ste sku gsung thugs kyi rten gsum gyi nang nas sku chos sku'i rten dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi rten gsum gyi nang nas sangs rgyas kyi rten no/ /yang tsinta ma ṇi'i gzungs/ za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo/ dpang skong phyag rgya pa gsum byung ba/

sku gsung thugs kyi nang nas gsung rten/ dkon mchog gsum gyi nang nas chos kyi rten te de dag ni bod 'dir rten la snga ba yin la/ de'i rjes su srong btsan sgam pos dam pa'i chos kyi srol btod ces grags pa ltar/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku ring la/ phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa blon po mgar zhes grags pa des/ bal po'i rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i sras mo bal mo bza' khri btsun bod du spyan drangs pa'i dus su sangs rgyas dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje dang / byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo/ rang byon sgrol ma ste sku'i rten dang / baiḍūrya'i lhung bzed gsol ba gang btab kyi 'bras bu dus su 'jo ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu ste 'di rnams bal yul nas byon no/ /de nas blon po des slar yang rgya nag rgyal po'i sras mo sgrol ma'i sprul pa rgya bza' kong jo bod 'dir spyan drangs dus/ ston pa dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad jo bo shākya mu ne zhes yongs su grags pa sangs rgyas nyid dang gnyis su med pa 'di nyid legs par spyan drangs/ de nas bal mo bzas 'o thang gi mtsho bsubs te ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ rgya mo bzas ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ rgyal po nyid kyis sa dgra gnon pa'i phyir ru bzhi'i dang / mtha' 'dul/ yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang la sogs pa bzhengs/ khyad par du sku rgyu spungs pa las jo bo rang byon bcu gcig zhal byon pa sogs sku'i rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon/ gsung gi rten ni/ de dus bod na yi ge med pa la thon mi a nu'i bu thon mi sambho ṭa rgya gar la yi ge slob par btang pas/ des yi ge dang lo tsā legs par shes te bod du byon nas rgyal po la sgra dang yi ge bslabs pas tshegs med du mkhyen/ thon mis bod kyi skad dang bstun nas gsal byed sum cu/

dbyangs yig gug skyed bzhir bsdus/ dbyibs kha che'i yi ge dang bstun nas bod yig bcos/ sum cu pa dang rtags 'jug sogs brtsams/ mdo za ma tog bkod pa dang / padma dkar po sogs bsgyur te glegs bam du 'bri ba mdzad/ de'i rjes su khri srong lde'u btsan gyis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad ces pa ltar 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis rgya gar gyi slob dpon byang chub sems dpa' bo dhi satwa dang / u rgyan gyi slob dpon padma sambha wa spyan drangs te dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang dbu rtse chen mor byang chub chen po dang / gling bzhi gling phran brgyad sogs rgyal po nyid kyis bzhengs/ btsun mo gsum gyis dge rgyas li ma'i gling sogs jo mo gling gsum du grags pa rnams bzhengs shing / chos mang du bsgyur nas glegs bam bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'bri bar mdzad do/ /de'i rjes su mnga' bdag khri ral pa can gyis 'on ljang rdo'i gtsug lag khang sogs gtsug lag khang sku gsung thugs dang bcas pa mang po dang / rgya gar nas paṇḍi ta mang du spyan drangs te chos bsgyur du bcug nas glegs bam bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhengs so/ /de nas bstan pa phyi dar la lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis mthon thing gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ lo chen rin chen bzang po sogs rgya gar la chos slob par btang ste/ lo chen des chos mang du bsgyur nas glegs bam du bris/ bse 'bag nag po phur shes sogs sku gzugs khyad par can mang du spyan drangs/ yo ga'i lha tshogs sogs rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mang du bsgrubs/ pho brang zhi ba 'od dang / lha btsun byang chub 'od kyis kyang sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku brnyan bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhengs par mdzad la/ de tsam nas bzung ste bod yul 'dir gtsug lag khang sogs rten gsum bgrang ba las 'das pa byon pa yin la/

'o na lha khang rnams rten gsum gang gi nang du 'du zhe na/ gtsug lag khang ni sku gsung thugs kyi rten gsum gyi nang nas sku'i rten du 'du bar gsungs pa yin no/ /de rnams kyi sgo nas de dag 'jig rten gyi khams su thog mar ji ltar byon pa'i tshul bstan zin to/ /spyi don gsum pa rjes su dad ldan dag rten bzhengs ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ thog mar gang du bzhugs pa'i gnas sam/ bzhengs pa'i sa yul legs par btsal bar bya dgos te/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad phyi nang gi rten 'brel khyad du ma bsad cing legs par bsgrigs pa las 'byung bas so/ /de yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i gnas sam byin gyis brlabs pa'i sa phyogs dang / gang zag khyad par can gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas dang / chos ldan gyi bya ba khyad par can 'byung bzhin pa'am sngon byung nas re zhig rgyun chad pa'ang rung ste bya ba mi shis pas bar du ma chod pa bkra shis pa'i gnas su grags shing grub pa'i yul phyogs yin na phyi'i sa dpyad brtag pa la sogs pa mi shes pa'am ma grub kyang dge legs ngang gis 'byung bas na brtag pa sogs nges par bya mi dgos la/ de lta bu ma yin na yul gyi dge yon dang / sa'i dpyad legs par brtag par bya ste/ de yang yul la dge bcu tshang na mchog dang / dge brgyad sogs kyang yul bzang bar bzung zhing / de man chad ci rigs tshang ba rnams kyang mang ba dag bzang zhing / nyung ba rnams ngan par shes par bya'o/ /dge bcu ni sa'i dge la khang sa dang zhing sar bzang ba gnyis/ chu'i dge la 'thung chu dang zhing chur bzang ba gnyis/ rtswa'i dge la gam 'brog dang rgyang 'brog tu bzang ba gnyis/ shing gi dge la khang shing dang bud shing du bzang ba gnyis/ rdo'i dge la khang rdo dang 'thag rdor bzang ba gnyis te bcu po 'di dag yin la/ gnyis tshan 'di dag cig yod sar cig shos yod par dkon pas na/

sngon 'khon dpal po ches yul btsal bas bsam yas la yul gyi dge bcu char tshang yang rgyal pos bzung tshar/ la stod ya chang la dang po brgyad tshang bar gzigs nas yul du bzung ba yin pas yul gyi dge de dag tshang ba dang / med pa shas che chung legs par brtags te dge mang po'i sa phyogs bzung bar bya zhing / sa dpyad la zhib tu phye na bsam gyis mi khyab kyang gtso bo ni/ sgra pa shes rab rin chen gyi dpal 'byor rgya mtsho las/ dpyad kyi gtso bo byang skyabs shing / /lho la mdun bstan lho nub gzhol/ /rgyab ri nye zhing mtho ba dang / /mdun ri ring zhing dma' ba dang / /nyi ma 'char snga rgas pa 'phyi/ /chu rgyun g.yas su 'bab pa rnams/ /kun tshang dpal ldan sa skya sogs/ /re re tsam las med par grags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi dpyad thams cad tshang ba ni shin tu dkon pas na phal cher tshang ba dag shis shing / de dag gtan nas ma tshang ba'am 'ga' re tsam yod pa yang ngan par bya ba dang / gzhan yang sa dpyad brtag pa'i tshe sa'i mdun rgyab dang / gdags srib shes dgos par gsungs pa'i mdun rgyab ni/ shar dang lho gnyis mdun dang / nub dang byang rgyab tu phal cher la shes dgos shing / yang lung pa rang rang gi gshis dang yang bstun na gang du kha bltas pa de shar dang / g.yas lho/ g.yon rgyab gnyis nub byang du 'dzin dgos la/ gdags srib ni shar dang lho gnyis gdags dang / nub dang byang gnyis srib yin zhing / yul gyi gshis dang bstun nas gdags srib 'jog lugs kyang snga ma la dpags te shes par bya'o/ /gzhan yang sa la pho mor mtshon pa'i rtags yod med dang / kha dog bzang ngan dang / ri la rgyal blon btsun mo'i ri gsum dang / srog chags nyal ldang sogs dang / rdzas nor bu dang / dug sbrul gyi gzugs sogs rdzas gzugs yod med rnams kyang legs par brtags te/ pho mo'i sa gnyis kyi nang nas kha dog sngo smug dang mdangs gsal zhing snum pa sogs dang /

ri rgyal blon btsun mo gsum gyi rtsa bar lha khang sogs 'debs pa bzang la/ srog chags mi 'gro 'dug sogs dang / rdzas gzugs nor bu 'dra ba sogs bzang zhing / dug sbrul 'dra ba sogs ngan par shes pa dang / gzhan yang sa la bzang po'i dpyad lha bzhi'i sa/ ya rab lnga'i sa/ yon tan gyi sa/ phyug pa'i sa/ mdzes pa'i sa/ snying po'i sa rnams la drug drug dang / mu yad kyi sa brgyad/ 'dod pa'i sa brgyad/ yon tan gyi sa brgyad/ gang ba'i sa brgyad/ bzhed stangs kyi sa brgyad/ gces pa'i sa dgu bzang po'i sa bcu/ gdab par 'os pa'i sa nyi shu/ mi thub pa'i sa nyi shu/ ngas rigs bzang po drug cu rtsa gsum/ nor nyen gyi sa nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa dang / gzhan yang grog po dang / shing dang / chu dang / lam la sogs pa'i dge yon gyi mtshan ma rnams nges par byas nas gdab 'os pa'i mtshan ma dang ldan pa dag brtsam par bya zhing / gal te gdab mi 'os pa'am sa dgra lta bu'i cung zad mi shis pa yod pa dag la sa dgra 'chos pa'i thabs gsung rab nas 'byung ba bzhin tshul 'di'i lag len la mkhas pa dag bsten nas legs par bcos te blang dor la 'bad par bya'o/ /'di dag gi rnam gzhag rgyas par ni tshwa rong pa bsod nams 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i rten gsum bzhugs gnas dang bcas pa bzhengs tshul yon tan 'byung gnas dang / sgra pa shes rin pas mdzad pa'i dpal 'byor rgya mtsho sogs su blta bar bya'o/ /de ltar sa btsal zhing sa dpyad legs par brtag pa byas nas gtsug lag khang sogs bzhengs pa'i sar 'os shing rung la/ 'gal rkyen med cing mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa rnyed na/ de nas mi dang mi ma yin pa la sa bslangs/ byin pa na brko zhing sa sbyangs pa dang / bzung ba dang / byin gyis brlabs pa dang / bsrung ba la sogs pa sa'i cho ga rnams bya bar bshad pas/ de dag ni dkyil chog rnams dang / sa'i cho ga logs su bkod pa dag nas 'byung ba bzhin byas pa yin no/ /sa der gtsug lag khang sogs ji ltar bzhengs pa'i cho ga'i rnam gzhag kyang gong gi yi ge gnyis po der gsal lo/

/de lta bu'i gtsug lag khang sogs kyi nang du bzhugs pa'i rten gsum gyi bzhengs tshul la/ tshwa rong pa'i yon tan 'byung gnas las/ sngon 'gro rgyu rkyen mtshan nyid ni/ /yon bdag bzo bo rgyu dang rkyen/ /tshad ldan 'dzoms na khyad 'phags 'byung / /zhes 'byung ba ltar/ yon bdag dang / bzo bo dang / rgyu rkyen mchog dang ldan pa 'dzoms na rten yang bzang ba yid du 'ong ba 'byung zhing / de dag 'bring na rten yang 'bring / de dag tha ma las rten yang tha ma 'byung bas na/ yon bdag kyang / sdig la mi 'dzems dad 'dun chung / /tshe 'di'i lo 'dod 'gran 'dod blo/ /ngang thung theg chung 'gyod sems can/ /mi 'grub bsgrub 'dod 'phror 'jog dang / /phan yon dag la the tshom zhing / /lha dang lha bzo dmod pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar gyi skyon rnams dang mi ldan zhing / /dad 'dun brtson 'grus snying rjer ldan/ /dge la mngon spro gtong phod can/ /brtan zhing ngang ring g.yo sgyu med/ /lha dang bzo la gus pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar rten bzhengs pa la phan yon rgya chen po mthong ba'i shes rab dang ldan pa/ rten bzhengs pa la blo rtse gcig pa'i bsam gtan dang ldan pa/ rten bzhengs pa la spro zhing 'dun pas brtson 'grus dang ldan pa/ rten gyi rgyu tshogs bsgrub pa'i dka' spyad la mi skyo zhing / gzhan la snying rje'i sgo nas bzod sran che ba bzod pa dang ldan pa/ rten gyi rgyu tshogs bsgrub la ngang ring zhing tshig 'jam pas tshul khrims dang ldan pa/ g.yo sgyu med par gtong phod che bas sbyin pa dang ldan pa ste phar phyin drug dang ldan zhing lha dang bzo bo la gus pas/ rten bzhengs pa la dga' spro dang ldan pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa ni yon bdag mchog dang / de dag phal cher dang ldan pa ni 'bring dang / ci rigs pa dang ldan pa yang rten bzhengs pa'i yon bdag tu gzung ngo / /lha bzo ba ni/ yon tan mi mkhas nga rgyal che/ /'grogs pa mi bde bkur bsti 'dod/

/'phral du tshig rtsub phugs 'dod che/ /yon rgyags gla thang tshad med 'bebs/ /des kyang ma tshim rgyu cha brku/ /cung zad tsam la bzo 'jog byed/ /'gro sdigs byed cing chang nag 'tshol/ /cung zad myos tshe smyon pa 'dra/ /dge las sdig par bsgyur ba po/ /zhes pa ltar gyi skyon dang mi ldan pa zhig dgos te/ de dag dang ldan pa'i bzo bo ni shi nas ngan song gsum las 'gro sa med pas de lta bu'i bzo bo ni mi brten zhing rgyang ring du spangs dgos par gsungs pas so/ /des na bzo bo'i yon tan ni/ sambu ṭir/ dul zhing dad ldan lang tshor babs/ /dbang po rnam gsal rnam rtog med/ /khro med lkog 'phyas med pa dang / /shin tu mkhas la spro ba dang / /bzod ldan snying rje che ldan pas/ /zhes dang / sdom 'byung las/ dul zhing bzo rnams kun shes la/ /cho ga mthong zhing mnyam bzhag pas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi yon tan dang ldan pa'i steng du/ 'dod pa chung zhing bkur ba sla/ /bzo la gzob cing rkyen ngan bzod/ /brtan cing ngang ring mkhas la nyan/ /lha la gus shing 'grogs bde ba'o/ /zhes pa'i yon tan rnams kyang ldan pa'o/ /rten gyi rgyu ni/ 'bur sku la rab rin chen mchog dang / 'bring gser dngul dang shel bzang po sogs/ tha ma zangs dang ra gan sogs dang / dar gos dang sman bzang gi lde gu sogs dang / phal pa ni rdo dang / shing dang / 'jim pa sogs la bya bar bshad cing / bris sku ni phal cher ras bzang dang / gos dar la yang rung la/ glegs bam ni/ rab gser dngul la ljang brdungs kyi shog bu la baiḍūrya zhun ma dang / gser zhun mas 'bri/ 'bring na mthing shog la gser dang / gser dngul spel mas 'bri/ tha ma shog skya'am shing shun la snag tshas 'bri ba dag go /thugs rten gyi rdo rje dang / gsung rten dril bu'i yu ba gser dngul ra gan sogs dang / dril bu'i khog pa 'khar bzang ba las bya zhing / thugs rten bum pa la sogs pa yang rab 'bring gi rgyu tshogs shes par bya ba sogs mdor na shing dang sa rdo la sogs kyang gang bzang dang spus gang dag mi 'grub blo rgyar ma song tsam gyis rtsal 'don ched gnyer du byas nas bzo bo la gtad/

bzo bos kyang bzo rgyu'i go rim ma log pa dang / skabs su babs pa'i lag cha pir dang smyu gu gzong sogs gang la gang dgos gsar bzo dang / rnying bcos sla bcos su ma song ba nan tan du bsgrubs te phun sum tshogs par bsogs pa dang / gnyis ka la dgos pa'i zhal bkod pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdo sngags kyi bstan pa 'dzin cing 'chad par 'gyur ba/ sa phyogs dang gnas dang rten gsum gyi mtshan nyid la mkhas pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi yon tan yongs rdzogs tshang ba zhig kyang nges par 'tshol ba sogs rkyen thams cad 'tshogs par byas nas rten dag bzhengs par bya dgos te/ 'di dag gi khyad par las bzo khyad mchog dman sna tshogs 'byung bas so/ /de ltar rgyu rkyen sogs legs par 'dzoms nas bzhugs gnas yin na sa chog dang 'brel bar arga'i cho ga bya zhing / sku gzugs kyi rten kho na yin na sa chog med kyang arga'i cho ga bya bar bshad pas/ 'di la rten gsar pa la rgyas pa'i ar chog dang / rnying pa la spo ba'i ar chog gnyis su gsungs la/ 'di dag gi tho yig tsam zhig rje btsun rin po ches mdzad cing / lag len bde ba ni tshwa rong pa sogs kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge mang du snang ba las rtogs par bya'o/ /de ltar legs par bzhengs rgyu'i rten rnams kyang phyag tshad dang ldan pa dgos te/ de dang mi ldan na nyes dmigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung bar bshad pas so/ /de ltar yang sdom 'byung las/ kos ko mgrin pa byin pa ste/ /gsum po ring na skyon chen po/ /sngags pa bdag nyid nges par ni/ /gnas ma nyams shing bskrad par 'gyur/ /snyan dang shangs dang phyag sor rnams/ /gsum po thung na skyon chen no/ /dngos grub nges par 'joms pa dang / /de bzhin dpal yang nyams par 'gyur/ /byin pa zhal dang mkhur tshos te/ /gsum po sbom na skyon chen no/ /sgrub po bdag nyid nges par yang / /dpal las ring zhing bdud bgegs 'byung /

/'gram pa brang dang rtsib logs te/ /gsum po gzhom na skyon chen no/ /'dir ni bgegs 'byung the tshom med/ /nu ma shangs dang dpral ba ste/ /gsum po yo na skyon chen no/ /sgrub po de dag myur bar ni/ /dgra yi rtsod pas gdung par 'gyur/ /brla dang sku dang nam tshong ste/ /gsum po nyams na skyon chen yin/ /chom rkun sogs kyis 'joms pa'am/ /'chi bar 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /snyan dang mchu dang dpral ba dang / /shangs nyams spyan ni yo ba'i skyon/ /nges par sngags pa bdag nyid la/ /sna tshogs bgegs 'byung 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gyen du gzigs zhing dbugs skyod tshul/ /gdan las yo zhing skyod lta bus/ /rang gi gnas nas nges 'pho zhing / /don rnams 'joms pa nyid du 'gyur/ /mgrin pa nam tshong la sogs sku'i/ /skyon ni grangs med cig tu grags/ /'dir ni spyan sogs yo ba'am/ /phyag rgya phyag mtshan nor gyur na/ /mya ngan sdug bsngal gyis rab gdung / /de phyir skyon brtags bcos par bya/ /rgyab yol gdugs dang gdan rnams te/ /gsum po chung zhing dog pa'i skyon/ /mdza' bos mi nyan brjod pa dang / /dpal nyams 'chi bar 'gyur ba yin/ /skyon 'di dag ni skyon chen no/ /mkhas pas legs par brtags par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa yin la/ 'o na rten bzhengs par mi rigs so snyam na/ phyag tshad dang mi ldan na nyes dmigs che yang / de dang ldan pa'i rten bzhengs pa la phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ sdom 'byung las/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs rdzogs shing / /gzugs mdzes pa ni bzhengs par bya/ /zhi la zhi ba'i tshul gyi sku/ /khro la drag cing 'jigs pa'i zhal/ /dpa' la dpa' zhing nga rgyal sku/ /sgeg pa la ni bzhad pa'i zhal/ /mtshan nyid 'di ltar mtshon nas ni/ /sngags pa rnams kyis bris sku bri/ /sngags pa las ni dang po pas/ /gzugs brnyan la sogs byas pa de/ /bris sku bsgrub na myur du ni/ /dngos grub rgya chen thob par 'gyur/

/zhes gsungs pas na dkon mchog gsum gyi rten phyag tshad dang ldan pa ci nas kyang bzhengs rigs pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i phyag tshad la yang / mchod rten gyi phyag tshad dang / sku gzugs kyi phyag tshad gnyis las/ dang po la che chung gi tshad ni/ mdo mang po las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel bzhugs pa'i mchod rten rgyar dpag tshad tsam zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pa ltar shin tu che ba dang / mdo kha cig las/ mchod rten ni kyu ru ra tsam zhes gsungs pa ltar shin tu chung ba yang bshad pas gcig tu ma nges so/ /so so'i 'phang sogs kyi tshad ni sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba mang yang / rang lugs ni tshwa rong pa'i yon tan 'byung gnas dang / stag tshangs pa'i dpal 'byor rgya mtsho dang / gzhan yang mchod rten gyi thig gdab tshul gyi yi ge tshad ldan dag las rtogs par bya yis/ 'dir ni yi ges 'jigs nas ma bris so/ /gnyis pa sku gzugs kyi tshad ni/ tshwa rong pa'i yon tan 'byung gnas las/ rdo rje sems dpa' bzhengs pa'i tshe/ /gdong pa dgu las 'da' ba med/ /zhi ma khro la gdong tshad brgyad/ /shin tu khros la gdong tshad drug /ces pa tshad mar mdzad nas/ zhi ba'i sku dang / zhi ma khro dang / khro bo gsum ka la zhal gdong rang sor bcu gnyis pa re khyad par med pa mdzad nas zhal gdong gi tshad des sku lus byin gyis tshad thams cad 'jal dgos par gsungs shing / 'jal tshul yang zhi ba'i sku la kos ko dang / shangs dang / dpral ba gsum la rang sor bzhi bzhi ste bcu gnyis/ skra mtshams yan chad la rang sor bzhi/ mgrin pa la yang rang sor bzhi/ mgrin pa nas thugs kha'i bar dang thugs kha nas lte ba'i bar dang / lte ba nas gsang gnas kyi bar gsum la zhal gdong re re ste rang sor bcu gnyis pa re/ brla dang byin pa gnyis la zhal gdong gnyis gnyis te rang sor nyi shu rtsa bzhi re/ long bu man chad la rang sor bzhi ste sku'i srid du zhal gdong dgu'am rang sor brgya dang brgyad/

phyag 'dom rgyang na'ang de dang 'dra bas gru bzhi pa 'byung zhing / rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na chu zheng gab pa'i sku 'byung bar bzhed/ zhi ma khro la zhal gdong sngar ltar la/ skra mtshams yan la rang sor phyed dang bzhi/ mgrin pa la yang rang sor phyed bzhi/ de nas thugs kha dang / thugs kha nas lte ba dang / lte ba nas gsang gnas kyi bar la rang sor phyed dang bcu gcig re/ brla dang byin pa gnyis la rang sor nyer gcig pa re/ long bu man la rang sor phyed bzhi ste srid du zhal tshad brgyad dam/ rang sor dgu bcu go drug pa 'phrad du yang de dang mnyam pas chu zheng 'gab/ shin tu khros pa la zhal tshad rang sor bcu gnyis pa sngar dang 'dra la skra mtshams yan chad du rang sor gsum/ mgrin pa mngon kyang gzhal rgyu med pas/ kos ko nas gsang gnas kyi bar la zhal gdong gi tshad phyed dang gsum/ brla dang byin pa gnyis la zhal gdong gi tshad re re long bu man la rang sor gsum ste sku'i srid du zhal gdong gi tshad drug gam/ rang sor bdun cu don gnyis 'byung la/ 'di mi'u thung gi rnam pa yin pas 'phred du rang sor drug cu re brgyad dam/ zhal gdong gi tshad phyed dang drug dang rang sor gnyis 'byung bas chu zheng mi 'gab kyang skyon med par bzhed/ des na tshwa rong pa'i bzhed pas/ zhi ba'i phyag tshad sdom 'byung dang / /sha ri'i bu yis zhus bzhin gtso/ /khro bo gshin rje gshed rgyud las/ /gsungs pa'i phyag tshad gtso bor gyis/ /dus kyi 'khor lo chu zheng du/ /sor brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / /sdom pa 'byung bar khro bo'i tshad/ /gdong tshad bcu gnyis gsungs pa sogs/ /rang dgar 'jug pa dgag par mngon/ /zhes gsungs nas/ dus 'khor las rang sor brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lngar gsungs pa sogs slob dpon med par sku gzugs kyi phyag tshad rang dgar byed pa dgag pa'i phyir grangs mang bar bshad pa yin pas sngar gyi phyag tshad bshad pa dag dus 'khor dang 'gal ba'i skyon yang med par bshad do/

/yang sgra pa shes rab rin chen gyi rig gnas kun shes las/ sku la longs sku rang sor brgya dang ni/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga dus kyi 'khor lor gsungs/ /sprul sku rang sor brgya dang brgyad pa yi/ /bcu gnyis pa ru rigs pas thob pa bzhin/ /gzhung lugs gzhan las 'byung bzhin lag len bya/ /zhes gsungs shing / de bzhin du rten gsum bzhengs tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtshor/ mi mkhas pa dag rdo rje sems dpa' bzhengs pa'i tshad/ /gdong pa dgu las 'da' ba med/ /zhi ma khro la gdong tshad brgyad/ /rab tu khro la gdong tshad drug /ces pa 'di kha ston du byed cing zhal re la sor bcu gnyis mar bzhag nas/ zhal dgu la rang sor brgya dang brgyad yod pa 'di rang gis 'thad par byas te/ dus 'khor nas sor mo brgya nyer lnga dang / sdom 'byung 'grel pa sogs su zhal bcu gnyis ma yang gsungs pa rnams rang dgar 'jug pa dgag pa'i drang don du 'dod pa dag gis ni tshul 'di lta bu khong du ma tshud pas nongs so/ /zhes gsungs nas tshwa rong pas de la zur za 'dra zhig mdzad nas/ rang gi bzhed pa ni/ de ltar zhal phyag rnam ldan lha/ /shin tu zhi dang zhi ma khro/ /khro dang shin tu khros pa bzhi/ /dang po'i phyag tshad gtsor byas nas/ /gzhan rnams khyad par cung zad brjod/ /phal cher shugs la rtogs par 'gyur/ /dang po la yang longs sprul gnyis/ /longs sku bzhugs dang bzhengs pa gnyis/ /gnyis ka'i thun mong chu zheng ni/ /sangs rgyas sor mo brgya nyer lnga/ /zhal re phyed bcas bcu gnyis pa/ /zhal bcur chu zheng mtshungs phyir ro/ /dag pa'i byang sems longs sku dang / /sangs rgyas sprul sku bde kye sogs/ /sor phyed bcu po phri ba yis/ /brgya dang nyi shu chu zheng mnyam/ /sar gnas byang sems longs sku dang / /phag mo spyan sogs gshegs ma dang / /sangs rgyas sprul sku shāka thub sogs/ /zhal dgu sor mo brgya dang brgyad/ /dgu brgyad gnyis ka zhi ma khro/ /khro bo phal cher zhal tshad brgyad/

/sor mo dgu bcu drug par 'dod/ /shin tu khros la zhal lnga dang / /sor mo drug cu re gnyis sogs/ /zhal tshad gsum pa'ang bshad ces grags/ /rgyal ba'i sprul sku yin na yang / /khro bo rnams la mtshan dpe yi/ /phyag ring mdzes sogs mi dgos kyis/ /mi sdug bco brgyad la sogs pa/ /gang la gang 'dul nges med yin/ /rgyal ba'i zhal tshad bcu po ni/ /gtsug tor skra mtshams mdzod spu rnams/ /sor bzhi phyed dang lnga dang bzhi/ /shangs rtse kos ko mgrin pa yang / /de bzhin snying lte gsang gnas rnams/ /zhal re phyed bcas bcu gnyis pa'o/ /brla dang rje ngar zhal do do/ /dpyi dang pus mo long bu man/ /bzhi bzhi phyed bcas bzhi pa ste/ /zhabs mthil bcu bzhi 'dir mi bgrang / /de bzhin 'doms la'ang zhal bcu ste/ /dbus nas phrag par zhal gang dang / /bar lhu phyag ngar phyag mgo rnams/ /nyi shu bcu drug phyag gang ste/ /gru mo mkhrig ma sum gnyis re'o/ /gtsug tor dbus su tshud pa yi/ /thor cog rgyal la bcu gnyis dang / /dpa' bo sems dpa' brgyad dam dgu/ /thor cog srid la mi rtsi'o/ /zhes gsungs nas/ zhal tshad bcu pa la/ gtsug tor sor mo bzhi/ de nas skra mtshams yan chad la sor mo phyed dang lnga/ de nas mdzod spu yan chad sor bzhi ste/ de la zhal gang du 'jog shangs rtse nas kos ko de nas mgrin phreng 'og ma'i bar la yang de bzhin dang / de nas thugs kha dang / lte ba nas gsang gnas kyi bar la zhal re re gtsug tor nas gsang gnas kyi bar la zhal gdong gi tshad lnga/ brla dang brje ngar la zhal do do/ dpyi dang pus mo gnyis la sor bzhi bzhi/ long bu man la sor mo phyed dang lnga ste gsang gnas nas rting pa'i bar la zhal lnga dang bcu po thams cad sor mo phyed dang bcu gsum mar mnyam pas yongs sdom srid du sor mo brgya nyer lnga dang / de bzhin du 'doms su lnga brgya nyer lnga ste/ brang gi tshangs thig nas phrag pa'i bar la zhal gdong gi tshad gang ste sor mo phyed dang bcu gsum/

bar lhu la sor mo nyi shu/ phyag ngar la sor mo bcu drug phyag mgo la sor mo phyed dang bcu gsum ste zhal tshad gang / gru mo dang mkhrig mar sum gnyis re ste zhal tshad bcu'am sor mo brgya nyi shu ste chu zheng gab pa'o/ /dag pa'i byang sems kyi sku dang / sprul sku mchog bde kyai sogs kyi sku la sor mo brgya dang nyi shur chu zheng mnyam pa dang / sar gnas kyi byang sems kyi sku dang / phag mo dang / spyan ma sogs de bzhin gshegs ma'i sku dang / sprul sku mchog ma yin pa shāka thub sogs kyi sku ni zhal gdong gi tshad de nyid dgu'am sor mo brgya dang brgyad par chu zheng mnyam pa zhi ma khro'i sku la zhal tshad brgyad pa dang dgu pa gnyis ci rigs pa tshang ba/ khro bo phal cher zhal brgyad pa'am/ sor mo dgu bcu go drug pa dang / shin tu khros pa la zhal tshad lnga pa'i/ sor mo drug cu re gnyis pa yin par bzhed cing / de dag rtsi tshul yang / zhal tshad kyi grangs ni dbu che chung dang / yan lag ring thung sogs kyis bzhag la/ sor grangs ni zhal so so'i bcu gnyis cha'am phyed dang bcu gsum cha la bzhag nas brtsi bar bya ba yin no zhes gsungs pas/ de ltar tshwa rong pa dang / stag tshang pa gnyis po cung zad mi mthun par snang bas/ stag tshang pa'i lugs 'di ltar na/ phyag zhabs sogs lhu lag shin tu ring ba zhig 'byung bar snang bas cung zad mi mdzes pa'i rnam pa 'byung dogs la/ des na phyag tshad dang mi mthun pa med phyin mdzes pa yang gal che bar snang ste/ ji skad du/ lus la mdzes pa ma tshang na/ /tshad dag gis ni ci zhig bya/ /zhes gsungs pas so snyam ste dpyad par bya'o/ /thugs rten rdo rje dang kha ṭāṃ ga bum pa sogs kyi tshad ni/ spyir rdor dril gyi tha snyad tsam zhig mdo sde 'ga' zhig nas bshad cing / bya spyod gnyis nas lag len yang byed mod kyis phyag tshad sogs kyi mtshan nyid ni yo ga dang bla med kho na nas 'byung bas/

de la phyi nang gi rdor dril gnyis las/ dang po ni yo ga nas bshad pa'i rdor dril gyi mtshan nyid can dang / phyi ma ni bla med las bshad pa'i rdor dril gyi mtshan nyid can te/ de yang rtse lnga dang rtse dgu pa gang yin yang rwa rnams chu srin gyi kha nas ma 'thon zhing padma la gnas pa dang / mtha' rwa'i rtse rnams dbus rwa dngos la ma zug par dbus rwa'i mthar padma dang 'khor lo la sogs pa'i mtshon byed kyis bskor ba la zug cing / rwa rnams tsher ma ltar rno zhing zur dang ldan pa ma yin par zlum por gnas pa dang / dril bu'i tshangs mgo'i zhal gyi 'og tu bum pa'i dod du bug pa yod pa dang / rdza ma'i steng gi pad 'dab kyi shar du spyan ma'i sa bon nam phyag mtshan yod pa rnams ni yo ga nas bshad pa phyi'i rdor dril yin la/ de rnams las ldog cing sgrol ma'i sa bon nam phyag mtshan yod pa ni bla med kyi rgyud sambu ṭi dang / sdom 'byung sogs nas bshad pa nang gi rdor dril yin no/ /de gnyis lte ba dang phyogs kyi rwa rnams sum cha mnyam dang / rdo rje'i bar gyi sum cha yang sum cha mnyam du byas pa'i bar ma lte bar bshad pa sogs rdor dril gyi phyag tshad dang mtshan nyid dag pa sogs kyi rnam gzhag rdor dril gyi rnam bshad dag las rgyas par 'byung zhing / sgra pa shes rab rin pa'i dpal 'byor rgya mtsho sogs las zhib par bshad do/ /kha ṭwāṃ ga ni/ rtse mor rdo rje rtse lnga pa rdzogs pa/ de'i 'og tu mi mgo skam po gsum brtsegs/ de'i 'og tu sna tshogs rdo rje/ yu ba'i rtse mor rdo rje rtse gcig pas mtshan pa dang / yang na rtse mo sna tshogs rdo rje/ de nas mi mgo skam po gcig de nas rlon pa gnyis/ des nas rdo rje rtse lnga rdzogs pa la ba dan gsum 'phyang ba/ de nas bum pa shing lo'i kha rgyan can rnams byas pa/ gnyis ka'i yu ba'i stod sbom zhing smad phra ba dril chung dang bcas pa dgos par bshad cing /
