gzhung gzhan las mi mgo skam rid rlon pa gsum brtsegs par yang bshad do/ /bum pa la zhi rgyas/ bsad bskrad/ dbang dgug reng ba'i bum pa rnams las/ dang po gnyis kyi lto sbom du sor bcu drug zhabs nas kha'i bar gyi dpangs sor nyi shu las mgrin pa sor drug kha'i rgya sor brgyad kyi dbus su sum cha bum pa/ mthar mchu sor gnyis 'phyang ba yin la/ gsum pa dang bzhi pa gnyis kyi sbom du sor bcu gnyis/ dpangs su nyer bzhi las mgrin pa sor brgyad yon po/ kha sor drug mchu sor gcig go /lnga pa dang drug pa gnyis la bzo bo mkhas pas ji ltar byas pa ma gtogs tshad ma bshad cing / bdun pa la rgya dpangs mnyam par sor bcu drug pa/ mgrin pa sor bzhi/ kha sor dgu mchu sbom zhing sor gnyis pa bya bar bshad do/ /gsung rten glegs bam gyi tshad ni/ rgyud 'ga' zhig las skra gseb dang mchan khung du sba bar gsungs pas sor bcu gnyis pa'am bcu drug pa bshad mod kyis/ brgyad stong pa'i mjug tu glegs bam shin tu che ba la yi ge gsal bar bri ba yang bshad pas 'byor skabs dang bstun nas bya'o/ /de ltar rgyu rkyen phyag tshad sogs nges par byas nas rten bzhengs tshul dngos ni/ sku la sogs pa lugs ma bzhengs par 'dod na/ rgyu bzang po lha bzo bo mkhas pas rus tshugs/ phra zhib/ skye mched/ gser kha la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa bya ste/ de yang lugs ma'i rus tshugs/ ru shing la rag las pas chen po la phyag tshad dang ldan pa dang / 'bring po la ring du tshad bzhin la/ sbom du spra tshil ji tsam yong ba'i chas phra bar bya/ chung ngu dag la phras pa dag gsal ba byas pa la spra tshil g.yogs te spra bzo la gzab par gces/ de nas 'jim pa g.yogs pa dang / lugs gtong ba dang / brko bru dang / phyis dang / gser mdog dang / phra spel sogs kun la zab la mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog pa bya/ de yang phyag tshad dang ldan pa phyag gi 'dzin stangs/ zhabs kyi bzhugs stangs bde ba gal che zhing /

gzhan yang sha tshugs dang / bzhin gyi rnam 'gyur zhi zhing 'dzum pa/ khro zhing 'jigs su rung ba la sogs pa zhi khro'i khyad par shan 'byed cing / skye mched rnams ya yo dang che chung sogs kyi skyon med pa/ spyan rtsa mtho dman ran zhing legs pa sogs shin tu mdzes pa bya zhing / ri mo la'ang phal cher don la tshon rnams kha dog gsal la dwangs shing snum pa/ zhib la dam tshad dang / bska sla ran pa byugs te/ ras tshon 'dres pa la mdangs chu sla la dwangs pas/ mdangs khye ma dang gad pa dang / che ba dang / chung ba la sogs kyi skyon med pa/ sha 'gyur 'bur du thon pa lta bu bya ba ni tshon bkrag phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu'o/ /lde gu las byed na/ dar zab dang / sman spos sogs la rin po che'i phye ma bsres pa dam tshad bsra zhing yang ba 'byung ba la bya ste/ rus tshugs sogs lugs ma ltar dang tshon bkrag bris ma dang mthun no/ /brkos ma byed na ba so dang / shing dang / rdo la sogs pa la skya ris kyi cha rnam par bsgos te shin tu legs par bya'o/ /chos kyi rten nam gsung rten glegs bam ni gzhi gser shog sogs gong du bshad pa bzhin la bri bya ni/ bri bar 'os shing bris na don che ba/ bris pa'am/ bklags pa'am/ mthong ba tsam la phan yon dpag tu med pa can bstan pa dang rang gzhan la nges par phan pa/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo rgyud dri ma med pa rnams dang / dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos rgya bod kyi mkhas grub tshad ldan dag gis sbyar ba rtsod pa dang bral ba rnams las/ rang nyid gang bzhengs par 'dod pa'i dpe shin tu dag par btsal zhing / shog khyim ma 'tshams pa'i thig dang / thig khyim ma 'tshams pa'i yig khyim la sogs pa bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas bri ba'i yi ge ni/ rgya gar na tshangs pa'i yi ge sogs yig rigs drug cu rtsa bzhi yod pa las/ bod kyi mkhas pa thon mi sambho ṭas kha che'i yi ge dper byas nas/ bod kyi yi ge sum cu/

bu drug dang bcas pa mdzad pa las rim par brgyud de/ khyung po g.yu khri dang / sum pa gnod sbyin sogs kyis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa/ zab chen dang / zab chung dang / 'bru chen dang / 'bru chung dang / 'bru chen la li lugs dang ldan lugs/ gshar ma dang kyus yig la sogs pa mang du yod pa'i nang nas gsung rab chen po dag ni zab chen zab chung dang / rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung 'grel rnams ni 'bru chen sogs dang / bod kyi gzhung lugs tshad ldan rnams 'bru chung sogs kyis 'bri bar bya yi/ de las gzhan bod kyi blun po mkhas par 'chos pa dag gis byas pa'i mdo rgyud rdzus ma dang / don phyin ci log ston pa'i bstan bcos gang dag 'phel zhing dar na bstan pa la gnod par 'gyur ba dag bri bar mi bya zhing / mdor na bri 'os pa dag yig rigs de dag gang 'bri yang yig gzugs legs la dkyus snyoms pa/ yi ge'i mtshan nyid dang / phyag tshad dang / brda dag sogs kyang ma nor zhing / shog bzo dang / shog mdog dang / snag mdog la sogs pa khyad par du 'phags pa phan tshun 'gran pa lta bu bri bar bya/ bris zin nas kyang zhus dag legs par byas/ rtsi gras dang / glegs shing dang / glegs thag na bza' sogs kyis brgyan cing / rab gnas dang rgya tshags yang dag par bgyis te mthong ba tsam gyis yid 'phrog cing dang ba'i dad pa rang dbang du skye ba dag bzhengs par bya'o/ /de bzhin du thugs rten rdo rje la sogs pa yang rgyu bzang po las phyag tshad tshang zhing / 'dag bya dag byed sbyor rgyu yod pa sogs rang rang gi mtshan nyid gsung rab nas bshad pa dang mthun par/ de dang de la mkhas pa'i bzo bo de dag gis lo 'dod dang / 'gran 'dod sogs kyi ched du ma yin par bsam pa dag pa'i sgo nas bsgrub par bya ba yin no/ /de ltar bzo bos las rnams yongs rdzogs grub nas bris sku la rgyab gzungs sogs bri/ mchod rten dang 'bur sku la gzugs gzhug legs par 'bul bar bya zhing /

'di nyid shin tu khag che bas na phyag len rnam par dag pas go rim dang / dbu zhabs sogs kyi gzungs ma nor bar gzhug dgos te/ gzungs gzhug 'bul legs nyes las rten gyi byin rlabs che chung dang / gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi rten 'brel bzang ngan thams cad 'byung bar bshad pas so/ /des na de'i tshul bla ma gong ma mang po'i yig cha rnams dang / khyad par don gsal gyi dgongs pa bzhin sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i rab gnas kyi cho ga 'di nyid kyi don tshan bdun pa rab gnas byas pa'i dgos pa bstan pa'i skabs su zhib par 'byung ba bzhin 'og tu 'chad do/ /de bzhin du pad gzungs kyi 'og tu tshul bzhin du bris shing bsgrubs pa'i gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor lo yang gzhug dgos par gsungs pa yin te/ don gsal las/ rten gyi nang rdzongs bshad pa'i mjug tu/ de nas gnod sbyin mnyes par byed pa'i 'khor los zhabs bsdams par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de yang rgyud gang las gsungs na/ dpa' bo gcig grub kyi rgyud las gsungs pa yin te/ rgyud de las/ gser la sogs pa'i byang bu la/ ba su dha ra gnod sbyin dang bcas pa dang / byang bu gnyis pa la bcom ldan 'das dzambha la gnod sbyin gyis bskor ba yang dag par bris la kha sbyar du bya ste/ zhes pa dang / gser dngul lam zangs kyi byang bu la nor rgyun ma gnod sbyin mo dang bcas pa dang / dzambha la gnod sbyin pho dang bcas pa bris la yang dag par kha sbyar/ zhes sogs gsungs pas so/ /des na de lta bu'i gnod sbyin gyi 'khor lo la yang / nor rgyun ma gnod sbyin mo brgyad kyis bskor ba'i mo 'khor dang / dzambha la la gnod sbyin pho brgyad kyis bskor ba'i pho 'khor dang / yab yum gnyis med kyi 'khor lo dang gsum la brten nas dngos grub bsgrub pa'i tshul gsum gsungs pa'i nang nas/ rten gyi zhabs sdom du bzhugs pa'i 'khor lo ni phyi ma yab yum gnyis med kyi 'khor lo 'di yin zhing /

'di la 'bri ba'i tshul dang / bsgrub pa'i tshul dang / bris bsgrub tshul bzhin byas pa'i 'khor lo gzungs gzhug tu bcug pa'i dgos pa dang gsum las/ dang po la snga rabs kyi mkhas grub gong ma rnams bzhed pa mi 'dra ba'i tshul cher med kyang / phyi rabs su mi 'dra ba mang du byung ba yin te/ de yang snga rabs pa rnams kyi gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i dpe bris rnying ma dang / rten gyi zhabs sdoms su bcug pa'i 'khor lo rnying pa rnams kyi 'khor lo'i lte ba'i lha dang sngags kyi dbu nub bstan dang / mjug shar bstan/ 'dab ma'i lha dang sngags kyi dbu phyir bstan dang / mjug nang bstan/ mo 'khor gyi 'dab ma'i lha sngags g.yas bskor/ pho 'khor gyi 'dab ma'i lha sngags g.yon bskor du bkod nas pho 'khor steng dang / mo 'khor 'og tu yod par kha sbyar nas rten gyi nang du bcug pa kho na 'byung zhing / bka' gdams pa rnams kyang de bzhin du mdzad pa la/ phyis su bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas/ rten gyi nang du 'bul ba'i gzungs rnams la zhu dag mdzad cing / gzungs kyang mang po bzhugs na phan yon che gsungs nas sngar las mang du gtong bar mdzad/ de'i dus su gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor lo la yang brtag dpyad gnang nas/ snga rabs pa rnams kyi pho 'khor steng dang / mo 'khor 'og tu yod par sbyar nas/ rten gyi nang du dbus kyi gtso bo yab yum gyi mgo nub dang / mjug shar du bstan nas 'jug pa 'di mi 'thad de/ 'khor lo kha sbyar ba'i dus su de ltar 'ongs kyang / lhar bskyed pa'i tshe rten gang yin pa de zhal shar du ston pa'i dus su/ nang rdzongs kyi gnod sbyin gyi gtso bo dzambha la la zhal nub bstan du 'gro bas rten dang 'khor lo'i gtso bo rgyab sprod 'byung la/ de ni phyi nang gi rten 'brel mi shis pas so/ /bu ston rin po che rang gi lugs la/ dbus kyi lha sngags dbu nub bstan dang / mjug shar bstan/

'khor gyi lha sngags kyi dbu phyir bstan dang / mjug nang bstan/ mo 'khor g.yon 'khor dang / pho 'khor g.yas bskor du bris te steng 'og tu kha sbyar nas rten gyi nang du bcug dus/ dbus kyi lha sngags kyi dbu shar dang / mjug nub bstan du bcug pas/ rten gyi zhal gzigs phyogs dang / nang rdzongs kyi 'khor lo'i gtso bo zhal ston phyogs 'grigs pas shin tu legs gsungs la/ de nas bri tshul dang / bsgom don gnyis ka dang 'gal bas mi 'thad par bshad pa yin te/ bris pa'i tshe tsant+ra kent+ye shar gyi 'dab ma la bri bar bshad cing / bsgom dus kyang dbus su nor rgyun ma/ shar du zla ba chu shel ma bsgom par bshad pa la/ bu ston gyis zla ba chu shel ma nub tu bzhag pas lha brgyad ka'i zhal blta phyogs dang bzhugs sa 'dzol 'gro bas so/ /des na snga rabs pa'i bzhed pa la rten dang 'khor lo'i gtso bo'i zhal gzigs phyogs ma mthun pas rten phyi nang gi rten 'brel mi legs pa'i skyon du 'gyur na/ bu ston rin po che nyid bzhed pa de la 'khor lo'i lha yab yum brgyad kyi bzhugs sa dang zhal gzigs phyogs nor ba'i skyon gnas pas na phyi nang gi rten 'brel la gnod par ci'i phyir mi 'gyur legs par dgongs 'tshal lo/ /yang chos rje bla ma dam pas dbus kyi lha sngags kyi dbu shar bstan dang / mjug nub bstan/ dbu yi phyogs kyi 'dab ma la shar byas pa na brtsams te/ 'dab ma'i lha sngags kyi dbu nang du bstan/ mjug phyir bstan du bris shing / pho 'khor steng dang / mo 'khor 'og tu yong ba kha sbyar gyi gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i dpe bris rnying pa zhig gzigs nas bsam yas kyi zhig bzos kyi rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo de ltar du mdzad par grags shing / de tsam rgyu mtshan du mdzad nas jo nang pa byang chub seng ges/ dbus su ba su dha ri yig mgo shar bstan/ de'i shar gyi lugs su byas te yig mgo ngos su/

tsant+ra kant+ye yig mgo nang bstan/ oṃ gnyis bar du byas te snga ma dang ngo sprod du bris/ pho 'khor la mgon po dzambha la dang / gang ba bzang po'i gzungs kyang de bzhin du byas te/ yig mgo thams cad nang bstan du bri ba'i yig cha yang mdzad/ phyag len la 'khor lo gnyis kyi dbus lha sngags kyi mgo'i phyogs dang / g.yas g.yon gnyis dang / phyogs gsum po gri lta bus so sor dras nas pho 'khor steng dang / mo 'khor 'og tu yod par kha sbyar nas lte ba'i lha sngags dras pa shar nas nub la gyen du bslangs pas/ dzambha la bzhengs pa shar du gzigs pa la nor rgyun ma mdun nas 'khyud pa/ 'dab brgyad mdun nas so sor rgyab la phyir gyen du bslangs pas pho brgyad kha nang bstan du bzhugs pa la/ mo brgyad mdun nas 'khyud pa re 'byung bas gdams ngag khyad par can du 'dod cing phyag len du mdzad par bshad la/ de'i rjes su 'brangs nas spos khang pa rin chen rgyal mtshan pa/ theg chen rin po che yang de ltar du bzhed cing / spos khang pa nas brgyud nas mtshal khung pa/ chos lung pa rnams kyis kyang de ltar byas so/ /de lta bu'i jo nang byang seng pa'i bzhed pa de la/ 'khor lo bri ba sogs gang la yang dbus kyi lha sngags gang yin de'i mdun la shar du byed dgos pa la/ lugs de la dbus kyi lha sngags kyi rgyab la shar du byas nas bris pas/ bri dus phyogs nor ba'i skyon dang / zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las bzhi'i 'khor lo la/ dang po gsum la yig mgo phyir bstan/ drag po la nang bstan byed pa srung 'khor spyi'i lugs yin la/ 'di nor rgyas pa'i 'khor lo yin pas na yig mgo phyir bstan 'bri dgos rgyu la/ chos rje byang seng pa'i lugs de la yig mgo nang bstan/ mjug phyir bstan du song ba bris pas/ zhi drag gi 'khor lo'i khyad par ma phyed pa'i skyon dang / 'khor lo 'di ston byed kyi rgyud las/ gser la sogs pa'i 'khor lo gnyis kha sbyar nas rten gyi nang rdzongs su gzhug par bshad kyi/

gri lta bus btubs nas slong bar ma bshad pas na rgyud dang 'gal ba'i skyon dang skyon chen po gsum 'byung bar bshad cing / gzhan yang byang seng pa'i bzhed pa de ltar na/ tsant+ra kant+ye ba su ra'i shar du bris par ma song gi yig mgo ngos de blos bslangs dus rgyab ngos su 'gro ba dang / lugs 'di ltar na lha 'bri ba'i dus na'ang lha'i dbu padma'i rtsa bar bstan nas 'bri dgos par 'gyur la/ de ltar du 'bri ba rgyud rgya gzhung dang / bod kyi gzhung tshad ldan gang las kyang ma bshad cing / yang na padma'i 'dab ma la mgo gsham slog nas 'bri dgos/ de 'dod na dkyil 'khor gyi rta babs kyang chos 'khor gyi phyogs nang du bstan pa 'bri dgos la/ de 'dra sus kyang ma bshad pas 'bri lugs kyang mi 'thad cing / bsgom don yang tsant+ra kant+ye nor rgyun ma zhal shar gyi 'dab ma la bstan pa'i mdun du bsgom par bshad kyi/ rgyab tu nub kyi 'dab ma la bsgom par ma bshad pas bsgom bya yang rgyud nas 'byung ba dang 'gal bas mi 'thad par bshad do/ /yang lo tsā ba rdo rje dpal gyi 'bri lugs bu ston rin po ches bzhed pa ltar la/ pho 'khor 'og dang / mo 'khor steng du yod pa kha sbyar nas rten gyi nang du dbus kyi lha sngags kyi dbu nub bstan/ mjug shar du bstan pas mi 'chug pa gcig yong ste/ dper na kyai rdor lta bu'i thang ka mdun du bkram pa bzhin zhes bshad cing phyag len yang mdzad la/ de yang gal te las ma grub na spog chog tu 'khor lo steng 'og brje ba zhig gshin rje gshed kyi 'khrul 'khor sogs kyi skabs su bshad mod kyang / de ni drag las yin la/ 'dir rgyas pa'i las yin pas 'khor lo steng 'og bsgyur ba yang mi 'thad par bshad la/ yang sa bzang ma ti dpon slob kyi/ gnon sbyin 'khor lo 'bri tshul la mkhas pa rnams dgag sgrub shin tu mang ba dag la nyams ldan gyi tshul du/ de ltar rgyag 'dre mang po byed don med gsungs nas/

dgag sgrub kyi spros pa cher ma mdzad par/ phyag len smar 'don gyi tshul du/ 'byor pa can gyis gnod sbyin pho mo'i gser sku re bzhengs la rten gyi zhabs su bcug de tsam gyi 'byor pa med na 'jim pa las bzhengs pa'i lha sku bcug de yang ma 'byor na shing leb dgu la lha dgu'i lha sngags gnyis ka'am sngags rkyang pa bris pa/ padma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar dzambha la'i lha sngags bris pa shar bstan dang / 'dab ma brgyad la 'khor gyi lha sngags bris pa'i shing leb brgyad kha nang bstan du bcug mo dgu'i lha sngags gnyis ka'am/ sngags rkyang shog bu dum bu dgu la bris pa pho dgu'i mdun ngos nas phyir sbyar ba skud pas so sor bkris nas bzhag lha yab yum dgu gyen du langs pa'i bar mtshams stong pa rnams su sman dang 'bru sna tshogs dang / dar sna tshogs kyis bkang nas rten gyi zhabs su bcug par gsungs shing / de nyid paṇḍi ta mi dbang bzang po'i phyag len yin par bzhed la/ lugs 'di nyid 'phral ngor blo yul du 'char bde zhing mi 'thad pa'i cha chen po med kyang / gnod sbyin 'khor lo 'di dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud la brten pa yin pas rgyud de nas bshad pa dang mthun pa zhig dgos pa la/ rgyud de las/ gser ram dngul lam zangs kyi byang bu la nor rgyun ma gnod sbyin mo dang bcas pa dang / dzambha la gnod sbyin pho dang bcas pa bris la yang dag par kha sbyor zhes las myur bar 'grub pa'i phyir du 'khor lo kha sbyar byed par bshad pa dang 'gal zhing / rgyud de las de ltar byed par yang ma bshad pas so zhes sogs rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gsung rgyun zin bris rnams las/ bu ston sogs kyi bzhed pa rnams mi 'thad pa'i shes byed mang du bkod nas snga rabs pa rnams kyi bzhed pa/ zhabs rub nyid 'thad ldan du bsgrubs par mdzad pa yin la/ des na ngor lugs la gnod sbyin 'khor lo 'bri ba'i tshul ni/

gzhi gser ram dngul lam zangs ma'i byang bu'am shog bu la sogs pa ji ltar 'os pa tshad du byas pa gnyis la padma 'dab brgyad mnyam pa gnyis bris/ 'dir yab yum gnyis su med pa'i 'khor lo yin pas/ mo gtso bor gyur pa'i 'khor gyi gnas yin pas thog mar mo'i 'khor lo bri ste/ de yang dbus su nor rgyun ma dbu nub tu bstan pa'i thugs khar oṃ ba su dha ri ṇya swāhā/ shar gyi 'dab ma la dbu phyir bstan pa'i thugs khar oṃ tsant+ra kant+ye swāhā/ de bzhin du lhor gnod sbyin ma'i thugs khar oṃ datta ye swāhā/ nub tu rab tu sbyin ma'i thugs khar/ oṃ su datta ye swāhā/ byang du 'phags ma'i thugs khar/ oṃ ārya yai swāhā/ shar lhor rab tu bzang mo'i thugs khar/ oṃ su bha tra yai swāhā/ lho nub tu sbas ma'i thugs khar/ oṃ gupta ye swāhā/ nub byang du mdzes ma'i thugs khar/ oṃ de wyai swāhā/ byang shar du dbyangs can ma'i thugs khar/ oṃ sa ra swa tyai swāhā/ zhes pa bri/ de ni phyogs dang lha ma 'dzol bar bkod pa gzhi mi 'gyur ba'i mo 'khor yin la/ de nas byang bu gnyis pa'i lte bar dbu nub tu bstan pa'i dzambha la'i thugs khar/ oṃ dzambha la dza lent+ra ya swāhā/ shar gyi 'dab ma la dbu phyir bstan pa'i nor bu bzang po'i thugs khar/ oṃ ma ṇi bha tra ya swāhā/ de bzhin du g.yon bskor gyi byang du gang ba bzang po'i thugs khar/ oṃ purṇa bha tra ya swāhā/ nub tu nor sbyin gyi thugs khar/ oṃ dha na da ya swāhā/ lhor rnam thos sras kyi thugs khar/ oṃ be shra ma ṇa ya swāhā/ byang shar du rol pa'i phreng ba'i thugs khar/ oṃ kī li mā le ne swāhā/ nub byang du dzambu 'khyil pa'i thugs khar/ oṃ tsi pi kaṇḍa li ne swāhā/ lho nub tu gdong gi dbang po'i thugs khar/ oṃ mu khan tra ya swāhā/ shar lhor spyod pa'i dbang po'i thugs khar/ oṃ tsa rent+ra ya swāhā/ zhes pa bri/ 'di ni phyogs ma 'dzol bar bkod na/

pho 'khor steng du 'jog dus yab yum mi 'grig cing 'chol nas 'gro bas g.yon skor du bkod pa yin gyi/ pho 'khor rkyang pa la 'god lugs 'di mi btub bo/ /'di rnams kyi sku mdog la sogs pa ni/ nor rgyun ma ni sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i gdan la skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu phyag g.yas shing thog bi dza pu ra ka dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya can/ phyag g.yon pa nas 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa/ rin po che'i cod pan can/ rgyan kun gyis yang dag par brgyan cing / bud med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'gying pa/ rin po che 'bar ba skyug par gyur pa'i padma'i gter la sogs pa zhabs kyis mnan pa/ 'khor gnod sbyin mo rnams kyang de dang mtshungs pa'o/ /dzambha la la sogs pa'i gnod sbyin rnams ni/ g.yon pa rnams ne'u le 'dzin cing / pho mo'i khyad par ma gtogs gdan dang sku mdog rnams gnod sbyin mo rnams dang mtshungs par bri'o/ /yang sngags rkyang pa bri na'ang gong du bshad pa'i sngags rnams kyi gtso mo dang / gtso bo'i sngags yig nub tu bstan pa dang / 'khor rnams kyi yig mgo phyir bstan pa la thams cad kyi swāhā'i gong du/ ma ma dha ni de hi de hi zhes pa'am/ che ge'i nor dang / 'bru dang / dpal dang 'byor pa la sogs pa rgyas par mdzod cig ces pa la sogs pa'i spel tshig kha cig pad 'dab kyi phyi rol tu mu khyud rim pa gsum byas pa'i nang ma la rten 'brel snying po spel tshig dang bcas pa dang / bar ma dang phyi ma la a l̥ dang ka l̥/ de'i phyi rol rdo ra me ris byed pa snang yang / bsgom don la gzhal yas khang gi dbus su padma 'dab brgyad bsgom par rje btsun chen pos gsungs pas rten 'brel snying po dang / a l̥ ka l̥ med kyang chog cing / rdo ra me ri ni srung 'khor yin pas 'bri dgos pa 'dra'o zhes shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis rje btsun gyi dngos slob ṇa ro bandhe gshin rje grags kyi phyag bris khungs ma bzhin 'bri bar mdzad pa'i yi ge las 'byung ngo /

/'o na lugs 'di la mo gtso bor byas pas phyogs snga ma rnams la brjod pa'i skyon de dag mi 'jug mod kyang / mo gtso bor byed pa la shes byed med do snyam na/ de la sgrub byed yod de/ 'di'i rgyud las/ gser la sogs pa'i byang bu la ba su dha ra gnod sbyin mo dang bcas pa dang / byang bu gnyis pa la dzambha la gnod sbyin gyis bskor ba yang dag par bris la kha sbyar zhes gsungs pa 'dis yab yum gnyis su med pa'i 'khor lo la mo gtso bor gyur pa bstan cing / sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang brgya rtsa'i dzambha la'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa las kyang / dpal ldan mgon po dzambha la nor rgyun ma la 'khyud pa dang / zhes pa dang / de'i 'khor gyi skabs nas kyang / dzambha la bzhin bsgom par bya'o zhes gsungs pa 'di dag yab yum gnyis med kyi sgrub thabs yin pas lha grangs mang nyung ma gtogs don la khyad par med pas so zhes 'byung ba yin la/ yang rdzong lugs pa rnams kyis rje btsun chen po'i dgongs pa dbu rub tu 'bri ba nyid yin gsungs shing / de yang bri ba'i gzhi ngor lugs dang 'dra ba la/ ji ltar 'bri ba'i tshul la/ thog mar pho 'khor dang / de nas mo 'khor 'bri/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang pho gtso bo yin pa dang / sngon la 'bri bar rje btsun chen pos bshad pa yin gsungs nas/ ngor lugs la mo gtso bo dang / sngon la bri bar bshad pa de rje btsun gyi gsung dang mi mthun par bshad nas/ rdzong pa rang lugs la pho dgu'i lte ba'i lha sngags dgu shar dang / zhabs nub tu bstan pa bri/ de nas 'khor pho brgyad 'khor lo rkyang par 'bri ba'i tshe g.yas bskor du 'bri dgos kyang / 'dir 'khor lo kha sbyar du byed pas/ gtso bo'i dbu'i phyogs la shar du byas te/ g.yon bskor du shar/ shar lho/ lho/ lho nub/ nub/ nub byang / byang / byang shar rnams kyi lha sngags rnams dbu nang du bstan zhing / mjug phyir bstan du bri/

mo dgu'i lte ba'i lha sngags dbu shar dang / zhabs nub tu bstan pa bri zhing 'khor brgyad gtso mo'i dbu'i phyogs mdun du byas te/ de nas brtsams la g.yas bskor du shar gyi lha sngags rnams byang shar gyi lha sngags kyi bar du bri/ de yang dbu nang bstan dang / mjug phyir bstan pa bri'o zhes bshad/ yang lha rkyang par 'bri ba'i tshul la/ de la gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor lo lhar 'bri na sku mdog dang phyag mtshan sogs/ dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud las/ bcom ldan 'das gser gyi mdog can ne'u le dang / bi dza pu ra ka 'dzin pa/ gsus pa 'phyang ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhes dang / g.yas kyi mchog sbyin pa/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pa zhes dang / slob dpon su bha ka ras/ padma dang zla ba'i steng du phyed krung gis bzhugs pa zhes pa nas/ rin po che 'bar ba skyug par gyur pa'i padma'i gter zhabs kyis mnan pa zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa ltar bri/ yang sngags rkyang pa 'bri na/ dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa bzhin pho dgu mo dgu'i sngags rnams bri'o/ /de'i sngags la spel tshig yod pa'am med pa gang rung bya/ spel tshig byed na rje btsun chen po'i dpa' bo grub pa'i man ngag las/ sngags la spel tshig yod pa'am med pa gang rung bri ste/ spel tshig dang bcas pa ni/ oṃ dzambha la dza lent+ra ye mā ma dha naṃ de hi de hi swāhā/ zhes bya ba ste gzhan rnams la yang de bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bya/ yang na/ oṃ dzambha la dza lent+ra ye sarba siddhi me tra ya tstshantu swāhā/ zhes pa dang / oṃ ba su dha ri ṇi sarba baṃ siddhi me pra ya tstshant+ra swāhā/ zhes pa'i spel tshig rdo rje 'chang a nanda'i gsung gi dpe bris las 'byung ba bzhin gang bde bde bya'o/ /lha sngags gnyis ka 'bri na/ rje btsun chen pos gzugs kyi snying khar sngags bri ba'am zhes gsungs pas sngags rnams rang rang gi thugs khar bri'o/

/de nas pho 'khor mo 'khor gnyis ka'i padma'i phyi rol tu mu khyud gcig bskor la rten 'brel snying po spel tshig dang bcas pa bri/ de yang pho 'khor la g.yon bskor dang / mo 'khor la g.yas bskor du bri'o zhes sgyi chu ba nam mkha' smon lam gyis mdzad pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo bri ba dang / bsgrub pa'i tshul gyi yi ge bsam 'phel zhes bya ba las 'byung ba yin no/ /lugs 'di ni dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / jo nang pa mkhan chen byang chub seng ge sogs kyi dgongs pa bzhin yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan ngor lugs kyi gsung rab dag las/ byang seng pa'i bzhed pa la 'bri dus phyogs nor ba'i skyon yod par bstan pa'i skyon spong du/ kha cig 'di la gtso bo yab yum gyi dbu'i phyogs la shar du byed pa gsang sngags spyi'i lugs dang mi mthun pas mi 'thad do/ /zer ba ma brtags pa ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha gzhan la de ltar byed pa ni bsgyel ba'i tshe gtso 'khor gyi yab yum rnams steng du yong la/ bslong ba'i tshe rgyab nas mdun du ldang ba'i dbang du byas shing / 'di ni rje btsun chen pos pho 'khor steng / mo 'khor 'og tu 'ong par gsungs pas/ de'i dbang du byas nas rgyab tu bzhag pa'i tshe gtso bo yab yum gyi dbu shar du bstan kyang / bslong ba'i tshe mdun nas rgyab tu ldang ba'i phyir de ltar byas pa yin la/ gzhan du na gnod sbyin dzambha la phyi'i rten la rgyab gtod pa'am/ mgo mjug phyin ci log tu ldang dgos pa'i skyon yod do zhes gsungs shing / zhi drag gi 'khor lo'i khyad par ma phyed pa'i skyon spong du/ yang kha cig 'di la lha sngags mgo nang du bstan pas drag po'i 'khor lor song la/ nor rgyas pa'i 'khor lor ma song bas mi 'thad zer mod/ de ltar na rje sa chen gyi rtog bdun 'grel pa dang / rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa gnyis su zhi rgyas dbang dgu pa bzhi pa yig mgo nang du/

bsad bskrad dbye mnan bzhi la yig mgo phyir bstan par gsungs pa yang mi 'thad par 'gyur bas spongs shig ces gsungs pa yin no/ /yang ngor lugs la mo gtso bo yin pa'i shes byed du dzambha la nor rgyun ma la 'khyud pa sgrub thabs rgya mtsho sogs su bshad pa de nyid bkod pa la/ sgyi chu ba'i yi ge 'dir/ de yang brtag par bya ste/ zhabs sdom gyi gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor lo 'di sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang brgya rtsa nas 'byung ba'i dzambha la'i sgrub thabs yin par ma gsungs shing / rab gnas don gsal las/ de yang dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud las 'byung ba gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu'i 'khor lo bris la zhes gsungs pas/ dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud la brten pa yin la/ de yang rgyud las/ gnod sbyin rgyal po brgyad rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba/ ba su dha ra dang bcas pa'i bcom ldan 'das gser gyi mdog can zhes gsungs pas/ yum yab dzambha la la 'khyud par bstan la/ de'i 'grel pa su bha ka ras mdzad pa las/ bcas pa zhes pa ni byin pa g.yon pa'i steng nas lha mos 'khyud pa'i don no/ /zhes yum rnams yab la 'khyud par gsal bar bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /rje btsun chen pos mo'i tsakra 'og pho'i tsakra steng du 'byung zhing / zhes gsungs pa yin yang / yum rnams yab la 'khyud par bstan te/ gtso bo yab yum gnyis kyi lha sngags dbu shar dang / 'khor yab yum rnams dbu nang du bstan pa'i pho 'khor steng du byas te kha sbyar nas ldang ba'i tshe gtso 'khor thams cad mdun nas rgyab tu ldang ba'i tshe yum thams cad rang rang gi yab la 'khyud cing / 'khor pho mo thams cad gtso bo dzambha la la zhal phyogs pa zhig 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes ngor lugs kyi yum gtso bor gyur pa'i 'khor lor bzhed pa la dpyad pa dang / rang lugs pho gtso bor yin pa'i rgyu mtshan dang bcas gsungs la/ de ltar na gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor lo 'bri tshul dang /

rten gyi nang du bzhugs tshul la bla ma gong ma rnams bzhed tshul mi mthun pa mang du byung ba de rnams kyi snying po bsdu na/ sngon gyi dus su yang dbu rub dang zhabs rub gnyis byung bar snang zhing / phyis kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi bzhed pa la yang lugs gnyis su byung ba las/ rje btsun chen po'i dngos slob ṇa ro bandhe gshin rje grags dang / bu ston rin po che dang / lo tsā ba rdo rje dpal dang / shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan dang / rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams zhabs rub kho na bzhed pa dang / zhabs rub la yang bu ston rin po ches 'bri ba'i tshe zhabs rub tu bris nas rten gyi nang du gzhug pa'i tshe 'khor lo'i gtso bo'i dbu shar dang / mjug nub bstan du 'jug par bshad cing lo tsa ba rdo rje dpal 'bri lugs bu ston sogs dang 'dra ba la rten gyi nang du pho 'khor 'og dang / mo 'khor steng du byas nas gzhug ye shes rgyal mtshan sogs rten gyi nang du gzhug pa'i tshe dbus kyi lha sngags kyi dbu nub bstan/ mjug shar bstan mdzad pas zhabs rub tu bzhed pa po rnams kyang rten gyi nang du gzhug tshul mi mthun pa mang zhing / dbu rub tu bzhed pa ni dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ jo nang mkhan chen byang chub seng ge theg chen kun dga' bkra shis sogs dang / rdzong lugs pa thams cad yin zhing / de dag gi nang nas mkhan chen byang chub seng ge 'khor lo gnyis kyi lha sngags kyi mgo phyogs dang / g.yas g.yon gnyis te gsum po gri lta bus dras nas kha sbyar byed pas/ bla ma dam pa sogs dang yang cung zad mi mthun no/ /de ltar lugs gnyis po de snga rabs kyi bla ma rnams kyi bzhed pa dag rang rang so so dang mthun pa'i phyogs su 'thad par mdzad nas/ ngor lugs pa dag snga rabs kyi bla ma rnams zhabs rub kho na bzhed kyi dbu rub bzhed mkhan ma byung gsungs pa dang /

rdzong lugs pa dag rje btsun rin po che'i dgongs pa dbu rub kho na yin gyi zhabs rub gtan nas mi bzhed gsungs kyang / kho bo'i bsam tshod ltar na snga rabs kyi bla ma rnams la yang dbu rub phyag len la mdzad pa zhig byung bar snang ste/ bla ma dam pas dbu rub mdzad pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i bris dpe rnying pa zhig gzigs nas/ bsam yas kyi zhig gsos kyi tshe de dang mthun par mdzad pa yin tshul rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun bris pa rnams las 'byung bas/ bla ma dam pas gzigs pa'i bris dpe de snga rabs kyi rnying ma zhig yin par snang bas so/ /de bzhin du rje btsun rin po che dbu rub kho na bzhed pa kha tshon gcod par yang dka' ste/ rje btsun gyi thugs sras ṇa ro bandhe gshin rje grags kyis zhabs rub bzhed par 'dug cing / des rje btsun dang mi mthun pa zhig mdzad pa mi srid pas/ rje btsun rin po che'i bzhed pa la yang dbu rub zhabs rub gnyis char byung bar sems so/ /gang ltar yang 'khor lo bris te rab gnas byas zin nas 'khor lo gnyis po mar dang sbrang rtsi ka ra bu ram zho 'o ma sogs sbyar ba'i lde gus padma rnams kyi bar dang tha mar byugs la mdun rgyab dang phyogs ma nor bar sbyar dar ram ras sogs kyi skud pa ser pos dkris steng 'og sogs mi nor ba'i mtshan ma bya'o/ /gnyis pa bsgrub tshul la mi mthun pa chen po med cing / bsgom don cung zad mi 'dra ba yod pa dag ni gong 'bri tshul gyi skabs su bshad pa las rtogs par bya zhing / bsgrub pa'i tshul lag tu blang ba'i rim pa ni/ sngags 'chang chen po'i rab gnas kyi cho ga 'di nyid las/ rten gyi gzungs rdzongs la med thabs med pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo bsgrub tshul kho bo'i lugs su bris pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs kyang gsung rtsom gnang ma grub pa nas/ sngags 'chang mtshungs med de nyid kyi dgongs pa rdzogs thabs su dmigs te/

gnod sbyin 'khor lo bsgrub pa'am/ mnyes pa'i cho ga phun tshogs kun 'byung zhes bya ba kho bos byas pa ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /gsum pa dgos pa ni/ sbyin bdag gi rten gsum bzhengs pa'i phyogs su nor rdzas thams cad song nas med pa lta bur gyur na/ rten gsum dang bstan pa la smod cing / las rgyu 'bras la skur 'debs 'byung srid pas de spong ba'i phyir dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i 'phrul 'khor 'di byas pas dpal dgu 'gyur du 'phel ba ste/ lo gcig gi nang du rten gyi ched du gang song dgu 'gyur 'byung ba'i phan yon yod par gsungs/ rten de la yang mchod pa rgyun mi chad pa 'byung ba yin te/ jo bo rje'i gsung las/ rten gyi nang du gnod sbyin 'khor lo bzhugs pas rten de nyid la mchod pa bzang po 'byung ba'i rten 'brel dang / sbyin bdag de nyid kyi'ang longs spyod 'phel ba'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ro/ /zhes 'byung ba dang / gzhan yang tshul bzhin bris shing bsgrubs pa'i 'khor lo 'di gang du yod pa'i sa phyogs der dgos 'dod char ltar 'bab pa'i phan yon dpag tu med par 'byung bar gsungs te/ dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud las/ dngos grub chen po brgyad ster bar mdzad na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos zhes dang / 'jig rten gsum gyi rgyal srid stsol bar mdzod do zhes dang / des gter mi zad cing 'phel bar 'gyur ro zhes dang / yid la re ba yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /zhes pa la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs so/ /de rnams kyi sgo nas rjes su dad ldan dag rten bzhengs ji ltar bya ba'i tshul mdor bsdus pa tsam zhig legs par bstan zin to/ /bzhi pa de ltar bzhengs pa'i phan yon bstan pa ni/ lung rnam 'byed las/ kun dga' ra ba gtsug lag khang / /mal stan 'tsho ba nar ma dang / /zhes sogs rdzas las 'byung ba'i bsod nams kyi gtso bo dge 'dun gyi sde dang /

der gtsug lag khang dang / sku gsung thugs dang glegs bam dang / mchod rten bzhengs pa rnams yin par gsungs shing / gnas mal gyi gzhi dang / gso sbyong gi gzhi las/ gtsug lag khang brtsigs shing ri mor bris pa dang / mchod rten bzhengs tshul dang / sku gzugs kyis 'gro don mdzad tshul dang / spong khang bsgrub tshul dang / dge 'dun bsdus nas bstan pa'i bya ba byed tshul rgyas par gsungs pa bzhin du/ sngon grub chen kambha la'am/ sa lu zhes bya bas kyang grub pa thob nas bstan pa la gang phan gzigs pas/ dge 'dun gyi sde 'dzugs pa las lhag pa med par gzigs nas rgyal por bsam bzhin du skye ba bzhes nas bi ka ma la shi la'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs nas bstan pa la 'phel rgyas byung tshul gong du rgyas par bkod pa ltar dang / jo bo chen po dpal ldan a ti shas kyang btsun pa rnam grol sde la sogs pa'i rjes su zhugs te rgya gar du gtsug lag khang du ma'i gnyer bdag mdzad cing / bod du 'brom ston chen po la yang 'dus byas kyi dge rtsa la dge 'dun gyi gnas gzhi bzhengs pa las lhag pa med pas gnas gzhi gyis shig ces gdams pas na rten gsum bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa la yang phan yon dpag tu med cing / de dag gi nang du bzhugs pa'i rten gsum bzhengs pa ni de dag pas kyang phan yon che ste/ de yang mchod rten gyi phan yon ni/ gsal rgyal gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ thub pa'i mchod rten byed dang byed bcug pa/ /mya ngan 'joms dang lus kun sgrim pa dang / /rin chen mdzod mang 'jig rten gtsor 'gyur zhing / /mi de dgra yi tshogs las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi mchod rten rnams dang ni/ /sku gzugs rnams la rdul phran ci yod pa/ /de yi grangs snyed de snyed mi rnams kyi/ /lha yul sa steng rgyal srid nges par thob/ /gzugs dang gzugs med khams kyi ting 'dzin dang / /phun sum tshogs pa'i sa mchog kun myong nas/

/tha mar skye rga na la sogs pa yis/ /sdug bsngal med pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang thob/ /ces pa dang / gzhan yang mdo du ma las/ sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun bye ba phrag du ma dang bcas pa la lo grangs dpag tu med par yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur byas pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs tshon gang pa ring bsrel gyi snying po can zhig 'jim pa las bsgrubs pa bsod nams lhag pa sogs mang du gsungs shing / sku gzugs bzhengs pa'i phan yon ni/ gsal rgyal gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ 'di na rgyal ba'i sku gzugs byed pa ni/ /gzugs bzang skal bzang yon tan nye bar ldan/ /de ni dbang po sbas dang nyi ma'i 'od/ /'jig rten kun gyis mthong na dga' bar 'gyur/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs bzhengs pa gang / /de yi lus ni dri ma med pa dang / /nad dang mya ngan 'jigs dang sdug bsngal bral/ /padma'i nang bzhin 'jam dang yangs par 'gyur/ /'di na rgyal ba'i sku gzugs byed pa gang / /bran du mi 'gyur dbul po'i rang bzhin min/ /las byed ma yin skye ba dman pa min/ /dbang po ma tshang min te skyes mchog 'gyur/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo dang / mar me 'bul ba'i mdo dang / mchod rten bskor ba'i tshigs bcad la sogs pa na sku gzugs bzhengs pa la phan yon yod tshul rgyas par bzhugs shing / rgyud sde gong 'og kun tu bris sku bsgrub tshul dang / bsgrubs pa la phan yon yod tshul mang du gsungs so/ /gsung rten glegs bam bzhengs pa'i phan yon ni/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi mdo las/ stong gsum rin po ches bkang nas de bzhin gshegs pa la phul ba bas/ bstan pa'i mjug tu chos tshig bzhi pa zhig bris pa'am/ bzung ba'am/ gzhan la bshad pa bsod nams che bar gsungs shing / khyad par du sher phyin gyi glegs bam bzhengs pa dang / de byang chub sems dpa' la phul ba'i bsod nams ni/

brgyad stong pa'i mchod bstod dang bkur bsti bsod nams rnam grangs kyi le'u na rgyas par bzhugs pa ltar/ bsdus pa tshigs su bcad pa las/ la la gaṅgā'i klung mnyam ji snyed zhing rnams na/ /sems can ji snyed 'khod kun dgra bcom btul ba bas/ /gang gis shes rab pha rol phyin 'di yig bris te/ /sems can mchog la glegs byin bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs shing / gzhan yang mdo rgyud so so'i phan yon rang rang las rgya cher gsungs pas/ mdo sde dang / rgyud sde rin po che rnams blta ba dang / mnyan pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas khong du chud par bya'o/ /de bas na spyir rten gsum gang bzhengs kyang phan yon dpag tu med pas rang rang gi longs spyod dang / sgo gsum gyi dad mos kyi nus pa dang bstun nas bzhengs par bya yis/ phyogs gcig la zhen nas gzhan la sdang smras kyi sgos spang bar mi bya'o/ /'on kyang sku gzugs ni gsung 'byon 'byon 'dra yang mi 'byon la/ glegs bam rnams ni mi gsung ba 'dra yang gsung bar snang bas/ mkhas pa'i skye bo la ltos nas ni sku gzugs las kyang gsung rab bzhengs pa bstan pa'i rgyun la phan zhing / mkhas rmongs spyi la ltos nas ni lha sa'i jo bo rin po ches 'gro don mdzad pa tsam glegs bam gyis dka' bas mkhas blun thun mong gi 'gro don sku gzugs che bar snang ba yod pa yang nges par bya'o/ /de dag ni rten gsum bzhengs pa'i phan yon mdor bsdus pa ste/ de rnams kyi sgo nas rten gyi bya ba rab rdzogs nas/ zhes pa'i don zhib tu phye ste gang rab tu gnas par bya ba'i rten gyi bya ba legs par bstan zin to/ /tsha tsha 'debs tshul sogs ni gzhan las kyang 'byung zhing / khyad par rje btsun chen po'i don gsal du gsal bar bshad pa las logs su 'chad mi dgos pas 'dir yang ma bris so/ /spyi don gnyis pa gang gis rab tu gnas par byed pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid ni/

gzhung 'di nyid las/ de nyid bcu shes zhing / byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa/ bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs pa/ rab gnas kyi cho ga la mkhas pa/ bsnyen dang bkur bsti la mi blta ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid can no zhes gsungs pa'i/ de nyid bcu la/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta chen pos/ de nyid bcu la rnam grangs mang / /cho ga'i de nyid bcu dang ni/ /gzhan yang rdo rje slob dpon la/ /nye bar mkho ba'i de nyid bcu/ /de bzhin de nyid kho na yi/ /de nyid bcu zhes bya ba yod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ gsang ba'i de nyid bcu/ phyi'i de nyid bcu/ cho ga'i de nyid bcu/ rdo rje slob dpon la nye bar mkho ba'i de nyid bcu/ de kho na nyid kyi de nyid bcu rnams su yod pa las/ dang po rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ phyir bzlog gnyis kyi cho ga dang / /gsang dang shes rab ye shes dang / /kha sbyor dbye ba'i cho ga dang / /gtor ma rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang / /drag shul bsgrub pa'i cho ga dang / /rab tu gnas dang dkyil 'khor bsgrub/ /gsang ba'i de nyid bcu yin no/ /zhes pa ltar dang / gnyis pa ni/ rgyud de nyid las/ dkyil 'khor ting 'dzin phyag rgya dang / /stangs stabs 'dug stabs bzlas brjod dang / /sbyin sreg mchod pa las sbyor dang / /slar bsdu ba yi rnam pa dang / /phyi yi de nyid bcu yin no/ /zhes pa ltar dang / gsum pa ni/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor dang ni ting 'dzin mchog /phyag rgya stangs stabs gdan dang ni/ /bzlas brjod sbyin sreg mchod pa dang / /las la sbyar dang slar bsdu ba'o/ /zhes pa ltar dang / bzhi pa ni/ bla ma yongs bzung gi rgyud las/ gnas dang dus dang lha dang sngags/ /bgrang phreng phyag rgya sbyin sreg dang / /dbang bskur dang ni rab gnas kyi/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs su shes/ /zhes pa ltar dang / lnga pa ni/ rin chen 'bar ba las/ rdo rje dril bu ye shes dang / /lha dang dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg dang /

/sngags dang rdul tshon gtor ma dang / /dbang bskur de nyid bcu pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar yin zhing / de ltar de nyid bcu la rnam grangs mang du yod kyang / rab gnas kyi rdo rje slob dpon la dgos pa'i de nyid bcu ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid/ ting nge 'dzin gyi de kho na nyid/ phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid/ stangs stabs kyi de kho na nyid/ gdan gyi de kho na nyid/ bzlas brjod kyi de kho na nyid/ sbyin sreg gi de kho na nyid/ mchod pa'i de kho na nyid/ las la sbyar ba'i de kho na nyid/ slar bsdu ba'i de kho na nyid dang bcu po 'di dag yin te/ rje btsun chen po'i don gsal las/ rab gnas kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid 'chad pa'i skabs su/ rgyud las slob dpon de nyid bcu shes shing / /mtshan nyid kun dang yang dag ldan/ /phyag rgya sngags dang cho ga shes/ /las rnams kun la mkhas pa'o/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /zhes gsungs nas/ de nyid bcu'i ngos 'dzin la/ de la de nyid bcu ni/ dkyil 'khor dang ni ting 'dzin mchog /ces sogs 'dren par mdzad pas so/ /'di'i rdo rje slob dpon la cho ga'i de nyid bcu shes pa dgos te/ dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid mi shes na/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i rab gnas kyi rnam gzhag mi shes pa'i phyir/ ting nge 'dzin gyi de kho na nyid kyang shes dgos te/ de nyid mi shes na rdo rje slob dpon gyi las gang yang mi rung bas so/ /phyag rgya'i de nyid kyang shes dgos te/ de mi shes na rab gnas kyi cho ga sogs cho ga khyad par can gang yang phyin ci ma log par shes pa mi srid pas so/ /stangs stabs kyi de nyid kyang shes dgos te/ de mi shes na sa'i cho ga mi shes shing / rab gnas kyi cho ga rgyas pa dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na sa chog shes dgos pa'i phyir/ 'dug stangs kyi de nyid kyang shes dgos te/ de nyid gsang sngags kyi rdo rje slob dpon kun la khyad chos su ldan dgos pa'i phyir/

bzlas brjod kyi de nyid kyang shes dgos te/ bum pa bsgrub pa sogs la de nyid med kha med yin pa'i phyir/ sbyin sreg gi de nyid kyang shes dgos te/ rab gnas kyi cho ga rgyas pa ltar na sbyin sreg bya dgos pas so/ /mchod pa'i de nyid kyang shes dgos te/ de nyid rab gnas kyi cho ga'i yan lag khyad par can yin pa'i phyir/ las la sbyar ba'i de nyid kyang shes dgos te/ rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi ye shes 'bebs pa dang / brtan bzhugs spyan dbye sogs med kha med kyi yan lag yin pas so/ /slar bsdu ba'i de nyid kyang shes dgos te/ gsang sngags kyi cho ga phal cher la tshul de dgos pas so/ /'o na rab gnas kyi rdo rje slob dpon la cho ga'i de nyid bcu po shes pas chog gam snyam na/ de dag ni nges par shes pa dgos kyi/ de tsam gyis chog pa yang ma yin te/ gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor chen por rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang thob cing dam tshig ma nyams pa/ byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa/ bsnyen pa las su rung ba/ rab tu gnas pa thos shing shes pa/ cho ga'i bya ba yang mthong ba/ rnyed bkur la mi zhen pa sogs mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa dgos te/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ slob dpon de nyid bcu shes shing / /zhes pa'i rjes su/ mtshan nyid kun dang yang dag ldan/ /phyag rgya sngags dang cho ga shes/ /zhes pa dang / de'i don don gsal las/ mtshan nyid kun dang yang dag ldan zhes bya ba ni rdo rje slob dpon du dbang thob pa/ byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa/ bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs pa/ rab tu gnas pa thos shing shes la cho ga mthong ba/ longs spyod kyi sred pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas bdag ched cher mi 'dzin pa'o zhes gsungs pas so/ /der ma zad dkyil 'khor 'bri ba la sogs pa'i las la mkhas shing nus pa zhig kyang dgos te/ rgyud de nyid las/ sngar gyi tshig rkang gsum gyi mjug tu/ las rnams kun la mkhas pa'o/

/zhes pa dang / de'i don don gsal du/ las rnams kun la mkhas zhes pa ni dkyil 'khor 'bri ba la sogs pa'i las la mkhas shing nus pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar na rab gnas kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid la rnam grangs mang du bshad kyang / gtso bor ldan dgos pa'i yon tan ni cho ga'i de nyid bcu shes pa'i steng du byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa/ lha'i bsnyen pa las su rung ba/ rab gnas kyi cho ga la mkhas pa/ rnyed bkur la ma zhen pa rnams te/ byang chub kyi sems dang mi ldan na theg pa chen po'i nyams len du mi 'gyur zhing gzhan don rgya chen po mi nus pas na/ de lta bu'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis rab gnas byas pa'i sku gzugs kyi 'gro don che ba'am yun ring du mdzad pa mi 'byung zhing / yi dam gyi lha'i bsnyen pa tshad ldan ma song na dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i las gang yang mi rung bar gsungs la/ tshad ldan gyi bsnyen pa song na/ bzang po yongs bzung las/ bsnyen pas bgegs kyi tshogs bcom ste/ /zhes pa dang / rin chen 'bar bar/ tshogs 'phel bgegs zhi don 'grub pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar gyi phan yon rnams 'byung bar gsungs shing / rab gnas kyi cho ga la byang ma chub na/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ lha dus bya ba dus bzhin spyad/ /gzhan du cho ga nyams pa'i phyir/ /'grub pa nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes pa dang / chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ cho ga nyams pa'i byin rlabs kun/ /bgegs kyi yin pa rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes pa ltar gyi nyes dmigs mang du bshad cing / cho ga dag par byas na/ cho ga dag par gyur pa las/ /byung ba sangs rgyas byin rlabs yin/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis rten la rab gnas chags par gyur te dge legs phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur la/ rnyed bkur la zhen na gzhan don rgya chen po lta ci/ rang gi don yang 'grub dka' bas so/ /des na cho ga'i de nyid bcu shes pa'i steng du byang sems dang ldan pa sogs khyad chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan pa tsam gyis snyigs ma'i dus 'dir rab gnas kyi rdo rje slob dpon rung zhing /

de dag dang nges par ldan pa dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rab gnas kyi cho ga 'di nyid du/ de nyid bcu'i steng du bzhi po de dag las rgyas par ma gsungs pa yin no/ /spyi don gsum pa gang du rab tu gnas par bya ba'i gnas ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ gsum pa gang du rab tu gnas par bya ba'i gnas ni/ bkra shis shing nyams dga' ba'i gtsug lag khang la sogs pa shin tu yangs pa'i phyogs su bya'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / don gsal las/ bkra shis shing nyams dga' ba ste/ gzhung gzhan las rgyas par shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas na/ spyir chos kyi bya ba bgyi ba'i gnas thun mong ba'i yon tan gyi gtso bo ni/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ gang na sa skyong chos ldan zhing / /gang zhig kho nar skye dgu rnams/ /bder gnas sa 'dzin rtsod med pa/ /der ni bsam gtan brtsam par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sa phyogs chos ldan gyi rgyal pos legs par skyong zhing / skye dgu rnams rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad pa dang / 'byor pa che zhing rtsod pa med pa sogs 'tshe ba dang bral ba zhig gal che ste/ gnas de lta bur chos ldan gyi bya ba gang yang bsgrub pa la bar chad nyung zhing mthun rkyen 'dzoms pas na 'grub sla bas so/ /de ltar yang mdo sde rgyan las/ blo ldan gang du bsgrub pa'i yul/ /legs par rnyed dang gnas bzang dang / /sa bzang ba dang grogs bzang dang / /rnal 'byor bde ba'i yon tan ldan/ /zhes gsungs pa yin la/ des na spyir chos kyi bya ba thams cad gang du bya ba'i yul ni/ yo byad dang / lus dang / sems dang / gnyis ka dang / rnal 'byor rnams la mi gnod cing phan pa dang / bsod snyoms btsal sla ba dang / chu bzang ba dang / gzhi bdag bzang ba dang / mthun pa'i grogs mang zhing / nyin mo skye bo'i rgyu 'grul nyung ba/ mtshan mo ca co'i sgra nyung ba sogs kyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i sa phyogs su bya zhing / bye brag rab gnas bya ba'i gnas ni/

mchod rten chen po lta bu la de'i mtha' bskor du cha ther phub nas bya zhing / gzhan la gtsug lag khang la sogs pa bkra shis shing nyams dga' ba yangs shing bde ba dag tu bya yi/ dkyil 'khor la sogs pa mi shongs pa'i gnas khang shin tu dog pa rnams la mi bya ste/ der khrus kyi cho ga sogs ji lta ba bzhin mi 'grub pas cho ga nyams par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ de ltar yang gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ shin tu dog pa'i gnas su ni/ /dkyil 'khor bri bar mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /spyi don bzhi pa ni rab tu gnas pa bya ba'i dus ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ bzhi pa nam bya ba'i dus ni/ rab dpyid zla 'bring po nag pa zla ba sangs rgyas dbang bskur ba'i dus dang / dgun zla 'bring po rgyal zla ba 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal gyi dus gnyis kyi yar ngo'i gza' tshes bzang ba/ 'bring zla ba gang rung gi yar ngo'i gza' tshes dang ldan pa/ tha ma mar ngo'i nyi shu brgyad yan gang rung gi tshes la/ gza' dang skar ma dus sbyor sogs 'dzoms pa'i dus la bya ste/ zhes pa nas dus dang sbyor ba zhi ba la lhag par gnas par bya'o/ /de'ang nyi ma byang bgrod kyi dkar po'i tshes la lhag par bzang ngo zhes pa'i bar te/ de lta bu'i dus 'di la rab 'bring tha gsum las/ rab ni sangs rgyas dbang bskur ba'i dus te/ chos rgyal zla ba bzang po la ston pas dbang bskur dus 'khor rtsa rgyud gsungs pa'i zla ba dus 'khor pa rnams lo mgor 'jog pa'i zla ba dang 'khor los bsgyur rgyal gyi dus te/ dgun zla 'bring po rgyal gyi zla ba 'khor los bsgyur rgyal gyi dus su grags pa gnyis kyi yar ngo'i gza' skar tshes grangs rnams bzang bar 'dzoms pa'i nyin bya zhing / 'bring du zla ba gang yang rung ba'i yar ngo'i gza' skar bzang ba/ tha ma ni zla ba so so'i mar ngo'i nyer dgu dang / gnam stong ma gtogs pa'i mar ngo'i gza' skar bzang ba la bya ba yin la/

zla ba rnams kyi yar ngo la thub na bya ba dang / ma thub na mar ngo la yang rung ste/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor dang ni rab gnas pa/ /yar gyi ngo la brtag par bya/ /zhes spyir bstan nas/ gza' dang skar ma 'dzoms gyur na/ /mar gyi ngo la nyes pa med/ /ces mar ngo'i gza' skar bzang ba la yang rung bar dmigs bsal gyi tshul du bstan pas so/ /'o na gong gi zla ba gnyis po de bzang mod/ zla ba gzhan rnams la shis mi shis kyi khyad par med dam zhe na/ tshig gter las lho byang bgrod pa gnyis la lo/ /zhes spyir nyi ma lho bgrod dang byang bgrod kyi dus gnyis sdom pa la lor bshad cing / de gnyis kyi nang nas lho bgrod kyi tshe ni mi shis pa ste/ lho phyogs na tshe srog mthar byed pa'i gshin rje rnams yod pas/ nyi ma lhor 'gro ba'i tshe rgyas pa'i las byas kyang 'grub pa'i rten 'brel du mi 'gyur la/ byang phyogs na tshe dang dpal 'byor dbang phyug la sogs pa rgyas par byed pa'i gnod sbyin stobs chen rnams yod pas/ de phyogs su nyi ma 'gro ba'i tshe rgyas pa'i las brtsams na legs par 'grub pa'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ba'i phyir na byang bgrod kyi dus shis shing / de bzhin du zla ba yang dgun zla tha chung / dpyid zla ra 'bring tha gsum/ dbyar zla ra 'bring gnyis po rnams shis la/ de dag gi yang yar ngo'i tshes gnyis/ gsum/ brgyad/ bcu gsum/ bco lnga rnams shis pa yin te/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ dpyid zla ra ba dpyid 'bring po/ /dgun tha dpyid kyi tha chung ngam/ /dbyar zla ra ba dbyar 'bring po/ /nyi ma byang du bgrod pa yi/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyi gnyis pa'am/ /rim bzhin de ltar gsum pa'am/ /bco lnga de bzhin brgyad pa dang / /bcu gsum pa'ang de bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /skar ma ni chu stod sogs gzhung 'di nyid du bzang bar gsungs pa rnams shis te/ rgyud de nyid las/ thams cad du ni chu stod dang /

/snrar ma de bzhin gro zhun sbo/ /dbo dang sgron dang snub dang ni/ /rgyal dang de bzhin chu smad do/ /khrum smad kyi ni de bzhin te/ /rgyu skar 'di rnams thams cad du/ /skye dgu 'phel zhing de yis ni/ /rab tu gnas pa mchog tu byed/ /skar ma sbo la rab gnas bya/ /des ni shes rab chen por 'gyur/ /yid la 'dod pa ci yang 'grub/ /dngos grub me bzhis ster bar byed/ /snub dang gro zhun dag gis ni/ /bka' rnams thams cad kyang shes 'gyur/ /lag la skal ba bzang por 'gyur/ /snrar mas gzhan las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /mgo yis zhi ba nye bar spyod/ /chu stod chu smad bu 'phel 'gyur/ /brtag par dngos grub khrum smad kyis/ /rgyal la thams cad du ni rgyal/ /snron gyis mchog tu bde bar 'gyur/ /lha 'tshams kyis ni mchog ster 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gza' yang gzhung 'di nyid du bzang bar gsungs pa bzhi po shis shing / lhag pa mig dmar spen pa gsum mi shis te/ rgyud de nyid las/ phur bu gza' lhag pa ba bzang / /zla ba'i gza' rnams zhes bya ba/ /'di rnams las byas bzang ldan te/ /rab tu gnas pa mchog tu dge /nyi ma mig dmar spen pa ste/ /nor rnams 'joms pas spang bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /tshes dang gza' 'dzoms pa yang gzhung 'di nyid du shis par gsungs pa 'di dag bzang ba yin te/ rgyud de las/ gsum pa bdun pa drug pa dang / /bcu dang bcu gcig zla ba shis/ /gnyis pa bzhi pa de bzhin brgyad/ /bcu dang bcu gcig gza' lhag bzang / /gnyis dang bdun dang de bzhin dgu /de bzhin bcu gcig phur bu shis/ /drug bdun bcu pa dor ba yis/ /pa ba sangs ni kun tu dge /dus dang sbyor ba la brten nas/ /de la brtag par gnas par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar na zla ba dang / tshes dang / gza' skar bzang ba rnams 'dzoms pa'i dus sam/ thams cad ma yin yang gza' skar dang tshes mthun pa'i dus su rab tu gnas par bya bar bshad de/

rgyud de nyid las/ gang tshe gza' dang tshes mthun na/ /nag po'i phyogs la'ang brtsam par bya/ /gang tshe thams cad mthun gyur na/ /mi rnams bkra shis 'phel bar byed/ /ces gsungs pa yin no/ /spyi don lnga pa gang la brten nas bya ba'i yo byad ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ lnga pa yo byad ni 'og nas 'byung ba rnams legs par brtag la ma tshang ba med pa'i yo byad gya nom zhing / khyad par du 'phags pas brel ba med par bsags pa ste/ rab tu gnas pa ni bkra shis pa'i yan lag yin pa'i phyir zhes gsungs pa ste/ de'i don yang rab gnas byed pa'i sngon du sbyin bdag sogs rang rang gi blos legs par zhib tu brtags nas rab gnas kyi sbyor dngos rjes gsum kun tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med pa dang / tshang ba rnams kyang gya nom pa ste shin tu bzang zhing 'di las gzhan khyad par du 'phags pa'i bya brel med par byas nas bsag par bya ste/ 'jig rten du bkra shis sam dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba'i gtso bo lus lta bu ni/ dkon mchog gsum 'jig rten du byon pa nyid yin zhing / rten la rab tu gnas pa byed pa ni de'i yan lag lta bu yin pas/ de yang yo byad bzang na legs pa 'byung zhing / ngan na mi legs pa 'byung ba rten 'brel gyi chos nyid lta bu yin pas na yo byad tshang zhing bzang ba dgos zhes pa'i don no/ /ji ltar bsog rgyu'i rdzas rnams ni 'og nas zhib tu 'byung bar ltar nges par byas nas bsag par bya'o/ /spyi don drug pa tshul ji ltar rab tu gnas par bya ba'i cho ga'i rnam gzhag la gsum ste/ cho ga rgyas pa'i rnam gzhag dang / cho ga 'bring po'i rnam gzhag cho ga bsdus pa'i rnam gzhag go /dang po la nub gsum ma dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i lugs dang / nub gnyis ma dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel ba'i lugs gnyis las/ dang po la yang sbyor ba sta gon/ dngos gzhi dang / rjes gsum las/ dang po la/ legs bsham bdag bskyed bum pa bzlas/

/rten sbyangs bkru zhing phyi ba dang / /rten bskyed ye shes spyan drangs la/ /bgegs bskrad mchod de dgug gzhug bya/ /rgyas btab mchod bstod gtor ma gtang / /snyan gsan dbab cing mchod bstod bya/ /bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol/ /rten dgab bdag bsrung sta gon no/ /zhes pa ltar don tshan bcu gsum las/ dang po legs par bshams pa la gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor la dgos pa'i yo byad/ rab gnas la dgos pa'i yo byad bshams pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te yo byad bsham pa'i tshul dang / bshams nas sta gon gyi cho ga la 'jug tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ gong du bshad pa'i gnas mtshan nyid dang ldan par sa chog dgos na/ dbang gi chu bo chen po la sogs pa dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa'i gzhung rnams dang / sa chog gi phyag len zur du bshad pa dag tu rtogs par bya'o/ /zhes pa nas/ las thams cad pa'i sngags a mṛ ta lan gsum tsam bzlas pas bsrung ba las gzhan ci yang mi dgos so/ /zhes pa'i bar te/ de yang dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i tshe/ dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i sngon du sa chog bya bar bshad pa'i sa chog la/ sa brtag pa/ bslang ba/ sbyang ba/ bzung ba/ bsrung ba ste lnga las/ dang po ni/ kha dog dang dbyibs sogs kyi sgo nas brtag pa ste gong rten gyi bya ba'i skabs su mdor bsdus bstan pa bzhin dang / rgyas par gzhan las bshad pa ltar ro/ /bslang ba la/ snang ba'i sa bdag las bslang ba dang / mi snang ba'i sa bdag las bslang ba ste/ dang po ni sa phyogs de rgyal po lta bu gzhan gyis bdag tu bzung ba yin na/ sa 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs 'dod pas byin cig ces bsgo ba'am/ yang rin gyis btsal ba yang rung ste/ sngon 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos gdan sa chen po 'di nyid du sgo rum gyi gtsug lag khang 'debs pa'i sngon 'gro sa brtag pa mdzad dus sa dpyad thams cad tshang bar gzigs nas/ slong ba na sa phyogs 'di'i spyi'i bdag po jo bo gdong nag dang /

sgos kyi bdag po zhang zhung gu ra ba/ bandhe grong bdun sogs la rta dang nor bu'i phreng ba sogs rin du gnang nas/ phyin chad na 'thad pa yong gsungs shing rin bcal ba'i sgo nas sa slong ba mdzad de gtsug lag khang btab pas deng sang gi bar du bod kyi bstan 'gro'i dpal du gnas pa ltar ro/ /mi snang ba la ni mchod gtor byas te bden pa brjod nas slong pa'o/ /sbyang ba la las dang bya bas skyon sbyang ba dang / ting nge 'dzin gyis bgegs sbyang ba gnyis/ bzung ba la stangs stabs kyi sgo nas sa bzung ba dang / sa phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor bya'o snyam pa'i yid kyis bzung ba dang gnyis/ bsrung ba ni slar bgegs mi 'jug par bya ba'i phyir phur gdab la sogs pa'i sgo nas bsrung ba'i cho ga ste 'di dag gi bshad pa rgyas par ni rje btsun chen po'i kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi dbang chu chen mo nas 'byung ba'i don/ kun mkhyen chen po'i dbang chu bde chen rgya mtshor zhib tu bshad pa ltar dang / kho bo cag gi gsang 'dus sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad nges don 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas zhes par yang 'gos kyi gsang ba 'dus pa'i stong thun chen mo nas 'byung ba dang sbyar nas rgyas par bshad zin pas de dag tu blta'o/ /de lta bu'i sa chog ni dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa rnying pa sogs su mi dgos shing / gzhan phyag dar dang / bla bre sogs rgyan dgram pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi thig gdab pa/ tshom bu dgod pa/ mchod pa bshom pa/ phyag cha dang bum pa sogs 'cha' ba dang / rab gnas kyi rten gyi bzhugs stabs sogs dkyil 'khor la dgos pa'i yo byad bshams pa'i tshul rnams ni/ gzhung 'di nyid nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gyi bshad pa dang lag len gnyis ka phyin ci ma log par thon pas 'dir bris kyang yi ge'i ngal ba las dgos pa gzhan med pa'i phyir na gzhung rtsa ba nyid la blta rtog gces so/ /gnyis pa bshams nas sta gon gyi cho ga la 'jug tshul ni/

gzhung 'di nyid las/ de nas dpon slob rnams gral la 'khod de/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ gnas yo byin rlabs/ tshogs pa che zhing slob dpon du 'os pa yod pa dang / rgyas par byed spro na zhu 'bul phyag bco brgyad bya/ ma byas kyang nyes pa med ces pa nas/ slob ma yod na des dbang rdzas kyang bsham zhes pa'i bar te/ de yang de ltar dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la dgos pa'i yo byad rnams tshang ba na/ sa chog mi byed pa'i tshe nub dang po de nyid la slob dpon dang tshogs pa ji tsam yod pa rnams 'dus nas gral la 'khod de/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas/ dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i bar kyai rdor sgrub mchod kyi sta gon gyi skabs bzhin bya ba ste/ de la sngon 'gro gtor ma zhes pa gang gi sngon du 'gro ba yin snyam na/ spyir dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi tshe/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma dang / bsgrubs zin nas gtong ba'i gtor ma gnyis las/ skabs 'di'i gtor ma ni dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir de bsgrub pa'i sngon du gtong dgos pa'i gtor ma yin pas na de skad ces bya/ 'di la rje btsun rtse mo'i kyai rdor man ngag lugs kyi dbang chu chen mo las/ sngon 'gro gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ 'byung po spyi'i gtor ma'am mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis gtong zhes 'dam kha can du gsungs kyang / da lta phyag len la kyai rdor sgrub mchod kyi tshe snying kha'i 'od kyis 'byung po brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi spyan drangs nas oṃ inda sogs kyis gtor ma 'bul ba mdzad la/ 'di skabs kyi gtor ma'i sngags inda dzā ma dzā la zhes sogs la 'byung po'i gtso bo brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i mtshan sngags las med kyang / sngags 'di brjod pa'i tshe 'byung po'i gtso 'khor thams cad la dmigs nas bsngo dgos pas na 'di nyid la 'byung po spyi gtor zhes bya ste/ kyai rdor rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa'i phyi ma las/

gtor sngags 'di gsungs pa'i rjes su gal te 'di'i gtor mas 'byung po thams cad mchod par byed na rnal 'byor pa rnams legs par 'gyur zhes pa dang / gal te 'dis 'byung po'i tshogs kyi phyir rtag tu gtor ma byin na dbang dang mngon spyod dang / dgra'i sde 'jigs pa dang / bskrad pa dang / bsad pa dang / dgug pa dang / zhi ba dang / rgyas par yang 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pas/ de lta bu'i sngon 'gro gtor ma'i cho ga song nas/ gnas yo byin brlab bya ste/ 'di la yang rje btsun rtse mo'i man ngag lugs kyi dbang chu chen mo las/ de nas mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par byin gyis brlabs te/ dril bu la sogs pa rol mo'i yo byad 'bud bkrol bya zhing / bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags dang / oṃ gaṇḍe ra ṇi la sogs pa'i sngags lan gsum brjod de mchod pa byin dbab bo zhes gsungs shing / ḍombhi lugs kyi dkyil chog dang / bde mchog nag po pa'i dkyil chog las kyang 'di dang 'dra bar mchod pa byin rlabs tsam las/ gnas khang byin rlabs rje btsun gong mas bshad pa mi snang yang / dkyil chog bzang po yongs bzung las/ rdzas lnga sta gon gyi skabs su/ thog mar gnas mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las 'byung bzhi 'khor lo dang bcas pa la/ rnam snang yab yum snyoms par zhugs te/ zhu ba brtan pas rkyen byas nas gnas khang gzhal yas khang du byin gyis brlabs zhes sogs bshad pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas bla chen 'phags pas sbyar ba yin pas shin tu legs te/ rje btsun gong mas skabs 'dir gnas khang byin rlabs dngos su ma bshad pa ni/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs su/ snod thams cad gzhal yas khang du blta ba'i rgyu mtshan yod bzhin pa'i dbang du mdzad pa yin par bshad cing / des na ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gso ba'i don du 'gyur bas shin tu legs par gsungs pas so/ /de lta bu'i gnas yo byin rlabs bya tshul la/

bsang ba dang / sbyang ba dang / bskyed pa dang / byin gyis brlab pa dngos dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ dpung bzang gi rgyud las/ mchod pa 'bul ba'i dus su/ gnod pa byed pa'i log 'dren/ khrus byed pa na g.yo zhing 'gul ba/ dri chab la dri za/ bdug spos la nag po lus med/ mar me la gtsug phud cig pa/ me tog la me tog cher bkod rnams gnod par gsungs pa dang / rig pa mchog las kyang / rlung phyogs na g.yog mo so sgo ma zhes bya bas mar me gsod pa la sogs pa mchod pa la gnod par byed pa'i gdon yod par gsungs shing / brag phug pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi gsung las kyang / chu bzhi la bar du gcod pa chu zla g.yo ba'i bdud dang / rnam lnga la bar du gcod par byed pa nag po lus brtsegs zhes bya ba yod par gsungs pas/ legs par bshams pa'i mchod pa rnams la/ lus kyis lag pa g.yas pa'i rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor te/ yid kyis rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las khro bo'i tshogs rnams 'phros pas bgegs rnams bskrad par bsam zhing ngag tu/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kunḍa li sogs brjod pa yin la/ gnyis pa sa sbyang ba ni/ de ltar gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams kyi 'bags pa dang / ma dag pa sogs thams cad stong par sbyangs par bsam zhing / oṃ swa bha wa sogs brjod pa yin zhing / gsum pa bskyed pa ni/ stong nyid de nyid kyi ngang las gnas khang bhruṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa bsgom/ de'i nang du bshams pa'i mchod pa rnams a las byung ba'i thod pa'i nang du hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung / mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa sa dang bar snang thams cad khyab pa 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par sprul pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig tu gyur par bsam pa yin la/

bzhi pa byin gyis brlab pa dngos ni/ lus kyi phyag rgya dang / ngag tu sngags brjod pa'i sgo nas byin gyis brlab pa ste/ de yang phyag rgya ni/ bzang po yongs bzung las/ mchod yon 'bul ba'i cho ga'i rim/ /khu tshur mnyam par dam bcings te/ /gung mo gnyis brkyangs rtse mo sbyar/ /arghaṃ chen po rab tu bstan/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo'i kyai rdor mngon rtogs su/ lag pa gnyis kyi khu tshur sbyar la gung mo gnyis brkyangs pa'i rtse mo sprad pa ni mtshon gyi phyag rgya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin dang / me tog la sogs pa'i phyag rgya ni/ de nyid 'dus pa las/ 'og tu blug dang gyen du 'thor/ /mthe bong bshibs te bsgrengs pa nyid/ /dri byugs pa yi tshul du ni/ /mchod pa'i phyag rgya rab tu brtag /ces pa ltar/ rje btsun rtse mo'i kyai rdor mngon rtogs su/ lag pa'i snyim pas gyen du 'thor ba ltar byas nas me tog gi phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog lag pa gnyis khu tshur thur du bstan la/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos/ lag pa gnyis khu tshur gshibs te mthe bong gnyis bsgrengs la/ oṃ badzra a lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ lag pa gnyis brkyangs pa byug pa byed pa ltar byas la/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri chab/ lag pa thal mo brkyangs pa kha gyen du bltas te bshibs la/ oṃ badzra nai wi te āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas/ lag pa gnyis se gol bya zhing / oṃ badzra shapta āḥhūm̐ gis rol mo rnams byin gyis brlab par gsungs pa ltar/ de lta bu'i mchod pa so so rnams/ rgyu'i khyad par 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rgyur byas pa las byung ba/ ngo bo'i khyad par mi'i btung ba sogs las khyad par du 'phags pa lha rdzas las grub pas bzang ba dang / dri mas ma gos pa gtsang ba/ yul gyi khyad par rab gnas sogs cho ga gang du byed pa'i yul phyogs de tsam ma yin par nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' thams cad du khyab pa/

dus kyi khyad par cho ga nam zin gyi dus tsam ma yin par 'khor ba ji srid ma stong gi bar rgyun chad med par bsam nas/ gaṇḍe ra ṇi lan gsum brjod cing rol mo rgyas par bya ba ste/ gaṇḍe ra ṇi lan gsum brjod pa'i dang po'i tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ gnyis pas gnas khang gzhal yas khang du byin gyis brlabs pa ltar de dag gis kyang byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ gsum pas mchod rdzas rang gis byin gyis brlabs pa ltar de dag gis kyang byin gyis brlabs par bsam pa bde chen rgya mtshor gsung rgyun bskyar ba'i tshul lta bu zhig bshad la/ 'di la bdag gi bla ma mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyi kyai rdor dbang gi dri ba'i sta gon skabs su/ gaṇḍe ra ṇi lan gsum brjod pa yis/ /rim bzhin mchod yul spyan drangs gnas byin brlab/ /mchod pa byin gyis brlab par 'chad 'di la/ /tshad thub lung gis zin pa ji ltar yod/ /ces 'dri bar mdzad nas/ rang lan mdzad pa na/ rang gi rtog pa la gnas dang mchod pa byin rlabs ni tshig zin la dngos su 'byung ba de yin la/ mchod yul spyan drangs pa ni 'og tu mdun bskyed la ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim pa dang / gzhan yang mchod pa 'bul ba'i sngon du mchod yul khyad par ba spyan 'dren pa yang yod pas de dag yin par sems la/ gaṇḍe ra ṇi lan gsum brjod cing rol mo thams cad 'bud dkrol byed pa la ni mchod pa byin dbab bam rol mo byin dbab zer bas/ byin dbab yin gyi byin rlabs ma yin no/ /des na byin rlabs dang byin dbab tha dad du bshad de/ rtse mo'i dbang chu las/ de nas mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par byin brlabs te/ dril bu la sogs pa rol mo'i yo byad thams cad 'bud dkrol bya zhing / bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags dang /

oṃ badzra gaṇḍe ra ṇi la sogs pa'i sngags gsum lan gsum brjod de mchod pa byin dbab bo zhes gsungs pas so/ /zhes gsungs la/ de la spyir lag len cho ga'i rnam gzhag rnams sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang mthun zhing / rje btsun gong ma'i gsung gis dngos shugs gang rung la zin pa zhig byung na 'khrul pa med pas/ tshad thub lung gis zin pa ji ltar yod/ /ces pa'i dri ba ni cis kyang 'jug mod/ 'on kyang rang lugs kyi yig cha kun mkhyen chen po'i dbang chu bde chen rgya mtsho sogs su/ gaṇḍe ra ṇi lan gsum gyi dang pos phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ zhes pa tsam las mchod pa'i yul du spyan drangs par ma bshad pas/ rim bzhin mchod yul spyan drangs zhes dri ba mdzad pa'i yul gsal ba zhig ma byung la/ gal te gaṇḍe ra ṇi dang pos sangs rgyas thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs pas mchod yul du spyan 'dren pa las 'os med du dgongs na/ de ltar spyan drangs pa de dag 'og mchod pa'i skabs su yang mchod yul du byas pa la ni 'gal ba med mod/ 'on kyang gaṇḍe ra ṇi sogs kyi skabs su spyan drangs pa ni mchod yul du ched gnyer nas spyan drangs pa ma yin gyi gnas khang dang mchod pa'i yo byad rnams byin gyis brlab pa'i ched du spyan drangs pa yin pas/ de tsam gyi ched du spyan drangs pa ni rje btsun gong ma'i gsung gis dngos su zin ma zin ci ltar yang 'gal ba med par sems te/ gnas khang sogs rang gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i steng du sangs rgyas byang sems kyis byin gyis brlabs na byin rlabs che bar 'gyur bas so/ /de ltar spyan 'dren mi 'os pa yang ma yin te/ rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub mchod kyi tshe/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /zhes sogs dkyil 'khor la byin gyis brlab pa'i ched du sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sogs spyan drangs pa dang /

dbang chu bde chen rgya mtsho las/ gaṇḍe ra ṇi lan gsum gyi dang pos phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ gnyis pas de dag gis gnas khang gzhal yas khang du rang gis byin gyis brlabs pa ltar byin gyis brlabs/ gsum pas mchod rdzas rnams rang gis byin gyis brlabs pa ltar byin gyis brlabs par bsam gsung ngo / /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de bzhin du sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos bde mchog nag po pa'i dkyil chog sogs su/ dang pos mchod yul spyan drangs zhes gsungs pa yang spyir mchod yul du gyur pa sangs rgyas byang sems rnams gnas khang sogs byin gyis brlab pa'i don du spyan drangs zhes pa'i don yin gyi/ 'og mchod pa'i skabs kyi mchod yul gaṇḍe ra ṇi dang po'i tshe spyan drangs zhes pa'i don du 'khrul par mi bya'o/ /des na 'og mchod pa'i skabs kyi mchod yul du ched gnyer gyis spyan drangs pa ni mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsungs pa ltar mdun bskyed la ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim pa dang / yang mchod yul khyad par ba spyan drangs pa rnams yin pas/ skabs 'dir 'og mchod yul ched gnyer du gaṇḍe ra ṇi dang po brjod pa'i tshe spyan drangs par khas blangs na/ sngar gyi dri ba de 'jug par ma zad 'og tu mchod yul ched du gnyer nas spyan 'dren bzhin du 'dir spyan drangs pa la dgos pa lhag po yang med do/ /byin dbab dang byin rlabs gnyis ni/ dbang chu chen mo'i dngos bstan de la brtags na tha dad du byed dgos pa 'dra zhig rang snang yang / rdo rje phur pa sogs dkyil 'khor gzhan las ni/ tshur gshegs dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes byin rlabs rang dngos su gsungs kyang / 'di la ni byin dbab zer zhing / kun mkhyen chen po'i bde chen rgya mtshor yang khyad par med pa 'dra zhig bshad snang bas 'gal bar mi sems la/ 'on kyang 'di 'dra'i rigs la deng sang ni rtog dpyod byed pa lta ci/

cho ga'i bsam bya dag la spyan ras lhung nas 'di ltar yin zhes smra ba dang / sgom par byed pa nyin skar ltar shin tu dkon par snang bas bdag gi bla ma'i gsung de ni rjes 'jug rnams gong ma'i gsung rab la rtog dpyod byed pa'i slad du dgongs pa can gyi dri ba yin par sems so/ /de nas zhu 'bul phyag bco brgyad ni/ dbang chu chen mo las/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes spyir maṇḍal phul/ so sor maṇḍal phul te lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba btab/ ces pa tsam las ma gsungs kyang / rje btsun rin po che dang chos rje sa paṇa gyi tshogs 'khor gyi yi ge gnyis las/ de'i rjes su so so'i me tog bsdus te thun mong du gtso bo la maṇḍal phul/ gtso bos kyang maṇḍal yid kyis bla ma la dbul bar gsungs pa bzhin rim gnyis bsgom par zhu ba'i yon du/ thog mar las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum btsal te/ rdo rje slob dpon tshogs pa dang bcas pa la maṇḍal phul nas/ gang zhu na/ kun bzang rnam sprul zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ de yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul las byung ba'i mchod pa lta bu'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po dag gis dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa'i mchod yul khyad par can rnams mchod pa dang / rgyu sbyor yon bdag sogs bdag gzhan thams cad la gnod cing bar du gcod pa'i bgegs rnams zhi zhing / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis su med pa'i zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin dag bsgom zhing de'i ngang la gnas par mdzod ces zhu ba 'bul/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes byang drangs nas tshogs pa kun gyis slob dpon la tshogs kyi rdo rje slob dpon mdzad par maṇḍal phul/ slob dpon gyis kyang bla ma yi dam sogs la maṇḍal phul/ de dag gi bar mtshams dag tu las kyi rdo rjes phyag bco brgyad bya ba yin la/

des na zhu 'bul phyag bco brgyad ces pa'i zhu ba ni rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom par zhu ba dang / phyag ni bar mtshams rnams su bya ba'i phyag rnams so/ /'di dag ji ltar bya ba'i tshul yang sngon gyi lag len pa dag gis 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir du phyag gsum btsal nas maṇḍal bsham/ /phyag gsum btsal nas me tog bkram/ /phyag gsum btsal nas zhu 'bul byed/ /phyag gsum btsal nas me tog bsdu/ /phyag gsum btsal nas maṇḍal dbul/ /phyag gsum btsal nas gral la 'dug /ces sdom du mdzad pa ltar ro/ /zhu 'bul phyag bco brgyad po 'di ni ma byas kyang 'gal ba med par gsungs shing / sngon 'gro gtor masogs gsum po 'di dag ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga ni dbang chu sogs so so'i phyag len bzhin bya ba yin no/ /de nas skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar nyams su len pa ste/ 'di dag gi bsgom don ni kho bo cag gi kyai rdor mngon rtogs kyi rnam bshad dges rdor chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed du blta'o/ /de'i rjes su dkyil 'khor gyi sta gon rnams bya ba ste/ spyir sta gon la sa'i lha mo sta gon/ lha sta gon/ bum pa sta gon/ slob ma sta gon dang bzhi las/ 'di dag la sta gon zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su dgos pa'i yo byad rnams 'tshog chas byed pas na de skad ces bya ste/ de yang dngos gzhi'i skabs su dkyil 'khor 'bri ba la sogs pa sa la longs spyod dgos pas/ de'i sngon du de nyid kyi 'tshog chas byed pa sa lha sta gon/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i tshe snyan gsan dbab pa'i ye shes pa dgos pas/ de'i sngon du de nyid kyi 'tshog chas byed pa lha sta gon/ dngos gzhi'i dus su tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i bum chu dgos pas/ de'i sngon du de nyid kyi 'tshog chas byed pa bum pa sta gon/ slob ma la dbang bskur tshe dbang dngos gzhi'i skabs su dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i slob ma dgos pas/

de'i sngon du de nyid kyi 'tshog chas byed pa slob ma sta gon bya ba yin no/ /de dag gi nang nas sa lha sta gon la/ lha mo yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa dang / rang gi lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du haṃ yig 'bar ba bsgoms nas/ sor mo dbus ma gsum sa la brdabs pas sa'i lha mo byon par bsam pa dang / rang gi lag pa g.yas pa'am/ g.yon pa'i srin lag gi rtsa bar haṃ yig bsgoms nas snga ma bzhin bsam pa dang / rang gi snying khar bskyed nas mdun du byon par bsam pa rnams su yod pa las/ 'dir ni lha mo yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed nas mchod gtor phul te mkhyen gsol bya ba yin la/ lha sta gon ni rten bskyed pa/ brten pa bskyed pa/ mchod bstod bya ba/ snyan gsan dbab pa ste bzhi'i sgo nas bya ba ste/ dang po ni bsang sbyang byas te srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i rjes su gzhal yas khang yan lag bzhi ldan du bskyed nas/ rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du lha snam shar dkar zhes sogs gdan bsgom pa la 'jug pa'am/ srung 'khor gyi nang du gzhal yas khang yan lag bzhi ldan du bskyed nas lha snam gyi gong du dur khrod bskyed pa bdag bskyed ltar yang rung la/ gnyis pa ni tshom bu'i 'god sngags brjod de lha sku skad cig gis bskyed pa la ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya ba'o/ /gsum pa ni chu bzhi sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang / gos zung ste phyi mchod dang / nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa/ yid 'byung gi mchod pa rnams dang / bstod pa rgyas pa bya ba'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /zhes sogs kyi sgo nas snyan gsan dbab pa ste tshigs bcad 'di dag gi don ni bde chen rgya mtshor blta'o/ /bum pa sta gon la/ spyir bum pa'i rgyu/ tshad/ nang gi bcud/ phyi'i rgyan/ de dag gi mtshon don/ bsgrub tshul rnams las/ dang po ni rten gyi bya ba'i skabs su mdor bsdus bstan zin la/

gnyis pa ni dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar ro/ /gsum pa la bum mtshan ni kṛ ya saṃ ṭa ltar gtso bo rnam snang gi rigs yin pa la dgongs nas 'khor lo bum mtshan du bshad/ don zhags kyi rgyud du gtso bo 'od dpag med yin pa'i dbang du byas nas padma bshad pa'i rigs pas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rigs lnga gang rigs la rigs lnga so so'i phyag mtshan dgos par grub cing / rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs mtshon byed yin pas thams cad la rdo rjes rung bar bshad do/ /mgul chings ni ji ltar mdzes pa'i srog gsum ma'am/ lnga'am/ bdun byed pa phyag len ltar/ kha rgyan ni kha cig ku sha kha rgyan du mi rung ste bum pa'i gdan du bshad pa'i phyir zer yang / de ni ma nges te/ slob ma sta gon gyi tshe ku sha slob ma'i sngas stan gnyis char du bshad pas 'di kha rgyan du rung ba yin la/ bum pa'i steng dung chos rdo rje gzungs thag dang bcas pa 'jog pa ni/ grub chen la ba pas/ de'i steng du dung chos dri zhim pa'i chus bkang ba me tog dkar po dang bcas pa bzhag ste/ de'i steng du me tog gi phreng ba bcings pa'i rdo rje bzhag la zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ de'i dung chos ni bla med la thod pas kyang rung bar bshad cing / ma 'byor na kham phor lta bu la bya bar yang gsungs la/ de'i steng gi rdo rje ni rdo rje'i rigs la rdo rje dang / padma'i rigs la padma dang / rnam snang gi rigs la 'khor lo sogs rigs gang yin pa de mtshan mas mtshan pas byed par rdo rje 'byung ba'i dkyil chog tu kun snying gis bshad do/ /gzungs thag ni rgya gar du me tog rlon pa srad bu la rgyus pa la byed pas/ da lta thig gu khra bos byed pa ni lag len zor yang yin par bshad do/ /bzhi pa mtshon don ni/ rje btsun chen po'i rdo rje 'byung ba'i ṭīkkar/ spyir bum pas sa bcu gcig gi gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mtshon la rtsa ba mi nag pas ye shes de rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i steng du glo bur gyi dri mas ma gos pa mtshon/

lto ba ldir zhing rgya che bas ye shes de zab cing rgya che ba mtshon/ mgrin pa ring bas ye shes de gting dpag dka' ba mtshon/ rin po che lngas ye shes des sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa skong bar mtshon/ sman lngas ye shes des sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i nad zhi bar byed pa mtshon/ 'bru lngas ye shes des sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la dge ba'i lo thog rgyas par byed pa mtshon/ dri lngas ye shes des sems can thams cad kyi 'tshal ba'i dri ma sel bar mtshon/ snying po lngas ye shes des sems can thams cad bde ba'i snying po zag med kyi bde ba la 'god pa mtshon/ yang nang gi bcud de thams cad kyis chu byin gyis rlabs pa'i rten 'brel bsgrig pa'o/ /rgyu dge ba spyad pas 'bras bu thar pa thob pas kha rgyan/ 'gro ba'i don la phyogs pas mgul chings/ bzlas pa'i sngags kyi phreng bas thugs kyi snying po ye shes skul bar byed pas rdo rje gzungs thag go /zhes gtso bor yo ga la sbyar nas gsungs pa yin no/ /lnga pa bsgrub tshul la/ rten bum pa bskyed pa/ brten pa lha bskyed pa/ de la mchod bstod bya ba dang gsum gyi sgo nas bsgrub pa ste/ de yang bum pa gzhal yas khang du bskyed pa ni/ slob dpon mi 'jigs pa'i phyag len sangs rgyas thod pa'i gzhung 'grel du bshad kyang / mkhas grub phal cher bum pa rang du bskyed par bzhed pas/ bum pa'i gdan ni padma dang zla bar kun mthun la/ sa bon ni/ a bha ya la sogs pas/ baṃ las bskyed pa dang / paṇḍi ta nyi ma sbas pas sgrol ma lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil chog tu bhruṃ las bskyed par bshad la/ de yang dang po bcud kyi sa bon phyi ma snod kyi sa bon du snang la/ snod bskyed pa'i skabs yin pas phyi ma ltar 'thad par mdzad nas/ rje btsun rtse mo'i dbang chu chen mor bhruṃ las bskyed par gsungs pa ltar phyag len la yang mdzad do/ /gnyis pa lha bskyed tshul la/

arya de bas chu nyid lhar bskyed pa dang / a bha yas bum pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gzhal yas khang lha dang bcas pa bskyed pa dang / kha cig phyi bum pa'i rnam pa la nang gzhal yas khang gi rnam pa can gyi nang du lha bskyed pa sogs lugs mang yang / 'dir bum pa'i nang du lha kho na bskyed pa yin zhing / de la yang chos rgyal 'phags pa'i bdag 'jug dpal 'byung ma dang / jin gin ma dang / rtse mo'i dbang chu chen mo'i lugs dang gsum las/ phyi ma ltar bum pa brgyad yod na paṃ bcu las padma bcu sogs dang / gnyis su bsdu na rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du paṃ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su nyi ma/ 'dab ma rnams la zla gdan/ de rnams kyi steng du bdud bzhi la sogs pa'i gdan sgrub thabs bzhin/ las bum du sna tshogs padma dang nyi gdan/ rnam rgyal gyi dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du gtso bo yab yum mngon byang lngas bskyed/ 'khor rnams dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yab yum gyi mkha' nang nas 'byin pa'i tshul gyis bskyed/ de nas yan lag lhag ma gsum tshang bar byas te/ phyi nang yid 'byung gi mchod pas mchod/ bstod thung gis bstod nas bzlas pa dang / mjug tu yang mchod bstod sngar bzhin dang / nongs pa bzod gsol bya zhing / dung chos kyi chu bum par blugs te bum nang gi lha rnams zhu bar bsam pa yin la/ sta gon dang po gsum po 'di dag ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga ni dbang chu sogs nas 'byung ba bzhin dang / bzhi pa ni dbang gi mtshams sbyor nas 'byung ba ltar ro/ /de nas yi dam chos skyong sogs la gtor bsngo dang bskang gso sogs so so'i phyag len bzhin dang / slob ma la dbang bskur na de'i sta gon gyi cho ga dang / rjes chog rnams sgrub mchod bzhin byed cing / rdul tshon gyi phyogs yin na thig tshon byin rlabs/ bri zhing rgyan bkram pa/ ras bris yin na dkyil thang 'grem pa sogs nub dang po la bya/

nub gnyis pa la dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i dngos gzhi'i cho ga mchod gtor sogs sgrub mchod ji lta ba bzhin dang / dbang bskur byed na de'i dbang rdzas kyang bsham mo/ /'o na skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa lus dkyil dang bcas pa bsgom pa dang / mdun bskyed bsgrub pa sogs dngos gzhi min pa'i yo byad bsham par ji ltar 'du snyam na/ de dag dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi dngos gzhi yin yang / rab gnas kyi yo byad bsham pa'i khongs su bsdu dgos te/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i rab gnas byed pa'i tshe rab gnas kyi sngon du dkyil 'khor bsgrub dgos la/ de bsgrub pa de rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi'i skabs su dgos pa'i yo byad 'tshog chas byed pa yin pas rab gnas kyi sta gon gyi chos su 'gyur zhing / dngos gzhi'i skabs su dgos pa'i yo byad 'tshog chas byed pa'i cho ga la sta gon gyi cho gar bshad pas so/ /de ltar yang rje btsun rtse mo'i dbang chu chen mo las/ de lta bu'i cho ga'i phyogs la ni sta gon zhes bya ba 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad sogs gong du 'tshog chas byed pa yin la zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /'o na gzhung 'di nyid las/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub mchod kyi dngos gzhi'i cho ga rnams bya bar gsungs pa'i rjes su/ rab gnas la dgos pa'i yo byad bsham tshul gsungs pa ji ltar yin snyam na/ de ni dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel ba'i rab gnas la yang dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa sogs dgos sam snyam pa'i dogs pa mi skye ba'i ched yin la/ des na 'di la dgos pa khyad par can gnyis mthong ste/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa 'di rab gnas la dgos pa'i yo byad bsham tshul gyi gong / spyir yo byad bsham pa'i khongs su bstan pas dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i tshe/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa sogs rab gnas kyi sta gon gyi nang du gtogs pa shes pa dang / rab gnas la dgos pa'i yo byad bsham pa'i sa khongs su ma bstan pas dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel na dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa rab gnas kyi yo byad la mi dgos par yo byad bsham pa 'di dag gis chog go zhes shes par 'gyur bas so/
