gong du rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dgug gzhug kyang zin pa yin yang slar phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems/ gzhan yang rang bzhin gyi gnas nas spyan drangs pa de bstim dgos shing / de nyid/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /zhes sogs kyis rten la bzhugs par gsol ba btab rjes bstim pa la 'gal ba med cing / spyir yang ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya ba mang gis legs par 'gyur bas so/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na don gsal las/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug lan gnyis byed par gsungs shing / gzhung 'di nyid las kyang de ltar du mdzad pa yin pas shin tu legs so/ /yang phyis kyi ngor pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga dag las/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad tshar re rdzogs pa'i rjes su yang dgug gzhug re re byed par bshad mod/ de ltar byas pa la 'gal ba chen po med na'ang / rje btsun chen po'i don gsal dang / ngor chen gyi bkra shis rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen chen po'i dge legs rgya mtsho rnams su tshigs bcad de dag lan gsum brjod pa'i rjes su dgug gzhug sngar ltar byed pa gsungs kyi tshigs bcad tshar re'i rjes su dgug gzhug tshar re byed par ma bshad pas mi dgos so/ /sta gon gyi skabs 'dir slob dpon a bha yas ye shes pa spyan drangs nam mkhar bzhugs pa rten la mi bstim pa zhig bshad yod 'dug kyang / rab gnas kyi rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs rang lugs 'di la slob dpon rab 'byor rkyang gis bstim par bshad pa ltar mdzad do// //spyi don brgyad pa rgyas gdab pa ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa zhes pa nas/ zhes brjod cing bsam zhes pa'i bar te/ de yang spyir rgyas gdab ces bya ba ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa mi 'bral zhing brtan par bya ba'i phyir na de skad du bya ste/ don gsal las/ rgyas btab pa ni rten la ye shes pa brtan par bya ba ste zhes gsungs pas so/

/rgyas 'debs bya tshul la/ bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud la brten nas rab gnas kyi tshe/ rigs gsum spyi'i sngags rgyas gdab par bya ste/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten de mi bskyod pa la sogs pa rdo rje'i rigs su bskyed pa yin na/ rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya dang / sa ma ya satwaṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥzhes pa'i sngags brjod/ rten gyi thugs khar 'khor lo bsgoms te rgyas 'debs/ gsung rab lta bu 'od dpag med la sogs pa padma'i rigs su bskyed pa yin na/ padma'i rigs kyi dam rgya padma'i phyag rgya dang sngags de nyid brjod cing thugs khar padma bsgoms te rgyas 'debs/ rnam snang la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su bskyed pa yin na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dam rgya gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya dang / sngags de nyid brjod cing thugs khar 'khor lo bsgoms nas rgyas 'debs bya ba yin te/ don gsal las/ bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud yin na rigs gsum spyi'i dam tshig gi phyag rgyas gdab ste zhes gsungs pas so/ /rigs gsum spyi'i phyag rgya yang / de nyid las/ de la rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya ni zhes pa nas/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ sa ma ya haṃ zhes brjod la thugs khar 'khor lo bsgom/ zhes pa'i bar gyis rigs gsum so so la rgyas gdab bya tshul dang bcas gsal bar bstan pa ltar yin no/ /'o na rgyud 'di gnyis la yang rigs lnga char bskyed pa yod pas rgyas gdab kyang rigs gsum gyis mi chog gam snyam na/ de ltar bskyed pa yod kyang bsdu na sku gsum gyi rigs gsum du 'dus pas rgyas gdab la de gsum gyi dam rgyas rgyas btab pas chog par bshad pa yin no/ /de dag ni rgyas gdab rgyas pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ bsdus pa ltar na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum brjod pas chog ste/ don gsal la de nyid las/ yang na yig 'bru gsum brjod pas kyang chog gsungs zhes gsungs pas so/

/don gsal las 'di ltar du bshad pa 'di yang bya spyod rang rkang gi dbang du byas pa yin la/ grub chen dze ta ris bkral ba'i tshe dpag med lha dgu lta bu rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyas skabs pa'i bya rgyud kyi rnal 'byor la brten pa'i rab gnas yin na/ rab tu gnas bya'i lha thams cad kyi dpral bar 'khor lo/ mgrin par padma/ thugs khar rdo rje bsgom la lha re la'ang phyag rgya gsum ka bstan nas rgyas gdab bya dgos te/ de lta bu ni rnal 'byor chen po ltar na sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa'i dod yin par bshad pas so/ /yang yo ga la brten pa yin na/ lha gang du bskyed pa de'i phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas gdab bya ba yin te/ de yang rten de bla ma'i sku brnyan yin na rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas gdab/ gsung rab yin na 'od dpag med kyi phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas gdab/ mchod rten dang / gtsug lag khang dang / khang bzang rnams rigs lnga'i phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs dang / phyag mtshan dang rta babs la sogs pa mi bskyod pa dang / rnam snang gi phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas gdab/ kyai rdor dang bde mchog sogs bla med rnams la dkyil 'khor de nyid bskyed pa yin na/ grub chen kun snying gi lugs kyi phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas gdab bya ba'am/ rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas gdab/ yo ga'i dkyil 'khor tshe dpag med 'chi bdag 'joms pa lta bu yin na yang / sbyong rgyud pa'i lugs kyi phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas gdab/ rten ngo mi shes pa'am/ mang po yod pa rnams rten bskyed kyi tshe rdo rje sems dpar bskyed pa bzhin rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs bya ba yin te/ don gsal las/ yo ga yin na phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas gdab ces gsungs so/ /bla med gshin rje gshed skor lta bu la brten pa'i rab gnas yin na/ lha thams cad kyi mig tu kṣiṃ kṣiṃ las zhes sogs skye mched sku gsung thugs sogs dang /

kyai rdor la lha thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs kyi skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs par gsungs shing / bsdu na/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa sogs kyi rgyas 'debs par bshad cing / yo ga'i tshe yang 'di nyid kyis chog pa yin te/ don gsal las/ rnal 'byor chen po yin na dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas padma āḥs mtshan pa/ snying khar hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bsam par bya'o/ /zhes pa dang / yo ga'i lugs yin zhing phyag rgya bzhi mi shes na'ang 'dis btub bo/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /des na 'dir ni bla med ltar gyi rgyas gdab bsdus pa gnas gsum du oṃ sogs yi ge gsum las 'khor lo padma rdo rje gsum bsgoms nas rgyas 'debs pa ste dkyus nas 'byung ba bzhin brjod cing bsam nas rgyas 'debs pa yin no/ /de nas sta gon gyi skabs 'dir dbang bsdus pa ste bskur bar mdzad pas/ de la thog mar rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs kha'i sa bon hūm̐ gi 'od zer dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas dbang lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ arghaṃ sogs sngags tsam gyis mchod/ rten la dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab pas/ dbang lha rnams kyis oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum chus dbang bskur bas/ rten gyi sku'i nang dbang gi chu rgyun gyis gang / dri ma dag lha'i sku lus gang ba'i chu lhag ma yar lud pas/ rgyas par na rten ngo shes pa rnams la rang gi rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs bya'am/ bsdu na rten thams cad la rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan ces brjod nas rdor sems kyi rgyas gdab byas pas chog la/ gong gi dbang lha spyan 'dren pa'i sngags don ni/ pañtsa lnga/ ku la dbang gi lha/ sa pa ri wa ri 'khor dang bcas pa/ badzra rdo rje/ sa mā dza dam tshig gis byon ces pa ste/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa rdo rje dam tshig dgongs la byon ces pa'o/

/dbang bskur ba'i sngags kyi don ni/ badzri bha wa rdo rje'i rang bzhin/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ dbang bskur zhes pa ste rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi dbang bskur zhes pa'o/ /'di'i skabs su rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gsung la rje de nyid kyi dngos slob chos kyi rje shes rab rgya mtshos zin bris mdzad pa mthong ba rnam grol bya ba las/ 'dir sta gon gyi skabs yin pas cho ga rdzogs par mi byed pa'i phyir/ dbang bskur rgyas 'debs byed pa ma dag mod/ gsang 'dus rab gnas su byas pa ni 'phags pa man gyi phyag len pa thams cad byed pa'i dbang du byas gsungs zhes gsungs shing / yang ngor chen gyi dngos slob dpal gyi ye shes kyis ngor chen gyi gsung la zin bris mdzad pa rab gnas don gsal gyi bshad pa'i zin bris mig thur gsal byed sgron me bya ba las/ 'dir rin po che pa'i yo ga'i rab gnas su dbang lha spyan drangs te dbang bskur rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs mdzad cing / lag len pa phyi ma rnams kyis de ltar du mdzad kyin 'dug pas/ dbang bskur zhing rgyas gdab pa byas kyang rung / thob thang la ni med de/ rgyas btab ces pa'i don ni/ phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs pa la sogs pa slob dpon rab 'byor bskyang gis bshad cing / rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud la brten pa'i rab gnas bzang drug sogs su/ sta gon gyi skabs su yan lag bzhi rdzogs su byas pa yod kyang / yo ga'i skabs su sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ sta gon gyi skabs su dbang bskur ba dang / rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa/ slob dpon rab 'byor bskyang dang / grub chen kun snying gi gzhung gnyis char du ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs la/ de la don gsal gyi sta gon gyi skabs su dbang bskur ba ma gsungs pas dbang rgyas pa ni ma byas pa nyid legs shing / bsdus pa ni bla med kyi skabs su byed pa nyid legs te/

don gsal las sta gon gyi skabs su ma gsungs kyang / don gsal las bshad pa'i sta gon gyi skabs 'di ni yo ga la brten nas rab gnas bya tshul 'chad pa'i skabs yin pas/ yo ga'i skabs su slob dpon rab 'byor rkyang dang / grub chen kun snying gnyis kas ma bshad pas sta gon gyi skabs su dbang bskur rgyas gdab byed pa cung zad mi legs kyang / rje btsun sku mched gnyis char gyi kyai rdor gyi rab gnas bzang drug tu sta gon gyi skabs su yang / dam tshig pa bskyed pa/ ye shes pa dgug pa/ byin gyis brlabs pa/ dbang bskur ba ste yan lag bzhi rdzogs bya ba bshad cing / khyad par bzang drug gi yan lag bzhi pa'i tshe/ de nas bzhi pa dbang bskur te dbu brgyan gyi bar du yan lag bzhi rdzogs yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas na bla med la brten pa'i rab gnas la sta gon gyi tshe yang dbang bskur rgyas 'debs byed pa shin tu legs la/ des na shes rab rgya mtsho'i zin bris las/ ngor chen gyi bkra shis rgya mtshor sta gon gyi skabs su dbang bskur rgyas 'debs bshad pa 'phags pa man gyi phyag len dang bstun pa yin gyi/ don la ma dag tshul ngor chen gsungs zhes pa bkod 'dug pa ni/ ngor chen gyi gsung rgyun cung zad ma zin pa'i skyon du snang ste/ rje btsun sku mched kyi bzang drug tu bshad pas 'phags pa'i gong du yang phyag len de nyid byung bar grub pas so/ /des nas dpal ye ba'i zin bris ltar yo ga la brten pa'i tshe sta gon gyi skabs su dbang bskur rgyas gdab mi dgos pa dang / bla med la brten pa'i tshe nges par dgos pa dang / yang rten gzhi rab gnas kyi rgyud la brten zhing / lha bla med la brten pa'i tshe sta gon gyi tshe dbang bskur rgyas 'debs ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur ba zhig yin pa'i khyad par 'byed dgos sam snyam ste/ kyai rdor gyi rgyud la brten pa'i rab gnas bzang drug tu de nyid bshad pa dang /

rab 'byor rkyang sogs yo ga'i rab gnas kyi gzhung las ma bshad pa dang / don gsal gyi dngos bstan la yang ma byung ba dang / yang 'phags pa rin po che'i man gyi phyag len la rab gnas bla med dang yo ga gang la brten kyang de nyid mdzad pa'i phyag srol byung pa dang / ngor chen gyi gsang 'dus kyi rab gnas bkra shis rgya mtshor yang bshad pa rnams la so sor brtags pas de ltar du gsal bas so snyam du sems so/ /des na gzhung 'dir kyai rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la brten pa'i skabs yin pas dbang bskur rgyas gdab bshad cing phyag len la mdzad pa 'di ni rje btsun sku mched sogs gong ma'i dgongs pa bla na med pa'o// //spyi don dgu pa mchod bstod bya zhing gtor ma btang ba la/ mchod pa bya ba/ bstod pa bya ba/ gtor ma btang ba dang gsum las/ dang po mchod pa bya ba ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ mchod stegs kyi mar me rnams sbar/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs zhes pa nas/ gaṇḍe ra ṇi sogs dbang chu mdzes rgyan bzhin gdangs dang bcas pa dang / zhes pa'i bar te/ de yang thog mar sta gon gyi mchod pa stegs la bshams pa rnams a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul ba ste/ a mṛ ta'i sngags don rten bskyed kyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin dang / mchod pa byin gyis brlabs tshul gong du gnas yo byin brlabs kyi tshe bstan pa ltar ro/ /'bul ba ni/ dku g.yon par khu tshur gnyis steng 'og tu kha sbyar te/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /zhes sogs sngags bcas kyis 'bul ba ste/ don ni mi gtsang ba la sogs pa'i dri ma med pas ngo bo gtsang ba dang / kha dog yid du 'ong ba yi yon tan dang ldan zhing / rgyu lha rdzas dam pa ste/ mchog gam rab tu gyur pa'i zhabs bsil byed kyi chab bam mchod yon 'di nyid sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'khor byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa mang po dang bcas pa la gus pa chen pos kun nas bslangs te 'bul bas na/

khyed rnams kyis thugs dges pa chen pos bzhes nas bdag gir mdzad de bdag cag la sogs pa'i 'gro ba thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol ces pa ste/ de bzhin du chu 'og ma gsum la yang sbyar te/ zhal bsil byed kyi chab bam mchod yon 'di zhes pa dang / 'thor ba'i 'thung byed de chab bam mchod yon 'di zhes pa dang / mchod yon 'di zhes sbyar nas sngags phyag rgya dang bcas pas 'bul/ sngags don ni/ oṃ mgo 'dren pa/ bha ga wan ni bcom ldan 'das/ mahā ka ru ṇi ka ni snying rje chen po/ he ni dgyes pa'am kyai/ badzra ni rdo rje/ sa pa ri wa ri ni 'khor dang bcas pa/ oṃ 'dra/ ni ri ni zhabs bsil/ hūm̐ gzung 'dzin gnyis su med pa/ khaṃ nam mkha'/ swāhā ni gzhi tshugs zhes pa ste 'og ma gsum la gzhan 'dra ba la/ ni wi te ni zhal bsil/ sarba saṃ sho dha ni thams cad yang dag par sbyong ba/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥni gnyis su med pa/ kham̐ gong bzhin/ ram̐ ye shes kyi me/ mahā ni chen po/ arghaṃ ni mchod yon/ pra titstsha ni so sor/ swāhā ni gzhi tshugs zhes pa'i don no/ /'di bzhi char mchod yon gyi yan lag yin pas kun la mchod yon 'di zhes sbyar ba la skyon med de/ dkyil chog bzang po yongs bzung las/ zhabs bsil zhal bsil bsang gtor sogs/ /rim pa bzhin du dbul bar bya/ /'di kun mchod yon yan lag phyir/ /mchod yon sgra ru bshad pa yin/ /zhes pa dang / chos rje sa paṇa gyi tshogs 'khor las/ dgyes rdor ba chu gsum mam bzhi/ bde mchog pa mchod yon zhabs bsil gnyis su bsdus nas mdzad/ chu de rnams mchod yon gyi yan lag yin pas mchod yon gyi ming du btags pa yang yod/ ces gsungs pas so/ /de nas me tog gi mchod pa ni/ gang dbul bar bya ba'i me tog 'di ni ngo bo bzang zhing sangs rgyas sogs 'dis mchod na 'bras bu rnam par dag pa 'byung bas dge ba'am/ shis pa zhig yin te/ ci'i phyir na shin tu gtsang zhing dag pa'i skye gnas las dag par skyes pas so/

/des na dngos su bshams shing yid kyis sprul pa las byung ba'i me tog gi mchod pa rnams bdag gis dad pa chen pos mchod yul khyed rnams la 'bul lags kyi/ thugs dges pa chen pos bzhes nas bdag gir mdzod la bdag sogs la byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes pa'i don no/ /bdug spos ni/ dri zhim po'i nags tshal dag ro ni zhim zhing nus pa che bas lus sems la phan pa dang / gzhan yang mchod pa gang zhig dri'i rdzas dang bdug spos mchog tu gyur pa 'di dag bdag gir sogs 'dra/ dhu paṃ ni bdug spos so/ /snang gsal ni legs par sbar na srin po ste grib non gyi gdon rnams 'joms nus shing ma rig pa'i mun pa sel ba'am dag par byed pa ngo bo dge zhing mun pa rnam par sel bar byed pa'i snang gsal gyi mchod pa 'di dag bdag gi sogs/ di paṃ ni snang gsal lam mar me/ dri chab ni snang gsal phul ba'i rjes su 'bul rgyu'i mchod pa 'di ni dri bzang po dang ldan zhing dge zhing shis pa zhig ste/ skye ba'i sa phyogs sam gnas dag pa sogs rgyu bzang po las 'bras bu rang gi ngo bo yang dri ma dag byed du skyes pas so/ /des na de lta bu'i dri chab 'di bdag gi sogs/ gandhaṃ ni dri chab bo/ /zhal zas ni/ sa gzhi las skyes pa'i sman rnams kyi bcud gtsang ma skye bo kun gyi yid khar 'ong bar sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i zhal gyi zas su mchod par 'os pa'i ro bcud phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i bshos 'di dag bdag gi sogs/ ni paṃ ni zhal zas so/ /rol mo ni dri med sogs rol mor 'don cha bsgyur ba ma gtogs gong chu bzhi'i skabs dang 'dra la/ shapta ni rol mo'o/ /'dir mchod pa la/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yis/ /zhes sogs rab gnas kyi rgyud nas 'byung ba mdzad pa gzhan gyi phyag len la yod kyang / rang lugs kyai rdor gyi rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas rab gnas byed pa'i tshe 'di bzhin mdzad pa ni shin tu 'brel mtshungs te/

dper na yo ga la brten pa'i tshe yo ga rang gi rgyud nas bshad pa'i mchod pa'am/ yang na spyi 'gro zhig byed pa skabs su bab cing / gsang 'dus la brten pa'i tshe de nas bshad pa'i mchod pa bya ba skabs su bab pa bzhin no/ /de ltar yang rje btsun chen po'i don gsal las/ dgu pa mchod bstod bya zhing gtor ma btang ba ni/ rang rang gi cho ga bzhin mchod pa bsang zhing byin gyis brlabs nas/ zhes mchod pa byin rlabs rang rang gi cho ga bzhin bya ba bshad pa'i rigs las mchod pa 'bul ba yang rang rang gi cho gas 'bul ba nyid legs par grub la/ don gsal nyid du byin rlabs rang rang gi cho gas bya bar gsungs nas mchod pa 'bul ba'i cho ga chu dang thang las skyes pa yis/ /zhes sogs yo ga nas 'byung ba ltar mdzad pa yang / yo ga la brten pa'i tshe de nyid kyi mchod pas mchod pa nyid legs pa'i rgyu mtshan du song ste/ don gsal gyi nub gsum ma rgyas pa'i phyag len 'di yo ga la brten nas mdzad pas so/ /des na rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsang 'dus kyi rab gnas bkra shis rgya mtshor/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /zhes sogs gsungs shing / phyis su ngor pa dkon mchog dpal ldan pa'i rab gnas kyi yi ger kyai rdor la brten pa'i tshe yang mchod pa 'di bzhin du mdzad 'dug kyang / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i dngos grub 'byung ba 'dir kyai rdor la brten pa'i tshe mchod pa/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yis/ /zhes sogs kyai rdor rang nas 'byung ba ltar mdzad pa ni don gsal gyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa'o/ /'on kyang yo ga ltar gsang 'dus sogs kyi tshe mi rung ba ni ma yin te/ bkra shis rgya mtshor de ltar du bshad snang bas so/ /gnyis pa bstod pa bya ba ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ de nas dril sil gdangs dang bcas pas zhes pa nas phyag byar 'os pa thams cad pa la/ shlau ka gdangs dang bcas pas bstod la/ zhes pa'i bar te/ de yang spyir rab gnas kyi skabs 'dir bstod pa la/

rab tu gnas bya'i rten de nyid bla ma'i sku brnyan yin na/ bla ma'i sku bstod dang / ston pa'i sku brnyan yin na thub pa'i dbang po nyid kyi bstod pa dang / de bzhin du gsung rab yin na chos kyi bstod pa dang / mchod rten yin na de nyid kyi bstod pa sogs rten rang rang gi sgos bstod dang / rten spyi'i bstod pa sogs rgyas par bya ba sogs mang du yod kyang / sta gon gyi skabs 'dir sgos bstod mi mdzad par spyi bstod mdzad pa'i phyag len mang zhing / de la yang rgyas bsdus 'ga' re snang yang 'dir ni de nyid lnga pa gsang 'dus kyi rgyud nas 'byung ba de nyid cung zad 'don pa bsgyur ba dang / snang stong ma dang / mdo phal po che nas 'byung bar bshad pa'i 'gro ba rgyud lnga ma dang gsum mdzad la/ de'i dang po gnyis ni rigs lnga'i bstod pa ste/ snga ma'i tshig don ni/ phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa gzhir byas/ gang la na nyon mongs pa'i tshogs thams cad kyis mi g.yo bas na mi bskyod rdo rje ste thugs rdo rje'i rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma la'o/ /de'i khyad chos ni stong pa nyid kyi bdag nyid yin pas na ye shes chen po/ rdo rje ni mi bskyod pa dang mi phyed pa la sogs pa ste/ de dag 'dzin pas na dbyings so/ /bden pa gnyis kyi tshul shes pas na mkhas pa chen po/ sku rdo rje la sogs pa gsum gyi nang nas gtso bo yin pas na mchog don dam pa dang / sku dang / phyung ba'i dkyil 'khor gsum gyi ngo bo ste/ de lta bu'i yon tan dang ldan pa'o zhes pa'i don no/ /rnam snang dang me long ye shes kyi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ 'od gsal ba'i me 'bar bar gyur pas na rnam par snang mdzad de sku rdo rje/ de'i khyad chos sam yon tan ni/ 'od gsal gyi sbyangs pas na dag pa chen po/ rdo rje ni de bzhin gshegs pa lnga ste/ de rnams thim pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i drug pa'i ngo bo yin pas na zhi ba/

mchog tu dga' ba'i bdag nyid can yin pas na dga' ba chen po/ ngo bo nyid kyis dag pas na rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba'i mchog ste/ de lta bu'i mtshan nyid can nam khyad chos can gyi sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i rigs de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'o/ /rin 'byung dang mnyam nyid ye shes kyi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ rin po che'i rigs dang ldan pa rnam par dag cing gsal bar mdzad pas na rin chen rgyal po ste rin chen 'byung ldan nam sku rdo rje/ de'i khyad chos ni/ mnyam nyid ye shes kyi bdag nyid yin pas na rab tu zab pa'o/ /de nyid kyi phyir nam mkha' dri ma med pa'o/ /gzod ma nas dag pas na nyes pas rang bzhin dag cing gos pa med pa'o/ /de lta bu'i mtshan nyid can gyi rin po che'i rigs kyi mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo ces pa'o/ /'od dpag med dang so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ padma'i rigs dang ldan pa rnams kyi bdag por gyur pas na rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che ste 'od dpag med dam gsung rdo rje/ de'i khyad chos ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid yin pas na mi rtog pa'o/ /de nyid kyi phyir na rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin zhes bya zhing / 'khor ba la zhen pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi 'dod chags kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i shes rab brnyes pa'i mtshan nyid can padma'i rigs kyi mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'o/ /don yod grub pa dang bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ don yod pa'i rigs kyi rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mngon du byas pas na don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ zhi ba la sogs pa'i las rnams kyi sgrub pa pos 'gro ba rnams kyis mngon par 'dod pa'i don thams cad rdzogs par mdzad pas na bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ dngos po thams cad dag pa'i ngo bo nyid ni 'od gsal bas te/ de las byung bas don grub pa'i ngo bo'am sna tshogs rdo rje'i rigs kyi mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i don no/

/bstod tshan gnyis pa'i don ni/ phyag 'tshal zhes pa gzhir bzung nas/ gang la na rnam par snang mdzad la'o/ /de'i yon tan gang zhe na/ kun rdzob tu sna tshogs su snang ba'i snang ba dang / de dag rang gi ngo bos stong pa'i stong pa zung du chug pa'i rdo rje sbyang gzhi ltar na nam mkha'i khams dag pa'i dbyings rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa rdo rje'i sku ste/ sku rdo rje'i ngo bo rnam pa gdul bya rnams la byang chub chen po mchog brnyes pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa can no zhes pa'i don la/ de ni rnam snang dang chos dbyings ye shes kyi sgo nas bstod pa yin la/ mi bskyod pa dang me long ye shes kyi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la na mi bskyod rdo rje la'o/ /sbyang gzhi ltar na gzung ba phyi rol gyi don dang / de dag 'dzin pa'i nang sems la sogs pas bsdus pa'i chos rnams brtan par byed pa'i sa'i khams dag pa'i rang bzhin/ 'bras bu ltar na ye shes lnga'i nang nas me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid thugs rdo rje'i sku/ gdul bya'i snang ngor gzugs sku bdud 'dul ba'i phyag rgya mdzad pa can zhes pa'o/ /rin chen 'byung ldan dang mnyam nyid ye shes kyi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la na rin chen 'byung ldan la'o/ /de nyid khyad par gyi chos gang dang ldan snyam na/ sbyang gzhi ltar na rin chen rdo rje ste rin 'byung 'di ni sbyang gzhi 'byung ba bzhi'i nang nas 'bar bar snang ba me'i khams dag pa'i rang bzhin/ 'bras bu ltar na ye shes lnga'i nang nas mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i rdo rje'i sku/ rnam pa gdul bya la mchog sbyin pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa can zhes pa'o/ /'od dpag med dang so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la na sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pa'i snang ba mtha' yas sam mu mtha' med pa de la'o/

/de yang khyad par gang dang ldan na/ 'dod chags dag pa'i ngo bo yin pas na 'dod chags rdo rje'am 'od dpag med/ 'di ni sbyang gzhi ltar na dri ma dag byed chos kyi chu'i rang bzhin/ 'bras bu ltar na ye shes lnga'i nang nas kun tu bzang so sor rnam par rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rdo rje'i sku/ rnam pa ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag pa'i phyag rgya can zhes pa'o/ /don yod grub pa dang bya grub ye shes kyi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la na don yod grub pa la'o/ /de nyid khyad par gyi chos gang dang ldan na/ nyon mongs pa lnga'i nang nas phrag dog dag pa las byung bas nas phrag dog rdo rje'am don grub 'di ni/ sbyang gzhi ltar na dngos po gzhan skyod par byed pa rlung gi khams dag pa'i rang bzhin te/ 'bras bu ltar na ye shes lnga'i nang nas bya ba grub pa'i ye shes sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'phrin las kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i rdo rje'i sku ste rnam pa 'gro ba rnams la mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa mtshon byed kyi phyag rgya can no zhes pa ste rigs lnga'i bstod pa gnyis pa'i tshig don mdor bsdus pa'o/ /bstod tshan gsum pa 'di ni mdo sde phal chen nas 'byung ba bzhin slob dpon zhi ba snying po'i mchod rten bsgrub pa'i cho gar yang bshad la/ tshig don ni/ 'gro ba rigs drug dang lam rgyud lnga skye gnas rnam pa bzhi la sogs pas bsdus pa'i sems can rnams kun gzhi'i lte ba rab tu brtan pa dang / ma rig pa la sogs pa'i rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi rtsibs dang ldan zhing / sdug bsngal gyi mu khyud kyis bskor ba'i srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun du 'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang du sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang / 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang / 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal sogs sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa mang po'i 'phrul 'khor drag tu 'khor bas yun du mnar zhing gzir ba'i 'gro ba dag thugs rje chen po'i spyan gyis gzigs nas/

thugs rje chen po des 'gro ba rnams kyi sdug bsngal gyi 'phrul 'khor de nyid 'joms pa'i phyir du chos kyi phung po brgyad khri la sogs pa gsungs te yang dag pa'i lam la 'god par mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid khyod la rdo rje slob dpon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa sgo gsum gyis phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa la 'gro ba rgyud lnga zhes sogs tshigs bcad dang po dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas khyod ni 'dod chags la sogs pa nyon mongs pa ma lus pa dag pa'am spangs pa'i bdag nyid can yin te/ khyod ni sems can gyi gnas khams gsum la sogs pa dag na sprul pa du ma'i gzugs kyis bzhugs shing 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la sogs pa la longs spyod pa ltar gyur kyang / 'dod yon la sred pa'i sgo nas ma yin gyi/ gdul bya sems can rnams 'khor du ma bsdus pa bsdus pa yin/ smin pa grol bar bya ba'i phyir kho na yin pas so/ /de yang yin te khyod ni padma 'dam las skyes shing / 'dam ldan gyi mtsho nang na gnas kyang padma rang gi ngo bo 'dam gyis cung zad kyang ma gos pa ltar/ sangs rgyas khyed kyang gdul bya'i don du srid par sprul zhing 'gro mdzad par gnas kyang rang rgyud la chags pa phra mo tsam gyis kyang ma gos par dag pa nyid yin pas so/ /rgyu mtshan des na khyed la bdag cag gus pa chen pos 'dud do zhes pa'i don la sems can smin cing zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis pa dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyed ni gdul bya'i ma rig pa'i mun pa sel ba'i ye shes kyi sgron me chen po yin te/ sems can thar pa'i longs spyod kyis bkren pa chos kyis dbul zhing 'phongs par gyur pa dag chos kyis 'phongs pa'i dbang gis gnas lugs kyi don sgrib byed ma rig pa'i mun pa 'thib po'i nang du song zhing gnas pa rnams dad pa dang gtong ba la sogs pa'i 'phags pa'i nor bdun stsal ba'i sgo nas yid tshim par mdzad dang /

de dag gi blo'i mun pa bsal ba'i sgo nas ye shes kyi snang ba spro bar mdzad pa yin pas so/ /des na mkhyen pa'i ye shes thogs pa med pa mnga' ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sras dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa la/ sems can bkren pa zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum pa dang / gzhan yang rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa khyed dag ni sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol ba la ded dpon mchog dang chos mtshungs pa yin te/ sems can gyi tshogs mang po dag 'khor ba gting mtha' med pa'i rgya mtsho chen por nub pa la thugs rje chen po'i thabs byang chub kyi sems dang / shes rab bdag med rtogs pa'i blo gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i lam khyad par can gyi grur bzhag nas/ sdug bsngal thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i gnas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che mchog dam pa bzhugs pa'i thar pa chen po'i gling du bde bar skyel bar mdzad pa po yin pas so/ /des na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas len par 'dod pa'i don mthun gyi skal ldan kun srid pa'i rgya mtsho chen po las legs par sgrol ba'i ded dpon sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa khyed la sgo gsum kun nas 'dud ces pa la/ sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor zhes sogs tshigs bcad bzhi pa dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas khyed ni 'gro ba rnams las kyi chu bo las sgrol ba la zam pa dang yang chos mtshungs pa yin te/ sems can gyi tshogs nyon mongs pa dang las kyi chu bo'i dmyal ba la sogs par 'khyer ba las skyobs pa'i phyir chos kyi grur zhugs pa ngan song gsum la sogs pa'i gnas su 'khyer ba'i las nyon gyi chu bor chos kyi gru nub pa rnams sangs rgyas khyed kyi dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis zam pa chen po btsugs nas las nyon gyi chu bo las sgrol bar mdzad cing / las nyon gyi chu bo'i ngogs sam de spangs pa'i skam sa chen po lta bu yang dag pa'i lta ba dang /

yang dag pa'i rtogs pa dang / yang dag pa'i ngag dang / yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' dang / yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba dang / yang dag pa'i rtsol ba dang / yang dag pa'i dran pa dang / yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin te 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i sa la sbyor bar mdzad pas so/ /des na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dam pa'i chos gsungs pa la thogs pa med pas na de gsungs pa'i mnga' bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa la/ sems can las kyi chu bor gru nub rnams/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad lnga pas bstod la/ de'i rjes su/ phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhes pa'i tshigs bcad 'di ni phyag 'os thams cad la don bsdu'i tshul du sbyor bar mdzad pa ste/ don yang de ltar gtso bo rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la bstod cing phyag 'tshal bar ma zad/ mdor na phyag bya ba dang mchod pa 'os pa'i yon gnas thams cad la bdag sogs rnams kyi lus 'di phyogs bcu'i zhing khams dag na sa'i rdul ji snyed yod pa de dag kun gyi grangs de snyed dang mnyam pa'i lus kyi grangs dpag tu med par blos sprul zhing gus pa chen pos btud pa yis/ dus dang gnas skabs kyi rnam pa kun tu yul khyed rnams la mchog tu'am rab tu dad pa chen po'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i don no/ /de lta bu'i bstod pa de dag gdangs dang bcas pas bstod rjes/ de nas gsum pa gtor ma gtong ba ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ gtor ma gtong ba ni gtor ma rnams bsang sbyangs zhes pa nas/ thun gtor 'bul dgos na'ang phul la zhes pa'i bar te/ de yang skabs 'dir 'bul rgyu'i gtor ma 'di nyid a mṛ tas gtor ma la bdag tu bzung nas gtor ma 'bul ba la bar chad byed pa'i bgegs rnams bsang / swa bhā was stong par sbyangs te/ stong pa nyid de'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu gdung pa ste bkug pa lta bu g.yo ba'i phyir ba dan gyis mtshan pa zhig bsam/ de'i steng du sa bon ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dbyibs gru gsum/

kha dog dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa bsgom/ de'i steng du a las gtor snod thod pa kha dog dkar po dum bu gsum pa de'i dpral ba'i phyogs rang la bstan pa/ de lta bu'i thod pa'i steng nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor skya 'khyil ba zhig bsam/ de'i steng du go ku da ha na rnams las sha lnga/ de dag gi steng du bhruṃ aṃ dzriṃ khaṃ hūm̐ rnams las bdud rtsi lnga/ de dag gi ngo bo yang bhruṃ la sogs pa'i yig 'bru lnga po de ye shes lngar bsam/ zla dkyil de'i mthar g.yon bskor du a li dang / g.yas bskor du ka li bsam/ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ kha dog dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje kha dog dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la yi ge hūm̐ gis mtshan pa zhig bsgom/ rdo rje de'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pa rlung gi ba dan la phog pas rlung cher g.yos/ des me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa de sbar ba'i rkyen gyis thod nang gi rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song ba steng gi oṃ sogs la phog pas rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ yig las bdud rtsi'i rgyun thur du 'dzag par bsam/ slar yang rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ de dag na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnams rnam pa he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par byung ste rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la phog pas rdo rje de nyid brjid chen po dang ldan par gyur/ de'i rkyen gyis rdo rje sogs 'og gi thod nang du lhung ba 'od du zhu ste thod nang na sngar yod pa'i bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur nas kha dog phun sum tshogs pa mthong ba tsam gyis yid 'phrog pa/ ro phun sum tshogs pa myong ba tsam gyis yid tshim zhing lus sems bde ba skyed par byed pa/

nus pa phun sum tshogs pa mthar thug zag med kyi bde ba bskyed nus pa'i bdud rtsi/ de yang nyung ngu ma yin par mi zad pa'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam zhing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥzhes pa'i sngags dang / lag pa g.yon gtor ma la bstan nas oṃ zhes brjod/ āḥbarjod pa'i tshe lag pa g.yas bstan/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pa'i tshe gnyis ka bstan/ de nas bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan te hoḥzhes dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhriḥzhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma byin rlabs kyai rdor sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi byin rlabs bzhin bya ba yin la/ de nas gtor mgron bskyed pa ni/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor rdul tshon dang / ras bris gang yin pa de'i phyi rol gyi dur khrod brgyad du hūm̐ brgyad bsam/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las shar phyogs kyi dur khrod du brgya byin/ lho'i dur khrod du gshin rje/ nub kyi dur khrod du chu lha/ byang gi dur khrod du gnod sbyin/ shar lho'i dur khrod du me lha/ lho nub kyi dur khrod du srin po/ nub byang gi dur khrod du rlung lha/ byang shar gyi dur khrod du dbang ldan te phyogs skyong brgyad sku mdog sngon po rang 'dra ba'i rig ma la 'khyud pa bsgom/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar dbang ldan phyogs na yod pa'i dur khrod kyi steng gi cha la chos 'byung la gnas pa'i padma 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba dang / 'dab ma rnams la oṃ dgu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su sku rdo rje dang / 'dab ma brgyad la shar du dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa'i lha chen brgyad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i rig ma la 'khyud pa rnams dang / de bzhin du mdun bskyed kyi srin po ste lho nub kyi dur khrod kyi 'og gi char chos 'byung dang padma 'dab ma brgyad sngar ltar gyi lte ba dang / 'dab ma brgyad la a dgu dang de dag las dbus su gsung rdo rje/

'dab ma rnams la klu chen brgyad sku mdog dmar po zhal phyag sogs 'dra ba dang / thams cad kyang gdan pad nyi zhabs g.yas bskums/ g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs/ rgyan rus rgyan rnams 'dra bar bsgom pa yin la/ de nas rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis sa steng / sa bla/ sa 'og gi sems can thams cad bkug nas 'byung po brgyad gsum po rim pa bzhin bstim/ thams cad lhar gsal ba'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs kyi skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi hūm̐ gis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'byung po brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rnam par ye shes pa'i 'khor lo dgug gzhug bya/ slar yang rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis dbang lha spyan drangs nas mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa dang / dbang bskur rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa'i tshe sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad dang bcas pa la rnam snang / phyogs skyong brgyad la mi bskyod pa/ gsung rdo rje klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa la 'od dpag med kyi rgyas gdab/ de nas oṃ bha ga wa na zhes sogs mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i chu bzhi dang / iṇḍa sogs kyis gtor ma phul/ de nas oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs kyis phyi mchod/ hūm̐ kham̐ sogs kyis nang mchod/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis yid 'byung gi mchod pa/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs kyis dang / mi bskyod rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ lha'i tshogs rnams zhes sogs 'phrin las bcol ba rnams 'don cha gtor chog nas 'byung ba ltar byas nas gtor ma 'bul ba 'di ni mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i gtor ma 'bul tshul te/ lha sta gon gyi tshe yang gtor ma 'bul tshul 'di ltar du bya dgos la/ spyir kyai rdo rje'i gtor ma la lha dang 'byung po tha dad pa'i gtor ma dang / de gnyis tha mi dad pa'i gtor ma gnyis/ dang po la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma dang /

'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gnyis/ dang po la mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba dang / ma 'brel ba gnyis las/ dang po ni byin gyis brlabs pa'i gtor ma mdun bskyed kyi yi dam gyi lha rnams la/ oṃ bha ga wan mahā ka ru ṇi ka he badzra sa pa ri wa ri i dam ba liṃ bhuñdza dzi ka sogs lnga'am bdun la sogs pas phul la/ me tog la sogs pas mchod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs dang / mi bskyod rdo rje sogs kyis bstod la 'dod pa'i dngos grub zhu bar bya ba de nyid yin la/ gnyis pa ni mdun du pam̐ las padma ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dgu'i steng du hūm̐ am̐ sogs sa bon las lha dgu bskyed/ yan lag lhag ma gsum byas nas gtor ma phul ba man chad gong dang 'dra bar rje btsun rtse mos bshad cing / rje sa skya pa chen pos kyang / mkha' dbyings pam̐ ram̐ pad nyi'i steng / /hūm̐ las dpal ldan lhag pa'i lha/ /dmigs te ye shes gzhug pa dang / /dbang bskur ba yang ji bzhin bya/ /lce hūm̐ rdo rje las 'od zer/ /ldan pas mnyes bya sngags gsum brjod/ /de nas mchod dang bdud rtsi myang / /bstod pa gsol btab gshegs su gsol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma la/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba dang / ma 'brel ba'i 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gnyis las/ dang po 'di la dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thog mar bya ba dang / bar du bya ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i tha mar bya ba'i gtor ma dang gsum las/ dang po ni dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub pa'i sngon 'gro'i gtor ma yin la/ gnyis pa bar du bya ba ni phyi rol pa'i gtor ma ste/ 'di la phyi rol pa'i gtor ma zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi rol tu gtong bas na phyi rol pa zhes bya ste/ rje btsun rtse mos/ phyi rol tu 'byung po'i tshogs gtor mas tshim par bya ste zhes gsungs pas so/ /gsum pa dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i tha mar bya ba'i gtor ma ni/

dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rnams grub nas 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma btang nas gtor mgron rnams rang rang gi gnas su gshegs su gsol ba'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel ba'i 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma ni/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel bar bya ba'i tshul ltar phul ba'i rjes su 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma phyi rol pa ltar las 'phrin las 'chol ba yan chad bya ba yin zhing / gnyis pa lha dang 'byung po tha mi dad kyi gtor ma la yang / dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba dang / dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel bar 'bul ba'i gtor ma gnyis las/ dang po ni/ skabs 'dir bya ba'i gtor ma mgron bskyed pa sogs gong du bstan pa ltar mdzad pa 'di la sogs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ mar me mdzad kyis/ shar lho'i dur khrod nam mkha' la/ /chos 'byung gsum brtsegs steng 'og rim/ /zhes pa ltar ram/ slob dpon kam̐ pa las/ shar gyi dur khrod nam mkha' la/ /chos 'byung gsum brtsegs bar ma ni/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bdag bskyed ma bsdus na shar gyi dur khrod kyi nam mkha' la e las chos 'byung gsum brtsegs kyi steng du pam̐ las padma 'dab ma brgyad pa re re bsam/ bsdu na rang gi shar gyi mdun du e las chos 'byung gsum brtsegs kyi nang du padma 'dab brgyad gsum brtsegs kyi gdan la kyai rdo rje lha dgu sku gsung thugs rdo rjes 'byung po brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi bskyed pa la ye shes pa dgug gzhug dbang bskur ba sogs gtor chog nas 'byung ba bzhin byas pa la/ oṃ bha ga wan mahā ka ru ṇi ka he badzra sa pa ri wa ra end+ra dza ma sogs nas aṣtha sappa swāhā'i bar brjod nas gtor ma 'bul ba lta bu yin no/ /'o na lha dang 'byung po tha dad dang tha mi dad kyi khyad par gtor mgron rnams 'byung po rang rgyud pa kho nar byas nas 'bul ba dang / 'byung po rnams lhar bskyed pa'i mgron la 'bul ba'i sgo nas 'jog gam snyam na/

lha dang 'byung po tha dad dang tha mi dad kyi gtor ma zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di kyai rdo rje ba'i lugs rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi man ngag las byung bar bshad pa yin la/ 'di gnyis kyi khyad par gtor mgron lhar bskyed mi bskyed kyi sgo nas 'byed pa ni ma yin te/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi skabs su phyi rol gtor ma 'di lha dang 'byung po tha dad pa'i gtor ma yin yang / de'i tshe 'byung po nyer bzhi po thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs su bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur rgyas gdab sogs mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i lha dang 'byung po tha mi dad kyi gtor ma'i skabs bzhin mdzad pas so/ /des na de gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi sngon 'gro gtor ma dang phyi rol gtor ma'i tshe kyai rdor lha dgu sogs yi dam gtor mgron du ma bskyed par 'byung po brgyad gsum nyer bzhi po'i dbang phyug chen po sogs lha dang brgyud pa rnams sku rdo rje sogs su bskyed nas gtor ma 'bul sngags la yi dam gyi mtshan sngags med par oṃ ind+ra sogs kyis 'bul ba dang / mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor ram/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor med kyang mdun du kyai rdor lha dgu la mtshan sngags kyi rjes su i dam sogs sbyar nas 'bul ba'i gtor ma gnyis sogs la lha dang 'byung po tha dad pa'i gtor ma zhes bya/ mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i gtor ma lta bu'i tshe kyai rdor lha dgu bskyed pa dang / 'byung po lhar bskyed pa gnyis ka gtor mgron du byas nas mtshan sngags kyi rjes su inda sogs kyang sbyar nas gtor ma lha dang 'byung po lhan cig tu phul/ 'phrin las 'chol ba yang lhan cig tu byed pa'i phyir phyi ma 'di lta bu la lha dang 'byung po tha mi dad kyi gtor ma zhes 'jog dgos te/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po'i kyai rdor gtor ma'i rnam bshad las de ltar du gsal bar gsungs pas so/

/des na phyi rol gtor ma 'di la 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i tha snyad kyang 'jug gam snyam ste/ de thams cad la gtor sngags la 'byung po brgyad gsum gyi mtshan sngags las med kyang / gtor mgron dgug pa'i tshe sa 'og sa bla/ sa steng gi sems can thams cad bkug nas 'byung po brgyad gsum po sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs su bskyed pa la bstim dgos shing / 'bul ba'i tshe yang de thams cad bsdus pa'i 'byung po brgyad gsum po la phul te 'phrin las 'chol dgos pas so/ /'o na gtor mgron de dag 'byung po rang rgyud pa yin na ni 'jig rten pa rang rgyud pa la rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len gyi bar chad zhi ba'i 'phrin las 'chol ba mi rung la/ ye shes pa yin na ni sems can bsdus pa dang 'gal lo snyam na/ 'di la bdag gi bla ma mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyi kyai rdor dbang gi dri ba'i gtor ma'i rang lan gyi skabs su/ 'di dag gi nang na sprul pas sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i ye shes pa yang srid mod/ phal cher ni sngon ston pa sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed de dkar phyogs skyong bar khas blangs pa'i 'byung po rang rgyud pa yin te/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po'i mngon rtogs dka' 'grel las/ 'byung po brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni bstan pa la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun yin pas zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na 'di dag ni ston pa'i spyan sngar dkar phyogs bsrung bar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i gza' rgyu skar/ rgyal chen sde bzhi sogs dang 'dra bar ston pa'i bka' las mi 'da' ba'i dam tshig can yin zhing / sngags la zhugs pa dang ma zhugs pa ni ci rigs par yod par sems te/ sngags kyis 'dul bar 'os pa'i dkar phyogs pa dam tshig can mang du yod pa'i phyir/ de dag ni dkar phyogs pa yin yang gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba yin no/

/skabs 'di'i lha chen brgyad la sogs pa 'di dag 'jig rten rang rgyud pa yin par ma zad rnam pa yang lha dang phyogs skyong la sogs pa rang rang gi rnam par yod la/ gtor mgron bskyed pa'i tshe lha chen brgyad sku rdo rje dang / phyogs skyong rnams thugs rdo rje dang / klu chen rnams gsung rdo rje'i rnam par bskyed nas de dag la sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i sems can kun bsdus te so sor bstim pa yin pas lha chen sogs gtor mgron gyi gtso bo yin pa gzhir bzhag yod/ sa bla sogs kyi sems can kun kyang skabs 'di'i gtor mgron yin te zhes gsungs/ kun mkhyen chen po'i dbang chu chen po'i rnam bshad bde chen rgya mtsho las/ phyi rol gtor ma'i skabs su gang la 'bul ba'i yul/ rdo rje gur le'u bzhi pa'i lung / nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas par/ /padma 'dab brgyad bsgom par bya/ /zhes pa nas/ lha mi dmyal ba sems can rnams/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas 'og tu 'o/ /zhes pa'i bar drangs nas/ zhes gsungs pa'i 'byung po brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi la'o/ /'di dag kyang rdo rje 'chang gi thugs ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul 'jig rten pa'i tshul bzung nas rgyud kyi srung mar bskos pa yin gyi/ 'jig rten pa rang rgyud pa la rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len gyi bar chad sel pa'i 'phrin las 'chol ba'i lugs ni med do/ /'jig rten pa'i tshul bzung ba la yang ming gi tha snyad 'jig rten pa'i tshul bzung ba dang / rnam pa 'jig rten pa'i tshul bzung ba gnyis las/ 'dir ni dang po'i dbang du byas pa ste/ rnam pa sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum dang khyad par med do/ /zhes gsungs pas 'dir/ kun mkhyen chen pos 'jig rten pa'i tshul bzung ba ma gtogs don la rdo rje 'chang gi thugs kyi sprul pa yin pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i tshul bzung ba yang ming 'jig rten pa'i tshul bzung ba yin gyi/ rnam pa lha'i rnam pa yin par gsungs pa 'di dang /

bdag gi bla ma mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i bzhed pa gong du bkod pa de cung zad mi mthun pa ltar snang mod/ rang gi bsam tshod ltar na dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub pa'i phyi rol gtor ma lta bu'i tshe 'byung po brgyad gsum nyer bzhi po sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum dang rnam pa mtshungs par bskyed pa la mgron dgug pa'i tshe/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i sems can thams cad bkug nas bstim pa yin pas/ de'i tshe gtor mgron du 'byung po rang rgyud pa dpag tu med pa zhig yod pa ni gzhir bcas la/ 'byung po'i gtso bo nyer bzhi po 'di dag ston pa nyid kyis dkyil 'khor chen por bcug nas dbang bskur te bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pa sha stag yin pas 'byung po phal pa ni ga la yin te/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po'i mngon rtogs dka' 'grel gyi lung mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pas 'dren par mdzad pa dang / ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi kyai rdor gtor ma'i cho ga'i rnam bshad las/ 'di la 'bul ba'i yul ni/ kha cig dkyil 'khor blta bar mi dbang pa'i 'byung po phyi rol pa'o/ /zhes pa ni ma yin te/ sngon rdo rje 'chang gis rgyud gsungs pa'i tshe dkyil 'khor du bcug ste dbang bskur nas bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pa'i phyir ro zhes gsungs pas so/ /yang ye shes pa kho na rang du'ang ma nges sam snyam ste/ sa chen gyis 'byung po brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni bstan pa la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun yin pas zhes byang sems su bshad kyi/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul du ma bshad pa'i phyir dang / gzhan yang slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo'i sambu ṭi'i 'grel pa gnad kyi gsal byed las/ de la zhing skyong ba'i gtso bo brgyad dang mkha' 'gro sum cu so gnyis dang bcas pa'i gtso bo brgyad ni nag po zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos te/ de la 'di rnams kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan brgya byin la sogs pa dang 'dra ste/

brgya byin la sogs pa 'dul bar byed pa'am/ de rnams nyid btul ba'i rang bzhin zhing skyong ba yin gyi/ 'di rnams ni 'jig rten pa nyid kho nar lta bar mi bya'o/ /de bas na 'di rnams mchod pas skyon du ga la 'gyur zhes 'jig rten pa nyid kho nar lta bar mi bya'o/ /zhes pa'i kho na'i nus pas zhing skyong gi gtso bo brgyad sogs phal cher 'jig rten las 'das pa yin yang / 'jig rten pa yang yod pa zhig bstan pa 'di dang mtshungs par/ 'dir 'byung po brgyad gsum nyer bzhi po la yang 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa gnyis su yod par byas nas bshad na legs bsam snyam mo/ /'o na gtor mgron la 'byung po yod na/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas bzhin pas 'byung po tha mal pa la mchod pa byas par song bas/ slob dpon dpal dbyangs kyis/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpar khas 'che la/ /'jig rten lha klu dag la phal mchod na/ /rkyen du mi 'tshams rnal 'byor zhing dang 'gal/ /rgyal pos dmangs kyi spyod pa byed pa bzhin/ /zhes pa dang 'gal lo snyam na/ 'di la bdag gi bla ma mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gsung las/ mdor na inda dza ma zhes sogs kyi mthar/ i dam ba liṃ bhuñtsa sogs kyi tshe sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i 'byung po kun la gtor ma bsngo bar bsam/ de yang sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi rnam par bsam nas byas na tshogs rdzogs phul che zhing / de la mchod bstod kyang bya rung ba yin te/ ngo bo sems can yin yang rnam pa lhar bskyed pa la gtor ma 'bul ba sogs byas na phan yon che ba yin no zhes pa dang / de ltar gtor mgron dam tshig pa kun lha'i rnam par gsal ba de la phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs nas bstims pas ye shes pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsam pa sogs kyang gsang sngags pa thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par yin pas phan yon che ste/

de ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs pa de la mchod gtor 'bul zhing / khyad par mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /sogs kyi bstod pa byed pa yang skabs su bab cing 'brel chags/ mjug tu 'phrin 'chol gyi tshe de nas kyang bdag cag rnal 'byor pa 'khor bcas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bsrung ba dang sdong grogs mdzod cig ces pa yang skabs su babs cing legs pa yin te/ gtor mgron gyi 'byung po rnams rang rgyud pa yin yang / de dag lha'i rnam par gsal ba la ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstims tshar bas ye shes pa rnams kyis byang chub ma thob kyi bar du srung skyob nus pas so/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di nyid shin tu 'thad pa yin te/ rje kun dga' bzang pos/ de dag ye shes par mi bsgyur bar 'byung po phal par 'dod pa ni rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung lugs la 'dris chung ba yin te/ rnal 'byor chen po'i lugs kyi ci dang ci snang ba thams cad lha'i rol par shes par bya'i/ tha mal pa'i spyod pa nam yang bkag pa yin la zhes gsungs pa dang / chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas tshogs 'khor rtsod spong las/ gtor mas 'byung po sangs rgyas su bsgoms la mchod/ de ltar ma yin na rgyal pos dmangs la gus pa byas pa'am/ dge slong gis khyim pa la gus pa byas pa ltar ltung ba 'byung bar bshad/ de ltar byas pas sangs rgyas kyang mnyes/ 'byung po'ang tshim pa'i rten 'brel yod gsungs zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi dgongs par snang bas so snyam du sems te legs par dpyod cig de lta bu'i 'byung po spyi gtor gyi 'bul sngags ni rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis nas 'byung ba'i oṃ inda sogs te/ 'di ni 'ga' zhig gis saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du 'khrul pa yod kyang / kra kri ta'i skad yin par bshad cing / sngags don ni/ oṃ ni bkra shis pa'i phyir sngags kyi mgo 'dren pa/ inda dbang po/ dza ma gshin rje/ dza la chu lha/ dzakṣa gnod sbyin/ bhu ta 'byung po/

ba hen me lha/ bā u rlung lha/ rakṣa srin po ste phyogs skyong brgyad do/ /tsanda zla ba/ su dza nyi ma/ gza' rnams lha'i khongs su 'du bar bshad/ ma da sa'i lha mo/ bāppa tshangs pa/ 'dis mtshon nas lha chen po brgyad do/ /ta la pa ta la rkang 'og na gnas pa/ aṣṭha brgyad/ sappa sbrul te 'dis mtshon nas klu brgyad do/ /swāhā gzhi tshugs shig pa'am/ shanti pas zhi ba'i don du bshad do/ /sngags de dag brjod cing pad kor bya ba'i/ pad kor gyis ni gtor ma'i mgron rnams gsal gdab par bya ba yin no/ /de nas rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ i daṃ ni 'di/ ba liṃ gtor ma/ bhu dza zo/ dzi gha snoms shig pa ste/ gang bsnom na phu la me tog dhu pa spos/ mam̐ sa sha chen/ piṃ ga nya sha ste rdzas de dag ni bzhes par zhu'o/ /bzhes nas ci mdzad na/ ambha bdag gi sappa thams cad/ katsa dza sa ta don sgrubs shig khanti khu ni bzod par gsol cig phe ṭa ga ta gnod pa sol cig ste/ de ni 'dod pa'i don zhu ba'o/ /de nas/ oṃ kā ro mu'i sngags don ni/ oṃ sngar dang 'dra/ a ni gdod ma nas ma skyes pa/ kā ro ni bya ba'am byed pa/ mu kham̐ ni sgo/ sarba thams cad/ dharmā ni chos te/ a zhes pa ni gdod ma nas ma skyes pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o zhes pa'o/ /ā dyā nutpan na twad ces pa ni gdod ma nas ma skyes pa'i de kho na nyid do zhes pa'o/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ ni de kho na nyid kyi ngo bor rnal 'byor pa dang mgron gyi lus ngag yid gsum de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs su mnyam pa'o/ /phaṭ dag pa swāhā gzhi tshugs shig pa ste/ 'di ni gtor ma dang / rnal 'byor pa dang / mgron gsum ka de bzhin nyid du byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /de ltar kyai rdor gyi gtor ma phul zin nas/ bde mchog sogs yi dam gzhan dang / gur zhal sogs chos skyong gi gtor ma yang 'bul bzhin pa rnams da lta phyag len la yod pa bzhin thams cad dang /

de nas chos skyong gi bskang gso byed spro zhing shes na/ bskang rdzas byin rlabs nas bzung bskang ba rgyas bsdus skabs thob dang sbyar nas bya zhing / de nas chos skyong gi bstod pa/ rdo rje'i glu sogs dang / bskang gso'i thun gtor 'bul ba sogs thams cad phyag len bzhin bya ba ni gtor ma btang zhes pa'i don yin no// //spyi don bcu pa snyan gsan dbab cing mchod bstod bya ba la/ snyan gsan dbab pa/ mchod pa 'bul ba/ bstod pa bya ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten la bcug pa'i ye shes pa rnams zhes pa nas/ rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes rab gnas kyi rten gyi gtso bo gang yin des mtshon nas brjod pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar te/ de yang snyan gsan dbab rgyu ni/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten dam tshig pa rnams la sngar spyan drangs nas bcug pa'i ye shes pa rnams/ rab gnas dngos gzhi'i ye shes pa spyan 'dren gyi bar nam mkhar btegs nas spyan drangs pa'i tshe/ rten byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir 'byon par zhu'o/ /zhes snyan gsan 'bebs pa ste/ dper na 'jig rten na bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen sogs thog mar rang gi bar chad sogs sel ba'i phyir spyan drangs pa la yon cung zad phul nas/ slar dus che ge mo zhig gi tshe khyed dag spyan drangs nas mchod par byed pas de dus brtse bas 'byon par mdzad dgos zhes spyan 'dren pa'i sngon du snyan gsan gsol ba dang 'dra'o/ /ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ dpon slob mang po yod tshe kun gyis rdor dril dang / slob dpon gyis spos dang bcas pas gdangs yod med gang rung gi sgo nas/ 'di zhes bya ba'i bcom ldan 'das zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gcig po brjod pa yin la/ de'i don yang 'di zhes pa spyi'i tshig ste/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten de nyid sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan yin na/ shākya'i rgyal po bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes pa dang /

bde dges gsang gsum so so'i sku brnyan la/ 'khor lo bde mchog bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes pa dang / dges pa rdo rje bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes pa dang / gsang ba 'dus pa bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes rim pa bzhin sbyar zhing / mchod rten yin na/ rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes sbyar ba'am/ yang mchod rten dang / gtsug lag khang dang / khang bzang rnams la/ bde gshegs rigs lnga bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes sbyar ba yang bshad la/ gsung rab yin na/ 'od dpag med mgon bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes sbyar/ rigs lnga re re ba yin na/ rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes pa dang / mi bskyod rdo rje bcom ldan 'das/ /dang / rin chen 'byung ldan bcom ldan 'das/ /dang / 'od dpag med mgon bcom ldan 'das/ /dang / don yod grub pa bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes rigs lnga so so'i sku brnyan gang yin dang bstun pa'i 'don cha bsgyur dgos par bshad la/ yang tshig brjod pa'i tshe yid kyis lha gang yin der mos pa'i sgo nas bde dges sogs la/ he ru ka dpal bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes pa las de dang der 'don pa ma bsgyur yang 'gal ba med do/ /de ltar 'don pa bsgyur ba'am/ ma bsgyur yang rung / de lta bu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rigs sngags rgyal po khyed la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa ste/ phyag btsal nas ci byed na/ ye shes pa khyed rnams thugs rje'i bdag nyid can gyis 'gro ba sems can rnams la spyan legs par dbye ba'am/ phye nas gzigs pa'i sgo nas byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir du rig pa 'dzin pa'am/ gsang sngags 'chang ba rdo rje slob dpon ga ge mo bdag gis rang cag gi slob ma yon bdag dang bcas pa rnams la sems brtse bas de dag la phan pa'i phyir dang / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas khyed rnams la yang rang rgyud la bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs pa'i ched du mchod pa rgya chen po 'bul ba'i phyir/ yo byad kyi dngos po rgya chen po'am/ 'on kyang rgya chung yang rung ci dang ci 'byor pa dag legs par bshams pa dang bcas pa dag gi sgo nas rten la rab tu gnas pa'i dngos gzhi nangs par bgyid par 'tshal bas na/

bdag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa dgongs par mdzod la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po la sogs pa'i ye shes pa'i tshogs pa thams cad ma tshang ba med par nam mkhar rab tu gnas pa'am/ rab tu bzhugs par 'gyur ba khyed rnams kun gyis rten la byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes pa'i don te/ de lta bu'i tshig rnams lan gsum brjod pa yin la/ tshigs bcad de dag gi bar la dril bu bcad gtubs su dkrol zhing / de nas slob dpon gyis spos bzhag kun gyis dril bu rgyun dkrol dang / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhes sogs brjod pa ste tshig don go sla'o/ /de dag gis ni don gsal las/ de la 'di zhes bya ba ni spyi'i tshig ste/ rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes bya ba rang rang gi lha'i mtshan gzhug par bya'o zhes gsungs pa'i don yang legs par bshad pa yin no/ /gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ de nas mar me dang / zhal zas sogs gsar pa ji ltar rigs pa phul zhing zhes pa nas/ shapta'i bar gyi sngags mchod sna tshogs rol mo dang bcas pas phul ces pa'i bar te go sla/ mchod pa'i sngags don ni 'og sngags dbul gyi skabs su 'byung ngo / /'di'i skabs su mchod pa la bla ma 'phags pa'i gsung bzhin 'jag chen gyi don gsal la mchan mdzad par/ mchod yon phal chen mchod yon bla bre dang / /zhes sogs dkon mchog ta la'i mdo nas 'byung ba 'di nyid mdzad par bshad kyang / don gsal las/ de nas mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas bsdus pa sngags tsam gyi mchod pa nyid legs so/ /gsum pa bstod pa bya ba ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ de nas dril sil gdangs dang bcas pas/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs de nyid lnga pa dang / phyag byar 'os pa sogs shlau ka gcig gis bstod ces pa ste bstod pa'i tshig don rnams ni gong du bstan pa ltar ro// //spyi don bcu gcig pa bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol ba ni/

nongs pa bzod gsol dang / ye shes pa gshegs gsol gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /ces dang zhes pa ste/ yig brgya'i sngags don ni bskyed rim gnad kyi zla zer dang / man ngag rnam bshad sogs nas 'byung ba ltar kho bo cag gi kyai rdor sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad du bshad yod pas der blta'o/ /tshigs bcad kyi don ni/ 'dir bdag cag rnams kyi mchod pa'i yo byad rgya chen po ma 'byor ba dang / 'byor pa dag kyang 'bags pa sogs kyis mchod pa bzang po ngan par nyams pa rnams kyis khyed rnams mchod par byas pa las byung ba'i nyes pa dang / nyes pa gang yang bdag cag las 'bras la rmongs pa sogs blo ma rig pa yis ni kun nas bslangs te bdag nyid kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas bgyis pa dang / gang zag gzhan la bgyid du stsal pa ste byed du bcug pa sogs dngos brgyud kyi sgo nas rang gzhan gyi nyes pa thog ma med pa nas bsags pa de dag kun sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs mdzad pa po rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bzod par bzhes la bdag sogs nyes pas ma gos par mdzod ces pa'o/ /gnyis pa gshegs su gsol ba ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ khu tshur gnyis kyi mthe'u chung sbrel zhes pa nas/ snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa kun dga' bzang po'i gsung rab rab gnas bkra shis rgya mtshor gsungs so zhes pa'i bar te/ de yang khu tshur gnyis kyi mthe'u chung sbrel/ mdzub mo gnyis brkyangs te rtse sprad pa 'di la gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya zhes bya zhing / de nyid spyi bor ldog ste 'jog pa ni rdo rje shugs kyi phyag rgya yin la phyag rgya de nyid bcas te/ hūm̐ badzra u tiṣṭha zhes pa'i sngags brjod nas sngar rten la bstims pa'i ye shes pa rnams nam mkhar btegs/

de ltar btegs pa la rten gyi ye shes pa thams cad ces sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ gong ltar sngags mchod tsam dang bstod pa bya ba ni ye shes pa gshegs su gsol ba'o/ /spyir ye shes pa gshegs gsol la/ rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol ba dang / nam mkhar gshegs su gsol ba gnyis las/ 'dir ni phyi ma ste/ rten gyi thad kyi nam mkhar 'degs pa'o/ /kha cig 'dir ye shes pa nam mkhar mi 'degs par brtan bzhugs byed pa man ngag yin zer ba yod kyang / rten rnying pa la rab gnas bskyar nas byed pa lta bu yin na sta gon gyi tshe yang nam mkhar mi 'degs par brtan bzhugs byed pa yin yang / gsar pa'i rab gnas kyi tshe sta gon gyi dus su brtan bzhugs byed pa ni snyan gsan dbab pa'i dgos pa dang go don ma shes pa yin te/ snyan gsan dbab pa'i don gong du bshad pa ltar ye shes pa rnams slar rten la spyan drangs pa'i tshe 'byon pa'i ched yin la/ brtan bzhugs byas pa'i tshe rten la bzhugs bzhin pa yin pa slar 'byon par gsol pa 'debs mi dgos pa'i phyir/ des na ngor chen gyi bkra shis rgya mtshor snyan gsan dbab pa'i dgos pa ma shes par zad do zhes gsungs pa'i don yang de nyid yin no/ /yang slob dpon a bha yas sta gon gyi tshe dam tshig pa mi bskyed par ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas nas spyan drangs pa la mchod bstod byas snyan gsan phab ste gshegs gsol byed par bshad 'dug kyang / don gsal du dam tshig pa bskyed ye shes pa bstim par bshad pa bzhin 'dir yang mdzad pa ni slob dpon rab 'byor bskyangs kyis de ltar du bshad pa dang mthun pa yin no// //spyi don bcu gnyis pa rten dgab pa ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las dar la sogs pa na bza' ser pos rten rnams mi mngon par dgab ces pa nas/ zhes don gsal las gsungs zhes pa'i bar te/ rten che ba dag la dar ser po la sogs pa bkab ste/ oṃ badzra wasatwa ya āḥhūm̐ swāhā/

zhes brjod de phul/ a mṛ ta lan gsum brjod pas bsrung bar bya ste/ 'di ltar dgab pa'i dgos pa ni/ rgyal po rgyal sar ma 'thon pa rgyal srid la mi dbang ba ltar rab gnas ma zin pa'i rten de mchod pa'i 'os sam yul bzang ba ma yin no/ /zhes bstan pa'i ched yin te/ de ltar du don gsal las bshad pas so/ /a mṛ ta brjod pa rten bsrung ba'i ched yin mod/ na bza' ser po sogs dgab pas kyang bsrung bar 'gyur te/ gos dmar can dag mthong ba na/ /kla klo la sogs 'bros par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas so// //spyi don bcu gsum pa bdag bsrung ba ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ de ltar rab gnas kyi sta gon zin pa dang / zhes pa nas/ spyod lam dang nyal ba'i rnal 'byor sogs bya'o/ /de dag gis ni rab gnas kyi sta gon gyi cho ga yongs su rdzogs pa bstan zin to/ /zhes pa'i bar te/ de yang rab gnas kyi sta gon yongs su rdzogs nas dkyil 'khor gyi mjug gi cho ga rnams bya ba yin la/ 'di la mchod pa 'bul ba/ bstod pa bya ba/ nongs pa bzod gsol/ dkyil 'khor gyi ye shes pa brtan bzhugs/ rten med kyi gtor mgron gshegs gsol/ bdag bsrung ba dngos/ bsngo ba smon lam bya ba/ rnal 'byor lhag ma gzhan bya tshul/ rab gnas kyi sta gon rdzogs tshul smos pa dang don tshan dgu ste rim pa bzhin mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ zhes sogs dang / bstod pa rnams bya'o zhes pa dang / yig brgya lan gsum zhes pa dang / rang kyai rdo rje zhes sogs dang / dge ba 'di yis zhes sogs dang / spyod lam dang nyal ba'i rnal 'byor sogs bya'o zhes pa dang / de dag gis ni zhes sogs kyis bstan pa yin te go sla'o/ /de rnams kyi sgo nas nub gnyis pa dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi dngos gzhi dang po'i cho ga'i don dang / rab gnas kyi sta gon gyi cho ga'i don rnams legs par bstan zin to/ /da ni nub gsum pa dkyil 'khor gyi dngos gzhi gnyis pa rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi'i cho ga'i don rnams bshad par bya ste/

'di la yang yo byad bsham pa'i tshul dang / cho ga dngos bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ nub gsum pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi dngos gzhi gnyis pa rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi la/ dkyil 'khor gyi mchod pa gtor ma sogs sgrub mchod ltar so so'i phyag len bzhin ma tshang pa med par bsham zhes pa nas/ tsa ru'i bza' ba phyag len bzhin bsham pa'o zhes pa'i bar te/ dkyus nas ji skad bshad pa ltar yo byad rnams gya nom par bsham par bya ba yin no/ /gnyis pa cho ga dngos ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga la sdom ni/ tho rangs bdag bskyed mdun bskyed mchod/ /rten sbyang bkru zhing phyi ba dang / /ring bsrel gzhug cing gsol ba gdab/ /rten bskyed spyan drangs dgug rgyas gdab/ /dbang bskur mchod bstod spyan dbye bya/ /gsol gdab mnga' dbul rgyas par bya/ /de yang mchod bstod bye brag dang / /sbyin sreg sngags te dngos gzhi'o/ /zhes pa ltar don bcu gsum gyi zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bdag bskyed cing mdun bskyed bsgrubs te de nyid mchod pa'i tshul sogs bshad pa/ rten sbyangs pa'i tshul bshad pa/ bkru zhing phyi ba'i tshul bshad pa/ ring bsrel gzhug pa'i tshul bshad pa/ gsol ba gdab pa'i tshul bshad pa/ rten bskyed pa'i tshul bshad pa/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bgegs bskrad cing mchod pa'i tshul sogs bshad pa/ rgyas gdab pa'i tshul bshad pa/ dbang bskur ba'i tshul bshad pa/ mchod bstod bya ba'i tshul bshad pa/ spyan dbye ba'i tshul bshad pa/ brtan par bzhugs par gsol ba gdab tshul bshad pa/ mnga' dbul rgyas par bya ba'i tshul bshad pa dang don tshan bcu gsum las/ dang po ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ sang tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs la/ gos ser po la sogs pa gon zhes pa nas/ de nas bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang rdzogs par blangs so/ /zhes pa'i bar te/ de yang mdang nub kyai rdor rang lugs kyi nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gnyis po gang gi sgo nas nyal ba dang mthun pa'i ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs la/

rgyas pa'i las 'grub pa'i ched yin pas gos kha dog ser po can gyon stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas/ phyi rol gtor ma'i rjes su dkyil 'khor khang pa'i nang du lhag chad kha bskangs pa'i bar cho ga yongs su rdzogs pa dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod ltar byas te/ rnam rgyal dang las bum dri bzang gi kha gso phyag len bzhin dang / bum bskyed sngar ltar mdzad cing / khrus bum gcig las med na gzungs thag skor lugs sogs dkyus bzhin byas rjes bdag 'jug rdzogs par blang bar bya ba yin la/ bdag 'jug gi bshad pa ni dbang chu bde chen rgya mtsho sogs su blta'o// //spyi don gnyis pa dang gsum pa ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ spyi don gnyis pa rten sbyang ba dang / spyi don gsum pa bkru zhing phyi ba ni/ sta gon gyi skabs bzhin bya'o zhes te cho ga yang sta gon gyi skabs bzhin bya zhing tshig don yang gong ltar rtogs par bya'o// //spyi don bzhi pa ring bsrel gzhug tshul bshad pa ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel lam/ rig sngags chen mo dang / rten 'brel snying po dang zhes pa nas/ zhes lan gcig brjod pa'o zhes pa'i bar te/ de yang spyir ring bsrel de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos sku'i ring bsrel gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'phags pa gsum gyi ring bsrel ni/ /yon tan stobs kyis 'byung ba yin/ /zhes pa dang / mi 'grib 'phel ba'i ring bsrel yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yon tan gyi stobs las byung ba rgyun mi chad cing 'phel bar 'gyur ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku gdung gi cha shas su gyur pa/ da lta ring bsrel du yongs su grags pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni/ oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wa zhes sogs rten 'brel snying po dang / oṃ sarba birya swāhā/ zhes pa dang / oṃ badzra a yu ṣe swāhā/

zhes pa dang / oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā zhes pa la sogs pa'i gzungs dang / bzod pa dka' thub dam pa bzod pa yi/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog ces sangs rgyas gsungs/ /rab tu byung ba gzhan la gnod pa dang / /gzhan la 'tshe ba dge sbyong ma yin no/ /zhes sangs rgyas rnam gzigs kyis gsungs pa'i so thar gyi mdo tshig gi gso sbyong gi tshigs bcad/ mig ldan 'gro ba yod pa yis/ /nyam nga ba dag ji bzhin du/ /mkhas pa 'tsho ba'i 'jig rten 'dir/ /sdig pa dag ni yongs su spangs/ /skur pa mi gdab gnod mi bya/ /so sor thar pa'ang bsdam par bya/ /zas kyi tshod kyang rig par bya/ /rab mtha'i gnas su gnas par bya/ /lhag pa'i sems la yang dag sbyor/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa 'o/ /zhes sangs rgyas gtsug tor can gyi gso sbyong gi tshigs bcad/ ji ltar bung ba me tog las/ /kha dog dri la mi gnod par/ /khu ba gzhibs nas 'phur ba ltar/ /de bzhin thub pa grong du rgyu/ /zhes sangs rgyas thams cad skyobs kyi gso sbyong gi tshigs bcad/ bdag gis rigs dang mi rigs la/ /brtag par bya ste gzhan rnams kyis/ /mi mthun pa dang gzhan dag gis/ /byas dang ma byas rnams la min/ /zhes sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gi gso sbyong gi tshigs bcad/ lhag pa'i sems la bdag bya ste/ /thub pa'i thub gzhi rnams la bslab/ /nyer zhi rtag tu dran ldan pa'i/ /skyobs pa mya ngan med pa yin/ /zhes sangs rgyas gser thub kyi gso sbyong gi tshigs bcad/ sbyin pas bsod nams rab tu 'phel/ /legs bsdams dgra sogs mi 'gyur ro/ /dge dang ldan pas sdig pa spong / /nyon mongs zad pas mya ngan 'da'/ /zhes sangs rgyas 'od srung gi gso sbyong gi tshigs bcad/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs pa spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin/

/yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /thams cad du ni sdom pa legs/ /kun tu bsdams pa'i dge slong ni/ /sdug bsngal kun las rab tu grol/ /ngag rnams srung zhing yid kyis rab bsdams te/ /lus kyis mi dge ba dag mi byed cing / /las lam gsum po 'di la rab sbyangs na/ /drang srong gsungs pa'i lam ni 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes 'o skol gyi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa 'di nyid kyis gsungs pa'i so thar gyi mdo tshig gam gso sbyong gi tshigs bcad la sogs pa yin la/ ring bsrel de dag gzhug tshul ni yungs 'bru'i ring bsrel ni gos dar la sogs pa'i nang du dri bzang dang bcas pa bstums nas sku gzugs la sogs pa'i dbu'i thad du gzhug cing / gzungs la sogs pa'i chos sku'i ring bsrel rnams ni tshar mang du bzlas nas gro ga'am shog bu la sogs pa la gur gum dang ghi wang bsres pa'i khu ba'am so so ba'i khu ba la sogs pas bris la sku gzugs 'bur rnams kyi dbu'i rgyab phyogs dang / mchod rten gyi bre'i thad kyi rgyab phyogs nas 'jug cing / bris sku la rgyab tu 'bri la/ gsung rab la mgo mjug tu 'bri ba yin zhing / sku gzugs dang mchod rten sogs la gzhug pa'i bug pa med na dbu'i bre la 'dogs par yang bshad mod/ de yang 'phags yul na rten 'bur sku rnams la bzhengs pa'i tshe dbu'am thugs kha'i thad du bug pa bzhag ste/ rab gnas kyi dus su slob dpon gyis sngags bzla zhing / lha bzo bas ring bsrel rnams gzhug ste bug pa sdom par byed pa zhig yod pa de dang sgo mtshungs par byed na gong ltar bya ba yin yang / bod 'dir rten bzhengs nas thog mar ring bsrel sogs nang rdzongs rnams legs par grub par byas te rten gyi bya ba'i skabs su bsdus nas/ de nas rab gnas mdzad pa nyid shas che bas deng sang phyag len la/ oṃ sarba bidya sogs dpon slob thams cad kyis bsgrigs 'don mdzad la/

de yang ring bsrel dang gso sbyong gi tshigs bcad la sogs pas rten gyi dbu nas gdan gyi bar thams cad go mtshams med par gang bar bsam ste/ sngags dang tshigs bcad bzla ba yin zhing / de yang dper na sgrub pa po'i lus la sems brten te yun ring du gnas dgos pa ltar/ sarba bidya ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi skad dod yin la/ badzra a yu ṣe ni tshe brtan pa zhes pa yin pas de ni sku'i dod sku de la thugs brten te yun ring du gnas pa'i rten 'brel ni su pra tiṣṭha badzra zhes pa ste/ 'di dag gzugs rdzongs su gzhug pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin la/ ye dharma sogs kyi sngags don ni/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs/ /zhes pa'o/ /de'i rjes su/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /zhes sogs kyi gso sbyong gi tshigs bcad kyi don ni/ 'di skad gsungs zhes pa las 'phros nas/ gang gsungs na thar 'dod kyi gdul bya rnams kyis sdig pa chung ngu la sogs pa ci yang mi bya ste/ de ltar byas pa'i nyes dmigs la brten nas ngan song gsum la sogs par skye bar 'gyur bas na/ sdig pa byed pa ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mi mthun pas so/ /dge ba ni phun sum tshogs pa ste rgya chen po lta ci smos chung ngu tsam nas spyad cing bsag par bya ste/ de ltar bsags pa'i sgo nas sgrib pa sbyong ba ni rang sems 'dul ba'i thabs yin zhing / de lta bu ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i don dang mthun pa yin pas so/ /de ltar yang bya ba'i tshul ni/ srog gcod pa dang / ma byin pa len pa dang / 'khrig pa'i las te lus kyi mi dge ba gsum spangs te bsrung ba ni lus kyi sdom pa'i legs par spyad pa yin la/ rdzun dang / phra ma dang / tshig rtsub/ ngag 'khyal te ngag gi mi dge ba bzhi spangs te bsrung ba ni ngag gi sdom pa'i legs par spyad pa yin zhing /

brnab sems dang gnod sems dang / log par blta ba ste yid kyi mi dge ba gsum spangs te bsrung ba ni yid kyi sdom pa'i legs par spyad pa yin pas/ de ltar mi dge ba bcu spangs te dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du ni lus ngag yid gsum spang bya las sdom pa'i sdom pa legs pa dang ldan pa yin pas de ltar bya'o zhes pa'i don te/ sngags tshan gnyis dang tshigs bcad gnyis po 'di lan gcig brjod pa ni ring bsrel gzhug pa'i cho ga'o// //spyi don lnga pa gsol ba gdab pa'i tshul bshad pa ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ dpon slob rnams snam sbyar la sogs pa gyon nas langs te zhes pa nas/ zhes dpon slob rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu brjod cing / lag na yod pa'i nas rnams gtor/ snam sbyar sogs bzhag nas gral la 'dug go /zhes pa'i bar te/ de yang gang 'di zhes sogs sde tshan bzhi po 'di dag la sems bskyed kyi tshig tu yang bshad/ rjes dran du yang bshad cing / gsol gdab kyi tshig tu yang bshad mod/ de dag 'gal ba ma yin pas sde tshan bzhi po 'di de gsum cha yin la/ sems bskyed kyi tshig yin te 'di rnams brjod pa'i thog mar yid kyis rten la byin gyis rlob byed kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkhar byon par bsam/ de dag gi spyan sngar sems bskyed nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi sgo nas sems can gyi don du rab tu gnas par byed par dam bcas shing / de ltar du sems bskyed pa yin pas so/ /rjes dran yang yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas rab gnas byed par dam bcas pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsol 'debs kyang yin te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkhar bzhugs pa rnams la rten la rab gnas mdzad par gsol ba btab pa'i sgo nas rab gnas bya bar dam bcas pa yin pas so/ /des na de dag gi tshig don ni/ gang 'di zhes pa spyi sgra yin yang /

'og gi bcom ldan 'das te zhes pa dang 'brel bas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das te/ de'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs ni/ bdud bzhi bcom zhing dbang phyug gi yon tan drug dang ldan pas na bcom ldan/ 'das zhes pa ni bcom ldan 'das kyi skad dod bha ga wan la med kyang / lo tsā ba rnams kyis bsnan pa yin par bshad la/ rang nyid kyi brnyes pa'i byang chub chen po ni sdug bsngal bag chags dang bcas pa dang bral zhing zag med kyi bde ba'i dpal 'byor kho na dang ldan pa de bzhin du gzigs pa der gshegs sam/ de bzhin nyid dag pa gnyis ldan du gshegs pas na de de bzhin gshegasapa/ nyon mongs pa'i dgra'am mi mthun pa'i phyogs bcom pas na dgra bcom pa/ sdug bsngal gyi rten mi byed par spang bya rnams yang dag par spangs shing ma lus par rdzogs par spangs pa dang / rtogs pa yang ji lta ba dang ji snyed pas bsdus pa'i rtogs bya thams cad rtogs pa mthar thug pas rtogs pa rdzogs pa ste/ tshul de'i sgo nas sangs rgyas pas na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ chos dang don dang nges pa'i tshig dang spobs pa so sor yang dag par rig pa dang / rdzu 'phrul zhabs su ldan pas na rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ lam bde ba nas 'bras bu bde bar gshegs pas na bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten la nyin mtshan du lan drug drug gzigs pas 'jig rten kun dar rgud kyi rgyu 'bras sogs ji lta ba bzhin mkhyen cing gzigs pas 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu sems can rnams kyi shes rgyud kyi sgrib gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i nyon mongs pa kun thabs sna tshogs pa bstan pa'i sgo nas 'dul bar byed pa'i kha lo pa yin pas na skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ rang gi gong rol lam bla na 'am steng na rang las lhag pa gzhan med pas na bla na med pa/ lha dang mir bcas pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa rnams la thar pa'i lam ston pa po mtshungs med yin pas na lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/

ma rig pa'i bag chags dang bcas pa'i gnyid las sangs shing / shes bya la blo gros padma rgyas pa ltar gyur pas na sangs rgyas/ lha'i bu'i bdud/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud/ 'chi bdag gi bdud/ phung po'i bdud de bdud bzhi bcom zhing / dbang phyug gi yon tan drug dang ldan pas na bcom ldan 'das te/ de ltar mtshan gyi rnam grangs mchog tu gyur pa mang po dang ldan pa de ni sangs rgyas nyid yin te/ de ni rgyu dus su thabs byang chub kyi sems dang / shes rab spros bral rtogs pa'i blo la yun ring du goms par mdzad pas 'bras dus su shes bya thams cad mngon sum du mkhyen pa mthar thug pa brnyes pas na rgyu'i dgos pa phun sum tshogs pa rang don du 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa de lta bu brnyes pas/ rang nyid kyis ji ltar gzigs pa'i lam gzhan la phyin ci ma log par ston nus shing ston par yang mdzad pa las gdul byas kyang go 'phangs de lta bu thob par 'gyur bas na 'bras bu'i dgos pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa dang / shes bya'i chos thams cad thugs su tshud cing mkhyen pa yin pas so/ /des na de lta bu'i mtshan dang yon tan dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nam mkhar mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa 'di dag gam 'di rnams kyi rten 'di la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tshul de bzhin du rdo rje slob dpon bdag gis kyang rab tu gnas par bgyi'o zhes pa'i don te/ de lta bu'i don dang ldan pa'i rjes dran gyi tshig 'di dag brjod pa'i rjes su rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bya zhing / rten la me tog gi char dbab spos kyis bdug pa dang / rol mo'i ring la 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te shākya mu ne ye/ ta thā ga ta ya/ arha te samyaka saṃ buddha ye/ tadya thā/ oṃ mu n+ya mu n+ya mahā mu n+ya ye swāhā/ zhes pa dang / gzhan yang rten ngo shes pa rnams kyi sngags dang / rang gi yi dam gyi sngags kyang brjod par bya zhing /

rjes dran 'di dag gi tshe rten gyi thad kyi steng gi nam mkha' la phyogs bcu'i zhing khams thams cad nas 'od zer gyi dra ba dpag tu med pa 'phros te 'od zer gyi dra bas khyab par byas pa'i steng du sangs rgyas dang byang sems bsam gyis mi khyab par bzhugs par bsgom zhing / de rnams kyis rten rnams la byin gyis rlob pa'i sgo nas rab gnas mdzad par bsam pa dang / de bzhin du rang nyid kyis kyang rab gnas byas par bsgom dgos pa yin la/ de'i phyir na 'di dag la gsol btab dang / rjes dran/ sems bskyed rnams gang ltar byas kyang 'gal ba med par 'grub pa yin no/ /rjes dran nam gsol btab bya ba'i don ni/ gong gi rjes dran de nyid kyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs rgyas par bstan/ yon tan gyi khyad par mdor bstan nas/ rjes dran phyi ma gsum gyis mtshan gyi rnam grangs mtshon pa tsam zhig las ma bstan par yon tan gyi khyad par rnams rgyas par bstan pa yin te/ de yang sangs rgyas de la yon tan ji ltar mnga' zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das gang zhig 'di ni yon tan gyi khyad par bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan te/ dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ yang dag spong ba bzhi/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ dbang po lnga/ stobs lnga/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad de nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i yon tan byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang / sangs rgyas kyi thun mong gi thun mong ma yin pa'i mkhyen pa'i yon tan stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gsum dang / thugs rje chen po dang / la sogs pa ste sogs khong nas sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gzhan yang bsrung ba med pa gsum dang bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba dang / bag chags yang dag par spangs pa dang / nyon mongs med pa dang / smon gnas shes pa dang / mngon shes drug dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang /

yongs su dag pa bzhi dang / dbang bcu dang / spyod pa ma 'dres pa drug rtogs pa ma 'dres pa drug 'phrin las ma 'dres pa gsum/ ye shes ma 'dres pa gsum ste sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad dang / sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las rnams dang / mdor na nyan thos sogs theg dman gyi gang zag slob pa dang mi slob pa/ nyan rang dgra bcom pa rnams su byed pa'i byed chos kyi rigs kun dang / mi slob pa'i mchog sangs rgyas su byed pa'i byed chos rnams dang yang dag par ldan pa dang / slob mi slob de dag thob pa la bgegs byed kyi skyon gyi ngo bo nyes pa sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang bral zhing / bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan gyi chos tshad med pa dang ldan pa yin pas so/ /des na de lta bu'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sogs gong dang 'dra'o/ /'o na dran pa nyer bzhag sogs 'phags pa 'og ma dang thun mong ba'i chos byang phyogs so bdun po ji lta bu/ sangs rgyas kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan stobs bcu la sogs pa gang zhe na/ dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi ni/ mdzod las/ zhi gnas 'grub par gyur pa yi/ /dran pa nyer bzhag bsgom par bya/ /lus tshor sems dang chos rnams la/ /mtshan nyid gnyis su yongs brtags te/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dmigs pa lus la dmigs nas rnam pa rang spyi'i mtshan nyid gnyis su brtags te/ dpyod par byed pa'i dran pa lta bu lus dran pa nyer bzhag dang / dmigs pa tshor ba la dmigs nas rnam pa tshor ba'i mtshan nyid gnyis su yongs su brtags te dpyod par byed pa'i dran pa lta bu tshor ba dran pa nyer bzhag dang / dmigs pa sems la dmigs nas rnam pa sems de'i mtshan nyid yongs su brtags te dpyod par byed pa'i dran pa lta bu sems dran pa nyer bzhag dang / dmigs pa chos la dmigs nas rnam pa chos de'i mtshan nyid gnyis su yongs su brtags nas dpyod par byed pa'i dran pa lta bu chos dran pa nyer bzhag dang bzhi'o/

/de la lus la sogs pa de bzhi'i rang gi mtshan nyid ni rim pa bzhin mi gtsang ba dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / mi rtag pa dang / bdag med pa rnams yin la/ spyi'i mtshan nyid ni rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa yin te/ chos rgyal 'phags pas/ hor gyi rgyal bu maṅga laṃ la gdams pa bkra shis kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba las/ lus dang tshor ba chos dang sems rnams la/ /mi gtsang sdug bsngal bdag med mi rtag dang / /rang bzhin med par shes nas dran par mdzod/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /yang dag spong ba bzhi ni/ dge ba ma skyes pa yang dag par bskyed pa'i brtson 'grus dang / skyes pa bsrung zhing spel ba dang / mi dge ba mi bskyed pa dang / skyes pa spong ba'i brtson 'grus dang bzhi po ste/ bla ma 'phags pas/ dge ba bskyed dang bsrung dang de bzhin du/ /mi dge mi bskyed pa dang spong ba ste/ /brtson 'grus rtogs pa yang dag rtogs pa bzhis/ /tshogs lam 'bring po mthar phyin mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ni/ 'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa/ brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa/ spyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa/ sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang bzhi ste/ bla ma 'phags pas/ 'dun dang brtson 'grus spyod pa dang ni sems/ /ting 'dzin rtogs pa rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhis/ /tshogs lam chen po'i 'jug ngogs bgrod par gyis/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /dbang po lnga ni sbyor lam drod yan chad kyis bsdus pa'i dad pa'i dbang po dang / brtson 'grus kyi dbang po dang / dran pa'i dbang po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po dang / shes rab kyi dbang po dang lnga po ste/ 'phags pas/ dad dang brtson 'grus dran dang ting 'dzin dang / /shes rab dbang po lnga ste 'di dag gis/ /dge ba'i chos rnams kun la dbang bsgyur zhing / /drod dang rtse mo mthar phyin bgyid pa lags/ /zhes pa ltar ro/
