/stobs lnga ni sbyor lam bzod mchog yan chad kyis bsdus pa'i dad pa'i stobs sogs lnga ste/ 'phags pas/ de dag stobs su gyur pa stobs lnga ste/ /lam gyi mi mthun phyogs rnams 'joms byed pa/ /bzod dang chos mchog dag ste de rnams kyis/ /sbyor ba'i lam rnams bgrod par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun ni/ mthong lam yan chad kyis bsdus pa dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag chos rab tu 'byed pa byang chub kyi yan lag brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag shin tu sbyang ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag bdun te/ 'phags pas/ dran dang chos rab 'byed dang brtson 'grus dang / /dga' dang yongs sbyangs ting 'dzin btang snyoms te/ /byang chub yan lag bdun gyis mthong ba'i lam/ /kun tu gzigs nas rnam grol brnyes par mdzod/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad ni/ sgom lam dang mi slob kyis bsdus pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba dang / yang dag pa'i rtogs pa dang / yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba dang / yang dag pa'i rtsol ba dang / yang dag pa'i dran pa dang / yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / yang dag pa'i ngag dang / yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' dang brgyad po rnams te/ 'phags pas/ yang dag lta dang 'tsho dang rtsol ba dang / /dran pa ting 'dzin ngag dang las kyi mtha'/ /rtogs pa dang ni 'phags pa'i lam brgyad kyis/ /sgom pa'i lam ni mthar phyin bgyid pa lags/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan stobs bcu ni/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs/ las kyi rnam par smin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs/ mos pa sna tshogs pa mkhyen pa'i/ 'jig rten gyi khams du ma mkhyen pa'i/ dbang po mchog dang mchog ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i/ thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam mkhyen pa'i/

kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba mkhyen pa'i/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i/ 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba mkhyen pa'i/ zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang bcu po ste/ 'phags pas/ gnas las khams mos dbang po kun 'gro'i lam/ /kun nas nyon mongs rnam byang dgod pa dang / /sngon gnas rjes dran 'chi 'pho skye ba dang / /zag pa zad mkhyen 'di dag stobs bcu lags/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /mi 'jigs pa bzhi ni/ gzhan don rtogs pa phun tshogs brnyes par dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa/ rang don spangs pa phun tshogs su dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa/ nyon mongs pa sogs spang byar dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa/ nges 'byung gi lam dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa dang bzhi ste/ 'phags pas/ ye shes brnyes dang spang bya spangs pa dang / /nges 'byung lam dang de yi gegs ston la/ /kun nas kun tu 'jigs pa mi mnga' ba/ /mi 'jigs pa ni rnam pa bzhi zhes bya/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gsum ni/ gdul bya la chos gsungs pa na/ gdul bya 'ga' zhig chos la 'dun pa dang / kha cig chos la mi 'dun par bsgrub pa dang / la la dag bar mar sems pa dag la rim pa bzhin chags pa dang / sdang ba dang / bar mar 'dzin pa'i sgo nas thugs nyon mongs par mi 'gyur ba gsum ste/ 'phags pas/ 'dun dang mi 'dun bar ma gsum gyi thugs/ /nyon mongs mi 'gyur dran pa nyer bzhag gsum/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /thugs rje chen po ni/ lhag par sems can kun la phan par dgongs pa'i sgo nas gzhan don byed pa'i mkhyen pa mthar thug pa ste/ 'phags pas/ kun la phan dgongs thugs rje chen po dang / /zhes pa ltar ro/ /bsrung ba med pa gsum ni sku gsung thugs kyi spyod pa rnam par dag pas la las skyon 'dogs su 'ongs snyam pa'i bcas pa med pa ste/ 'phags pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi spyod pa yongs dag las/ /bca' ba mi mnga' bsrung med rnam gsum dang / /zhes pa ltar ro/

/bsnyel ba mi mnga' ni yul dus rnam pa thams cad du sems can gyi don dus las mi 'da' bar mdzad pa ste/ 'phags pas/ gzhan gyi don la bsnyel ba mi mnga' dang / /zhes pa ltar ro/ /bag chags yongs su spangs pa ni sgrib gnyis kyi bag chags ma lus pa spangs pas gshegs bzhugs thams cad du kun mkhyen ma yin pa'i spyod pa mi mnga' ba ste/ 'phags pas/ bag chags bcas pa'i sgrib pa spangs pa dang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /nyon mongs med pa ni/ bdag nyid la nyon mongs pa mi mnga' bas/ gzhan gyi nyon mongs pa 'dul ba'am 'joms par mdzad cing / nyon mongs pa can gyi skye bo 'dul bar mdzad pa'i mkhyen pa ste/ 'phags pas/ bdag nyid nyon mongs med pas gzhan dag gi /nyon mongs 'joms bgyid nyon mongs med pa dang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /smon gnas mkhyen pa ni/ shes bya'i chos kun lhun grub tu chags thogs med par mkhyen pas 'dri ba thams cad kyi the tshom gcod pa'i mkhyen pa ste/ 'phags pas/ smon pas shes bya'i chos kun lhun grub tu/ /mkhyen nas the tshom kun gcod smon mkhyen dang / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /mngon shes drug ni rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes/ lha'i mig gi mngon shes/ lha'i rna ba'i mngon shes/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i mngon shes/ zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i mngon shes dang drug po ste/ 'phags pas/ rdzu 'phrul lha yi mig dang rna ba dang / /pha rol sems dang sngon gyi gnas dang ni/ /zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa zhes bgyi ba'i/ /mngon par shes pa rnam pa drug dang ni/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ni/ chos so so yang dag par rig pa/ don so so yang dag par rig pa/ nges pa'i tshig so so yang dag par rig pa/ spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa dang bzhi po ste/ 'phags pas/ bshad bya chos dang don dang 'chad byed ni/ /nges pa'i tshig dang spobs pa zhes bgyi ba/

/so so yang dag rig pa rnam bzhi dang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /yongs su dag pa bzhi ni/ sku lus gang 'dod du skye ba len pa la dbang ba dang / der sku tshe gang 'dod du gnas pa dang / nam gtong 'dod pa'i tshe gtong ba la dbang ba ste rten yongs su dag pa dang / med pa sprul pa dang / yod pa bsgyur ba la dbang 'byor ba ste dmigs pa yongs su dag pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du ting nge 'dzin la dbang ba lta bu thugs yongs su dag pa dang / shes bya thams cad la ye shes sgrib pa med pa la dbang ba lta bu shes rab yongs su dag pa dang bzhi po ste/ 'phags pas/ rten dang dmigs pa thugs dang ye shes te/ /yongs su dag pa bzhi dang de bzhin du/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /dbang bcu ni/ sku tshe bzhed tshad bzhugs pas tshe la dbang ba dang / ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin sems la 'jug pa las su rung bas sems la dbang ba dang / ji ltar bsam pa bzhin gyi yo byad 'byor pas yo byad la dbang ba dang / sgo gsum gyi las ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin bsgrub nus pa las la dbang ba dang / gang 'dod par lus len pa 'grub pa skye ba la dbang ba dang / sa yang gser du bsgyur ba sogs gang dang cir mos pa der bsgyur nus pa mos pa la dbang ba dang / ji ltar smon pa'i don 'grub pa smon lam la dbang ba dang / sku gsung thugs kyi rdzu 'phrul gang ji snyed pa de snyed ston nus pa rdzu 'phrul la dbang ba dang / ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i ye shes kyi chos kun thogs med du mkhyen pa ye shes la dbang ba dang / mdo la sogs pa'i chos 'dod pa ji ltar smon pa chos la dbang ba dang bcu po ste/ 'phags pas/ tshe dang sems dang yo byad las dang ni/ /skye ba mos pa smon lam rdzu 'phrul dang / /ye shes chos la dbang ba zhes bgyi ba/ /dbang bcu dag tu gsungs pa de dag dang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi spyod pa ma 'dres pa drug ni/

sku la 'khrul ba mi mnga' ba dang / gsung la ca co mi mnga' ba dang / thugs la mnyam par ma bzhag pa mi mnga' ba/ dran pa nyams pa'am bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba dang / 'khor 'das bzang ngan tha dad pa'i thugs mi mnga' ba dang / so sor ma brtags pa'i btang snyoms mi mnga' ba dang drug ste/ 'phags pas/ 'khrul dang ca co mnyam par ma bzhag dang / /dran pa nyams dang tha dad 'du shes dang / /ma brtags pa yi btang snyoms mi mnga' ba/ /spyod pas bsdus pa rnam pa drug dang ni/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /rtogs pa ma 'dres pa drug ni/ 'dun pa nyams pa mi srid pa dang / de bzhin du brtson 'grus dang / dran pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab dang / rnam par grol ba nyams pa mi mnga' ba rnams te/ 'phags pas/ 'dun dang brtson 'grus dran dang ting 'dzin dang / /shes rab rnam grol ye shes mi nyams pa/ /rtogs pas bsdus pa drug dang zhes pa ltar ro/ /ye shes ma 'dres pa drug ni/ 'das pa'i dus la ma chags pa thogs med du 'jug pa/ da lta ba'i dus la ma chags thogs med du 'jug pa'i ye shes/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus la ma chags thogs med du 'jug pa'i ye shes dang gsum po ste/ 'phags pas/ dus gsum la/ /thogs med ye shes kyis bsdus rnam gsum dang / /zhes pa ltar ro/ /'phrin las ma 'dres pa gsum ni/ sku'i 'phrin las ye shes kyi sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'brangs pa dang / gsung gi 'phrin las ye shes kyi sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'brangs pa dang / thugs kyi 'phrin las ye shes kyi sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'brangs pa dang gsum ste/ 'phags pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi las rnams ye shes kyi/ /rjes su 'brangs pa ye shes kyis bsdus pa/ /'di dag ma 'dres pa yi chos bco brgyad/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid la mnga' ba lags/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /rgyal ba'i 'phrin las ni/ slob pa'i gnas skabs kyi las gnas gyur pa ste/

'di la gdul bya rnams mngon mtho'i lam la 'god pa'i 'phrin las dang / nyan thos kyi lam la 'god pa'i 'phrin las/ rang sangs rgyas kyi lam la 'god pa'i 'phrin las/ byang sems kyi lam la 'god pa'i 'phrin las te nges legs kyi lam la 'god pa gsum/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god pa'i 'phrin las dang 'phrin las lnga/ 'di dag tu 'phrin las nyi shu rtsa bdun du gsungs pa la sogs pa rnams kyang 'du bar gsungs pa rnams te/ 'phags pas/ las gnas gyur pa rgyal ba'i 'phrin las te/ /gdul bya mngon mtho'i dpal la 'god pa dang / /theg pa gsum gyi lam gyis nyer drangs nas/ /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob mdzad 'phrin las lnga/ /'phrin las nyi shu rtsa bdun gang lags pa/ /thams cad 'di yi nang du 'dus mkhyen mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /rjes dran gsum pa'i don ni/ gong ma dang 'dra bar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang zhig 'di ni yon tan gyi khyad par gzhan yang bla na med pa'am/ gong na med pa'i tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / la sogs pa ste/ ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po lnga dang yang yang dag par ldan pa dang / sku rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul/ gsung rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul/ thugs kun brjod pa'i cho 'phrul rnam pa gsum dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa ste ting nge 'dzin rnam pa gsum dang / tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ shes rab kyi bslab pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa ste bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum dang / byams pa tshad med pa/ snying rje tshad med pa/ dga' ba tshad med pa/ btang snyoms tshad med pa ste tshad med pa'am tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi dang / zag pa med pa'i bsam gtan dang po dang / gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa'i ting nge 'dzin bzhi dang / 'di bzhis mtshon nas byang chub sems dpa' dang thun mong ba'i yon tan/

rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / zad par bcu dang / zil gnon brgyad dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i rnam pa dang yang dag par ldan pas/ sangs rgyas des yul bden pa bzhi yang dag par phyin ci ma log par mkhyen pa'i ye shes te shes par byed pa yun dang / shes par bya ba'i yul bdag med gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad la mnga' brnyes pa'am mnga' bsgyur bas na/ nyon mongs pa dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa la sogs pa sgrib pa ma lus pa rnams spangs pa ste spangs pa'i yon tan mang po dang / nyon mongs pa'i bdud dang / lha'i bu'i bdud dang / 'chi bdag gi bdud dang / phung po'i bdud dang bdud bzhi'i gnas ngan las dang bcas pa bcom pas na de dag las rab tu rgyal ba sogs spangs rtogs kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pas so/ /des na de lta bu'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di dag gi sogs gong bzhin no/ /de lta bu'i zag med kyi phung po lnga'i tshul khrims kyi phung po ni/ spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs legs par sdom pa ste 'di la mang du yod do/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po ni/ dmigs pa la rtse gcig pa'i sems sems byung rnams/ shes rab kyi phung po ni/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi blo rnams so/ /rnam par grol ba'i phung po ni/ sgrib pa las grol ba'i ye shes so/ /rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs pa'i phung po ni/ de kho na nyid gzigs pa'i ye shes so/ /sku rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul ni/ rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes kyis gdul bya gang na gnas pa der gshegs pa'o/ /gsung rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul ni/ lha'i rna bas kun gyi skad mkhyen pa'o/ /thugs kun brjod pa'i cho 'phrul ni/ gzhan gyi sems 'dod chags dang bcas ma bcas sogs ji lta ba bzhin du mkhyen pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi rnam par thar pa'i sgo dang po ni chos thams cad stong pa dang bdag med par rtogs pa'o/

/gnyis pa ni mya ngan las 'das pa zhi bar rtogs pa'o/ /gsum pa ni 'dus byas mi rtag pa dang zag bcas sdug bsngal du rtogs pa'o/ /bslab pa gsum gyi tshul khrims kyi bslab pa ni/ so sor thar pa rigs brgyad dang byang sems kyi sdom pa smon 'jug gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i nyes spyod spong ba'i tshul khrims/ dge ba chos bsdus kyi tshul khrims/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims gsum dang / sngags kyi sdom pa rgyud sde nas 'byung pa'i smin grol gnyis kyis bsdus pa thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa mang du bshad pa rnams te/ so thar ni mdzod las/ so sor thar zhes bya rnam brgyad/ /rdzas su rnam pa bzhi yin no/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /byang sems kyi sdom pa ni/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems ni mdor bsdus na/ /rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste/ /byang chub smon pa'i sems dang ni/ /byang chub 'jug pa nyid yin no/ /zhes ngo bo'i sgo nas smon 'jug gnyis so/ /cho ga'i sgo nas/ sdom gsum rab dbye las/ theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed la/ /dbu ma sems tsam rnam pa gnyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gnyis sam/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i cho ga las thob pa dang gsum du yod do/ /dge ba chos bsdus ni/ de dag las ngo bo logs su med mod ldog pa mi 'dra ba tsam ni/ dge ba'i chos bsgrub pa'i phyir mi dge ba rgyu dang bcas pa spong ba'i don dam sems bskyed la sogs pa rnams so/ /sems can don byed kyang snga ma de dag las logs su med kyang ldog pa'i sgo nas gzhan don bsgrub pa'i phyir de dang 'gal ba gzhir bcas spong ba'i sems pa mtshungs ldan rgyun chags pa rnams so/ /sngags kyi sdom pa ni/ mtshan rtog las skyobs pa'i thabs khyad par can mi mthun phyogs spong ba'i sems pa mtshungs ldan rgyun chags pa ste rgyud sde bzhi'i dbye bas bzhir yod la/ shes rab kyi bslab pa ni/

bdag med gnyis yod pa'i stobs kyis yul can gyi blo yang bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab gnyis su yod pa rnams so/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa ni/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gis bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin mang du yod pa rnams so/ /tshad med bzhi'i byams pa tshad med pa ni/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu gnyis char dang bral bar 'dod pa'i sgo nas phan 'dogs pa'i rnam pa can te/ 'jug pa las/ 'gro la phan pa nyer bsgrub pa/ /byams pa chen po zhes bya 'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /snying rje tshad med pa ni/ 'gro ba rnams sdug bsngal las skyobs pa'i rnam pa can dang / dga' ba tshad med pa ni/ sems can bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan pa la dga' ba bsgom pa dang / btang snyoms tshad med pa ni/ sems can rnams la chags sdang med pa'i btang snyoms pa'i rnam pa can te/ 'jug pa las/ sdug bsngal can rnams yongs skyobs pa/ /thugs rje chen po'o dga' ba ni/ /rab dga'i mtshan nyid btang snyoms ni/ /ma 'dres mtshan nyid can zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /zag med kyi bsam gtan dang po'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ de nyid kyi nyer bsdogs dang / dngos gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa rnams kyang de dang de'i nyer bsdogs dang dngos gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin ni snyoms 'jug rnams so/ /rnam thar brgyad ni/ gzugs can gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ gzugs med gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ sdug pa'i rnam thar/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi rnam thar/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi rnam thar/ 'du shes med pa'i skye mched kyi rnam thar/ 'du shes med min yod min gyi skye mched kyi rnam thar/ 'gog pa'i rnam thar dang brgyad po ste/ 'phags pa rin po ches/ gzugs can gzugs med gzugs la blta ba dang / /sdug pa sngon byas mkha' dang rnam shes dang / /ci yang med dang yod min med min dang /

/'gog pa zhes bgyi rnam thar brgyad po dang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu ni/ bsam gtan dang po dang / gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug nam mkha' mtha' yas/ rnam shes mtha' yas/ ci yang med pa'i skye mched/ med min yod min gyi skye mched de gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi'i snyoms 'jug 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug dang dgu po ste/ 'phags pas/ nam mkha' mtha' yas rnam shes mtha' yas dang / /ci yang med dang med min yod min te/ /gzugs med rtogs pa'i skye mched mu bzhi dang / /'gog pa dang ni snyoms 'jug rnam dgu dang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /zad par bcu ni/ zad par sa dang / chu dang / me dang / rlung ste dbyibs kyi bzhi dang / sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po ste kha dog gi bzhi/ nam mkha' dang / rnam shes su bsgom pa gnyis te zad par gyi ting nge 'dzin bcu po ste/ 'phags pas/ ting 'dzin phul du phyin pa zad par ni/ /sa chu me rlung sngon po ser po dang / /dmar po dkar po mkha' dang rnam shes su/ /bsgom pa zhes bgyi zad par bcu dang ni/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /zil gnon brgyad ni/ gzugs can gzugs chung ngu la lta ba'i zil gnon/ gzugs can gzugs chen po la lta ba'i zil gnon/ gzugs med gzugs chung ngu la lta ba'i zil gnon/ gzugs med gzugs chen po la lta ba'i zil gnon/ gzugs med gzugs sngon po la lta ba'i zil gnon/ gzugs med gzugs ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po la lta ba'i zil gnon rnams te/ 'phags pas/ gzugs su 'du shes ldan pas phyi yi gzugs/ /phra dang rags dang gzugs med 'du shes pas/ /chung dang chen po'i gzugs dang de bzhin du/ /sngon po ser po dmar po dkar po la/ /blta zhing zil gnon zil gnon brgyad rnams la/ /mnyam bzhag rnal 'byor bsgoms pas so so yi/ /spang bya'i nyes dmigs tshang tshing rab bsregs nas/

/ting 'dzin snang ba dam pa thob par mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /rjes dran gsum pa'i don ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang zhig 'di ni yon tan gyi khyad par gzhan yang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / de bzhin du bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste srid zhi'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / bsod nams kyi tshogs dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis slob pa'i gnas skabs su yang dag par bsags pas da lta yongs su rdzogs pa dang / sku'i yon tan skyes bu chen por mtshon byed mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis sku la yang dag par brgyan pa dang / sku mdzes byed dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus yang dag par mdzes pa dang / skyes bu chen po sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyi sku blta bas chog mi shes pa dang / sems can su zhig gis mthong na mi mthun pa'am mi legs pa med pa mthong ba tsam la yang don dang ldan pa ste/ mdor na sangs rgyas de'i gzugs sku'i 'byor pa'am yon tan ma lus pa mthar thug pa ste rdzogs par mnga' bas na/ 'gro ba ma lus pa'i rtsa lag ste gnyen du gyur pa yin pas so/ /des na de lta bu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sogs gong bzhin no/ /de lta bu'i mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis ni/ phyag dang zhabs kyi mthil 'khor los mtshan pa dang / zhabs rus sbal ltar shin tu gnas pa/ phyag dang zhabs kyi sor mo dra bas 'brel pa/ phyag dang zhabs kyi mthil 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags pa dang / sku'i mdun mtho ba dang / sor mo ring ba dang / rting pa yangs pa dang / sku che zhing drang ba dang / zhabs kyi long bu'i tshigs kyi 'bur mi mngon pa dang / sku'i ba spu gyen du phyogs pa dang / byin pa ri dwags e na ya 'dra ba dang / phyag shin tu ring bas pus mor sleb pa/ 'doms kyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa dang / lpags pa srab cing gser gyi mdog ltar ser ba dang /

spu rnams re re nas skyes shing g.yas su 'khyil ba dang / zhal gyi dkyil 'khor la mdzod spus brgyan pa dang / sku'i ro stod seng ge dang 'dra ba dang / phyag dpung mgo shin tu zlum pa dang / thal gong rgyas pa dang / ro mi zhim pa'ang ro mchog tu snang ba dang / sku shing ne gro ta ltar chu zheng gab pa dang / dbu gtsug tor dang ldan pa dang / dbu skra g.yas su 'khyil ba dang / dpral ba'i dbyes mnyam pa dang / ljags ring zhing srab pa dang / gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang ldan pa dang / zhal 'gram seng ge dang 'dra pa dang / tshems shin tu dkar ba dang / tshad mnyam pa dang / thags bzang ba dang / grangs bzhi bcu tham pa tshang ba dang / spyan 'thon mthing la spyan rdzi ba mchog gi rdzi ma 'dra ba rnams te/ 'phags pa rin po ches/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi tshig ji lta ba bzhin la tshig zur cung zad mi 'dra ba/ lus gnas gyur pa 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku/ /phyag zhabs 'khor los mtshan dang rus sbal zhabs/ /phyag dang zhabs sor dra bas 'brel pa dang / /phyag ni zhabs bcas 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags/ /thub pa'i sku ni mdun dag mtho ba dang / /sor mo ring zhing rting yangs sku che drang / /zhabs 'bur mi mngon spu ni gyen du phyogs/ /byin pa e na ya 'dra phyag ring mdzes/ /'doms kyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa'i mchog /lpags pa gser mdog 'dra dang lpags pa srab/ /spu ni re re nas g.yas legs 'khrungs dang / /zhal mdzod spus brgyan ro stod seng ge 'dra/ /phyag gi dpung pa'i mgo zlum thal gong rgyas/ /ro mi zhim pa'ang ro mchog nyid du snang / /sku ni n+ya gro ta ltar chu zheng gab/ /gtsug tor 'bur ldan ljags ring mdzes pa dang / /tshangs dbyangs 'gram pa seng ge 'dra dang tshems/ /shin tu dkar dang tshad mnyam thags bzang dang / /grangs ni bzhi bcu tham pa tshang ba dang / /spyan ni mthon mthing spyan rdzi ba mchog gis/ /'dra ba'i mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis kyis mtshan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/

/sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku mdzes par byed pa dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu la/ sen mo'i dbang du byas dang / sor mo'i dbang du byas pa dang / rtsa'i dbang du byas pa dang / zhabs kyi dbang du byas pa dang / gshegs tshul gyi dbang du byas pa dang / sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang du byas pa dang / phyag gi dbang du byas pa dang / zhal 'khor bcas kyi dbang du byas pa dang / dbu dbu skra dang bcas pa'i dbang du byas pa ste sde tshan dgu las/ dang po ni/ sen mo zangs mdog ltar dmar ba dang / ser mo snum pa dang / sen mo mtho ba rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni sor mo zlum pa dang / sor mo rnams rgyas pa dang / sor mo rnams byin gyis phra ba dang gsum mo/ /gsum pa ni rtsa mi mngon pa dang / rtsa mdud med pa dang gnyis so/ /bzhi pa ni/ long bu mi mngon pa dang / zhabs mi mnyam pa med pa gnyis so/ /lnga pa ni seng ge'i stabs su gshegs pa dang / glang po che'i stabs su gshegs pa dang / ngang pa'i stabs su gshegs pa dang / khyu mchog gi stabs su gshegs pa dang / g.yas phyogs su ldog cing gshegs pa dang / mdzes par gshegs pa dang / mi g.yo bar gshegs pa dang bdun no/ /drug pa ni sku 'khril bag chags pa/ sku byi dor byas pa lta bu/ sku rim par 'tshams pa/ sku gtsang ba/ sku 'jam pa/ sku rnam par dag pa/ mtshan rdzogs pa/ sku khong lag yangs shing bzang pa/ bsgom pa mnyam pa/ sku shin tu gzhon sha can/ sku zhum pa med pa/ sku rgyas pa/ sku shin tu grims pa/ yan lag dang nying lag shin tu rnam par 'byed pa/ gzigs pa rab rib med cing rnam par dag pa/ dku zlum pa/ dku skabs phyin pa/ dku ma rnyong pa/ phyal 'phyang nge ba/ lte ba zab pa/ lte ba g.yas phyogs su 'khyil ba/ kun nas mdzes pa/ kun spyod gtsang ba/ sku la sme ba dang / nag babs med pa dang nyer lnga'o/ /bdun pa ni/ phyag shing bal ltar shin tu 'jam pa/ phyag gi ri mo snum pa/ phyag gi ri mo zab pa/ phyag gi ri mo ring ba dang bzhi'o/

/brgyad pa la zhal mchu dang bcas pa'i dbang du byas pa/ ljags gsung dang bcas pa'i dbang du byas pa/ mche ba'i dbang du byas pa/ shangs kyi dbang du byas pa/ spyan 'khor dang bcas pa'i dbang du byas pa/ snyan gyi dbang du byas pa/ dpral ba'i dbang du byas pa ste bdun las/ dang po ni/ zhal ha cang mi ring ba dang / zhal la gzugs kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba gnyis so/ /gnyis pa ni/ ljags 'jam zhing mnyen pa/ ljags stabs pa/ ljags dmar ba/ ljags glang po che'i nga ro dang 'brug gi sgra dang ldan pa/ gsung snyan zhing mnyam la 'jam pa dang lnga'o/ /gsum pa ni mche ba zlum pa/ mche ba rno ba/ mche ba dkar ba/ mche ba mnyam pa/ mche ba byin gyis phra ba dang lnga'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ shangs mtho ba dang / shangs gtsang ba gnyis so/ /lnga pa ni spyan rnam dag pa/ spyan yangs pa/ rdzi ma sdug pa/ spyan dkar nag 'byes shing padma'i 'dab ma rang pa lta bu/ smin tshugs ring ba/ smin ma 'jam pa/ smin ma spu mnyam pa/ smin ma snum pa dang bdun no/ /drug pa ni snyan shal stug cing ring ba/ snyan mnyam pa/ snyan gyi dbang po ma nyams pa dang gsum mo/ /bdun pa ni/ dpral ba legs par dbyes pa/ dpral ba dbyes che ba dang gnyis so/ /rtsa ba'i dgu pa ni/ dbu shin tu rgyas pa/ dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag pa/ dbu skra sdug pa/ dbu skra 'jam pa/ dbu skra ma 'dzings pa/ dbu skra mi bshor ba/ dbu skra dri zhim pa/ phyag dang zhabs kyi mthil dpal be'u dang g.yung drung 'khyil bas brgyan pa ste brgyad dang bcas pas dpe byad brgyad cu ste/ 'phags pa rin po ches/ sen mo zangs mdog snum zhing dbyibs mtho zlum/ /sor mo rab tu rgyas shing byin gyis phra/ /rtsa mi mngon dang rtsa mdud med pa dang / /long bu mi mngon zhabs mthil kun nas mnyam/ /seng ge glang chen ngang pa'i rgyal po dang / /khyu mchog stabs dang g.yas kyi phyogs nas gshegs/ /mdzes gshegs drang gshegs 'khril bag chags pa'i sku/ /byi dor byas 'dra rab mdzes rim par 'tshams/

/gtsang 'jam rnam dag mtshan rnams yongs su rdzogs/ /sku yi khong lag yangs shing rab tu bzang / /gos snyoms spyan ni rnam dag gzhon sha chags/ /ma zhum rab rgyas shin tu grim pa'i sku/ /yan lag rnams 'byed gzigs pa rab rib med/ /dku zlum skabs byin ma rnyongs pa yi dku /phyal ni 'phyang nge ba dang lte ba zab/ /g.yas su 'khyil dang kun nas rab tu mdzes/ /kun spyod rab gtsang sku la sme ba med/ /phyag ni shing bal lta bur rab tu 'jam/ /phyag gi ri mo mdangs gsal zab cing ring / /zhal ni ha cang mi ring 'tshams pa dang / /zhal sgros bim pa ltar dmar ljags mnyen srab/ /zangs mdog ltar dmar 'brug gi sgra dang ni/ /gsung snyan mche ba zlum rno rab dkar mnyam/ /byin gyis phra dang shangs mtho rnam par dag /spyan yangs rdzi ma rab sdug dkar nag 'byed/ /smin tshugs ring 'jam snum zhing spu ni mnyam/ /phyag rgyas snyan mnyam ma nyams dpral ba 'byed/ /dbyes che dbu rgyas dbu skra bung ba'i mdog /sdug 'jam ma 'dzings mi bshor dri zhim dang / /phyag zhabs g.yung drung dpal gyi be'us mtshan/ /'di dag dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu ste/ /de 'dras mgon de'i sku mdog mdzes pa lags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar na rjes dran dang pos rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs cung zad rgyas par bshad nas/ rjes dran phyi ma gsum gyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gyi khyad par rgyas par bstan pa ste/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan la yang thugs kyis bsdus pa'i yon tan dang / skus bsdus pa'i yon tan dang / gsung gis bsdus pa'i yon tan dang gsum las/ dang po la yang sems can dang thun mong ba'i yon tan dang / sangs rgyas kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan gnyis kyi/ dang po la yang theg dman dang thun mong ba'i yon tan dang / byang sems dang thun mong ba'i yon tan gsum las/ dang po dang gnyis pa ni byang phyogs so bdun sogs te rjes dran gnyis pas gtso bor bstan/

gsum pa ni rnam thar brgyad la sogs pa ste bsam gtan bzhis mtshon nas rjes dran gsum pas bstan/ sangs rgyas kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan ni/ stobs bcu la sogs pa ste rjes dran phyi ma gsum gyis ci rigs par bstan/ skus bsdus pa'i yon tan ni rjes dran phyi mas bstan cing / gsung gis bsdus pa'i yon tan ni gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la sogs pa yin zhing / 'di dag gi rjes dran bzhi po'i dngos bstan la ma byung yang / skus bsdus pa'i yon tan gyi nang tshan dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i sde tshan brgyad pa'i ljags gsung dang bcas pa zhes pa'i nang tshan nam sde tshan ljags glang po che'i nga ro dang 'brug gi sgra lta bu dang / gsung snyan zhing mnyam pa gnyis kyis mtshon nas gsung dbyangs drug cu rtsa gnyis po thams cad bstan par 'chad dgos pas na/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi yon tan ni rjes dran bzhi pas bstan cing / mdor na rjes dran bzhi po 'dis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan sku gsung thugs kyis bsdus pa thams cad bstan pa yin no/ /de la gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu rtsa gnyis ni/ gsung snyan pa/ gsung 'jam pa/ gsung yid du 'ong ba/ yid du 'thad pa/ dag pa/ dri ma med pa/ gsung gsal ba/ snyan cing mdzes pa/ snyan par 'os pa/ mi tshugs pa/ snyan pa/ dul ba/ mi rtsub pa/ mi brlangs pa/ shin tu dul ba/ rna bar snyan pa/ lus sim par byed pa/ sems tshim par byed pa/ snying dga' bar byed pa/ dga' ba dang bde ba bskyed pa/ yongs su gdung ba med pa/ kun tu shes par bya ba/ rnam par gsal ba/ dga' bar byed pa/ mngon par dga' bar byed pa/ kun shes par byed pa/ rnam par rig par byed pa/ rig pa/ 'brel ba zlos pa'i skyon med pa/ seng ge'i sgra'i shugs/ glang po che'i sgra skad/ 'brug gi sgra dbyangs/ klu'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs/ dri za'i sgra dbyangs/ bya ka la ping ka'i sgra dbyangs/ tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs ltar bsgrags pa/

shang shang te'u'i sgra dbyangs ltar grag pa/ lha'i dbang po'i dbyangs ltar snyan pa/ rnga bo che'i sgra dang 'dra ba/ ma khengs pa/ mi dma' ba/ sgra thams cad kyi rjes su zhugs pa/ tshig zur chag med pa/ ma tshang ba med pa/ ma zhum pa/ mi zhan pa/ rab tu gnas pa/ khyab pa/ chub pa/ rgyun chags pa/ 'brel ba/ sgra thams cad rdzogs par byed pa/ dbang po thams cad tshim par byed pa/ ma smad pa/ mi 'gyur ba/ ma stabs pa/ nye 'khor kun tu grags pa/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa rnams te/ 'phags pa rin po ches/ ngag gnas gyur pa 'gag pa med pa'i gsung / /dbyangs kyi yan lag drug cus brgyan pa ste/ /mnyen dang 'jam dang yid 'ong yid du 'thad/ /dag dang dri med gsal dang 'jebs pa dang / /mnyan 'os mi tshugs snyan dang dul ba dang / /mi rtsub mi brlangs rab dul rna bar 'bab/ /lus tshim yid tshim yid dga' byed pa dang / /dga' bde bskyed dang gdung sel kun shes byed/ /rnam par rig bya rnam gsal dga' ba bskyed/ /mngon par dga' dang kun shes rnam rig byed/ /rigs pa dang ni 'brel dang zlos skyon bral/ /seng ge glang chen 'brug gi sgra dbyangs dang / /klu dbang dri za ka la ping ka dang / /tshangs dbyangs shang shang te'u'i sgra ltar snyan/ /lha dbang dbyangs dang rnga sgra lta bur brjid/ /ma khengs mi mnga' sgra kun rjes zhugs nas/ /tshig zur ma chag ma tshang med pa dang / /ma zhum mi zhan rab tu dga' ba dang / /khyab dang tha bar bcas pa'i ched dang ni/ /rgyun chags 'brel dang sgra kun rdzogs byed dang / /dbang po tshim byed ma smad mi 'gyur dang / /ma stabs pa dang nye 'khor kun tu grags/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa yi/ /zab dang rgya che'i chos tshul ston par mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rags rim du bkod pa 'di dag ni/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches hor gyi rgyal bu maṅga laṃ la gdams pa'i tshigs bcad bkra shis kyi phreng ba zhes pa sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rnams sdom gyi tshul du mdzad pa de nyid tshig nyung la don 'dus che ba zhig snang bas/

mdo dang bstan bcos kyi tshig mang po dag btang snyoms su byas nas rjes dran bzhis sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bstan tshul rnams kun gyis rtogs sla ba'i phyir 'phags pa'i gsung de nyid dang sbyar te bkod pa yin la/ gzhan sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rgyas par ni/ gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal po'i mdo dang / mdo sde dkon mchog sprin dang / sa bcu pa dang / dgongs 'grel dang / gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo dang / bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo rnams las rgyas par 'byung ba'i don/ mgon po byams pas mngon rtogs rgyan dang / mdo sde rgyan dang / rgyud bla sogs su ci rigs par gsungs shing / slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi mngon pa mdzod dang / zla ba grags pa'i dbu ma 'jug pa sogs su yang mdor bsdus pa 'byung la/ khyad par bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇḍi tas thub pa dgongs gsal du mdo sde rgyan las/ sems can rnams la brtse ba can/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad bcu bdun gyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan brjod pa'i sgo nas bstod par mdzad pa'i don rnams dang / de'i kha skong chos rje nyid kyis thob bya'i yon tan kun brnyes la/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad bcu bzhi dang bcas pa mdzad pa'i don rnams zhib tu bshad pa'i sgo nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rgyas par bstan pa ltar nges par byas nas 'chad pa'i tshe yang rgyas par spro bar bya zhing / rab gnas kyi tshe de lta bu'i yon tan rnams yid yul du gsal bar dran pa'i sgo nas dad gus dang bcas pas rten la rab gnas mdzad par gsol ba btab pas/ mdzad par bsam zhing rang nyid kyis kyang byed pa yin te/ rjes dran gyi don de lta bu yin pas so/ /rab gnas kyi cho ga rnam par dag pa zhig byung na nam mkhar gnas pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis de ltar du byin gyis brlabs pa rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin te/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas rje btsun chen po'i nang rten 'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar ba la rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe bla ma gsal chen pas de ltar mthong ba'i lo rgyus dang /

chos rje bla ma dam pas bo dong gi gtsug lag khang gsar ma la rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe chos rje bla ma nyid kyis gzigs pa dang / khro phu lo tsā bas byams chen la rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe lo tsā ba rang gis gzigs pa'i lo rgyus bzhin no/ /de lta bu'i rjes dran bzhi char gyi mjug tu rol mo dang bcas me tog gi char dbab/ spos kyis bdug oṃ na mo zhes sogs dkyus nas 'byung ba bzhin dang / rab tu gnas bya'i rten gang yin pa ngo shes pa rnams kyi sngags dang / rab gnas byed pa po rang gi yi dam gyi sngags kyang cung zad re bzla zhing / tshul de ltar du rjes dran bzhi po 'di lan gsum bya ba yin zhing / rgyu mtshan ni 'di dag gong du bshad pa ltar sems bskyed kyi gzhung tshig yin zhing / sems bskyed kyi tshig rnams lan gsum re bya bar sems bskyed kyi cho ga'i gzhung mang po nas 'byung bas so/ /gong gi sngags don ni/ oṃ sngags kyi mgo 'dren pa/ na mo ni phyag 'tshal ba/ bha ga wa te ni bcom ldan 'das/ shākya mu ni ni shākya thub pa la/ ta thā ga ta ya ni de bzhin gshegs pa/ arya ha te samyaka saṃ buddha ni dgra bcom pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ tadya tha ni 'di lta ste/ oṃ gong dang 'dra/ mu ni mu ni ni thub pa thub pa/ mahā mu ni ni thub pa chen po/ swāhā ni gzhi tshugs zhes pa'o/ /de nas dpon slob thams cad stan la tsog pur 'dug ste/ lag pa'i mthil gnyis bsdams pa'i bar du nas cung zad re bzung la/ byams pa dang snying rje kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dung pa yun cung zad bsgoms te/ sems bskyed nyer gnyis bskyed pa'i tshig ngo mtshar chen po zhes sogs brjod pa bya ste/ de yang gong du bstan pa'i yon tan gyi khyad par de dag la sogs pa shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i yon tan chen po gcig dang gnyis la sogs pa'i grangs dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bgrang du med cing / sems can gyi blos ji lta ba bzhin bsam du med pas na bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/

/de ltar phyag dang skyabs 'gro byas nas ci bya na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag bdag la dgongs shing rjes su gzung du gsol te/ bdag gis sems can thams cad la gnas skabs su bde skyid dang / mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug pa'i phyir dkon mchog gsum gyi rten la ye shes pa rab tu gnas pa'i thabs cho ga rnam par dag pa bgyi ba 'di'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs dbyung ngo / /'khor ba'i gcong rong ngam g.yang sa chen po la mi lhung ba'i thabs bstan te bsgral bar bgyi'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa las pha rol lam/ phyi rol gyi rgol ba po bdud sdig can dang log 'dren te rnam pa thams cad du gnod pa 'ba' zhig sems shing byed pa thams cad yid pham par bgyi'o/ /sems can 'khor ba ma spangs pa thams cad nyon mongs pa sogs kyi bag chags kyi dbang gis srid par nying mtshams sbyor ba'i rgyur gyur pa nyon mongs pa dang / de dang mtshungs ldan du gyur pa'i rtog pa thams cad bsal ba ste med par bgyi'o/ /sems can nga rgyal can rnams kyi rgyud kyi mtho zhing brtan pa'i ri bo dang 'dra ba'i nyon mongs pa rags shing drag pa gnyen pos gzhom dka' ba'i nga rgyal rnams ri brag dag pha lam rdo rjes bshig cing bsnyil ba ltar gnyen po lam bstan pa'i sgo nas gzhom par bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang sems can 'khor ba pa rnams 'khor bar rang dbang med par skye ba'i ljon shing sdug bsngal gyi yal ga lo 'dab dang ldan zhing / slar yang srid pa'i sa bon byed pa'i 'bras bu dang ldan pa'i 'khor ba'i ljon shing rtsad nas sam rtsa ba nas gcad do ste gcad par bgyi'o/ /lus can rnams kyi srog gi shing sreg par byed pa'i 'chi bdag gi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor phye ba dang 'dra bar brlag go ste brlag par bgyi'o/ /'gro ba'i blos shes bya mthong ba la sgrib par byed pa'i ma rig pa'i mun pa chen po rig pa ye shes kyi snang bas gsal bar bgyi'o/

/mu stegs byed la sogs pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la ma dad pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa las phyir rgol ba dag dang / las rgyu 'bras med par lta ba la sogs pa lta ba phyin ci log pa rnams lta ba de spangs te las rgyu 'bras la blang dor byed pa la sogs pa'i 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba la gzud cing sangs rgyas sogs la dad pa dang ldan par blo bsgyur te bsgyur bar bgyi'o/ /sems can rnams 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lhung bar byed pa'i zag bcas kyi las kyi chu bo ldog ste med par bgyi'o/ /sdug bsngal gyi gting zab cing rgya che ba'i srid pa'i rgya mtsho chen po skem par bgyi'o/ /'gro ba rnams kyi blo mun sel ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi sgron me sbar bar bgyi'o/ /'gro ba rnams byang chub tu 'gro ba'i lam byang chub kyi sems la sogs pa bstan par bgyi'o/ /yul mchog ma yin pas yul mchog la gnod pa byed pa dag bzod pa dang des pa ste sems dul ba la gzud do ste de ltar du 'jug par bgyi'o/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dga' ba me lta bu brtser stsal to ste tshul de la 'god par bgyi'o/ /'dod pa'i yon tan la chags pa med pa'i yon tan gyi bud shing bsreg pa'i chags pa'i me'i phung po gzhil bar bgyi'o/ /rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa gcod par byed pa'i zhe sdang gi mtshon gyi rtse rnon po gzhom par bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang bden pa mthong ba'i lam la gzud do ste 'jug par bgyi'o/ /rang gi yon tan gyi phur ma khyer ba'i phrag dog gi 'tshub ma ste rlung chen po zhi bar bgyi'o/ /gzhan la gtong mi phod par sred pa'i kun slong gis dam du bcings pa'i ser sna'i mdud pa bkrol bar bgyi'o/ /mdor na rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad bsal ba'i sgo nas 'bras bu sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar bgyi'o/ /de ltar zhi nas las nyon gyi 'jigs pa ma mchis pa dang / sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba chen po dang ldan pa'i thar pa bla na med pa'i grong khyer du 'jug par bya zhing gnas par bgyi'o/

/bdag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa de lta bu dang ldan pas na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyed rnams kyis tshul de dgongs shing mkhyen par mdzad de bdag cag slob ma dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad la khyed rnams kyis las kyi dngos grub kyi mchog ste/ rgyas pa'i las bsgrub pa la nus pa dang ldan pa'i byin rlabs bstsal zhing gnang bar mdzad du gsol zhes pa'i don te/ 'don cha dkyus nas 'byung ba bzhin dpon slob thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu brjod cing lag gi nas rnams rten la gtor/ snam sbyar sogs bzhag nas gral la 'dug go /'di la sems bskyed nyer gnyis kyi tshig ces kun las 'byung bas sems bskyed kyi dam bca'i tshig tsam yin gyi/ sems bskyed 'bog pa'i cho ga lta bu ni ma yin la/ nyer gnyis brjod pa'i tshig yin pa ni/ gzhung 'dir/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi dbugs dbyung ngo zhes pa nas/ bde ba chen po'i grong khyer du 'jug par bgyi'o zhes pa'i bar tshig rnams bsngos pas gsal lo// //spyi don drug pa rten bskyed pa dang / spyi don bdun pa ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bgegs bskrad cing mchod pa dgug gzhug bya ba/ spyi don brgyad pa rgyas btab pa rnams sta gon bzhin no zhes gzhung 'di nyid nas gsungs pa ltar tshig don rnams kyang sta gon gyi skabs su bstan pa ltar ro/ /spyi don dgu pa dbang bskur ba ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yab yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes pa nas/ de ltar na dbang bzhi bskur bas dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan pa sta gon bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i bar te/ de yang spyir dbang bskur la rgyas bsdus gsum las 'dir ni 'bring po bskur ba ste/ thog mar snying kha'i 'od zer gyis gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang lha spyan drangs te rten bzhugs pa'i phyogs der gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa rta babs dang bcas pa'i nang du bzhugs par bsam/

dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ rang gi mdun du stegs kyi steng du rnam rgyal bum pa/ dbu rgyan/ rdo rje dril bu la sogs pa'i dbang rdzas rnams gzhung 'di nas 'byung ba bzhin yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed nas/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas de dang der gyur par bsam zhing / nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis rten la dbang bskur bsam la/ rig pa'i dbang lnga/ rdo rje brtul zhugs/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang rnams maṇḍal dang / rtogs bskyed med par gzhan slob ma la ji ltar bskur ba ltar bya ste/ de'i tshe bum chu rten la dngos su gtor ba'o/ /me long gi nang du rten gyi gzugs brnyan shar ba la chu dbang bskur ba gang bde bya bar bshad pa bzhin da lta phyag len la bum chu ting la sogs pa'i snod du blug mchod g.yog pas rten gyi drung du 'jog pa mdzad do/ /de bzhin du dbu rgyan dbu la dngos su bcings kyang rung mod/ phyag len 'ching pa'i tshul byas te rten gyi drung du mchod g.yog pas 'jog rdo rje dang dril bu yang phyag tu gtad pa'i tshul bya zhing rten gyi drung du 'jog pa 'dra/ de nas nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos byang chub kyi sems rten gyi ljags la bzhag pa dang / ye shes kyi phyag rgya gtad pas zung 'jug gi ye shes skyes par bsam la/ gsang dbang dang / shes rab kyi dbang dang / dbang bzhi pa rnams kyang lam dus kyi dbang 'bring po'i skabs ltar bya ba yin no/ /de ltar dbang bskur nas chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rten ngo shes pa rnams la rang gi rigs bdag dang / ngo mi shes pa rnams la rdo rje sems dpas rgyas btab tshul sta gon gyi skabs bzhin no/ /'dir ngor chen gyi zin bris 'ga' zhig las/ rig pa'i dbang lnga'i skabs su yang chu dbang re re bskur ba sogs byas kyang /

lugs 'di la de'i phyag len med mod/ dbang gi gong du yang byur bsal ba'i cho ga byed srol med cing / slob ma dbang bskur la rig pa'i dbang lnga'i dus su dbang rdzas lhar bskyed pa dang / slob ma yang de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga de dang der bskyed pa sogs yod kyang / rten la dbang bskur ba'i dus su rten de dang po gang du bskyed pa de la dbang bskur ba ma gtogs/ dbang de dang de'i skabs su lhar bsgyur ba dang / dbang rdzas lhar bskyed pa'i phyag len med mod/ rten de kyai rdo rje sogs ma gtogs rab tu byung ba'i cha byad can rnams la dbang gong ma gsum yang bskur mi dgos so zhes gsungs shing / de bzhin du kha cig las/ des na 'di'i lugs la lam dus kyi 'bring po bzhin du dbang bzhi ka bskur la/ 'on kyang dbang rdzas dang / slob ma'i bskyed chog dang / maṇḍal gsol btab sogs mi byed pas/ zhes pa dang / gal te rnal 'byor rgyud man chad kyi lha'am bla ma rab byung lta bu'i rten yin na rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bor byed kyang / de la dbang gong ma gsum mi bskur zhes 'byung mod/ de la zin bris dang po der rig pa'i dbang lnga la chu dbang re re bzhin mi bskur gsungs pa de chu dbang rgyas pa gsung rgyu yin nam bsdus pa yin/ dang po ltar na slob ma la dbang bskur ba dang / rang nyid dbang len pa sogs kyi tshe rig pa'i dbang phyi ma rnams la chu dbang rgyas pa mi bskur bzhin du rab gnas kyi rten la dbang bskur ba'i dus su de ltar dgos pa'i dogs pa tsam yang gang la 'byung / phyi ma ltar na rje btsun kun dga' bzang po'i gsang ba 'dus pa'i rab gnas bkra shis rgya mtshor/ rig pa'i dbang drug rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang che chung gnyis dang bcas pa dkyil chog bzhin rgyas par bskur zhes gsungs la/ dkyil chog ye shes rgya mtshor/ rig dbang lnga la chu dbang re re bzhin bskur bar gsungs shing /

de dang 'dra bar rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi'i skabs 'dir bya bar gsungs pa dang 'gal la/ der ma zad kun mkhyen chen po'i kyai rdor gyi rab gnas dge legs rgya mtshor yang / rig pa'i dbang lnga/ rdo rje brtul zhugs/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang rnams slob ma la ji ltar bskur ba ltar te/ zhes gsungs pas rig dbang re re la chu dbang re bskur ba 'di nyid 'thad pa yin no/ /de bzhin du dbang rdzas dang / rten rnams rig pa'i dbang lnga po re re la bskyed chog byed par yang / ngor chen dang kun mkhyen gyi gsung de dag gis 'grub bo/ /rten rab byung yin na dbang gong ma gsum mi bskur bar gsungs pa la yang rnam dpyad ma byung ste/ rab byung gi rten du song ba nas phyag rgya gtad pa mi dgos shing phyag rgya gtad pa mi rung ngo dgongs na/ dngos kyi phyag rgya ni slob ma dbang bskur gyi tshe yang phyag len la mi mdzad pas/ de ni gtod dgos mi dgos dang rung mi rung gi dogs pa med la/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya gtad pa rten rab byung gi cha byad can la mi rung zhing mi dgos gsung rgyu yin na ni/ slob ma la dbang bskur gyi tshe yang rab tu byung ba dag la dbang gong ma gsum bskur mi dgos par mtshungs pas ha cang thal zhing don gsal las/ rnal 'byor chen po'i lugs yin na dbang bzhi char bskur bar bya'o zhes kyang gsungs so zhes pa dang / bkra shis rgya mtsho dang / dge legs rgya mtsho gnyis char du/ de nas nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos byang chub kyi rten gyi lce la bzhag pa dang / ye shes kyi phyag rgya gtad pas zung 'jug gi ye shes skyes par bsam la gsang dbang dang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang / dbang bzhi pa rnams dkyil chog bzhin dang / lam dus kyi dbang 'bring po ltar bskur bar gsungs pa dang 'gal lo/ /gal te de gsum char rab byung gi cha byad can gyi rten la rab gnas kyi skabs kyi dbang bskur gyi dbang du mdzad pa min gsungs na ni/

rab gnas kyi tshe de dag las gzhan pa'i rten rab byung gi cha byad can la dbang bskur tshul logs su gsungs dgos pa las de 'dra yig cha de gsum las mi snang ba'i phyir ro/ /des na zin bris gnyis po der de ltar bshad pa ni cung zad gsung rgyun ma zin nam snyams shing / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i rab gnas dngos grub 'byung ba 'dir kyai rdor la brten pa'i tshe dbang gong ma gsum yang lam dus kyi dbang 'bring po'i skabs ltar bskur bar mdzad pa 'di ni rje btsun chen po'i don gsal dang / ngor chen gyi bkra shis rgya mtsho dang / kun mkhyen gyi dge legs rgya mtsho gsum char gyi dgongs pa 'khrul pa med pa yin la/ gzhung 'di nas 'byung ba'i dbang bskur gyi tshig don zhib par ni bde chen rgya mtsho sogs su blta'o// //spyi don bcu pa mchod bstod bya ba'i tshul bshad pa ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ mchod pa'i mar me ma sbar ba rnams sbar/ zhal zas dang mar me gsar pa yod na'ang phul zhing / zhes pa nas/ zhes rgyal ba gnyis pa kun dga' bzang pos gsungs zhes pa'i bar te/ mchod bstod ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga dang / cho ga'i tshig don rnams gong sta gon gyi skabs bshad pa ltar ro/ /skabs 'dir mchod pa la kha cig 'phags pa rin po che'i rab gnas nyin gang mar spyan dbye ma byas par mchod pa mi 'bul bar bshad pa dang / spyan dbye ma byas par mchod pa dang bstod pa'i yul du mi 'os pas na/ thog mar spyan dbye byas/ de nas mchod bstod bya ba yin zhing / sdom tshig kyang / dbang bskur spyan dbye mchod bstod bya/ /zhes bsgyur dgos zer ba la/ gzhan dag 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i rab gnas nyin gang ma de ni don gsal gyi rab gnas bsdus pa de gzhir bzhag yin pas/ bsdus pa'i tshe dbang bskur dang spyan dbye ba'i bar du mchod bstod mi dgos shing / don gsal du yang ma bshad gsungs pa byung yang / don gsal gyi rab gnas bsdus pa'i skabs su/

dbang bskur gyi rjes su mchod bstod byed pa gsungs shing / spyan dbye bya ba'i gsal kha ma byung yang spyan dbye bya dgos pa gzhir bcas la/ mchod bstod bya ba ni dngos su bstan te/ de nyid las/ dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab pa sngar bzhin bya/ mchod pa ci 'byor pa dang / bstod pa gang yang rung bas bstod ces gsungs pas so/ /des na rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gsang 'dus kyi rab gnas bkra shis rgya mtshor gsungs/ de nyid gzhung 'dir 'dren par mdzad pa'i don bzhin rab gnas kyi mchod bstod kyi yul du 'os pa la spyan dbye nges par sngon du 'gro dgos na sta gon gyi skabs su spyan dbye mi byed pa ni kun mthun zhing tshad ldan gyi gzhung las kyang ma bshad/ mchod bstod byed pa ni tshad ldan gyi bshad pas sta gon gyi skabs su mchod bstod byas pa la dgos pa med par 'gyur ro// //spyi don bcu gcig pa spyan dbye bya ba'i tshul bshad pa ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ gser drug rnam las mi chung ba'i thur mas/ dngul gyi kong bur bzhag pa'i mar dang / sbrang rtsi blangs pa'am/ dkyil 'khor gyi rdul tshon phra mo zhig blangs la zhes pa nas/ ces pa lan gsum brjod ces pa'i bar te/ de yang gser dngul gyi snod du sbrang rtsi dang / mar dang / mig sman arja na dang sbyar ba gser gyi thur mas blangs pa'am/ ma 'byor na sangs rgyas spyan gyi dam tshig phyag rgyas rdo rje bzung nas/ rdo rje'i rtses rdul tshon phra mo zhig blangs nas rten gyi spyan la byug par gsungs kyang / phyag len de ltar du bsam zhing mos nas gser gyi thur ma'am thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du rdo rje bzung nas/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang / /zhes sogs brjod cing rten so so'i spyan gyi thad khar byug pa'i tshul bya ba yin la/ tshigs bcad 'di'i don yang / kun mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pas sgrib byed kyi skyon kun dang bral ba yin yang /

bdag cag rnams gus pa chen po'i dbang gis 'phags pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gzugs kyi spyan dbye bar bgyis pa 'di la brten nas/ nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa ji tsam pa/ /sems can ma lus mtha' yang de bzhin te/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nam mkha' la mtha' med pa ltar sems can gyi grangs la yang mtha' dang tshad med pas na nam mkha'i mthar thug pa dang mnyam par gyur pa'i sems can rnams kyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi spyan ni thob par shog ces pa'i don te/ sngags don ni/ oṃ 'dra/ tsakṣu tsakṣu ni mig mig ces pa dang / sa manta ni dag pa/ tsakṣu bi shwa dha ni rnam par sbyangs pa'i mig ces pa dang / swāhā ni gzhi tshugs zhes pa'o/ /de yang dper na 'jig rten na skyes bu mig long ba rnams kyis gzugs mi mthong zhing / grong khyer la sogs par rang stobs kyis 'jug mi nus pa de mig dbye mkhan gyis phye ba na phyis gzugs mthong zhing / grong khyer la sogs par rang stobs kyis 'jug nus pa ltar/ sku gzugs kyi rten 'di dag kyang sbyin pa'i bdag po la sogs pa la bkra shis dang zhi ba dang dge legs su byed pa sogs sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces pa ste/ de lta bu'i don can gyi tshigs bcad rnams lan gsum brjod pa ni spyan dbye ba'i tshul lo/ /grub na 'di dag rten gyi spyan re re la gsum mam/ gnyis la sogs pa bya bar bshad cing / legs pa yang yin te/ 'di rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi'i gtso bo gcig yin pas so/ /de ltar yang slob dpon rab 'byor bskyangs kyis mdzad pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga la spyan dbye ba'i cho ga zhes mtshan 'dogs pa'i dgongs bzhed spyan dbye rab gnas kyi gtso bo gcig yin pa'i rgyu mtshan la dgongs pas kyang gsal bar grub pa yin no// //spyi don bcu gnyis pa gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshul bshad pa ni/

gzhung 'di nyid las/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga gong bzhin gyi sngags mchod/ de nyid lnga pas bstod do/ /zhes pa nas/ yi dam/ sangs rgyas/ chos srung gi sku sogs so so'i mngon rtogs bzhin bskyed pa rnams ni zhal bsgyur mi dgos so zhes pa'i bar te/ 'di la gsol ba gdab pa dang / zhal bsgyur ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gsol gdab kyi sngon du oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga sngags tsam gyi mchod pa dang / bstod pa de nyid lnga pa'am/ phyag len la snang stong ma dang / 'gro ba rgyud lnga ma gnyis mdzad cing / de nas dpon slob thams cad bzhengs te/ mgrin gcig tu ye dharma lan gsum brjod pa'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i me tog bzung ste/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i zhes sogs brtan par bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pa yin te/ de yang gang la gsol ba 'debs pa'i yul ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ces pas bstan/ bdag la dgongs su gsol zhes pa ni thugs gtod par zhu ba yin la/ gsol 'debs dngos la spyir rgyal ba rnams sems can gyi don la mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ ji srid ces sogs dang / bye brag tu rab gnas byas pa'i rten rnams la spyan drangs nas bstims pa'i ye shes pa rnams dus kyi khyad par rten la 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar brtan par bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pa ni bye brag tu zhes sogs kyis bstan/ de ltar gtso bor rten la brtan par bzhugs par gsol ba btab nas/ zhar byung rang gzhan la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi dngos grub stsol bar gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ brtan par bzhugs nas zhes sogs kyis bstan to/ /de lta bu'i gsol 'debs kyi tshig brjod pa'i rjes su rol mo dang bcas rten la me tog 'thor ba ste/ de ltar 'thor bar bya rgyu'i me tog ni bka' gdams pa'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyis phyag len la tshul bzhin du bsgrub par mdzad de/

bsgrub tshul ni/ grub na sta gon dang / ma grub na dngos gzhi'i nub mo nas dge slong gtsang ma 'ga' bsags/ ras la sogs pa'i steng du rten la 'thor rgyu'i nas dkar mo'i phung po spungs pa'i steng du bum pa mgul bcings dang bcas pa/ chus sum gnyis gang ba/ bum rdzas nyer lnga pa blugs pa ku shas kha brgyan pa/ de'i steng du me long la ghi wang ngam/ gur gum gyis ye dharma bris la/ kha rgyan la bstan nas yig mgo steng du bstan pa bsham/ de nas dge slong rnams kyis nas phung gi mtha' bskor te/ rgyud sde bzhi po gang la brten nas byed pa'i kyai rdo rje lta bu yin na/ de'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i bar sngon du song nas/ de nas bum pa la a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'o/ /dmigs pa me long la bris pa'i yig 'bru rnams gser gyi yi ge 'od 'bar ba dang bcas par bsgom/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs kha nas rten byin rlabs can du byed pa'i nus pa can gyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dpag med spyan drangs yig 'bru rnams la thim pas yig 'bru rnams las kyang de 'dra ba'i bdud rtsi babs nas bum pa'i nang gang bar bsam zhing / ye dharma mang du bzlas/ de nas kyang rten la 'thor ma ran gyi bar du thun byas te bar ma chad par bzlas so/ /mjug sngar bzhin yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ bdud rtsi spyan drangs yig 'bru rnams la thim pas/ yig 'bru rnams kyang rten byin rlabs can du byed pa'i nus pa can gyi bdud rtsir gyur nas bum nang gi bdud rtsi la thim/

de yang me tog gi phung po la thim pas nas 'bru re re bzhin ye dharmā'i yig 'bru gser 'od 'bar bar bsam zhing / nas la bum chu cung zad bsres pa de nyid rten la 'thor ba yin la/ de ltar ma grub na ye dharmā tshar kha yar 'don cing / nas 'bru re re ye dharmā'i yig 'bru re rer gyur par bsam nas rten la 'thor zhing / su pra tiṣṭha sogs kyi sngags brjod pa dang bcas lan gsum bya ba ni gsol 'debs dngos so/ /rten 'brel snying po'i sngags don gong bzhin dang / su pra'i sngags don ni shin tu rab gnas rdo rje zhes pa'o/ /de nas bla ma'i sku brnyan sogs sngar rten bskyed kyi skabs su rdo rje 'chang kyai rdo rjer bskyed pa rnams 'od du zhu nas bla ma'i sku'i rnam par bsgyur ba sogs rten rnams rigs lnga sogs de dang der bskyed pa rnams sangs rgyas byang sems sogs kyi rten de dang de'i rnam par gyur par bsam pa sogs zhal bsgyur ba ste phal cher gzhung 'di nyid kyi dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar bya zhing bsgom pa yin pas go sla'o/ /zhal bsgyur mi dgos pa'i rigs kyang dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar yi dam sangs rgyas chos srung rnams rang rang gi mngon rtogs bzhin bskyed pa dag la zhal bsgyur mi dgos shing mchod rten rnams la yang de dang 'dra la/ gzhan zhal bsgyur dgos pa'i bris 'bur gyi rigs dkyus na mi gsal ba rnams gong gi rten bskyed dang bstun pa'i rigs 'gre shes dgos pa yin no/ /gsol 'debs dang zhal bsgyur gnyis kyi go rim la/ rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gsang ba 'dus pa'i rab gnas bkra shis rgya mtshor/ thog mar zhal bsgyur dang / de nas gsol 'debs 'byung zhing / de bzhin du ngor pa'i phyag len phyi ma thams cad la da lta'i bar du yang go rim de nyid yod snang yang / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i dngos grub 'byung ba 'dir thog mar gsol 'debs dang /

de nas zhal bsgyur mdzad pa 'di ni rje btsun chen po'i don gsal gyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa yin te/ don gsal las/ bcu gnyis pa brtan par bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ces pa nas brtan par bzhugs su gsol bar bsam la/ zhes pa'i bar gyi gsol 'debs mdzad pa'i rjes su/ rten de dag mchod rten dang / sku gzugs dang / glegs bam dang / phyag mtshan dang / lha khang la sogs pa nyid du gyur par bsam mo/ /zhes zhal bsgyur ba'i tshul gsungs shing / de bzhin du kun mkhyen chen po'i dge legs rgya mtshor/ sngon du ngor pa'i phyag len dkyus bzhin 'dri bar mdzad nas 'di ni phyag len ltar bris pa yin la/ rab gnas don gsal gyi dpe kun las/ thog mar brtan bzhugs byas nas/ de nas zhal bsgyur ba 'byung ste/ brtan bzhugs 'di rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi yin pas 'di ma tshar bar du bsgyur du mi rung ba la dgongs sam snyam mo/ /des na brtan bzhugs kyi dam tshig pa bskyed pa la ye shes pa spyan drangs pa brtan par byas nas mnga' dbul gyi gong du rang rang gi rnam par bsgyur ba 'di dgongs pa yin pa 'dra'o zhes gsungs pas so// //spyi don bcu gsum pa mnga' dbul rgyas par bya ba'i tshul la/ de yang mchod bstod bye brag dang / sbyin sreg sngags te zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mchod pa'i mnga' dbul/ bstod pa'i mnga' dbul/ bye brag gi mnga' dbul/ sbyin sreg gi mnga' 'bul/ sngags kyi mnga' dbul dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ rten gsar pa'i mdun du mar me/ zhal zas la sogs pa'i mchod pa ci 'byor pa dang / mchod pa rnying pa rnams kha gsos la/ a mṛ tas bsang zhes pa nas/ de rnams phyag rgya dang bcas pas dbul zhes pa'i bar te/ thog mar mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshul ni gong gnas yo byin gyis rlabs pa'i skabs ltar gyi don bsam zhing /

ngag 'don ni dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar ro/ /de nas mchod pa dngos la/ nyer spyod rol mo sogs kyi mchod pa/ rgyal srid sna bdun gyi mchod pa/ 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ stong gsum 'di'am zhes sogs te/ don yang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten khams 'di'am/ 'di nyid las gzhan pa'i zhing khams dag na/ rang gi ngo bo mi sogs 'gro ba gzhan gyi longs spyod kyi dngos po'am rdzas las ches khyad par du 'phags pa lha'i rdzas sam dngos por gyur pa mchod yon nam mchod pa'i chab ji snyed de mang du yod pa rnams dang / gzhan yang dngos su 'byor pa dang yid kyis mang du sprul te mchod yon gyi rigs ma lus pa kun/ yul khyad par can rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sras byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa'i 'khor tshogs du ma dang bcas pa rnams la gus pa chen po'i sgo nas 'bul bas na/ khyed rnams kyi thugs rje chen pos bdag sogs 'gro ba rnams tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i don gyi phyir dges pa chen pos bzhes la bdag gir mdzad du gsol zhes pa'i don dang ldan pa'i tshigs bcad brjod cing / pad kor sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra titstsha pu dza me gha sa mu ḍa spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes pa'i sngags kyi mchod yon 'bul bar bya zhing / sngags don/ oṃ ni gzhan dang 'dra/ sarba ta thā ga ta ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ arghaṃ ni mchod yon/ pra titstsha ni so so bzhes/ pu dza ni mchod pa/ sa mu ḍa ni rgya mtsho/ spha ra ṇa ni 'phro ba/ sa ma ye ni dam tshig ces pa'o/ /de bzhin me tog sogs 'og ma kun la de ltar du sbyar la rol mo'i bar du 'bul ba ste tshig don rnams ni rigs 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa rgyal srid sna bdun gyi mchod pa ni/ thog mar oṃ las rin po che sna bdun yid kyis sprul te/

de yang oṃ ni gzhan dang 'dra/ sarba bid ni thams cad rig pa/ pu ra pu ra ni mdun du mdun du/ su ra su ra ni mdzes shing mdzes pa/ a warta ya a warta ya ni 'phel ba 'phel ba zhes pa ste/ de lta bu'i don dang ldan pa'i sngags brjod/ de nas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /zhes sogs kyis 'bul ba ste tshigs bcad kyi don yang / lam bde ba nas 'bras bu bde bar gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la yid kyis sprul pa'am/ dngos su bshams pa'i 'khor lo rin po che 'di nyid legs par 'bul bas na/ dges pa chen pos bdag gir mdzad nas/ ma rig pa'i rten 'brel sogs yan lag bcu gnyis kyi rtsibs dang ldan pa'i srid pa'i 'khor lor 'gro ba rnams yang nas yang du 'khor ba 'di'i rgyun bcad nas dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi chad par bskor ba shog ces pa'i don dang / 'khor lo 'bul ba'i sngags don ni/ oṃ 'dra/ sarba ta thā ga ta ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ tsakra ratna ni 'khor lo rin po che ste/ pu tsi te mchod/ hūm̐ thugs kyi sa bon te de nyid sbyar nas 'khor lo rin po che 'bul ba'o/ /de bzhin du mchod yul de dag la nor bu rin po che yid kyis sprul par de nyid 'bul bas/ dges pas bzhes nas 'gro ba rnams bkren cing 'phongs pa dang dbul ba'i sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa rgyun bcad nas/ zag med kyi 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par shog ces pa dang / sngags don ni gzhan rnams gong dang 'dra ba la/ ma ṇi ratna ni nor bu rin chen no/ /gzhan yang yul de dag la btsun mo rin po che 'di nyid 'bul bas dges pa chen pos bzhes te/ bdag cag 'gro ba rnams kyi rgyud la yod pa'i de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa dang / las 'bras la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i ma rig pa mun pa dang chos mtshungs pa dag rgyun bcad nas/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab bam rig pa ye shes kyi de kho na nyid dam/

chos kyi dbyings kyi don phyin ci ma log pa rtogs te/ thabs byang chub kyi sems dang / shes rab stong nyid rtogs pa'i blo gnyis dbyer med du 'dre ba'am/ zung du chug par shog ces pa dang / sngags don gzhan 'dra ba la/ wasti ratna btsun mo rin chen no/ /de bzhin du yid kyis sprul pa'i blon po rin chen 'di nyid 'bul bas bdag cag rnams/ phyi mtshan nyid kyi theg pa/ nang bya spyod kyi theg pa/ gsang ba bla med kyi theg pa ste theg pa gsum dang ldan pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa/ so so skye bo rnams kyi blos ji lta ba bzhin bsam yas pa ste bsam du med cing tshig gis brjod du med pa'i lung rtogs kyis bsdus pa dag rab tu 'dzin cing / thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad dang ldan par shog ces pa dang / gzhan yang glang po rin po che yid kyis sprul pa 'di dag kyang 'bul bas/ las rgyu 'bras dang skye ba snga phyi med par lta ba la sogs pa phyi rol pa'i lta ba ngan pa drug cu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa rnams ni rab tu bsal ba ste med par byas shing / bla na med pa'i theg pa mtshon pa'i glang po che'i bzhon pa la brten te/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i grong khyer sangs rgyas kyi sar bgrod par shog ces pa dang / hasti ni glang po che'o/ /de bzhin du rta mchog rin po che 'di yang 'bul bas na/ de'i mthus 'gro ba rnams srid pa'i gzeb ste 'khor ba'i gnas las nges par grol zhing / rdzu 'phrul mchog gi stobs shugs thob nas myur bar 'gro ba kun rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa'am zhing kun bgrod nas de dag tu skye bar shog ces pa dang / tu ram ga ni rta mchog go /gzhan yang khyim bdag dmag dpon rin po che 'di yang 'bul bas na/ de'i mthus 'gro ba rnams thar pa thob pa la gnod cing gegs byed pa'i nyon mongs pa'i dgra tshogs bcom ste de dag las rgyal bar gyur cing /

phyi rol mu stegs byed la sogs pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la pha rol tu gyur pa'i rgol ba ngan pa dag tshar bcad nas/ snyem pa ste nga rgyal dang bral ba'i 'bras bu mchog sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ni thob par shog ces pa dang / khaṅga ni dmag dpon nam khyim bdag go /de dag gi rjes su 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa ni/ kha dog ces sogs te/ de yang kha dog mdzes shing sna tshogs pa dang ldan pa dbyibs shin tu legs pa yid du 'ong ba rgyan gyi phreng ba dang ldan pa/ yul phyogs 'dir ma zad phyogs thams cad dang / dus 'dir ma zad ji srid 'khor ba ma stong gi bar ram/ yang na 'das ma 'ongs da ltar gyis bsdus pa'i dus kun gyi tshe blos sprul pa'am dngos su yod pa'i 'dod yon gzugs kyi mchog dang mchog ma yin pa la sogs te ci mchis pa rnams yul khyad par can la gus shing mos pa'i blos rab tu gnas par byas pa'i ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyer med pa'i lha tshogs la bdag sogs dad pas 'bul gyi/ khyed rnams kyis bdag gir bzhes shig bzhes nas kyang bdag sogs la bla na med pa'i grub mchog ste mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol zhes pa dang / sngags don ni gzhan rnams gong rin chen sna bdun dang 'dra/ ru pa ni gzugs/ ka ma ni 'dod pa/ gu na ni yon tan no/ /de bzhin du yul phyogs dang dus kun nas legs par bshams pa'i yid kyis sprul pa'i 'dod pa'i yon tan sgra'i tshogs zin pa skyes bu dang 'brel ba dung dang rol mo la sogs pa'i sgra dang / ma zin pa 'brug dang chu la sogs pa'i sgra 'dod pa'i yon tan tshig gi mchog gam sgra snyan pa ci mchis pa rnams yul khyad par can la mos pa'i blos sogs gong ltar ro/ /shapta ni sgra'o/ /gzhan yang phyogs dang dus kun tu dngos sam yid kyis sprul te/ tsandan sbrul gyi snying po can dang / a ka ru dang / na gi la sogs pa sna'i dbang po tshim par byed pa'i 'dod yon dri'i tshogs ci mchis pa rnams yul khyad par can la mos blos sogs dang /

gandhaṃ ni dri'o/ /de bzhin du yul phyogs kun nas dus kun tu dngos sam yid kyis sprul pa'i ro zhim zhing bcud chen po dang ldan pa'i 'dod pa'i yon tan rol ba tsam gyis lus sems brtas pa ste/ rgyas par byed pa'i ro mchog tu gyur pa ci mchis pa rnams/ yul khyad par can la mos blos sogs dang / ra sa ni ro'o/ /de bzhin du phyogs dus kun nas dngos sam yid kyis sprul pa'i 'dod pa'i yon tan shin tu 'jam zhing mnyen pa lus la 'khril chags pa'i reg bya'i khyad par ram yon tan lus dang sems tshim par byed pa rnams/ yul khyad par can la mos blos sogs dang / parṣe ni reg bya'o/ /de rnams phyag rgya dang bcas 'bul ba ni mchod pa'i mnga' dbul ba'o/ /gnyis pa bstod pas mnga' dbul ba ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ de nas dril sil gdangs dang bcas pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa nas/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yang dag yon tan rgya chen te/ /lan gcig tsam zhig brjod pas kyang / /sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstod do/ /zhes pa'i bar te/ 'di la yang rten so so'i sgos kyi bstod pa dang / spyi'am thun mong du bstod pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rten de nyid bla ma'i sku brnyan yin na/ bla ma la bstod pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /zhes sogs bya bar gsungs pa'i tshig don ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i sku/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'am/ rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo nyid du gyur pa skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po 'grub pa yang bla ma la rag las pas na/ de gsum gyi rtsa bar gyur pa ste/ de bas na bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa ste tshigs bcad dang pos bla ma la mdor bstan pa'i tshul gyis bstod nas/

cung zad rgyas bshad kyi tshul du bstod pa ni/ bla ma'i sku ni zhes sogs te/ de yang bla ma la phyag 'tshal na yon tan ji lta bu dang ldan pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis phyag 'tshal ba yin zhe na/ de lta bu'i bla ma'i sku ni/ don dam par rang gi ngo bo chos sku'i rang bzhin las ma g.yos pas na gang gis kyang gzhom zhig dang bral ba rdo rje'i sku yin zhing / gdul bya'i snang ngor shin tu mdzes shing blta bas chog mi shes pas mtshan dang dpe byad la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan dang ldan pas na bla ma'i sku la yang phyag 'tshal zhing / der ma zad bla ma de dag gi gsung ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang khyad par med cing / nam du yang 'gag pa med pa ste rgyun chad pa med pas seng ge'i nga ro dang 'dra ste ri dwags ngan pa lta bu'i phyi rol mu stegs byed kyi lta ngan drug cu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa log par lta ba mtha' dag 'joms par mdzad pa can yin pas so/ /des na bla ma'i gsung la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan yang bla ma dag gi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ni rang bzhin gyis 'gag pa med cing / gzugs su med kyang de'i byin rlabs gdul bya dag pa thams cad kyi sems rgyud la mtha' med du 'jug cing khyab pas na nam mkha' dang 'dra ste/ bde ba dang gsal ba'i ngo bor yod kyang de ltar du mi rtogs pa'i ngang tshul can yin zhing / rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin du legs par gnas pa can yin pas so/ /des na bla ma'i thugs la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan yang bla ma ni sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang / chos dkon mchog dang / dge 'dun dkon mchog ste skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyi byed po'am/ sprul pa po yin te/ bla ma'i sku ni sangs rgyas dkon mchog gsung ni chos dkon mchog sku ni dge 'dun dkon mchog gam ngo bo nyid yin pas so/ /des na bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i don no/

/de nas rab tu gnas kyi rten der bla ma'i sku brnyan ched du gtad pa yod na bla ma de'i sku bstod bya ba sogs bla ma spyi dang bye brag gi bstod pa skabs thob dang bstun nas byed cing / gzhan yang yi dam lha so so'i rten gang yod pa rnams kyi sgos bstod shes shing byed par spro na bya zhing / mi shes pa'am bsdu na yi dam spyi la/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig dang / chos pu ti sogs la/ dag pa'i 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig chos sku'i rten mchod rten la/ sna tshogs padma zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis sogs kyis bstod par gsungs pa'i tshigs bcad dang po'i don ni/ rgyal ba rnams kyi chos kyi sku ni nam mkha' bzhin du thams cad la khyab pas rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas gzugs sku dang dbyer med kyang / gdul bya'i las snang dang / rgyal ba nyid kyi sngon gyi smon lam sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs pa'i mthu las rgyal ba'i gzugs kyi sku gnyis ni 'ja' tshon bzhin du rnam 'phrul sna tshogs pa gdul bya so so'i skal ba dang 'tshams par de dang de'i dus dang gnas skabs su gsal bar sprul nas ji lta ba bzhin 'dul ba'i thabs thugs rje chen po dang / ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin 'dul nus pa'i gnyis su med pa'i shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'am/ mnga' bsgyur ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i bde bar gshegs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i don no/ /gnyis pa chos la bstod pa'i don ni/ rang gi ngo bo dag pa gnyis ldan yin pas na/ gzhan gyi 'dod chags sogs sgrib pa kun bral ba ste spong ba'i rgyu byed cing / rnam pa dkar ba'i dge ba'i rang bzhin yin pas na nyams su len pa po'i gang zag ngan song du skye ba'i las las grol bar 'gyur zhing / gcig tu don dam pa'i bden pa chos thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa rgyu kun 'byung dang /

'bras bu sdug bsngal gyis bsdus pa'i spang bya mtha' dag dang bral ba'am/ de dag zhi bar gyur pa 'gog lam gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i lung rtogs kyi dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa mchod rten la bstod pa'i don ni/ kha dog dang dbyibs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i padma dang / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i gdan gyi steng du rgyu sna tshogs pa rin po che'i khams las grub pa'i/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sku'i rten gzhan gyi mchod pa'i rten du stsal pa lta bu rin po che la sogs pa'i rgyan sna tshogs pas mdzes par brgyan cing ngo bo sangs rgyas kyi sku gsum gyi nang nas chos sku'i rang bzhin can mchod rten du grags pa la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa dang / tshigs bcad gnyis pa'i don ni/ de lta bu'i mchod rten la yang rnam pa mang du yod pa'i rang rang gi steng dang / 'og dang / de gnyis kyi bar mtshams dag dang / phyogs bzhi dang phyogs mtshams bzhi la sogs pa rnams ci rigs par sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku'i rten yod pa dang gzugs sku'i rten gtan nas bkod pa med pa yang rung ste/ rnam pa mi 'dra ba mang po yi mchod rten rnams la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i don no/ /de ltar rten so so'i sgos bstod zin nas/ rten thams cad la thun mong du/ snang stong ma dang / 'gro ba rgyud lnga ma dang / mnyam nyid ma sogs kyis bstod par bya ba las/ snga ma gnyis kyis ni sta gon gyi skabs ltar bya zhing tshig don yang gong du bkod pa ltar yin zhing / mnyam nyid ma 'di 'phags pa sangs rgyas mnyam par sbyor ba'i rgyud dang / rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud gnyis nas 'byung bar bshad pa yin la/ bstod pa 'dis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rgyas par bstan pa yin te/ de yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni chos thams cad kyi dbyings su mnyam pa nyid thugs su tshud cing mi g.yo bas na mnyam nyid mchog gi chos nyid dam chos kyi dbyings dri ma med pa chos sku can yin yang /

de'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du gdul bya la thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid du gyur pas na 'gro ba rnams kyi sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad pa yin te/ rgyal ba de dag la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan mtha' yas pa mnga' ba'i stobs kyis 'gro ba rnams la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad sbyin par mdzad cing / sgrib pa'i dri ma med par spangs shing slar yang mi g.yo ba ste mi ldog pa rang snang la chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i ngo bor mnyam pa nyid dam pa'i mchog gam/ dam pa chos nyid kyi sku dang ldan pa can yin pas so/ /de lta bu'i rgyal ba dag gi yon tan ni shin tu phra ba ste chung ngu yin la/ yang tshad 'di ltar zhes gzhag tu med de/ de'i dpe ni rgya tshad nam mkha' dang yang 'dra'o zhes brjod pa dang bskrun du yod pa ma yin pas so/ /de lta bu'i dngos grub ste yon tan mtha' yas shing dpag tu med pa dpe zla bral ba rang gis brnyes pa bzhin/ sems can gyi khams sna tshogs pa dag dngos grub mchog dang mchog ma yin pa rnams nges par stsol bar mdzad pa yin la/ de yang lan gcig dang gnyis la sogs pa ma yin par dus rtag tu stsol bar mdzad pa yin te/ dri ma med pa'i thugs rje'i shugs las de ltar 'byung ba dang / sngon gyi smon lam gyi 'bras bu yongs su rdzogs par grub pa/ skye ba dang 'gag pa med pa'i dri med kyi chos nyid mnga' ba can yin pas so/ /'o na 'gro ba'i don bsgrub pa la rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa mdzad pa ma yin nam snyam na/ rgyal ba rnams kyi rang snang la chos thams cad chos nyid du ro gcig pa'am mnyam pa nyid yin yang / de dang 'gro ba'i don la brtson pa mdzad pa ltar snang ba mi 'gal te/ gdul bya'i las snang la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'gro ba sems can gyi don bsgrub pa'i phyir rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa mdzad pa dang /

'gro ba la thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can du rtag tu rnam par snang ba yin pas so/ /des na rgyal ba rnams ni yon tan gyi tshogs tshad med cing tshad dang bral ba shin tu ste/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang bla na med pa'i byang chub dam pa brnyes par gyur kyang / khams gsum gyi sems can rnams la dngos grub kyi mchog rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rnams stsol bar mdzad pa'i thugs rje chen po'i spyod pa rkyen gzhan gyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa las gzhan du mi g.yo zhing 'gag pa ste rgyun chad par yang yongs su mi 'gyur bar 'khor ba ji srid kyi bar 'byung ba yin la/ rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir na/ e ma hoḥzhes pa ngo mtshar ba'i tshig ste/ ngo mtshar chen po dang ldan pa'i rgyal ba rnams ni shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog ste rang don chos sku mngon du mdzad pa dang ldan pas/ gzhan la mchog sbyin pa po rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa'i go 'phang mchog bla na med pa'i byang chub brnyes pa dang / de'i dbang gis khams gsum gyi sems can kun la rtag tu dngos grub rnam pa gnyis stsol bar mdzad pas na sems can kun gyi mgon por gyur pa dus gsum sgrib pa med cing chags thogs med par mngon sum du rab tu ste mkhyen pa mthar thug pa mnga' ba khyed rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig gi mchog tu gyur pa gsum dang dngos grub dam pa ste/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bdag sogs la stsol bar mdzad du gsol zhes pa ste bstod pa dngos kyi don no/ /tshigs bcad phyi ma 'di ni bstod pa 'di nyid kyi phan yon ston pa ste/ de yang / de skad du bstod pa'i tshigs bcad 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yang dag pa'i yon tan rgya chen po dag brjod pa'i sgo nas sangs rgyas thams cad la bstod pa yin pas phan yon dpag tu med de/

'di nyid lan mang du brjod pa'i sgo nas sangs rgyas rnams la bstod na lta smos kyang ci dgos sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rnams yid la dran bzhin pas lan gcig tsam zhig brjod pas kyang / de'i 'bras bu las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi go 'phang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'grub par 'gyur bas so zhes pa'i don te/ de dag ni bstod pa'i mnga' dbul ba'o/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu nye bar mkho bas mnga' dbul la/ rten thams cad la spyir mnga' dbul ba dang / bye brag so so la mnga' dbul ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor khrus dang na bza' rgyan/ /rnam lnga rin chen bdun dang bcud/ /gdugs sogs dag ni spyi yi 'o/ /zhes pa ltar/ dkyil 'khor gyi mnga' dbul ba/ khrus kyi mnga' dbul ba/ na bza'i mnga' dbul/ rgyan gyi mnga' dbul/ 'dod yon lnga'i mnga' dbul/ rin chen bdun gyi mnga' dbul/ bcud kyi mnga' dbul/ gdugs sogs kyi mnga' dbul ba dang bdun las/ dang po ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ dang po dkyil 'khor ni gling bzhi gling phran brgyad ri rab dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bris pa de rten rnams la dngos su phul bar bsam la zhes pa nas/ rim pa bzhin bkod pa mdzes par gcal du bkram par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i bar te/ de yang gang 'bul ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ gling brgyad ri rab dang bcas pa bris pa'i dkyil 'khor te/ de nyid kyi tsa ka li 'bul ba yin zhing / 'bul ba'i tshe slob dpon gyi tsa ka li'i rgyab yig bklags te 'bul ba'i stangs ka re byas nas mchod g.yog pa la gtad la/ des kyang gong bshoms kyi skabs su gsungs pa ltar mnga' 'bul stegs kyi steng rin po che'i snod 'brus bkang pa'i mthar rim pa bzhin bkod pa mdzes par byas te gcal du bkram par bya ba sogs lag len ji ltar bya ba'i tshul dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar bya zhing 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /'bul ba'i tshigs bcad kyi don ni/

'jig rten gyi khams kyi sa gzhi 'di spos kyis legs par khyab par byugs shing / shin tu mdzes pa'i me tog gi tshogs mang du bkram pa'i steng du ri rab lhun po dang / de'i mthar gling bzhi gling phran bzhi ste brgyad nyi zla gnyis dang bcas pas mdzes par brgyan pa 'di nyid dmigs yul bdag sogs 'gro ba rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing bzang po thob par bya bar dmigs nas 'bul bas na/ de ltar phul ba yi mthus 'gro ba kun las ngan pa rnam par dag pa las byung ba'i zhing mchog rnams su skye zhing gnas nas rgyun ma chad par zhing de la longs spyod par shog ces pa dang / sngags don ni/ badzra rdo rje/ su re khe sa gzhi yin pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i mchod pa zhes pa'i don yin la/ mchod pa rnams la mgor oṃ dang / mjug tu āḥhūm̐ sbyar ba ni/ bla med pa rnams/ rdo rje gsum ldan byin rlabs bdag /rang ming sa bon ldan par bya/ /zhes pa ltar sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi sa bon gyi bar du mchod pa rang rang gi ming bcug pas de gsum gyi mchod pa'i sngags su 'gyur ba'i don yin zhing / swāhā ni gzhi tshugs pa'o/ /gnyis pa khrus kyi mnga' dbul ba ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ khrus bum bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam la zhes pa nas/ zhes brjod cing gong bzhin gtad ces pa'i bar te/ de yang khrus kyi bum pa dngos su 'bul ba'am ras gzhi sogs la bris pa gang bde 'bul bar gsungs pa ltar phyag len la tsa ka li 'bul ba mdzad pas ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni dkyus nas 'byung ba gong ma ltar 'og ma kun la bya ba las/ tshigs bcad kyi don ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir ma zad stong gsum gyi stong gsum chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu dri mchog 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i spos kyi mchog dag sbyar ba'i chus yongs su gang ba'i bum pa 'di'i chus/ thub pa'i dbang po rnams kyi sku gser sbyangs pa byas pa'i btso ma dag byi dor byas pa ltar shin tu dwangs shing dri ma med pa 'od 'bar zhing chags pa dang ldan pa de dag bkru zhing byug par bgyi'o zhes pa dang /

sngags don ni/ badzra rdo rje/ gandhe ni dri dang / oṃ dang / āḥhūm̐ dang / swāhā ni gong ltar ro/ /gsum pa na bza'i mnga' dbul la/ sangs rgyas longs sku'i cha byad can sogs la na bza' 'bul ba dang / sprul sku'i cha byad can sogs la na bza' 'bul ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang zhes pa nas/ zhes brjod cing gtad ces pa'i bar te/ de yang longs sku dang / byang sems kyi khyim pa'i cha lugs can dang / mchod rten sogs la stod g.yogs smad g.yogs sbub can la sogs pa kha dog sna tshogs pa'i na bza'am/ de ltar bris pa 'bul ba ste/ 'bul tshig gi don ni/ kha dog shin tu mdzes shing bzang ba dri zhim pa reg na bde ba bskyed pa/ dbyibs srab pa 'jam pa yang ba gyon na mdzes pa la sogs pa yon tan du ma dang ldan pa/ rgyu lha rdzas kyi dngos po las byung ba yi na bza' mchog tu gyur pa 'di dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rdo rje'i sku la gus pas 'bul gyi/ bdag sogs rnams kyis bgres pa ste rgas pa med pa dang / gzhan yang skye ba dang na ba dang 'chi ba med pa'i rdo rje'i sku thob par shog ces pa dang / sngags don gzhan 'dra/ badzra wasatra sya ni rdo rje na bza' zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa sprul sku'i cha byad can sogs la na bza' 'bul ba ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku dang zhes pa nas/ zhes brjod cing gtad ces pa'i bar te/ de yang sprul sku dang rab byung gi cha lugs can gyi rten rnams la snam sbyar la sogs pa ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan dngos su'am bris pa 'bul ba yin pas/ 'bul tshig gi don yang / rgyal ba'i dri ma med pa'i mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis sogs la sgrib byed kyis sgrib pa dang gsal byed kyis gsal bar 'gyur ba mi mnga' yang / bdag cag rnams rgyal ba khyed la dad pa chen pos na bza' ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'bul bar bgyis pas/
