gzhan don tshan phyi ma yon bdag bsgo ba sogs bcu gnyis po rnams gong rgyas pa'i skabs bzhin bya bar gsungs pa rnams kho bo'i rab gnas kyi cho ga ltar byas nas/ tshig don ni thams cad gong rgyas pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar dang / phyag len phra mo dngos grub 'byung bar mi gsal ba 'ga' zhig kho bos rab gnas kyi yi ge'i mchan du bkod pa rnams kyang nges par bya'o/ /de dag gis ni rab gnas 'bring po thun mong ba'i don bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa 'bring po thun mong ma yin pa'i don bshad pa ni/ dngos grub 'byung ba 'dir/ rab gnas bsdus pa'i kha 'phangs dang / rab gnas kyi phan yon dang / gzungs gzhug 'bul tshul gsungs pa'i rjes su cho ga 'bring po thun mong ma yin pa bya tshul gsungs kyang / 'dir bshad sla ba'i phyir 'og gi thun mong ma yin pa de yar blangs te 'dir bshad na/ 'di la yang rten gyi bya ba sogs cho ga'i sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i chos lnga ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ yang mgon khang lta bu mgon po lha brgyad kyi sku dang / zhal gyi sku yongs rdzogs sam/ bram gzugs gtso 'khor sogs kyi bris sku/ 'bur sku/ logs bris sogs gur zhal gtso bor gyur pa'i rab gnas thun mong ma yin pa bya tshul ni/ rten gyi bya ba yongs su rdzogs pa sogs don tshan lnga ni gong du bshad pa ltar ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gong du bkod pa bzhin 'dir yang nges par byas nas/ cho ga dngos la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sbyor ba legs par bsham pa ni/ gzhan thams cad gong rab gnas thun mong ba ltar la/ 'di rang gi khyad chos su dgos pa rnams kyang dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar dang / dngos gzhi'i don tshan dang po bdag bskyed pa nas don tshan lnga pa gsol ba btab pa'i bar don tshan bzhi'am/ bum pa bsgrub pa gcig tu byas na lnga 'byung pa rnams gong rgyas 'bring gnyis kyi skabs ltar cho ga yang bya zhing / tshig don yang gong ltar ro/

/don tshan drug pa rten bskyed pa ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ gur zhal sogs sku gang yod rnams a mṛ tas bsang zhes pa nas/ zhes brjod cing bsam la byin gyis brlab ces pa'i bar te/ de yang rten bskyed tshul gzhan rnams ni gong rgyas pa'i skabs su zhib par bkod pa ltar yin zhing / 'di rang gi rten bskyed thun mong ma yin pa yang gtor chog nas 'byung ba ltar bya tshul dkyus nas 'byung ba bzhin gyi tshig don ni go sla'o/ /bdun pa ye shes pa spyan drang zhing dgug gzhug bya ba la/ spyan drang ba dngos/ bgegs bskrad cing mchod pa/ dgug gzhug bya ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ spyan drang ba ni/ slob dpon gyis dril sil/ gzhan rnams kyis dkyus rnga cha lang / mchod g.yog pa gnyis kyis rkang gling g.yab dar zhes pa nas/ mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /zhes sngags dang bcas pa'i bar dang / zhes pa'i bar te/ 'di la yang tshig lhug pa'i sgo nas spyan drang ba dang / tshigs bcad kyi sgo nas spyan drang ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang gi snying kha dang zhes sogs sngags dang bcas pa brjod pa ste/ spyan 'dren pa'i tshe rang lhar gsal pa'i thugs kha dang / mdun bskyed kyi chos skyong 'khor bcas kyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phro ba dang / gnas rang bzhin gyi gnas dang / 'og min sogs bzhugs pa'i gnas gnyis char dang / yul ni rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba spyan 'dren pa ni 'di'i khyad par ro/ /gnyis pa tshigs bcad kyi sgo nas spyan 'dren pa la thun mong ma yin pa dang / thun mong ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ hūm̐ rdo rje 'chang chen mkha' 'gro rdo rje gur/ /zhes sogs te/ de yang hūm̐ zhes pa ni thugs bskul zhing bod pa ste/ gang na sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi yon tan dang ldan pas na rdo rje 'chang ste/

brgyud pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang dang / de las chos skyong gi gdams pa sogs dngos su gsan pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ de'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi dngos su gsol ba'i slob dpon chen po/ bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs pas na bram ze/ yang dag pa'i gdams ngag mchog 'dod cing sred pas na mchog sred de bram ze mchog sred dang / de'i dngos kyi slob ma nor bu gling pa bde ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang ldan pas tshul khrims kyi dri bsung gzhu 'dom lnga brgya tsam gyi sa phyogs su khyab nus pa'i stobs kyis chos skyong yang rang 'khor du 'byung ba de nyid dang / shaddha ka ra warma ste dad byed go char grags pa dang / de nyid las chos skyong gi gdams pa sogs mang du nos shing kha ba can la bka' drin mchog tu che ba'i skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā ba chen po rin chen bzang po/ de'i thugs sras gu rub rin chen bsod nams sam/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims dang sogs pa ste mgon po'i chos skor gzhan gyi brgyud pa rnams gshegs su gsol lo zhes pa dang / gzhan yang brag steng pa'i dngos slob bla ma mal lo tsā ba dang / de'i thugs kyi sras mchog bla ma rje btsun sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ de'i sras slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ de'i gcung rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ de'i thugs sras chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta/ de'i dbon chos rgyal 'phags pa la sogs pa ste zhang dkon mchog dpal ba dang / dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams brgyud pa'i bla ma gzhan rnams dang bcas gshegs su gsol zhes pa dang / bla ma 'phags pa las chos skyong gi chos skor yongs su nos shing mgon po dngos dang khyad par med pa sga a gnyan dam pa'am/ dam pa spre bor yang grags shing / mtshan dngos dam pa kun dga' grags pa dang / de la chos skyong gi gdams pa rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan cing /

sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i srog rtsa lta bur gyur pa bla ma bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal dang / de'i sras kyi thu bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ de'i dbon bla ma chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ de'i sras mkhyen rab 'jam dbyangs dang dbyer med pa 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ de'i sras che ba grub pa'i dbang phyug rgya dkar shes rab bzang po/ de'i thugs sras sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams dang / la sogs te bdag chen rgya dkar ba dang / sa lo chen po nas gzhan la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyang gshegs su gsol zhes pa'i don yin zhing / sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa nas da lta'i bar gyi mgon po'i chos skor gyi brgyud pa rnams dang / bla ma dam pa nas yar lung pa sogs la brgyud pa'i srol chen po zhig kyang snang bas de'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams spyan 'dren pa'i tshigs bcad kho bo'i bshad pa'i chos kyi rgyal po'i mgon khang gi rab gnas kyi ye shes pa spyan 'dren gyi tshigs bcad kyi kha skong du sbyar ba'i tshigs bcad 'di dag kyang mgon khang gi rab gnas kyi tshe bya zhing / 'di dag gi don yang bla ma dam pa'i dngos kyi slob ma mang du yod pa'i nang nas rgyal tshab chen po gnyis kyi nang tshan yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ de'i sras mkhan chen rgyal ba mchog dbyangs pa/ yang de las kyang mgon po'i chos skor gsan pa 'jam dbyangs chen po nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ de'i sras chung ba bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan/ yang zhang gi slob ma na bza' brag phug pa dang / bla ma dam pa las brgyud pa phyogs gcig bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen buddha shrī/ snyigs dus kyi rdo rje 'chang chen po ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ de'i thugs sras mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang / la sogs pa ste sems dpa' chen po la mgon po'i chos skor gsan pa'i zha lu ba sangs rgyas dpal bzang sogs bla ma gzhan rnams kyang gshegs su gsol zhes pa dang /

gzhan yang ngor chen dang mus chen gnyis ka'i slob ma rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug dang / de gsum ka'i dngos kyi gdams pa nos pa kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge de'i thugs sras 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ mnga' ris pa dpal ldan rgyal po/ sems dpa' chen po'i spyan tshab pa tshul khrims bzang po/ mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog lhun grub/ 'phags chen dpal ldan bkra shis dang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho la sogs pa ste dam pa de dag la chos skyong gi chos skor gsan pa'i bla ma gzhan yang gshegs su gsol zhes pa dang / gzhan yang bdag chen rdo rje 'chang nas chos skyong gi lam srol chen po gcig ni rdo ring pa las brgyud nas dar ba yin pas na/ rdo ring zhes pa'i yul du sku 'khrungs pa 'jig rten gyi bya ba kun spangs te bstan pa rin po cher zhugs pa'i grub mchog chos kyi nyi ma/ de'i thugs kyi sras mchog mthu stobs kyi mnga' bdag tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po blo gsal rgya mtsho/ dam pa de la slob ma'i mchog bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byon pa'i nang nas chos skyong gi chos brgyud 'dzin pa rje bod mkhar ba don grub rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug ta ra ba bsod nams chos 'phel/ de gsum dang / bod mkhar ba'i slob ma spyan snga chos rgya mtsho/ mkhyen brtse ba'i slob ma thub bstan mkhan chen byams pa rab brtan/ de'i slob ma snying rje bzang po/ mkhyen brtse ba dang / ba ra ba gnyis ka'i slob ma kho bo cag gi yongs 'dzin dbang phyug rab brtan te tshar chen dngos slob/ yang slob dang bcas pa rnams dang / gzhan yang sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa la chos skyong gi gdams pa ma lus pa thugs su chud pa snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i nyi ma chen po sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ de'i sras grub pa'i dbang phyug bsod nams dbang po dang /

rgyal sras sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros gnyis la sogs pa ste/ gzhan yang dam pa de dag las chos skyong gi gdams pa gsan pa'i bla ma gzhan yang gshegs su gsol zhes pa dang / khyad par du yang gdug pa can zhi bas 'dul bar mi nus pa dag 'jigs su rung ba drag po'i cha lugs can gaṇḍe 'dzin pa ste gur gyi mgon po dang dbyer med pa rgyal ba mus pa chen po 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan dang / rig pa'i gnas lnga sogs la mkhas pa'i dbang po ngag dbang chos grags dang / spyan snga rin po che kun dga' don grub dang / sogs khong nas bla ma de dag las mgon po'i chos skor gsan pa rnams kyang gshegs su gsol zhes pa ste/ de dag ni chos skyong gi bla ma brgyud pa rnams so so'i mtshan brjod pa'i sgo nas spyan drangs pa yin la/ de nas rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams kun 'dus shing / yi dam gyi lha zhi ba dang khro bo la sogs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid du gyur pa dang / chos skyong ba'i srung ma kun gyi 'phrin las kyi dngos grub kyang rnal 'byor pa la bsgrub pa'i stsol bar mdzad pa'i gang zag de 'dra ba gang yin na rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid yin pas rtsa ba'i bla ma khyed gshegs su gsol zhes pa ni skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi bla ma bye brag tu spyan drangs pa'o/ /de nas khyad par du yang chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du rang bzhin lhun grub kyi sgo nas sems can thams cad la khyab cing spros pa dang bral ba'i pho brang ste lhun grub de'i ngang nas ma g.yos bzhin du gdul bya 'dul ba'i thabs la mkhas pa dang / sems can la snying brtse ba'i thugs rje'i dbang las drag pos 'dul 'os pa la rnam 'phrul drag po la sogs pa gang la gang 'dul gyi skur ston cing / gdul bya skal ba bzang po la rmad du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog gur gyi mgon po lha mo dang bcas pa'i gtso 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kun gnas gshegs la gdan la bzhugs su gsol zhes pa dang /

da lta sems can dang / chos dang / lta ba dang / tshe dang / dus snyigs ma ste snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus tshod 'dir khyed rnams gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ni shin tu ngan pas spyan 'dren par mi 'os na yang / bcom ldan 'das shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa la gnod byed bsrung ba dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa sogs sems can thams cad la phan gdags pa'i phyir gnas 'di nyid du bdag gi lhag bsam bzang por dgongs te gshegs nas kyang mchog gi dngos grub dang / de'i rkyen du thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa yang stsol bar mdzod ces pa'i don te/ tshigs bcad kyi sgo nas ye shes pa spyan 'dren thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /de nas na mo gu ru zhes sogs ni sngags kyi sgo nas ye shes pa spyan 'dren thun mong ma yin pa ste/ sngags don ni/ na mo gu ru sa pa ri wa re bhyaḥni bla ma 'khor dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa mā dzaḥni 'dus pa yang sa ma dzaḥzhes pa ltar na dam tshig gis dgongs nas byon ces pa'o/ /padma ka ma la ya satwaṃ ni padma dkar po rgyas pa khyod ces pa ste/ bla ma rnams la gdan de 'bul ba'o/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥni gnyis su med par bstim pa ste gong du bshad pa ltar ro/ /oṃ badzra shrī zhes sogs ni/ rdo rje dpal he ru ka kyai rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pa rdo rje dam tshig dgongs la byon ces pa dang / padma ka ma la ya ni de dag la padma'i gdan phul ba dang / dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥni gnyis med du bstim pa'o/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya ni dpal nag po chen po/ mahā kā li de wi ni lha mo nag mo chen mo/ tsa turmu kha ni zhal bzhi pa/ badzra kā la yakṣa ni rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po/ kā li yakṣi ni ni nag mo gnod sbyin/ kā la pu ṭa ni nag po pu ṭa/ ru ṭa bha ṭa ni srin po bha ṭa/ ru lu rakṣa si ni sring mo/ sa pa ri wa re ni 'khor dang bcas pa/ badzra sa mā dza sogs sngags tshan gsum ni sngar dang 'dra'o/

/sngags 'di dag 'dren pa'i ring la rol mo chems brdungs bya tshul sogs dang / ye shes pa bstim pa'i dmigs pa rnams ni dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar ro/ /gnyis pa tshigs bcad kyi spyan 'dren thun mong ba dang / bgegs bskrad cing mchod pa/ dgug gzhug bya ba dang / brgyad pa rgyas btab pa rnams rgyas pa'i sta gon bzhin dang / dgu pa dbang bskur ba/ bcu pa mchod cing bstod pa/ bcu gcig pa spyan dbye ba/ bcu gnyis pa brtan par bzhugs su gsol ba gdab cing zhal bsgyur ba/ bcu gsum pa mnga' dbul rgyas par bya ba rnams rgyas pa'i dngos gzhi ltar byas pa'i steng du/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par cung zad yod pa bya tshul dang / mnga' dbul gyi tshe mchod pa'i mnga' dbul la lhag por bdud rtsi lnga mchod dang / bstod pa srin gzugs ma sogs chos skyong gi bstod pa mdzad tshul rnams dkyus nas 'byung ba bzhin bya'o/ /de nas mjug gi cho ga rnams ni gong du bshad pa'i rab gnas 'bring po bzhin la/ gtor ma sbyin pa'i don tshan la mnga' gsol gyi chas bsham tshul dang / spyan 'dren bzhengs nas mdzad rjes bskang gso dang mnga' gsol/ bstod pa sogs mdzad tshul dang / slar bzhengs te pu tra bskul dang / spyi btab kyi gtor 'bul/ srid zhi dpal 'byor ma sogs phyag len bzhin bya ba'i tshul rnams dkyus su zhib par 'byung ba ltar bya zhing / bdud rtsi lnga mchod dang / chos skyong gi bstod pa so so/ bskang ba mnga' gsol rnams kyi tshig don rnams ni mang bas 'jigs nas ma bris so/ /de nas mjug gi cho ga'i chos skyong bsgo ba man ni gong 'bring po thun mong ba'i skabs ltar ro/ /de rnams kyi sgo nas rab gnas thun mong ma yin pa 'bring po'i phyag len dang sbyar nas gsungs pa'i don rnams bstan zin to/ /thun mong ma yin pa 'di rgyas pa mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba gnyis kyi phyag len dang sbyar nas bya tshul yang sngar gyi de dag gis rtogs nus so/

/'dir rab gnas grub rjes chos skyong gi sku de snod min la mi ston pa dang / mchod gtor rgyun ma chad par bya tshul gyi zhal gdams mdzad pa yang dpyod ldan dag gis nges dgos so/ /gong gi spyi don gsum pa rab gnas kyi cho ga bsdus pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ gzhan du kha 'phangs mdzad nas zhib tu ma gsungs kyang / legs par bsham pa la mchod pa gtor ma phal cher 'bring po bzhin bsham/ mnga' dbul chas dang / khrus stegs bsham mi dgos shing / rten bsham tshul yang 'bring po bzhin dang / lha bum gnyis dang / khrus bum gcig byed pa'am/ ma 'byor na las bum du khrus rdzas rnams blugs nas bya zhing / bdag bskyed pa 'bring po bzhin dang / bum bzlas la lha bum bzlas pa 'bring po bzhin la/ khrus bum las bum dang gcig byas pa yin na las bum gyi lha zhu ba'i cho ga zin nas khrus bum gyi sngags rnams bzla ba yin la/ de nas rten sbyang ba dang / bkru ba dang / phyi ba rnams 'bring po bzhin dang / gsol ba gdab pa mi dgos la/ de nas rten bskyed pa/ ye shes pa spyan drangs te gzhug pa/ rgyas btab pa rnams rgyas pa bzhin la/ dbang bskur ba bsdus pa zhig byas kyang rung la/ de nas spyan dbye dang / brtan bzhugs gsol btab 'bring po bzhin bya ba ste dngos gzhi'i cho ga'o/ /de nas mnga' dbul la mchod bstod rgyas pas mnga' dbul dang / tsa ru'i bza' bas mnga' dbul ba/ sngags sam bkra shis kyi mnga' dbul rnams byas la/ bye brag gi mnga' dbul mi dgos shing / 'on kyang bla ma 'phags pas rab gnas kyi cho ga saṃ gha mar/ bye brag gi mnga' dbul gyi nang nas rten spyi la mnga' dbul ba mdzad pas 'di tsam byas na shin tu legs so/ /mjug gi cho ga rnams ni 'bring po ltar bya ba yin zhing / tshig don rnams ni gong rgyas pa'i skabs su bshad pa dag gi ji lta ba bzhin shes par 'gyur ro/ /de rnams kyi sgo nas rab gnas bsdus pa'i don rnams bstan zin to/

/bsdus pa 'di dang / nye mkho bsdus pa gnyis 'khrul par mi bya ste/ 'di la ni bdag bskyed nges par sngon du 'gro dgos la/ nye mkho'i bsdus pa 'di thun mtshams kyi lha gang yang rung ba'i nga rgyal gyis rung ba yin pas snga ma dang khyad par shin tu che'o/ /des na snga ma ni don gsal gyi dngos bstan la yod pa'i bsdus pa de yin la/ phyi ma ni don gsal gyi shugs bstan lta bu bla ma rnams kyi phyag len bde ba'i phyir man ngag yin par shes par bya'o/ /de nas dngos grub 'byung ba 'dir rab gnas bsdus pa kha 'phangs mdzad pa'i rjes su/ rab gnas byas pa'i dgos pa dang / rten la gzungs 'bul tshul gsungs pa'i rab gnas byas pa'i dgos pa ni 'og tu 'chad cing / gzungs gzhug 'bul ba'i tshul la/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ thog mar zhal gdams kyi tshul du/ rab gnas kyi phan yon don gsal las 'byung tshul bkod pa'i rjes su/ ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin rten la gzungs gzhug dang / rab gnas gtso che ba yin kyang / deng sang dbus gtsang khams gsum na yon bdag dad pa dang 'byor pa che zhing / sku gsung thugs kyi rten shi gson thams cad kyi don du bzhengs pa zhig 'dug pa rjes su yid rang ste/ nged rang mchod gnas rnams gal chung chos kyi bya ba la mdzad pa'i stobs kyis/ gzungs gzhug dang / rab gnas kyi rnam gzhag sangs rgyas dang bla ma gong mas gsungs pa dang mi mthun zhing zhes pa nas/ sbyin bdag gi blo dang mthun par bzo rig pa la sku'i rnam gzhag rnams phyag tshad ma 'chugs pa'i zhal bkod dang zhes pa'i bar gsungs nas/ de nas gzungs gzhug 'bul tshul rgyas bsdus 'tshams pa zhig 'byung bas/ phal cher ni dkyus nas 'byung ba bzhin gyis chog mod/ 'on kyang rgyas pa la dga' ba dag gi don dang / blo dman pa rnams kyis rtogs sla ba'i phyir du cung zad phye ba'i sgo nas dkyus su mi gsal ba rnams gsal bar brjod na/ thog mar gzungs gzhug legs par 'bul dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/

dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ gtsang zhing dben pa'i sa yi phyogs su ni/ /'jim pa'am ni bye ma las byas pa'i/ /bde gshegs mchod rten rten 'brel snying po can/ /sdig pa sbyang ba'i phyir ni rtag tu gdab/ /ring bsrel can gyi gzugs sam mchod rten la/ /bstod cing phreng ba dri dang mar me dbul/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan rol mo dang / /mchog tu dad pa yis ni mchod par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di nyid kyis bstan pa yin te/ de yang rten 'brel snying po ni ye dharmā/ gzugs sam zhes pa lugs ma sogs sku gzugs dang / ring bsrel zhes pa ni/ byang chub snying po gnas kyi cho ga zhib mo las/ chos kyi sku'i ring bsrel dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung gi ring bsrel dang / sku bal gyi ring bsrel dang / chos kyi ring bsrel dang / yungs 'bru tsam gyi ring bsrel zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ de dag nang rdzongs su byas pa'i sku gzugs dang mchod rten dag mchod par bya zhes nang bzhugs kyi dbang gis rten de mchod yul khyad par can du 'gyur ba'i don yin la/ gzhan yang slob dpon a bhya ka ra guptas dkyil chog rdo rje phreng ba las/ gang gi tshe de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung la bkur sti'i khyad par 'dod na/ de'i tshe bsgrub pa'i dus nyid du sku gzugs kyi dbu'am/ rgyab dang mchod rten gyi dbu stong par bya'o/ /grub pa na gro ga la gur gum dang / ghi waṃ dag gis/ na mo bha ga wa te shākya mu ne zhes sogs dang / ye dharmā dang / gzungs kyi khyad par yang bris nas/ des khrus byas pa'i gdung la dkris te/ oṃ mant+ra dha ru garbha ya swāhā/ zhes brjod cing stong par bzhugs so/ /de nas oṃ dharmā dha tu garbha ya swāhā/ zhes brjod cing / rdo rje 'dag pas stong pa'i sgo bkag nas snga ma bzhin du de rab tu gnas par bya'o zhes gsungs pa yin zhing / de ltar gzungs gzhug dgos pa lung gis kyang grub cing /

gzhan yang bod kyi bla ma rnams kyi sku gzugs la mdo rgyud kyi gzungs sngags mang po dang / glegs bam sogs nges par bsgrigs chags su bzhugs pa 'di bod 'dir rten lugs ma rnams kyang srab mor bsgrub pa dang / brdungs ma rnams khog yangs par byung ba stong par bzhugs pa bas gzungs kyis khengs par byas na phan yon che bar dgongs nas phyag len la rtsol ba chen po mdzad cing / lo chen rin chen bzang po'i rab gnas kyi sdom tshig las kyang / ring bsrel gzhug cing gsol ba gdab/ /ces ring bsrel bzhugs par gsungs shing / de ltar 'jug rgyu'i ring bsrel la yang / gong du bshad pa ltar lnga'am/ chos sku'i ring bsrel dang / chos kyi ring bsrel gnyis gcig tu byas nas bzhir yod pa'i/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung gi ring bsrel ni de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyi sku gdung gi cha shas thams cad dang / chos sku'i ring bsrel ni gzungs sngags rnams dang / sku bal gyi ring bsrel ni/ sangs rgyas byang sems dang / bla ma rnams kyi dbu skra dang phyag sen sogs dang / sku gdung yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel ni yongs su grags pa'i 'phags pa gsum gyi ring bsrel rnams dang / chos kyi ring bsrel ni gzungs sngags dang / dam pa'i chos bka' dang bstan bcos kyi glegs bam ji snyed pa rnams yin par bshad cing de dag bzhugs pa tsam gyis rten de khyad par bar 'gyur bas na/ sku gzugs la gzungs 'bul ba'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin la/ des gang 'bul ba'i yo byad rnams thog mar legs par bsags dgos pas/ de'i tshul ni/ spyir rten la srog shing 'jug pa dang / mi 'jug pa'i phyag len gnyis snang bas/ dang po ni/ nges par bya dgos pa'i bshad tshod med kyang bla ma la las phyag len la nges par mdzad byung zhing / phyi ma ni sngon gyi rab gnas mkhan po tshad ldan rnams dang / khyad par don gsal las/ sarba birya kyi sngags mchod rten gyi srog shing la 'bri/

sku gzugs 'bur ma yin na dbu la bzhugs zhes pa dang / badzra ā yu ṣe'i sngags kyang mchod rten gyi srog shing dang / sku gzugs kyi thugs khar bzhugs zhes pa dang / mchod rten la srog shing gi mnga' dbul gsungs/ sku gzugs la ma gsungs pas kyang rtogs nus pa'i phyir na/ nges par med mi rung ma yin zhing / sku gzugs chung ngu la ni 'jug pa yang dka' la/ 'on kyang lde bzo'i rus shing 'jog pa'i tshad la rus shing dang srog shing gcig tu bsgrubs na legs shing / brdungs ma sku tshad che ba'i rigs la'ang sku'i cho 'dzin la 'gal ba med par gsungs la/ 'phags pa rin po che sogs kyis chos skyong gi sku la srog shing mdzad pa ni mag ngag dmigs bsal du gyur pa yin pas de dang sku gzugs gzhan mi mtshungs so/ /yang 'ga' zhig srog shing rtsa dbu ma/ g.yas g.yon du dur ba dang ku shas bkug nas ro rkyang gi tshul yin zer zhing lag len yang byed pa dag byung mod kyang bshad khungs mi snang ngo / /des na srog shing ni nges par dgos pa'i med mi rung yang ma yin/ byas kyang nyes pa yod pa'i rigs kyang ma yin pas skabs su gang babs bya ba las/ byed pa'i tshe tsandan dkar po'am/ shug pa lta bu la thig shing ltar shin tu 'drongs par byas/ stod phyogs cung phra ba'i rtse mor rnam rgyal mchod rten dang / rtsa bar rdo rje phyed pa brkos la/ rten gyi dbu gtsug nas/ lugs sku yin na rdo rje skyil krung yan chad la 'thus pa bya/ la la lte ba yan la byed pa'ang snang la/ gang ltar de nyid kha che sogs kyi kha dog ser por byug pa'i dbu'i dbyings thad tsam du yod pa'i srog shing gi phyogs bzhir oṃ sarba biryas swāhā zhes pa dang / mchod rten yin na brir gzhug rten gyi thugs kha'i thad mnyam tsam yod pa'i srog shing gi phyogs bzhir/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swāhā zhes pa dang / oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ zhes pa gser ram mtshal sogs kyis 'bri/

gzhan yang rten che bar yod na/ rten bzhengs pa po rang gi'am/ nang rten lta bu yin na gshegs pa de nyid rang gi rtsa ba'i yi dam gang yin gyi gser sku'am/ lder sku shing sogs las/ mu tig dang gser la sogs pas phreng bas brgyan/ dri bzang po dang lhan cig tu sku mdog dang mthun pa'i dar gyis dril/ de'i phyi la shog bu sogs la bcom ldan 'das che ge mo zhes bgyi bas/ sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo zhes bgyi ba la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tshe ring ba dang / longs spyod rgyas par mdzad du gsol sogs 'di phyi gnyis ka la dmigs pa'i 'dod don gang yod/ gshegs don yin na/ sgrib gnyis byang ba sogs 'don pa bsgyur te bris la dkris/ bla ma'i yin na thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i smon lam sogs bya/ de gos dar mang pos dril la thugs khar 'jug rgyu dang / gzhan yang bla ma'i sku brnyan dang / mchod rten dang / gdung tsha dang / na bza'/ dbu lo sogs bzhugs 'os pa dag bsags/ gzungs kyi rigs la sdom pa gsum gyi brgyud pa dang / dbang bka'/ nyams khrid/ bshad bka'/ man ngag gi brgyud pa rnams gang tshang rdo rje 'chang nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi bla ma so so'i mtshan rnams grub na legs sbyar gyi skad dang / min na bod skad du phyag 'tshal ba'i tshig sngon du 'gro ba yi ge gsum dang spel ba'am/ yang na phyag 'tshal skyabs 'gro dang spel ba gang bde bris pa dang / lhag par rten tshe dpag med lta bu yin na rten gang yin de rang gi bla ma brgyud pa tshang ba re med mi rung dang / de dag re re'am thams cad kyi mjug tu 'phrin las dang dngos grub gang 'dod kyi spel tshig chug pa bri zhing / bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan yig legs sbyar dang bod skad gnyis char gzhung 'di nyid nas rdo rje 'chang dang / sa lo chen po gnyis la sbyar nas gsungs pa ltar gzhan la yang sbyar bar bya ba yin pa las/ spyir brgyud pa'i rim pa la/

rgyud sde la brten pa'i phyogs dang / mdo sde la brten pa'i phyogs gnyis las/ dang po la yang rgyud sde bzhir yod pa'i rnal 'byor chen po'i phyogs la pha rgyud/ ma rgyud/ gnyis med rgyud la brten pa'i phyogs gsum las/ dang po pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa la brten pa'i phyogs la dbang bskur/ bshad bka'/ man ngag gi brgyud pa dang gsum/ dang po la mi bskyod pa'i dbang brgyud/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ gsang ba 'dus pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang brgyud dang gsum/ ma rgyud 'khor lo bde mchog la brten pa'i phyogs la yang dbang bshad man ngag gi brgyud pa gsum/ kyai rdo rje'i phyogs la yang dbang bka' sogs gsum/ dang po gnyis la sa lugs dang / rngog lugs kyi brgyud pa gnyis gnyis su yod cing / sa lugs kyi dbang brgyud la kyai rdor bka' bab rnam pa bzhi'i brgyud pa dang / bshad bka' la 'grel pa lugs dang / man ngag lugs kyi brgyud pa gnyis dang / dbang bshad man ngag gsum ka la nye brgyud ring brgyud gnyis gnyis su yod la/ yang ma rgyud spyi tsam pa la sgyu thod gdan gsum du grags pa'i rdo rje gdan bzhi la yang dbang bshad rgyud gsum gyi brgyud pa dang / sgyu ma bde mchog la yang de bzhin du gsum mo/ /pha ma gnyis med kyi rgyud dus kyi 'khor lo la yang / dbang bka'/ bshad bka'/ man ngag gi brgyud pa gsum du yod cing / rnal 'byor la thams cad kyi rtsa ba dpal de kho na nyid 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang dang / bshad bka'i brgyud pa gnyis/ spyod rgyud la rnam snang mngon byang gi dbang dang bshad lung gi brgyud pa gnyis/ bya ba'i rgyud la brten pa'i phyogs la yang dbang dang / rgyud lung gi brgyud pa dang gnyis/ dang po la rigs gsum so so'i dbang gi brgyud pa dang / rigs gsum spyi'i dbang gi brgyud pa gnyis/ gnyis pa mdo sde la brten pa'i phyogs la/

sdom brgyud/ bshad brgyud/ man ngag gi brgyud pa dang gsum/ dang po la so thar sdom brgyud dang / byang sems sdom brgyud gnyis rnams so/ /phyi ma la dbu ma lugs dang / sems tsam lugs kyi byang sdom gyi rim gnyis/ bshad pa'i brgyud rim la/ 'dul ba'i sde snod kyi bshad brgyud/ mngon pa'i sde snod kyi bshad brgyud/ mdo sde'i sde snod kyi bshad brgyud dang gsum/ man ngag brgyud rim la/ bka' gdams kyi man ngag rnams kyi brgyud pa/ zhi byed kyi brgyud pa/ gcod khrid kyi brgyud pa ste gsum dang / gzhan yang zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams pa'i brgyud pa/ dbu ma'i lta khrid kyi brgyud pa sogs gdams pa mang du yod pa dag gi bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi mtshan sngags rnams dang / yi dam gyi sngags la/ kyai rdor bka' bab bzhi'i lha tshogs kyi sngags/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i sngags/ gur saṃ gnyis kyi sngags/ a bhi dha nar gsungs pa'i yi ge brgya pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo dang / bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi sngags/ 'khor lo bsgyur drug gi sngags/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ mahā ma ya/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ la ba pa bcu gsum/ seng ge can/ sgrol ma bla med sogs ma rgyud kyi phyogs gtogs kyi sngags/ phur pa rtsa dum gyi sngags/ gsang 'dus rigs gsum gyi sngags/ gshin rje dgra gdong / dmar 'jigs/ rnam snang sgyu dra/ phyag rdor 'khor chen/ phyag rdor gtum po rnams kyi sngags/ yo ga rdor dbyings/ kun rig rtsa dkyil/ sbyong dkyil phyi ma bcu gcig rnams kyi sngags/ chos dbyings gsung dbang / khams gsum rnam rgyal/ dpal mchog gtsug tor gdugs dkar/ rnam snang mngon byang / a ra pa tsa na lha lnga/ dpa' bo gcig grub/ bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs ring / seng ge sgra sa bcu pa'i gzungs/ byang sems gzi brjid chen po'i gzungs/ 'od zer can ma/ sman lha/ mi bskyod pa/ stobs po che/ phyag rdor/ mi g.yo ba/

rnam 'joms rnams kyi gzungs/ rdo rje dbyings kyi snying po/ chos dbyings snying po/ sngags dbyings snying po/ bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong sogs kyi snying po/ mdzod spu nor bu'i sngags/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa/ mtshams med pa'i sgrib pa sbyong ba'i gzungs/ don yod grub pa'i gzungs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags la sogs pa dang / gzhan yang de dag tu ma 'dus pa'i rgyud sde mang po nas yi dam gyi lha tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'byung ba rnams dang / dbyangs gsal gnyis/ skye mched byin rlabs kyi sngags dang / gzhan yang mdo sde mang po nas kyang gzungs sngags khyad par can du ma 'byung bas/ de dag gi nang nas kyang ci rigs pa dag 'bri ba'am/ bla ma gong ma'i gzungs 'bul phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs par mdzad pa dag nas 'byung ba bzhin te/ mdor na gzungs kyi rigs khungs ma rnams mang bar byung na legs par bshad pa yin pas na ci 'grub dang / rig pa phug ron gyi gzungs 'di 'ga' zhig gis khungs ma yin min the tshom can du mdzad kyang / rang re'i phyag len la gzungs 'khrugs pa sel byed du bris nas 'jug par mdzad pas de yang bri/ de ltar gong du bstan pa'i yi dam gyi sngags rnams kyi mjug tu las dang dngos grub zhu ba'i gang 'dod bri/ gzhan yang gzungs kyi rigs tshe dpag med kyi gzungs dang / khyad par du gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ dri med/ gsang ba ring bsrel/ byang chub rgyan 'bum/ rten 'brel snying po rnams la gzungs chen sde lngar grags pa bzhin so so'i mjug tu ā yu puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ zhes bris pa dang / pad gzungs gur lcam dral 'khor bcas/ zhal bzhi pa sogs chos skyong srung ma'i sngags ring thung dang / nor lha rnam thos sras rta bdag brgyad dang / gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu phyogs skyong / gza' dang / rgyu skar/ rgyal chen bzhi sogs dpal mgon bdun bcu rtsa lnga'i gzungs sngags mdzad bcu/

dkon mchog gsum sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad rnams te thams cad gser dngul mtshal snag sogs ci 'byor gyis 'bri ba'am/ spar du 'debs pa gang bde bya/ bla gzungs sogs ghi waṃ dang kha che sogs kyis bris na legs par bshad cing / dpe cha 'bri ba ltar yig phreng gong 'og tu mi bya gcig rjes gcig ste phreng gcig tu bri/ de ltar min na lus btub kyi nyes par 'gyur bar gsungs la/ gzhung 'dir lo btub kyi skyon 'byung zhes pa ni par ma dag pas lus btub dag pa yin no/ /de rnams la sngags dag ma dag gi zhu chen yang rung ba dang / shog mthud sogs ma nor bar byas dri bzang legs par byugs/ ma dril gong du yang bgegs bskrod pa sogs bya zhing / de nas sgril ba'i tshe/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas dbu nas klog pa'i tshul la dgongs zhabs nas yar bsgril bar bzhed kyang / rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos/ rtsa ba'i rig pa sbrul 'khyil pa lta bu zhes spyod rgyud nas 'byung ba'i rigs pas/ oṃ dbus su byas mjug rnams kyis mtha' bskor ba rten 'brel shis pa sogs la dgongs/ dbu oṃ nas sgril bar bzhed pa bzhin gzungs rnams sgril la/ na bza' ser po sogs kyis dril/ dar ram ras kyi skud pa ser po gang 'byor gyis dkris/ bla ma'i na bza' sku chos ber sogs kyi rigs yod na/ gzungs kyi phyi g.yogs na bza'i tshul du dkris/ na bza' skyi chags kyi rigs dang zhabs lham sogs 'jug pa cung mi legs par byed/ gzungs rnams kyi dbu zhabs ma log pa/ rgyud sde gong 'og mdo gzungs sogs phan tshun ma 'dres pa kha byang btab la bzhag dpa' bo gcig grub nas gsungs pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo 'bri tshul gong du bshad pa ltar bris nas tshul bzhin du bsgrub pa'ang bsags/ gzhan yang dri bzang gi phye ma dang / shug pa'i phye ma dag gam/ zi chung sogs bar mtshams 'gengs pa'i chas dang / mtshams dar gyi rgyu dang ras ser po sogs khrol yod par yo byad thams cad tshang par bsags shing /

gser sku lta bu la bug pa dang / bsgrigs mtshams la chu 'gro ba sogs yod na/ ma 'ongs pa na sku rten la khrus chab gsol tshe rlan gyis gzungs rul 'gro bas rtsis bsgrigs dam pa dang / 'ber sogs byugs/ tha ma spra chus kyang srub med par byas/ nang gi rdzab ro sogs ma lus par bton/ phyi'i gser mdog sogs la ni ma gnod pa byas te chus bkrus la skam pa la tsandan dkar dmar/ a kar dza ti li shi sogs dri bzang po rnams gtsang sbra che bar byas te phye mar btags/ dug med pa'i sbrang gi 'byar rtsi dang bcas chu gtsang ma la sbyar ba'i skyo ma gar sla zho tsam pa lan mang du byugs/ long yod na dri mi yal ba'i phyir grib skam bya/ gzhan yang rten chen po la rgyud sde dang / sde snod kyi glegs bam chen po dang / mdo phran sogs glegs shing med par dbu shog yar bstan/ zhabs shog mar bstan/ snga logs kyi gug skyed sku'i rgyab phyogs dang / zhabs kyu mdun phyogs la bstan pa dri bzang gi phye ma dang lhan cig tu dar zab dang / rten kheb sogs na bza' bzang pos dril te bzhag gzhan yang 'bras/ so ba/ mon sran/ bra'u/ nas/ gro til rnams te 'bru lnga dang / 'bras so ba ma rnyed na 'bras gzhung ma dang / mon sran ma 'byor na'ang bod sran nyid dang / gzhan yang spags ka ma gtogs pa'i 'bru sna gang 'dzoms/ kandha kā ri/ sle tres/ ge sar gsum pa/ shu dag dkar po/ rgya mtsho'i lbu ba ste sman lnga/ 'di rnams la yang ngos 'dzin dang ming mi 'dra ba mang du snang yang / skabs 'dir ci ltar 'byor pas 'thus pa dang / gzhan yang 'bras bu gsum/ ghi waṃ sogs dug rigs dang sha'i rigs min pa'i sman ci 'byor/ bu ram sbrang 'o ma mar tshwa ste bcud lngar grags pa dang / gzhan yang ka ra/ shing thog bzang po gang rnyed dang / gser dngul/ byu ru/ mu tig mu men te rin po che'i lnga dang / bai ḍūrya/ int+ra ni la/ margad/ padma rā ga g.yu/ spos shel/

zangs/ lcags/ dung la sogs pa ji tsam 'byor pa dang / gzhan yang rin po che'i rigs mi 'dra ba mang du 'byung ba rin chen brtag thabs las 'byung ba bzhin dang / bla ma mchog rnams kyi phyag nas sa med pa dang / ja dang gos dar gyi thum bu sna tshang ba dri mas ma gos pa dang / sha'i rigs ma gtogs pa'i zas sna tshang pa'am ci 'byor pa/ dri bzang phye ma sbyar chu rnams bsags/ de dag kyang khrol bur blugs na mi legs pas re re bzhin la dar ras ci 'byor pas thum bu byas te dam du bkyigs pa'am btsems kyang legs shing / rnal ma'i rigs la srin bu skye srid pas mi gzhug gzhan yang nang bzhugs la 'bul rgyu'i byin rlabs rten dam rdzas ril bu sogs the tshom gyi rigs med pa rnams kyang bsag go /gong du bstan pa'i rin po che sna lnga'i gser ni/ lugs kyi bstan bcos kyi rin po che brtag thabs dag las/ sa las byung ba rin chen gser yin te/ /mchog tu gyur pa 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser/ /rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi gser thig tshe ring byas/ /zos pa'i brun nyid gser du gyur pa las/ /btso ma dang 'dra ji ger btso gser zer/ /mtha' yi rgyal pos rgya nag rgyal po la/ /phul ba'i gser mchog dmar ngam yod pa nyid/ /gar log gser zhes tha snyad byas pa yod/ /phal pa'i gser la sa le sbram dang ni/ /sil ma la sogs rtogs par sla bar snang / /zhes gser mchog dang / phal pa'i gser gnyis dang / yang gser la 'jang gi gser dang ngam nag mnyen/ /sngo zhing mnyen pa stod kyi gu la gser/ /bod gser kha dog gang du'ang nges pa med/ /cung zad gong ma rnams las gyong nyams che/ /ra gan 'jang gser gser gsum bsres pa la/ /gsum gser zhes su ming du chags pa ste/ /cung zad gser ngam che ba zhig tu 'ong / /sngo nyams yod pa ljang gser ming du chags/ /skya nyams yod snyam mo rag gser zhes zer/ /de bas skya gong pho rag ces su 'dogs/ /zhes pa ltar thor bu'i gser la sogs pa mang du yod pa rnams so/

/dngul ni nor gyi rin po che yin zhing / de la yang rnam grangs mang ste/ dngul ni chu dron dag gis bshal ba la/ /dkar dang che ba lhad med bzang ba yin/ /ser na ra gan dmar na zangs bsres yod/ /mdog nag tsha brdungs dgos na li bsres yod/ /gsum dngul zhes pa li dang ra gan dngul/ /gsum bsres mdog sre gyong nyams che ba yin/ /'khar dngul 'khar ba dang ni 'dres pa ste/ /khams nyams gyong shas che ba zhig la zer/ /gu lang dngul ni ngang dkar 'o ma'i mdog /'di dang bod dngul 'ga' zhig mtshungs par snang / /ljang dngul sngo skya shing kun dngul gyi mdog /shing kun dkar ba dag la 'dod pa yin/ /khams na gar log dngul du mkhas pas dpyad/ /ces pa ltar mang du yod do/ /byu ru ni/ 'ga' zhig shing du 'dod cing / kha cig ni byi ba'i rwa bya ba yin zer ba sogs mi 'dra bar yod kyang / gru gu'i yul gyi bas mtha' bye ma'i thang / /seb tu rdo ba'i dbyibs shig sdod pa'i dbyibs/ /chags pa kha dog dkar dmar gnyis su srid/ /dung gi 'khor dang byu ru dkar po la/ /sul rig nor pa yod pas yang lci brtag /byi ru yang la dung ni lci ba yin/ /zhes pa ltar te dkar dmar gnyis so/ /mu tig ni/ mu tig mchog dang phal pa gnyis su dbye/ /mchog tu gyur pa mkha' las babs pa'i char/ /rgya mtsho'i nang gi nya yis 'thungs pa yi/ /lto bar mu tig dag tu chags pa ste/ /dmar dang dkar ba sngo dmar can gsum yod/ /dmar po mchog gi mchog tu bshad pa yin/ /phal pa cha g.yang rtse las byung ba dang / /chu yi lbu ba lta bur chags pa gnyis/ /cha g.yang rtse ni nya lcib ces 'og de/ /de dag kha sbyar nang nas byung ba ni/ /cung zad 'ja' tshon mdangs ldan shun rim med/ /chu yi lbu ba lta bur chags pa ni/ /zhib cing sob pa shun rim can dag ste/ /de dag dkar la sngo rnam yod pa srid/ /ces mu tig mchog dang / phal pa gnyis/ mchog la yang mchog gi mchog 'bring dman gsum/

phal pa la yang cha g.yang rtse las byung ba dang / chu'i lbu ba lta bur chags pa gnyis su yod pa rnams so/ /mu men ni/ mu men la ni mthing kha gzhir bzhag la/ /gser ngam yod na gser gyi mu men zer/ /sngo ba'i phra chags g.yu yi mu men yin/ /snga ma mnyen la phyi ma cung zad bsud/ /ces pa ltar te/ de dag la rin po che sna lnga zhes grags shing / yang brtag thabs 'ga' zhig tu dang po bzhi dang dung dang lnga la rin po che sna lngar byas pa yang 'byung bas gang bde'o/ /de dag las gzhan pa'i rin po che yang mang ste/ rin po che brtag pa'i yi ge dag las/ rin po che la rin chen nyid dang ni/ /'ching bu bcos bu gsum du dbye bar 'dod/ /ces pa ltar/ rin po che nyid dang / 'ching bu dang / bcos bu'i rin po che dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rin chen nyid ni shel rigs las byung ste/ /gtso bo bran gyi dbye ba rnam pa gnyis/ /zhes pa ltar/ gtso bo dang / bran gyi rin chen gnyis las/ snga ma ni/ gtso bo yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po nyid/ /bai ḍūrya yi mchog tu gyur pa yin/ /kha dog sngo skya zur brgyad zur drug pa/ /gsol ba btab na dgos 'dod ma lus ster/ /'di dag bsod nams dbang las byung ba'i phyir/ /skye bo phal pa rnams kyis rnyed pa dka'/ /bod yul dag tu byung bar mi snang ngo / /zhes pa ltar yin pas bod 'dir rten gyi nang bzhugs kyi rdzas su bsags par mi nus la/ des na bod 'dir rten gyi nang rdzongs la 'os pa'i rin chen ni bran du gyur pa'i rin po che rnams te/ de yang bai ḍūrya ni/ bran du gyur pa'i rin chen bai ḍūrya/ /kha dog sngo skya shin tu dwangs pa yin/ /bar snang khyer na mig lam mi mngon pa/ /gzhi gdan mdog gis kha dog bsgyur nus pa/ /sgong gzugs dbyibs su yod pa mang ba yin/ /zhes pa ltar dang / int+ra ni la ni/ de las cung nag int+ra nī la ste/ /sngo ser 'dug na mthon ka zhes su 'bod/

/de bas sngo shas che ba mthon ka che/ /zhes pa ltar bai ḍūrya las cung zad nag pa'i rin po che zhig yin zhing / gzhan yang padma rā ga dang / nal dang / pu ga dang / karke ta dang / margad dang / khyung skyugs sogs shin tu mang ste/ dmar dwangs padma rā ga zhes su grags/ /mchin kha spos shel smug na nal zhes zer/ /dkar gro pug ste dkar dwangs karko ta/ /ljang khu margad ser skya byi la mig /khyung skyugs zhes bya rgya mtsho chen po nas/ /khyung gis nor bu mid de skyugs pa ste/ /'di la rigs lnga gzhi gdan ljang skya ste/ /dkar po dmar po ser po ljang khu sngo/ /khra rigs dbye bas phye la rnam pa lnga/ /gzhi gdan dkar la khra yod dkar khra men/ /dkar dmar ser ljang sngo ba'i khra yod lnga/ /man shel zhes pa gser mdog nag pa ste/ /gser len byi la mig gnyis gcig pa yin/ /shel rigs 'di dag dwangs pa khyad par chos/ /gzhan dag nor bu'i rigs ni mang mod kyi/ /kha ba can du mkho ba de nyid tsam/ /zhes pa ltar bsam gyis mi khyab par yod par shes par byas nas sna gang 'dzoms bsag par bya'o/ /de dag las gzhan pa'i nor bu'i rigs su gtogs pa ni/ srog chags las byung gla ba dbang ril yin/ /rtsod med mdog dwangs dkar gro sgong gzugs can/ /gzhi gdan nam mkha'i kha dog len pa yin/ /de bas zhel ba shun rim can zhig yong / /sbrul gyi dbang ril yong yang dkon par snang / /stag gi rwa co sor gcig tsam yod pa/ /byu ru'i mdog can nor bur 'dod pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar srog chags las byung ba'i rin po che'i rigs kyang mang du 'byung zhing / yang gong du bstan pa'i mching bu'i/ rin po che shel rigs de dag kyang rdo las grub pas dwangs cha chung zhing / spyir shel gyi rigs dwangs pa dang / rdo'i rigs rnams lci zhing mi dwangs pa zhig 'byung ba yin te/ 'ching bu shel rigs gong du smos pa rnams/ /rdo las grub pas dwangs cha chung ba yin/

/shel rigs yang la rdo rigs lci ba yin/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /yang 'ching bu'i rigs g.yu ni/ rdo rigs 'ba' zhig g.yu rnying yin pa ste/ /drug dkar drug dmar g.yu spyang gsum du 'dod/ /dkar shas che ba drug dkar chig pa mang / /dmar ngam snum pa drug dmar nyid du bshad/ /gang dang bsgrigs kyang mi 'dre mdog bkrag pas/ /gnyis ka zil gnon g.yu spyang mchog tu grags/ /zhes drug dkar drug dmar g.yu spyang ste g.yu'i mchog gsum du bshad la/ de lta bu'i rin po che rnams ni phal cher rgya nag dang rgya gar nas 'byung ba mang zhing / de gnyis rtsis kyang che bar byed de/ rin po che rnams rgya gar rgya nag las/ /'byung zhing rtsis kyang mchog tu che bar grags/ /zhes pas so/ /bcos bu'i rin po che ni/ bcos bu lugs dang tshon gyis bsgyur ba ste/ /zhes pa ltar yin zhing / hor las byung ba'i rin po che yang 'ga' zhig snang ba rnams ni/ hor las byung ba'i rin po che rigs la/ /dngul zangs lcags dang ra gan gsha' dkar dang / /zha nye la sogs rtogs par sla ba nyid/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /yang thor bu'i rin po che ni/ rin po che la pha lam zhes bya ba/ /dkar gro gang yang gcod par byed pa ste/ /'di nyid gang gis gcod par mi nus pa/ /zur brgyad rnam pa lta bu yod la zer/ /yin min brtag pa rdo ba la grud pas/ /thogs med ri mo skyong mor byung ba bzang / /cung zad thogs srid ngan par shes par bya/ /ri mo mi dod pha lam min par nges/ /zhes pa ltar rdo rje pha lam par grags pa dang / ma na ho ni rta klad ces su 'byung / /dmar po dkar sngo'i ri mo can la zer/ /zhes pa ltar/ ma na ho dang / g.yang spre'u lug gi klad par 'byung / /dkar sngo'i mdangs dang ldan pa zhig gi ming / /zhes pa ltar g.yang spre'u ste khyad par can gsum dang / gzhan yang / gzi ni dkar nag spel dang smug nag spel/ /smug nag spel ba'i khra mo rnam gsum dang /

/dkar po 'ba' zhig gzi dkar zhes su 'bod/ /dmar dang smug pa 'ba' zhig mchong zhes zer/ /'di rnams rdo rigs 'ba' zhig yin par 'dod/ /ces pa ltar gzi mchong sogs 'ga' zhig 'byung ba rnams ni rdo rigs 'ba' zhig yin par bshad pa yin no/ /de ltar rin po che la rigs mang du yod pa de dag thams cad tshang ba'am/ phal cher gyi sna tshang ba'i bar du bsag par bya/ de lta bu'i rin po che rnams kyang dkar yol khyad par can dag la phal cher tshang zhing sngon gyi rten chen po rnams kyi nang du hor dkar sogs dkar yol khyad par can bzhugs pa yang 'byung ba yin te/ gdan sa chen po'i lha khang chen mo'i ti shī grags pa 'od zer gyi nang rten thub chen gyi gzungs gzhug la ti shī de nyid kyi zhal dkar grags 'od ma gcig dang / dang chung utpa ma gcig sogs bzhugs par lo rgyus las 'byung zhing / phyis su tshar chen chos rje'i sku gdung hril po bzhugs pa'i gser gdung gi nang rdzongs la yang rje de nyid kyi zhal dkar karma gan dkar gcig bzhugs par bshad pas/ 'byor na dkar yol gyi rigs mchog dag kyang gzhug par bya ste/ de yang spyir dkar yol la/ sgra bshad dang / ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ dbye ba dang gsum du dkar yol brtag pa'i yi ge rnying ma dag las 'byung bas na/ dkar yol khyad par can rten gyi nang rdzongs la bzhugs 'os pa ngos zin par bya ba'i phyir cung zad phye ste yi ge rnying ma dag las 'byung tshul bkod na/ sgra bshad la/ kha dog dkar po'i snod du ja chang la sogs pa nyin mtshan yol ba med par 'thung bas dkar yol zhes pad dkar chun po sogs dkar yol brtag pa'i yi ge mang po las 'byung yang / yi ge 'ga' zhig las/ dkar yol la ni sgra bshad byung tshul dbye/ /sgra bshad kha cig kha dog dkar ba la/ /ja chang yol ba med par 'thung zhes grags/ /de nyid yol go snod kyi mtshan nyid du/ /ma rtogs yol gyi 'bru bsnon byas par snang /

/de nyid thog mar byung ba'i kha dog dkar/ /yol go yin pas dkar yol nyid du 'bod/ /yang na 'dod rgyal thog ma'i sgra yin pas/ /sgra bshad med par byas kyang 'gal ba med/ /ces bris nas thog mar byung ba'i kha dog dkar po'i yol go ste snod yin pas na dkar yol zhes bya ba'i sgra bshad byas pa 'byung la/ 'di ni 'thad par sems te/ yol go snod kyi brda'am ming rnying pa yin par brda gsar rnying shan 'byed kyi yi ge dag las bshad pas so/ /sgra bshad de ldan gyi dkar yol thog mar byung ba'i tshul ni/ dbang phyug gis bzhengs gangs can mtsho rgyal sku/ /lañtsha'i rgya mtshor bzhugs pa'i spyan snga na/ /lha yi nor bu'i rigs gyur dkar yol ni/ /ga'u kha sbyar mtsho nang yod ces zer/ /de nyid rtags dang ming du chags pa'i slad/ /nam mkha' lding gis lha yi gnas su khyer/ /phyi yi khyung so sder mo'i rjes su grags/ /de las lhung pa 'brug gi rgyab tu chags/ /de phyir 'brug rgyab ces su 'bod pa yin/ /de nas rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang du/ /rten 'brel dbang gis lha mo mdzangs ma dang / /lha yi dpa' bo bdud rgyal dbang phyug dang / /sprul pa'i nya mo glang po'i dbang po dang / /gya ling rta mchog rnams ni 'dzoms pa las/ /brgya byin dbang pos kha phye bdud rtsi blangs/ /thon pas thams cad ya mtshan gnas su gyur/ /re res dngos grub sbyin pa'i rtags re bzhag /mkha' lding dbang po'i sder mo'i rjes nyid des/ /de yi gdug pa'i gdon kun zil gyis gnon/ /glang chen mkhal ma'i rjes bzhag zas mchog ster/ /rta rmig rjes bzhag gling bzhi mgyogs 'gro 'grub/ /nya yi gshog rjes btung ba'i mchog sbyin byed/ /dpa' bos mkha' la ral gri g.yugs rjes las/ /dgra las rgyal ba'i dngos grub 'bras bu ster/ /mdzangs mas me long rjes bzhag snang srid rnams/ /gsal bar mthong ba'i snang gsal mig mchog sbyin/

/nor bur byin rlabs kha sbyar byin yang ni/ /gangs can mtsho rgyal mchod pa'i rten du phul/ /'di nyid dpag tshad du ma'i khyon ldan pas/ /che chung tshad kyang gzhal bar dka' zhes thos/ /rgyu ni shel rigs lha yi nor bu yin/ /'di la dpe byas pho tshon drug cu pa/ /bkrag mdangs 'od dang ldan te klu yis bsgrubs/ /de yang pho tshon re bar khyung so re/ /khyung so zhes bya sder mos brad 'dra yin/ /mkhal ma'i rjes ni sgor 'jong ri mo can/ /gnyis su sbrel ba dag la byas pa yin/ /rta rmig rjes ni mthil gyi mtha' phyogs bzhir/ /rta yi rmig rjes lta bu'i ri mo yod/ /nya yi gshog rjes chu ris gsad 'dra ste/ /dpa' bos ral gri g.yugs pa'i rjes zhes pa/ /kha yi rgyun la rtsi med nyid la grags/ /mdzangs ma'i me long bzhag pa'i tha snyad ni/ /mthil du cung zad dma' ba'i sgor mo nyid/ /rtags drug nor bu'i dpyad ldan klu yi rdzas/ /thub chen phyag tu dad pas phul bar grags/ /de nas 'phags yul dbus kyi tshong pa ni/ /tshong dpon dang bcas rgya mtsho chen por ni/ /nor bu len phyir gzings chen bskyod pa'i tshe/ /gangs can mtsho rgyal drung slebs dkar yol ni/ /kha sbyar rkyang pa 'od ldan mthong ba'i tshe/ /tshong pa dag gis nor bu'i rigs su shes/ /che ba ma 'drongs chung ba nor bu khyer/ /ya mtshan che bas rdo rje gdan du ni/ /byang chub chen po'i mchod pa'i rdzas su phul/ /kha cig ser skya'i gnas su yod ces grags/ /rdo rje gdan nas mtha' dmag gis khyer ba/ /de las kha shas chad cing byung bar grags/ /'on kyang tshad ldan gtam du nges par dka'/ /zhes pa ltar te/ chos 'byung sogs lo rgyus khungs ma dag las de 'dra'i gsal kha ma 'byung bas tshad mar 'dzin dka' yang / sngon gyi gtam rgyud la de ltar du grags pas de nyid ltar na dkar yol gyi thog ma'i byung tshul de ltar yin la/ dkar yol gyi dbye ba la/

dbye ba rgyu rtsi yul gyi dbye ba gsum/ /zhes pa ltar/ rgyu'i sgo nas dbye ba/ rtsi'i sgo nas dbye ba/ yul gyi sgo nas dbye ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rgyu la sa rdo sa yol rnam pa gsum/ /zhes pa ltar/ shel yol/ rdo yol/ sa yol gsum ni rim pa bzhin/ shel yol shel dkar bsres zla cung zad yod/ /'bras shel rnams dang shel rtse rnams la 'byung / /rdo yol rdo rigs dag las grub pa ste/ /hor dkar phal mo che la yong bar snang / /sa yol sa las grub pa'i be'u can/ /rgya nag dkar yol bod dkar rnying ma sogs/ /shas che dag la de 'dra 'byung ba mang / /zhes pa ltar yin zhing / gnyis pa rtsi'i sgo nas dbye ba ni/ rtsi ni tsha rtsi grang rtsi rnam pa gnyis/ /tsha rtsi be'u rtse gnyis bsregs pas byugs/ /bu gu can rnams mkhregs par byung ba ste/ /hor dkar bod dkar rnying ma 'ga' la 'byung / /grang rtsi rtsi skol ngad yal tsam la byugs/ /bu ga med pa'am sob pa dag la zer/ /bod dkar rnying ma 'ga' la 'byung ba yin/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa yul gyi sgo nas dbye ba ni/ yul gyi dbye ba rgya gar hor dang bod/ /rgya nag rnam pa bzhi ru yod pa las/ /zhes pa ltar/ rgya gar gyi dkar yol/ hor gyi dkar yol/ bod kyi dkar yol/ rgya nag gi dkar yol dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ rgya gar gong du bshad dang da lta yang / /phor bzo khra bo 'ga' zhig yong ba thos/ /gzhan pa'i dkar yol dbye ba mang ma mthong / /zhes pa ltar gong du bkod pa'i lha dang klu'i nor bu rin po che las grub pa rnam pa gnyis po de dag dang / deng sang yang phor pa'i bzo byas pa 'ga' re 'byung ba rnams so/ /gnyis pa bod kyi dkar yol ni/ /bod kyi yul du 'gro snyan lde ru'i dus/ /a tsa ra yi 'brug chen gsum tsam khyong / /de dang 'dra ba sum cu rtsa gcig bzos/ /de rjes rgya yi bzo bo bos nas ni/ /grangs mang dag kyang bzos zhes grags par snang /

/rtags drug tshang ba 'brug chen zhes bya ste/ /rtags bzhi rtags gnyis ldan pa 'brug chung yin/ /gnyis ka che chung tshad ni sna tshogs yong / /'brug chen legs la 'brug chung zher ba yin/ /de dag gang yang rgyu ni sa shas che/ /grang rtsis byugs pas 'bol zhing yang ba la/ /kha dog dwangs ser dag tu 'byung ba yin/ /'brug chen 'brug chung rnams ni 'bol zhing yang / /khyung so mang la mdog ni ngang chags pa/ /kha ni cung mthug yo 'khyog med pa bzang / /de las ldog pa ngan par shes par bya/ /zhes pa ltar 'brug chen 'brug chung gnyis te rgya gar gyi dkar yol dper byas pa 'brug rgya ma dang / byang skya yu thung kha sbub cung zad yod/ /rdo yol tsha rtsi byugs pa mkhregs nyams yod/ /rtsi ni sngo dkar sbu gu can gyi nyams/ /kha kri phyi la 'phyang zhing shang gzugs srid/ /ri mo'i sgo nas dbye bar byed pa la/ /bya dang sha pho nya dang me tog dang / /shing lo la sogs ri mo skyong la yod/ /bya dang sha ba shing khyer la sogs pa/ /ri mo gnyis pa srab dang bzang ba yin/ /kha sbub la yang kha kri'i ming du 'dogs/ /srong btsan sgam po'i dus su byung bar grags/ /rgya yi bzo bo bos nas mang du bcos/ /zhes pa ltar chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus su byung ba'i byang skya dang / 'od ma'i rgyu rtsi 'brug rgyab ji bzhin la/ /ser zhing yang la ri mo me tog shing / /khyung so nya yi gshog rjes yod pa'ang srid/ /'di dbyibs rtsa ba thung bar 'dra ba la/ /rtsa nas sogs dkar theb pa shang gzugs ma/ /dkyil du sgo mo mthil snyoms lte mig ma/ /lte mig med par kha theb ri mo med/ /mdog ser phal pa'i 'od mar grags pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar 'od ma dang / dar rtse dus dang rgyu rtsi bzo bo sogs/ /byang skya dang mtshungs rtsi ni cung zad sngo/ /yu thung byang skya las ni cung zad btsong / /ldig cing shing lo me tog pa tra sogs/ /skyong mor bris pa cung zad rtsing ba yod/

/zhabs kyi kha la rtsi 'khyil mthug par chags/ /sngo nyams che ba dar rtse'i yu rnying zer/ /zhes pa ltar dar rtse dang bzhi po la bod kyi dkar chen bzhi'am/ bod kyi dkar yol rnying ma rigs bzhi zhes grags pa ste/ de dag bod kyi dkar chen bzhi zhes pa'am rnying ma rigs bzhi zhes su grags pa yin/ zhes so/ /de dag gi rjes su bod dkar rnying ma rtse bdun nam lngar grags pa rnams byung ste/ de yang rtse bdun ni/ de yi rjes su rtse bdun byung ba ste/ /theg rtse shel rtse skya rtse sa rtse dang / /rdo rtse shing rtse 'on rtse rnam pa bdun/ /zhes pa ltar/ theg rtse sogs bdun nam/ lnga ni/ kha cig rdo rtse shing rtse med pa yi/ /rtse lnga dag tu 'dod pa'ang mang zhig 'byung / /zhes pa ltar rdo rtse shing rtse gnyis dor bas lnga'o/ /dang po theg rtse ni/ theg rtse rgyu rtsi 'brug rgyab ji bzhin la/ /yu ba 'brug rgyab dag las cung zad mtho/ /zhabs nang stong pa mdog dwangs snum zhing 'tsher/ /'brug rgyab dag pas zhabs mtshams bcum pa ste/ /'brug rgyab khyung so byang skya'i kha kri dang / /mdo la'i lte mig dar rtse'i sngo rkang yod/ /'di la nga la yod bzhi mar grags pas/ /'brug rgyab kyis kyang gral mgor bzhag ces thos/ /de phyir bod dkar rnams kyi mchog tu bshad/ /rtse bdun nang nas theg rtse bzang bar grags/ /zhes pa ltar dang / shel rtse ni/ shel rtse rgyu ni shel dkar rdo bsres dang / /srab cing tsha rtsi sngon po sbu gu can/ /chu ris me tog zlum brtsegs skyong mar bris/ /mthil rgya ran cing kha ni cung zad g.yel/ /yu ba cung ring yid khar 'ong pa ste/ /hor gyi bzo bos bod du bzos par 'dod/ /ces pa ltar dang / skya rtse ni/ skya rtse sa yol grang rtse shin tu sob/ /yu ba cung thung mthil che ngo bo drang / /kha nyid cung g.yel ri mo med pa mang / /yu ba ngo bo gzer gyis bsdams pa rnams/ /nang gi mthil du byung ba'i gzer mgo ni/

/gsum pa bzhi pa lnga pa yong ba ste/ /gzer lnga ma ni mchog tu bzang bar 'dod/ /yang rtse ma ni 'brug rgyab zhabs 'dra ste/ /zhes pa ltar dang / sa rtse ni/ sa rtse sa yol tsha rtsi sngo bas byugs/ /shel rtse'i dbyibs 'dra cung zad chung ba ste/ /me tog shing lo la sogs nang la spras/ /dbus su sa yod sa med gnyis su yong / /sa yod gzab ma'i yi ge gsal ba ste/ /sa med rdo rje rgya gram yod pa mang / /zhes pa ltar dang / rdo rtse ni/ rdo rtse rdo yol tsha rtsi ngang dkar byugs/ /yu ba cung thung ngo bo sbug la mthug /ldig cing lci ba ri mo med pa ste/ /zhes pa ltar dang / shing rtse ni/ shing rtse zhes pa ngo bo de 'dra la/ /de las cung che kha g.yel shing lo yis/ /nang la lhag par brgyan pa zhig la zer/ /zhes pa ltar dang / 'on rtse ni/ 'on rtse gyog ces bya ba'i yul grur ni/ /sa yol cung zad dmar ngam yod pa la/ /yangs shing grang rtsi sngon pos g.yogs pa'i 'bol/ /dbyibs ni phor gzugs bzo kha cung zad g.yel/ /padma me tog shing dang pa tras spras/ /kha la rtsi med khab tsam sgor mar yod/ /gsham ni phor pa'i gsham ltar thung ba yin/ /tsha rtsi dkar po byugs pa'ang re re srid/ /mi shes pa rnams rgyal mo gan dkar zer/ /kha cig la go gan dkar yin par 'dod/ /kha cig phor gzugs thams cad 'on rtse zer/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar yin zhing / gzhan yang bod dkar rnying ma ni/ ka pad rgyu rtsi sa rtse'i rigs dang mthun/ /rtsi dwangs dkar zhing sa rtse dag las che/ /yu ba cung thung nang gi ri mo la/ /me tog shun ka pā la 'dra ba yi/ /steng na padma yod pa snyug gus bris/ /yang zhing che snum grog tu bzos pa yin/ /de dag phal cher hor gyi bzo bos bsgrubs/ /zhes ka pad bya ba'i dkar yol yang 'byung la/ de dag las gzhan pa'i pug dkar dang / gnam dkar dang / tshal ming dkar yol la sogs pa mang du 'byung ba rnams ni bod kyi dkar gsar yin no/

/gsum pa hor gyi dkar yol la ni rigs shin tu mang ste/ 'brug rgyab ma ni/ 'brug rgyab bod kyi 'brug rgyab dbyibs 'dra la/ /cung mthug kha sbug rgyu ni rdo yol la/ /tsha rtsi sngon po sbu gu can du yod/ /che chung 'bring po khyung so nya gshog rjes/ /skyong mor yod pa dag ni mang ba yin/ /khyung so nya gshog rjes med dbyibs che ba/ /kha g.yel rtsi ni dmar po byas pa'ang srid/ /ces pa ltar hor dkar 'brug rgyab ma dang / theg rtse mo gor rgyal sar yod pa'i dus/ /sa yol tsha rtsi dkar pos byugs pa la/ /gzugs ni byang skya dag las thob pa ste/ /srab cing ri mo 'bur du dod pa legs/ /yang zhing rgyab la khyung so yod pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar hor dkar theg rtse dang / mo gor gan dkar zhes pa'i dkar yol ni/ /sa yol tsha rtsi ngang dkar byugs pa la/ /'bras shel rtsa sbab dbyibs can rtsa ba phra/ /kha yol phyi la ri mo 'bur dod yod/ /ces pa ltar nor dkar mo gor gan dkar te/ 'di dag 'bri khung chos rje'i dus su hor yul du byung bas 'bri khung 'bras shel du 'bod cing / sog po 'bras shel zhes kyang grags la/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i gsol dkar du se chen rgyal pos phul ba'i chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gan dkar la/ se chen rgyal po rgyal sar bzhugs pa'i dus/ /chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gsol dkar du phul ba'i/ /'bras shel la ni dung skrad gsham chung ba/ /rtsa sbab la bzo ma dang bzhi ru byung / /zhes pa ltar ram/ yang na/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i gan dkar zhes bya ba/ /'bras shel la ni rnam pa gsum yin te/ /yu thung rtsa ba che dang rtsa sbom gsum/ /rtsi ni ma na ho dang g.yang kre'u/ /bzhus nas blugs pas gzhan las khyad par 'phags/ /bzang ngan nang tshan ri mos 'byed pa ste/ /shin tu dwangs shing ri mo nyis 'brug can/ /padma'i nang na bkra shis rtags brgyad ldan/ /rgya nag pa tra kha la 'khor ba dang / /rdo rje seng lam pad 'brus brgyan pa dang /

/kha cig nang gi kha la zlum brtsegs yod/ /yu ba'i nang la gan rtsi rab tu bzang / /phyi nang yu ba dag dang bcas pa la/ /'brug chen gcig gis khyab par byas pa dang / /gzhan yang 'brug chung gnyis gnyis kha sprod yod/ /yu thung 'di la dung sprad ma zhes bya/ /gtsang ma bris med ngan pa gcig kyang yod/ /ces pa ltar dang / brtag thabs kha cig las/ dung sprad shel rdo 'dres pa'i be'u la/ /tsha rtsi sngo dkar byugs pas gnyis su yod/ /mthil rgya che zhing bzo kha cung zad dma'/ /yu ba thung zhing kha 'tshams phyi la 'phyang / /dkar po dung gi sprad skor 'dra ba yod/ /yu ba'i nang la gan rtsi 'byig mor yod/ /srab cing dwangs la kha yon yod pa mang / /ri mo med cing srub ris 'dra ba yod/ /ces 'byung ba ltar yin zhing / yang 'bras shel sham chung ma ni/ gsham chung ma ni rgyu rtsi gong dang 'dra/ /mthil rgya chung zhing cung zad btsong ba dang / /che chung ran zhing kha ni cung zad g.yel/ /gsham ni ring la phra bar mngon pa dang / /de dag 'brel mtshams cung zad phra ba yong / /gsham gyi kha la bcad kha gtsang bar yod/ /nang la ri mo 'bur dod mchog tu gtsang / /ri mo med pa'i gtsang ma dag kyang srid/ /ces pa ltar 'byung zhing / 'bras shel rtsa sbab ni/ rtsa sbab rgyu rtsi gong dang 'dra ba la/ /mthil rgya 'bring po bzo kha gsham chung las/ /cung mtho rtsa ba ring zhing segs kha yod/ /snga ma gnyis pas lhag par snom pa yin/ /ri mo dag ni gsham chung ma dang mtshungs/ /che chung la sogs rnam grangs du ma mang / /zhes pa ltar dang / 'bras shel rtsa bo che'am/ la bzo ma ni/ de bas 'od dang la bzo ma zhes bya/ /zhes pa dang / brtag thabs 'ga' zhig las/ rtsa bo che ni la phug phyed gtubs bzhin/ /cung zad sbug la kha ni phyir chal zhing / /ri mo rnam grangs me tog padma dang / /pha gu pa tra dag gis brgyan pa dang / /kha cig me tog nang gi kha la ni/ /pa tra phyi la zlum brtsegs 'bur yod dang /

/mi chung me tog khyer ba'ang yod pa yin/ /ri mo'i dbye ba shin tu mang ba ste/ /zhes pa ltar yin zhing / de lta bu'i 'bras shel de dag thams cad kyang shel yol kho na yin pas shin tu dwangs pa sogs khyad chos mang po dang ldan pa yin te/ ji skad du/ gang la'ang shel yol las grub lhag par dwangs/ /'od che mtshan mo gsal ba mchog tu grags/ /zhes pa dang / 'ga' zhig las/ mdor na 'bras shel gsum ka'i mtshan nyid ni/ /dkar la dwangs shing ri mo'i rnam grangs phyug /de dag bzang zhing phyi rtags mtshan nyid yin/ /rigs lnga'i rtags tshang rgya hor yi ge sogs/ /nang la gser gyis bris pa'ang yod pa yin/ /dpal ldan sa skyar bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi slebs/ /zhes pa ltar te/ 'bras shel grangs de tsam zhig sngon gdan sa chen por 'dir 'byor nas phyogs mthar khyab pa yin no/ /de dag ni bla ma 'phags pa'i gsol dkar du se chen rgyal pos phul ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gan dkar du grags pa yin la/ rgyal po nyid kyi gsol dkar se chen gan dkar du grags pa ni/ se chen gan dkar zhes pa rgyal pos te/ /rgyu ni rdo yol tsha rtsi mchin khas byugs/ /mthil rgya che zhing bzo kha mtho dman snyoms/ /kha ni cung g.yel phyi nang ri mo rnams/ /'bur dod yu ba ring thung ran pa la/ /rtsa rtse chung zhing gsham kha phyi la 'phyang / /mchog tu yid khar 'ong ba dag la zer/ /legs shos ri mo gser gyis byugs pa ste/ /dkar dmar dag kyang yod pa srid pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar dang / yang brtag thabs kha cig las/ se chen gan dkar zhes pa'i dkar yol ni/ /gzugs ni 'bras shel yu thung dbyibs 'dra la/ /phyi ma rim pa lnga ldan de dbus na/ /gser gyi rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bris pa dang / /nang la seng lam ri mos mtshan pa yod/ /zhan pa bris med gtsang ma gcig kyang yong / /ya mtshan can gyi dkar yol chen po 'di/ /'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa la/

/se chen rgyal pos 'bul ba'i thog mar phul/ /de 'dra'i dkar yol dpal ldan sa skya ru/ /bcu phrag gsum du gsum gyis chad pa byung / /zhes kyang 'byung ba yin la/ gzhan yang hor dkar gyi rigs la/ mdo la rdo yol tsha rtsi byugs pa la/ /dkar sngo dud kha la sogs ci rigs 'byung / /bzo rigs dbye ba bod dang mtshungs pa la/ /ri mo gang yod ming gis so sor 'dogs/ /mkhregs shing dwangs pa dag la zer ba yin/ /zhes pa ltar hor dkar mdo la dang / ti shrī grags pa 'od zer gyis khyer yang / grags 'od ma zhes bya ba'i dkar yol ni/ /rdo yol tsha rtsi sngon po sbu gu can/ /mthil che bzo kha dma' zhing kha g.yel ba/ /nang la padma phyi la 'brug kha sprod/ /'bur du dod pa shin tu legs pa yod/ /yu ba ring thung sbom phra snyoms pa la/ /rtsa rtse snyoms shing gsham kha phyir mi 'phyang / /phyi yi kha mtshams yu ba'i ma mtha' la/ /sgo ris dag gis spras pa'ang yod pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar ti shrī grags pa 'od zer gyi dus su byung ba'i grags 'od ma dang / de yi rjes su byung ba'i dang chung ni/ /rdo yol tsha rtsi sngon po sbu gu can/ /cung zad mthil chung kha g.yel grags 'od las/ /rtsa ba cung phra chung la dwangs pas na/ /dwangs chung zhes su ming 'dogs byung ba yin/ /nang la utpal bdun brtsegs lnga dang bzhi/ /gsum brtsegs 'brug dang sprin pa me tog ma/ /pha gu sgo ris la sogs du ma yod/ /ri mo med pa'i gtsang ma'ang yong bar snang / /zhes pa ltar hor dkar dang chung dang / kun blo ma zhes bya ba'i dkar yol ni/ sa yol tsha rtsi dkar pos byugs pa la/ /grags 'od ma las mthil chung kha g.yel ba/ /rtsa ba cung zad ring la 'brug kha sprod/ /phyi la yod pa dag la zer bar snang / /zhes pa ltar te/ 'di la che chung gnyis yod pa ni ti shrī kun dga' blo gros kyi gan dkar dang gan g.yog yin te/ brtag thabs kha cig las/ kun blo ma zhes bya ba'i dkar yol ni/

/ngo bo dang chung yin mod phyi nang la/ /'brug chung gnyis gnyis kha sprad me tog gi /zlum brtsegs khor ma yu bar gan rtsi can/ /chu ba'i nang la gan rtsi med pa'ang yod/ /che chung gnyis yin che ba bzang po 'o/ /ti shrī kun blo'i gan dkar gan g.yog yin/ /zhes kyang 'byung ba dang / de dag las gzhan pa'i dkar yol yang / chos rje gan dkar zhes su grags pa ni/ /ti shrī sangs rgyas dpal bas khyong pa las/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i gsol dkar nyid du phul/ /bsam yas chos 'khor dus su 'gyed par mdzad/ /de la chos rje gan dkar zhes su grags/ /rdo yol tsha rtsi dkar pos byugs pa la/ /cung zad btsong zhing cung zad kha g.yel ba/ /yu ba phra ring phyi la 'brug kha sprod/ /'bur du dod pa dag la 'dod pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar bla ma dam pa la ti shrī sangs rgyas dpal bas phul ba'i chos rje gan dkar du grags pa dang / de bzhin du kun rgyal ma dang / 'jam dbyangs gan dkar dang / nam rgyal ma dang / sangs rgyas dpal mor grags pa ti shrī sangs rgyas dpal ba'i gsol dkar la sogs pa sa skya pa'i gdung rgyud rin po che du ma dang / de dag gi bu slob rgya nag gi rgyal po'i ti shrīr gyur pa rnams kyi sku ngo la byung ba'i dkar yol khyad par can mang du byung ba rnams dang / gzhan yang / dbang rad ces pa rdo yol tsha rtsi dkar/ /grags 'od ma las mthil dang ngo bo chung / /dwangs shing rtsa ba ring ba dag la zer/ /phyi la 'brug ris yod pa shas che ste/ /phyi yi gsham du pad 'dab byas pa mang / /blo kha byas pa dag kyang 'ong bar snang / /'di la che chung rnam pa gnyis tsam srid/ /ces pa ltar hor dkar dbang rad mar grags pa dang / rtsod ru kun blo ma dang dbyibs 'dra la/ /de bas mthug cing che ba lci nyams yod/ /rtsa bar sger chang lta bu'i 'theb gnyer yod/ /de nyid sran chung rtsod chung zhes su grags/ /rgyal bu rtsod chung de dang 'dra ba la/ /srab dang yu ba ring zhing 'theb gnyer med/

/ces pa ltar rtsod chen rtsod chung sogs hor dkar gyi rigs ni shin tu mang zhing / yang brtag thabs 'ga' zhig las/ grags 'od ma la yang che chung gnyis su byas che ba sho mig ma dang / grags yon che chung gnyis te gsum dang / grags 'od chung ba ni dbang rad ma la ngos bzung zhing / dwangs chung la yang utpal ma dang / pha gu ma dang / lcags sgrog ma dang / rgya bya ma dang / pad byung ma dang / gan dam ma dang drug tu bshad pa yang 'byung ngo / /bzhi pa rgya nag gi dkar yol la/ rgya nag la ni snga dar phyi dar dbye/ /zhes pa ltar rgya nag snga dar gyi dus kyi dkar yol dang / phyi dar gyi dus kyi dkar yol gnyis las/ dang po ni/ snga dar 'brug rgyab rdo yol tsha rtsi dkar/ /sngo ba'ang srid cing mkhregs la cung zad srab/ /gzhan dag hor gyi 'brug rgyab ji bzhin no/ /shing lo me tog dag gis spras pa'ang srid/ /ces pa ltar rgya nag gi 'brug rgyab ma dang / rgya nag rgyal mo 'u zi dan gyi dus/ /thags su btags pa'i dkar yol yod par grags/ /de dus sa yol tsha rtsi ngang dkar byugs/ /cung zad sob cing mthil che kha g.yel ba/ /grags 'od ma las che zhing gsham bzo theb/ /cung zad mi legs kha mtshams me tog dang / /'brug dang sprin sogs me tog pa tra dang / /utpal la sogs ri mo sna tshogs pas/ /phyi nang spras shing 'bur dod legs pa yod/ /'di la gan dkar me tog mar grags so/ /zhes pa ltar dang / gzhan yang de dag gi rjes su byung ba'i rgyal mo gan dkar bya ba dang / rgya nag dwangs chung du grags pa dang / 'brug 'khor mar grags pa sogs hor dkar dang khyad par cher med pa mang du byung ba yin zhing / de dag hor dkar dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ mdor na rgya nag rnying ma hor khyad par/ /hor dkar gsham gyi nang du gan rtsi ni/ /zho kha'i rnam pa yod dam gan rtsi ni/ /ngo bo zhabs mtshams rtsub 'khyil 'dra ba'ang / /shas cher dag la yod pa mang zhes grags/

/med pa'i hor dkar dag kyang srid pa yin/ /rgya nag rnying ma de dag med par nges/ /zhes pa ltar rtogs par bya'o/ /rgya nag phyi dar gyi dkar yol ni/ rgya nag phyi dar dus kyi dkar yol ni/ /rgya yi rgyal po gong ma ye dbang gi /dus nas dar ba rnams la zer ba yin/ /de yang karma pa yi sprul pa'i sku/ /lnga par gyur pa de bzhin gshegs pa dang / /ya mtshan slad du gong ma ye dbang gis/ /tshe ring bya yi brun las byung ba'i gser/ /las grub dkar yol gzugs chung yu ba ni/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser las byas pa zhig /gsol ja bzhes pa'i yo gor phul bar snang / /zhes pa ltar rgya nag rgyal po ye dbang bya bas karma pa de bzhin gshegs pa la thog mar gser gyi dkar gzugs de bzhin phul/ de nas/ dkar yol thog mar me tog gan dkar ni/ /shel yol tsha rtsi dkar po byugs pa la/ /mthil chung za kho mtho zhing kha g.yel ba/ /yu ba ran zhing phyi nang rtsi g.yogs srab/ /shin tu srab pa shog bu tsam du bzos/ /ri mo phra zhing 'brug dang seng ge dang / /bkra shis rtags brgyad me tog zlum rtsigs dang / /gyi ling pa sogs ci rigs yod pa yin/ /mchog tu gyur pa kha yar bzos zhes grags/ /de rjes dmar ser sngo ljang dag kyang phul/ /ha cang srab pa gsol ja bas phyis pas/ /dum bur song bas karma gan dkar zhes/ /sa yol rtsi sogs gong dang 'dra ba la/ /cung zad 'thug pa kha dog lnga pa phul/ /zhes pa ltar gyi dkar yol phul zhing / gzhan yang / de las srab pa ra zhing sogs kyi khyong / /bod kyi yul du dar bar byas par snang / /de yi mi 'gyur rtags su ni gi dbus/ /sgor mo'i nang du rgya yig bzhi yis mtshan/ /de dang dus mtshungs rgyal po'i gsol dkar du/ /ye dbang gan dkar zhes pa nam 'degs ma/ /rgyu rtsi la sogs gong dang mtshungs pa la/ /rtsi mdog dkar po gang ni cung zad ring / /khyad par sgor mo yi ge bzhis mtshan pa/ /dkar yol nang gi logs la 'byung ba yin/

/gnyis kar ri mo gser gyis bris pa'ang srid/ /karma 'on rtser grags pa che chung gnyis/ /che ba yangs shing gong las cung zad 'thug /phor zhabs lta bu'i zhabs yod mthil yangs shing / /kha yel ri mo skong mar bris pa ste/ /'di la khra bo dag kyang yod par snang / /chung ba de bas cung thung ri mo 'bur/ /de bas chung ba karma gan phrug zer/ /gan phrug phal pa de bas 'thug pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ me tog gan dkar dang / ye dbang gan dkar sogs karma pa sprul sku rabs bdun gyi nang tshan lnga pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i dus su byung pa rnams dang / theg chen chos rje la phul dkar yol ni/ /theg chen gan dkar zhes su grags pa ste/ /rgyu rtsi sa yol tsha rtsi dkar po la/ /dbyibs ni padma gan dkar dag dang mtshungs/ /de bas che ba 'thug kyang cung zad 'thug /ri mo la sogs phal cher 'dra ba mang / /nyin mo bde legs yi ge 'bur mo dang / /gsham du pad 'dab bar du sked nyag can/ /de 'dra ba'ang 'ga' zhig 'byung bar snang / /de bas cung chung sngo khra dag kyang yong / /theg chen gan rtse zhes pa de bas 'thug /rgyu rtsi 'dra la cung chung mthil rgya che/ /zo kha cung zad ri mo 'bur la gsal/ /ser ta'i theg chen rtse ru phul bar snang / /zhes theg chen gan dkar du grags pa theg chen rin po che kun dga' bkra shis la rgya nag tas ming rgyal pos phul ba rnams dang / gzhan yang btsun mo gan dkar la sogs te rgya nag gsar ma'am/ phyi dar gyi dkar yol yang mang du byung ba yin la/ de ltar dkar yol la rnam grangs mang du bshad pa de dag ni rgyu rtsi sogs khyad par can 'ba' zhig las grub pas dkar yol mchog kho na yin la/ dkar yol phal pa'i rigs ni bsam gyis mi khyab pas dkar dpyad du yang mchog rnams kyi brtag pa bshad kyi phal pa ni mi 'byung la/ des na rten gyi nang rdzongs su bzhugs 'os pa'i dkar yol yang gong du bshad pa de dag yin par shes par byas nas ci 'byor pa bsag par bya'o/

/de dag ni rten la nang bzhugs 'bul rgyu yo byad ji ltar bsag pa'i tshul te/ de ltar gzungs 'bul ba'i sngon du dgos cha rnams bshom par lhag chil te yod pa shin tu gal che bas/ de grub nas lag len dngos ni/ 'ga' zhig gi phyag len la rab gnas dngos gzhi'i nyin gzungs gzhug 'bul ba mdzad pa ni/ ston gyi dus lta bu sogs sngon nas gzungs phul na khrus gsol gyi tshe gzungs chud 'dza' ba'i nyes pa byung dogs pa yin yang / da lta phyag len la me long la rten gyi gzugs shar ba la khrus 'bul bas de lta bu'i dogs pa mi dgos la/ des na sta gon gyi nyin nam/ de'i snga rol tu yang rung ste/ gza' skar dus sbyor sogs bzang ba la rten la sbyang ba gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i bgegs bskrad/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug rten gyi phyi dar sogs chas bzang pos dril/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon lhag pa'i lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan zhing / gzhan yang grogs dge slong / dge tshul/ dge bsnyen/ khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs sdom brtson dam tshig dang ldan pa gtsang sbra la gnas bzhin pas/ rten gyi zhabs steng du phyogs par byas nas/ oṃ mandhu garbha ya swāhā/ zhes dri med 'od kyi srog shing 'bul ba'i sngags bzla bzhin pas dang por gtsug tor gyi gzungs dang srog shing 'bul zhing / skye mched byin rlabs 'jug tshe de rnams so so'i thad du sbyar ba'am/ dril te 'jug pa rten che chung dang bstun pa/ rten chen po la dbu dang phyag sor gyi gzungs khrigs kha'i gong du bzhugs pa ste/ de nas bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad 'don bzhin du las byed rnams ja bur/ mar thud/ zho 'bras sogs dkar gsum gyis tshim par byed pa dang / khar bu ram sogs cung zad bcug la kha stong par mi byed pa rten 'brel legs par dgongs pa bzhin phyag len mdzad/ de nas byin rlabs rten gsum ldan gyi bla ma dam pa gang zag mchog gi sku gdung ring bsrel/

dbu lo/ na bza'/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung sogs rten gtsug tor can yin na/ dbu'i gtsug tor dang / gtsug tor gyi nang du gzhug gtsug tor med na dbu gtsug gi thad du gzhug pa dang / bla gzungs rnams dbu nang dang / mchod rten gyi bre yan la gzhug mgrin pa'i thad du dbyangs gsal mang du 'bul ba la khungs med kyang / dbyangs gsal gsang sngags thams cad kyi gzhi yin pas gzhug kyang 'gal ba med pas 'jug pa'am/ med na thugs kha'i stod yan la bla gzungs yangs dog dang bstun nas 'bul/ de nas rgyud sde bzhi'i gzungs bla med rnams sku'i stod la bzhugs/ de dag rnams kyi gzungs so sor 'phral thub na/ g.yas su pha rgyud/ g.yon du ma rgyud/ dbus su gnyis med rgyud/ thugs kha'i dbyings su yi dam gyi sku bzhugs/ sa tsha dang sku gzugs byin rlabs can gzhug par 'dod kyang rigs mi mthun mi 'gyur bar na bzas bklubs/ rten de nyid kyi zhal phyogs dang mthun par bzhugs/ de nas rnal 'byor rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ bya rgyud dang / mdo gzungs rnams ka tho kha byang gi rim pa ma 'khrugs pa'i dbu rnams yar bstan/ gzungs zheng che ba rnams dbu g.yas su bstan pa'i 'phrad gzungs byas/ skyil krung yan gyi sku'i cha la rdzogs par bzhugs shing / gzungs 'khrugs pa sogs kyi nyes pa sel ba'i rig pa phug ron gyi gzungs dang / gzungs chen lnga ni sku gzugs kyi pad gdan dang khri/ mchod rten gyi seng khri ma gtogs stod smad thams cad la khyab par bcug yang rten che ba rnams la lte ba yan la gzungs rnams dang / lte ba nas skyil krung yan la gong du bshad pa'i glegs bam dag 'jug mtshams kyis bcad kyang rung / phyag la gzungs 'jug pa dang mi 'jug pa'i lugs gnyis snang bas gang bde dang / skyil krung yan khrig gis gang ba'i mtshams su gzungs stod smad kyi bar mtshams gcod phyir dar ser po sogs kyis bcad pa'i khar rin po che lnga la sogs gong du bshad pa'i rin po che'i rigs rnams khod snyoms pa zhig bkram nas/

de nas sku'i padma'i mchod rten gyi seng khri'i dbus su gnod sbyin 'khor lo steng 'og phyogs ma nor bar shar rten gyi mdun phyogs la 'ong bar byas bcug pa'i mtha' skor du nor lha'i gzungs dang bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad/ pad khri dang seng khri'i g.yon du chos skyong dang / dpal mgon bdud cu rtsa lnga'i gzungs rnams 'jug pa'am/ yang pad gzungs kyi 'og tu mtshams dar gyis bcad pa'i khar zas 'bru sogs dang mnyam du gnod sbyin 'khor lo bzhugs kyang rung la/ zas sna'i rigs stobs ches na rdzus te skye ba'i sems can srid pas sna tshang tsam/ de'i khar skye mched byin rlabs su yod pa'i gdan byin rlabs kyi sngags bzhugs pa'i steng du 'bru sman/ gos dar zas sna tshogs sogs gong du sta gon byas pa'i thum bu rnams dam du gcer/ stod smad byin gyi bar bar du spos kyi thum bu chung ngus kyang zhib tu gcer nas cung zad kyang mi khrol ba'i tshags dam du byed pa ni shin tu gal che zhing / de'i khar 'og gzhi byin rlabs kyi sngags gzhug pa yang 'ga' zhig gis mdzad/ de nas mtshams dar kha dog bzang pos g.yogs te/ oṃ dha tu garbha ya swāhā/ zhes pa brjod bzhin pas sdom ra bsgrig par bya'o/ /yang sku tshad phra mo la gzungs thams cad ma chug na mdor bsdus pa'i lag len 'di ltar bya ste/ srog shing la khong seng mi thub pas gru bzhir byas pa'i rtser rnam rgyal gyi snying po oṃ bhrum̐ swāhā/ a mṛ tā a yurda te swāhā/ zhes pa tsam dang / dbus su oṃ sarba bidya swāhā dang / rtsa bar oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ zhes pa shog bu'am/ srog shing nyid la yi ge phra mor bris kyang rung / skye mched byin rlabs kyang byed tshe rnam grangs gang yang rung ba re re srog shing la dkris pa zhal ras kyi thad du yong ba bya/ byin rlabs rten kyang gtso che ba re re tsam mam sna 'dus pa nyung ngu re gzhug cing /

bla ma'i sku yin na de rang gi thugs dam gyi gtso bo gang yin gyi brgyud pa'i gtso bo'i mtshan sngags yi dam chos skyong / rten 'brel snying po rnams nas sna re gzhug gang la dmigs pa de nyid kyi smon lam dang shis brjod kyis brgyan pa bya/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo yang ma shong na/ jo bo rje'i dbu zhwa'i nang nas rnyed pa'i 'khor lo dzam̐ dgu dang / bam̐ dgu bris pa snang bar bshad pas bsdus pa de tsam gyis kyang rung zhing / chos skyong nor lha'i gzungs dang bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad bcug pas kyang rung ba yin la/ 'bru sna sogs kyang sna them tsam dang bcas dam du gcer/ mtshams dar dang sdom ra sngar bzhin no/ /yang yi dam gyi sku la srog shing sngar bzhin la/ skye mched byin rlabs kyi sngags kyang 'jug tshe rgyud sde gang yin dang mthun pa byed/ yi dam de rang gi dbang bshad bka'i brgyud pa dang mthun pa'i bla ma'i mtshan sngags dang / yi dam de rang gi snying po sogs sngags rgyas bsdus pa ci rigs pa dang / gnod sbyin 'khor lo sngar bzhin yang thub pa'i sku yin na srog shing sngags bcas dang / skye mched byin rlabs sngar bzhin la/ shākya thub pa nyid kyi mtshan brgya/ stong phrag brgya pa bzung bar 'gyur ba/ brgyad stong pa bzung par 'gyur ba sogs nas ci ltar 'tshams pa gzhug cing / bzod pa dka' thub dam pa sogs rnam gzigs kyi gso sbyong shlau ka gcig sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing sogs thub pa nyid kyi gso sbyong shlau ka gcig ye dharmā gnod sbyin 'khor lo dang bcas pa sngar bzhin dang / de bzhin du chos skyong gi sku yin na srog shing sngags bcas kyi khar/ chos skyong de rang la mnga' bsgyur ba'i bla ma'i mtshan sngags/ chos skyong rang gi rigs bdag gang yin gyi yi dam gyi snying po/ chos skyong nyid kyi snying po/ chos skyong spyi'i sngags rdo rje gur gyi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i chos skyong gi dam brdar ba'i sngags su'ang grags pa shā sa na spel tshig ji ltar 'dod pa/

gnod sbyin 'khor lo/ 'bru zas rin po che sogs ji ltar 'tshams pa sngar bzhin bzhugs/ yang nor lha'i rigs la'ang srog shing sngags bcas/ nor lha de rang dang 'brel ba'i brgyud pa'i mtshan sngags/ yi dam gyi snying po/ nor lha de rang gi snying po tshar mang ba/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo sogs sngar bzhin bya zhing / sku brnyan shin tu chung ba la ni bla gzungs kyai rdor man ngag lugs lta bu zhig dang / aṣṭa lta bu kyai rdor lha dgu'i sngags tsam gyis kyang chog par dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar yin zhing / rten 'bring rnams la ni gong gi rigs pas rjes su dpag ste shes par bya'o/ /yang mchod rten la ni srog shing gi bsgrub tshul sngags dang bcas pa sngar dang 'dra ba las/ srog shing gi dkyus ni mchod rten dang mnyam par byed par bshad mod/ 'on kyang mchod rten dngos ni/ rmang dge ba nas bre phyin yin pas gzungs kyang de'i khongs su chug dgos shing / 'di ni gtso bor srog shing gi sngags rnams rgyas pa dang / gzhan yang gsang ba ring bsrel/ byang chub rgyan 'bum/ gtsug tor dri med/ rten 'brel snying po rnams rgyas par byed kyi/ mtshan sngags/ rgyud sde bzhi/ chos skyong skor/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo dang bcas pa go rim sngar bzhin bzhugs kyang legs te/ che chung la ji ltar 'os pa dang / rang rang gi bzhed pa dang bstun pas nyes par 'gyur ba 'ga' yang med par bshad do/ /zhar byung bris sku'i rgyab gzungs kyang / de la glegs bam dang bris sku la ni/ de nyid kyi mtha' mar ro zhes gsungs pa ltar/ jo bo rje'i thugs dam ma mi 'khrugs pa'i thang ka la/ de'i mtha' mar mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs bris pa snang bar grags na yang / da ltar gyi rnams la ni de ltar byed pa mi bde bas sku gzugs kyi rgyab kyi dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ thugs kha rnams su oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang / lha gang yin de'i mtshan sngags/ sarba bidya/ badzra a yu ṣe/

ye dharmā/ bzod pa dka' thub kyi tshigs su bcad pa rnams sku la 'bri ba dang / smon lam shis brjod dang bcas pas chog mod/ rgyas par na mchod rten dang / gzungs mang du bri ba'ang snang bas bshad khung mi snang yang 'gal ba med par gsungs so/ /de ltar rten la gzungs gzhug phul na legs pa tsam zhig gong du drangs pa'i lung rnams kyis grub mod/ nges par dgong pa ma yin te/ rgya gar gyi li ma rnams la gzungs bzhugs med pa shas che bas so snyam na/ li ma phal cher la de ltar 'byung ba bden mod kyang / li ma 'ga'i gzungs la ni nang bzhugs sdom ra dang bcas pa rgya gar gyi bzo ma 'chugs pa 'byung ba dang / kha che'i li ma la sogs pa la'ang / nang bzhugs rnams sku'i rgyab nas phul nas pad gdan btang snyoms su byas pa 'byung la/ la la yun ring pas chud zos pa dang / kha cig ni gar lugs byas pas sku la khong seng med pa dang / phal cher ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku brnyan ni/ che chung dang / rgyu ci las bgyis kyang rung ste/ phyag tshad dang ldan pa zhig yin gzhir bzhag la/ ye shes pa gzhug par 'os pa ni/ nang bzhugs kyi rim pa la ma ltos pa nyid kyi dbang du mdzad kyis/ nges par bzhugs mi dgos pa la dgongs pa ma yin la/ deng sang ni nang bzhugs kyi rim pa med mi rung yin te/ bod kyi 'bur sku phal cher la nang shin tu yangs par yod pas/ nang du rten gyi rim pa ji ltar bzhugs pa de ltar du rten de byin rlabs che la/ gong du drangs pa'i dpung bzang gi lung des nang bzhugs kho nas kyang rten de mchod yul khyad par can du 'gyur bar bstan pas so/ /yang 'o na srog shing 'bul ba 'di mchod rten las gzhan pa'i sku gzugs la mi dgos so snyam na/ 'di la 'ga' zhig ni srog shing gtso cher mchod rten la gsungs kyang / mchod rten la srog shing phul ba la phan yon ji snyed pa de snyed sku gzugs gzhan la srog shing phul ba la yang 'byung bar mtshungs pas sku gzugs la yang srog shing nges par byed pa nyid mkhas pa'i phyag len yin gsungs la/
