la la ni byas na yang legs shing / thams cad la nges par dgos pa yang ma yin zhing / sku gzugs chung ngu dag la ni srog shing bya ba lag len mi bde bas so/ /zhes srog shing mdzad pa dang / nges par dgos pa ma yin pas ma byas kyang chog pa'i lugs gnyis su snang ba las/ gong du bkod pa'i srog shing bcas gzungs 'bul tshul rnams ni byed pa'i dbang du byas nas bris pa yin no/ /yang gong du bstan pa'i ring bsrel rnam pa lnga po de yang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel lnga zhes pa yin pas/ sku bal gyi ring bsrel yang sangs rgyas kyi dbu skra dang / phyag sen sogs dang / de dag dang mtshungs pa'i bla ma mchog gi dbu skra sogs la dgongs pas de dag rten gyi nang rdzongs su bzhugs 'os kyi/ de las gzhan pa dag mi rigs te/ 'di la dgongs nas sngon gyi bla ma rnams kyi sa ma thob pa'i gang zag gi rus pa/ sa tsha cho ga bzhin btab nas 'jug de ltar min na gang zag de la'ang gnod par gsungs pa dang / bka' gdams kyi yi ge rnying ma jo bo rje'i gsung bris pa dag las/ gang zag mchog ma yin pa'i rus pa sku'i stod du bcug na dur khrod lta bur 'gyur bas sku smad du 'jug ces 'byung bas so/ /yang bla ma dngos grub mchog brnyes pa'i gdung / dbu lo/ phyag sen sogs khrus gsol legs par byas nas brgyud rim mam/ snga rim gyis bzhugs shing / dam tshig gi sel dang / thugs mi mthun par lhad snang ba'i rigs rnams lhan cig tu mi bzhugs la/ mchil lam dang na bza' dri ma can dang / gsang chab ril bu'i rigs sogs kyang ma bcug pa legs par bshad do/ /'o na gang zag mchog ma yin pa dang / rang gi pha sogs kyi rus bu sku'i smad sogs su gzhug kyang mi 'gal lam snyam na/ de dag rang dgar bcug na mi legs shing / sbyong rgyud nas 'byung ba'i rus chog tshul bzhin du byas/ sa tsha btab/ rab tu gnas pa byas te gzhug pa ni legs par 'gyur te/

rus bu la sa tsha btab rab gnas legs par byas pas na de'i ye shes pa de 'byung ba sogs kyi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du gnas la/ ye shes pa de ji srid bzhugs pa de srid du mchod pa'i yul mchog tu gyur pa yin pas so/ /de lta ma yin na ni rab gnas byas pa'i dgos pa yang med cing / ye shes sems dpa' nyid kyang mchod pa'i yul ma yin par 'gyur ro/ /yang bla ma la sogs pa'i mtshan sngags sbyor tshul la/ yi ge gsum dang spel bar ma zad phyag 'tshal lam skyabs su mchi'o zhes pa'ang sbyor ba yod/ rnam dbye gnyis pa dang bzhi pa'i sgra mi sbyor bar ngo bo tsam dang / rdo rje gsum spel ba rgyud sde'i dgongs par 'chad pa yang yod pa las snga ma ltar legs te don gsal las de ltar du 'byung bas so/ /yang sangs rgyas kyi gsungs la bzang ngan med pas gzungs la gong 'og gi khyad 'byed mi dgos so snyam na/ rgyal ba nyid kyis rgyud sde mchog dman gyi rim pa gsungs pas na/ gzungs kyang rgyud sde'i go rim bzhin ma 'khrugs par bya ba nyid legs la/ yang gzhung 'dir bla ma zhal bzhugs pa'i byin rlabs rten dang / gzhan zhabs lham gyi rigs gzhug tu mi rung bar byed ces gsungs nas dogs pa'i gnas lta bur mdzad cing phyis kyi yig cha 'ga' zhig las/ bla ma zhal bzhugs pa'i dbu skra sogs rten gyi nang du bzhugs su mi rung ba'i tshul zhig bshad 'dug kyang / de yang gtan nas mi rung ba ni ma yin par sems te/ chos rje sa paṇa gyi sku brnyan chos rje nyid kyi sdom phrug bgres pa bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan skyobs pa dpal bzang pos bzhengs pa'i nang bzhugs la chos rje nyid kyi dbu lo bub bzhugs pa la bdag nyid chen po de nyid kyis phyag nas mdzad par sku brnyan de nyid kyi zhabs pad kyi 'og gi yi ge rnying ma las 'byung ba dang / brgyud pa'i bla ma tshad ldan dag gi phyag len la yang dbu skra sogs la sbyang khrus sngon du 'gro bas gzhug par mdzad pa snang bas so/

/de dag ni rten la gzungs 'bul tshul gyi yi ge bla ma gong ma rnams kyi mang du 'byung ba dag las 'thad pa'i cha rnams blangs shing / the tshom gyi gnas rnams btang snyoms su byas/ rang lugs don gsal gyi dgongs pa gzhir bzhag nas dogs pa'i mtha' rnams kyang dpyad de/ dngos grub 'byung ba'i gzungs gzhug 'bul tshul gyi gsal byed du bkod pa yin la/ da ni zhar byung kun rig la brten pa'i rab gnas nyin gang ma'i cho ga'i don bshad par bya ste/ de yang gzhung 'di nyid las/ deng sang gshin po'i don du rus pa bsreg sbyong byas/ tsha tsha btab nas kun rig la brten pa'i rab gnas nyin gang ma mdzad pa'i phyag srol bzang po zhig 'dug na'ang / legs par brtags na cho ga rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rnam gzhag gang dang yang mi mthun pa zhig 'dug pa nas/ rang nyid kyis mi shes rung / gzhan la phan pa zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam/ rje btsun gong ma rnams dang / sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa la gsol ba btab nas bri bar bya'o/ /zhes cho ga 'di mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan mdor bsdus bstan nas/ de nas don dngos la/ de la rten gyi bya ba yongs su rdzogs pa sogs ni gong du bstan pa bzhin dang / cho ga dngos la sdom ni/ legs bsham bdag bskyed bum pa bzlas/ /rten sbyangs bkru zhing phyi ba dang / /ring bsrel gzhug cing gsol ba btab/ /rten bskyed spyan drangs dgug rgyas gdab/ /dbang bskur mchod bstod spyan dbye bya/ /gsol btab mnga' dbul rgyas pa bya/ /de yang mchod bstod bye brag dang / /sbyin sreg sngags te dngos gzhi 'o/ /zhes tshig rkang dang po 'don pa cung zad bsgyur te/ don bco lnga las zhes gsungs pa ltar rab gnas thams cad la sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i don tshan lnga gong ltar shes par byas nas/ cho ga dngos la/ legs par bsham pa/ bdag bskyed pa/ bum pa bzlas pa/ rten sbyang ba/ khrus bya ba/ ring bsrel gzhug pa/ gsol ba btab pa/

rten bskyed pa/ spyan drang zhing dgug gzhug bya ba/ rgyas gdab pa/ dbang bskur ba/ mchod bstod bya ba/ spyan dbye bya ba/ brtan par bzhugs su gsol ba btab pa/ mnga' dbul rgyas par bya ba dang don tshan bco lnga las/ dang po ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ legs par bsham pa ni tsha tsha la sogs pa rten gsar pa stegs mtho bar bzhugs pa'i mdun du zhes pa nas/ de bas stegs cung dma' ba la cha gsum gtor ma rnams bsham pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar te ji skad gsungs pa bzhin bsham mo// ༈ //spyi don gnyis pa bdag bskyed pa la/ sngon du 'gro ba'i chos/ srung 'khor bsgom pa/ bdag bskyed dngos dang gsum las/ dang po la yang gnyis te/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa dang / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ thog mar mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas bgegs bsal/ zhes pa nas/ dharmā ra ṇi sogs brjod cing rol chen byas te mchod pa byin gyis rlabs so zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan la/ gnyis pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya ba la/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang / sems bskyed pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de nas bdag dang 'gro ba zhes pa nas/ skyabs 'gro nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa byas nas zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan cing / gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ don dam sems bskyed bsgom pa dang / kun rdzob sems bskyed bsgom pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa yin pa la zhes pa dang / gnyis pa la/ de ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bya'am bgyi'o zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed ces pas bstan to/ /gnyis pa srung 'khor bsgom pa la/ sgo gsum byin gyis brlab pa/ srung 'khor dngos/ brtan par bya ba dang gsum las/

dang po ni/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs kyis stong par bsgom zhes pas yid byin rlabs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas/ zhes brjod pas lce rdo rje byin gyis brlabs zhes pa'i bar gyi ngag byin rlabs/ lag pa gnyis kyi mthil du a a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa re re/ de zhu ba lag pa la thim pas lag pa gnyis rdo rje'i rang bzhin dang / sor mo rnams rdo rje rtse gcig par gyur ces pas lus byin rlabs bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa srung 'khor bsgom pa la yang / bdag bsrung ba/ gnas bsrung ba/ khro bo'i las kha tshar ba'i bsrung ba dang gsum/ dang po rigs kyi khro bo bskyed pa/ de la dam tshig gsum 'dzin pa/ khro bo'i dbang bskur ba/ go bsgo ba dang bzhi'i sgo nas bya ba'i tshul ni/ hūm̐ las bdag nyid khro bo me ltar 'bar ba zhes pa nas/ bdag nyid rigs kyi khro bor bskyed pa'o zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa gnas bsrung ba la/ sngar yod kyi bgegs tshar bcad pa dang / phyin chad mi 'jug par bya ba'i phyir srung 'khor bsgom pa dang gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de nas srung 'khor bsgom pa'i phyir oṃ badzra zhes pa nas/ sngar yod kyi bgegs bsal ba'i cho ga'o zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan cing / gnyis pa la 'og bcings pa/ phyogs bcings pa/ dkyil 'khor bcings pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ de nas oṃ badzra ḍi ḍho me bha wa zhes sogs kyis bstan la/ gnyis pa ni/ oṃ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭ kyis steng bcings zhes pa nas/ oṃ badzra shi ṣa re ru ṭa phaṭ kyis lho bcings zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan cing / gsum pa dkyil bcings pa ni/ oṃ badzra karmas dkyil bcings zhes sogs kyis bstan to/ /gsum pa khro bo las kha tshar ba'i bsrung ba la/ khro bo spyan drangs te mchod bstod bya ba/ hūm̐ bzhi pa'i bsrung ba/ slar yang sems dpa' bzhi'i bsrung ba dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas zhes sogs dang /

gnyis pa ni rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya snying khar reg cing zhes sogs dang / gsum pa ni rdo rje las kyi phyag rgya dang zhes sogs kyis bstan to/ /gsum pa brtan par bya ba ni/ dril bu gsil/ rdo rje gsor zhing / rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya ba lan gsum brjod cing brtan par bya'o zhes pas bstan to/ /gsum pa bdag bskyed dngos la/ lha 'grub pa'i rgyu bsgom pa/ 'bras bu lha bskyed pa dngos/ ched du gtad pa'i bzlas pa bya ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rang gi lag mthil gnyis su a a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re zhes pa nas/ ye shes pa rnams brtan par bsam mo zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan to/ /gzhung 'dir/ gzhan phan 'od zer gyi sgrub thabs ltar srung 'khor bsdus pa nyid shin tu legs shing skabs su babs pas mkhyen pa rnams kyis de ltar bya'o zhes gsungs pa ni rab gnas kyi skabs 'dir bdag bskyed la srung 'khor bsdus pa skabs su babs kyang / kun rig la brten pa'i rab gnas mdzad pa po rnams srung 'khor rgyas pa la byang chub pas 'jug pa bde ba la dgongs par mngon no/ /gnyis pa 'bras bu lha bskyed pa dngos ni/ swa bhā wa sogs brjod cing stong par bsam zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas kun pas sngar sangs rgyas/ /zhes sogs 'og nas 'byung ba ltar brjod pas bstod par bsam mo zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan to/ /gsum pa ched du gtad pa'i bzlas pa ni/ de nas gsum pa ched du gtad pa'i bzlas pa rang gi snying khar zhes pa nas/ zhes pas bstod de bdag bskyed pa'o zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan to/ /'di dag gi tshig don rnams ni kun rig gi rnam bshad rnams las 'byung ba ltar shes par bya'o// ༈ //spyi don gsum pa bum pa bzlas pa la/ rnam rgyal dang las bum bzlas tshul/ khrus bum bsgrub tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i steng du dung chos dri bzang gi chus gang ba dang zhes pa nas/

dam tshig pa 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu nus pa dang ldan par gyur ces brjod ces pa'i bar te/ rten bum pa bskyed pa ni/ a mṛ tas bgegs bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs nas/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes sogs bum pa gnyis bskyed tshul gong rgyas pa'i skabs dang 'dra la/ brten pa lha bskyed pa ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu'i dbus su zhes sogs rdo rje sems dpa' dkyus nas 'byung ba bzhin dang / las bum du rdo rje gnod sbyin dkyus bzhin bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan drangs pa la gdan phul zhing mchod pa bsdus pas mchod/ oṃ badzra aṃ gu sha dza zhes sogs phyag rgya dang bcas pas dam ye dbyer med du bsres/ 'di dag gi sngags don 'og rab gnas kyi ye shes pa bstim pa'i skabs su 'chad do/ /de nas oṃ bhrin sogs phyag rgya dang bcas pa ni gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa ste/ de yang bhri ta sogs kyi sngags rgya'i tshe bum nang gi lha rnams kyi lus de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba dang dbyer med du gyur par bsam/ tra ṭa sogs kyi tshe bum nang gi lha rnams kyi ngag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang ldan pa dang dbyer med du gyur par bsam/ tshindha sogs kyi tshe bum nang gi lha rnams kyi yid de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i bdag nyid dang dbyer med du gyur par bsam zhing / sngags don ni/ oṃ gzhan dang 'dra/ bhri ta bhri ta ni chod chod/ gang chod na/ sarba a wa ra ṇa ni sgrib pa thams cad/ tra ṭa tra ṭa ni grol grol/ gang na sarba a wa sogs 'dra/ tshindha tshindha ni gtubs gtubs/ gang na gong bzhin no/ /de ltar gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas/ de nas oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa sogs kyi dbang bskur ba ste/ sngags don ni/ oṃ gzhan dang 'dra/ badzra rdo rje/ a bhi mngon par rtogs pa/

ṣiñtsa dbang / buddha sangs rgyas/ ratna rin chen/ padma ni padma/ karma las te/ rdo rje'i mngon par dbang bskur ba/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs kyi mngon par dbang bskur ba/ rin chen rigs kyi mngon par dbang bskur ba/ padma'i rigs kyi mngon par dbang bskur ba/ rin po che'i rigs kyi mngon par dbang bskur ba/ las kyi rigs kyi mngon par dbang bskur ba zhes pa'i don no/ /de nas oṃ sarba sogs kyi mchod pa'i sngags don ni gong rgyas pa kyai rdor la brten pa'i mchod bstod kyi mnga' dbul gyi skabs ltar ro/ /bstod pa ni kun rig bstod chen gyi nang gi rdo rje sems dpa' dang / rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi bstod pa shlau ka re re po de 'dir mdzad de/ don ni badzra satwa zhes pa 'di'i snying po yin pas snying po'i sgo nas mtshan rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ de yang rdo rje ni stong pa nyid de de bzhin nyid do/ /de la yang rgyu dus kyi de bzhin nyid dang / 'bras dus kyi de bzhin nyid gnyis las/ drang don du phyi ma de yid la byed pa'am/ thob par 'dun pas na sems dpa'/ de nyid ma thob par 'dun pa chen po mdzad pas na sems dpa' chen po/ nges don du mi 'gyur ba lha'i ngo bor bzhugs pas na rdo rje/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid dam/ de dag bskyed par byed pas na de bzhin gshegs pa kun no/ /sems dpa' bcu drug gi rdo rje rgyal po la sogs pa las thog ma kho nar grub pas na rdo rje dang po'o/ /dngos ming gi sgo nas mtshan du brjod pa kun tu bzang po'o/ /phyag na rdo rjes mtshan pas na gsang ba'i mtshan phyag na rdo rje zhes ming gi sgo nas dbang bskur ba brnyes pas na phyag na rdo rje ste mtshan bdun gyi sgo nas bstod pa'o/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi bstod pa'i don ni/ badzra yakṣa zhes pa 'di'i snying po yin pas snying po'i sgo nas mtshan du gyur pa rdo rje gnod sbyin/

'khor gsum dang bral ba'i rtogs pa'i thabs kyis bdud mi dmigs par rtogs pas thabs chen po/ phyag mtshan gyi sgo nas rdo rje mche ba/ nam mkha' khyab pa'i phyag mtshan de nyid kyis bdud rnams skrag par byed pas 'jigs pa chen po/ dngos kyi mtshan bdud 'joms/ rdo rje mche ba'i phyag rgya mang po sprul nas don byed pas rdo rje mi zad pa'o/ /ming dbang bskur ba'i dus gsang mtshan du rdo rje drag po zhes brjod pa ste mtshan bdun gyi sgo nas bstod pa'o/ /de nas pad skor dang bcas gzungs thag blangs te/ dmigs pa dkyus nas 'byung ba bzhin bum bzlas byed la/ bzla rgyu'i sngags don ni/ oṃ gzhan dang 'dra ba'am/ yang na sku bskul ba/ badzra satwa ni rdo rje sems dpa' ste snying po/ hūm̐ ni thugs kyi ngo bo ste de nyid bskul ba/ yang oṃ dang hūm̐ sngar ltar la/ badzra yakṣa rdo rje gnod sbyin no/ /a bhi ṣe ka ta sogs kyi sngags don gong du bshad pa ltar ro/ /de nas slar yang mchod bstod sngar bzhin dang / rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya/ ma 'byor ba sogs dang / mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu ste bum chu nus pa can du gyur par bsam pa sogs dkyus nas 'byung ba bzhin bya ba ni rnam rgyal dang las bum bsgrub pa'o/ /gnyis pa khrus bum bsgrub tshul dang / spyi don bzhi pa rten sbyang ba/ lnga pa khrus bya ba rnams ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ de nas rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa khrus bum gyi steng du bzhag ces pa nas/ gong gi nub gsum ma'i sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar bya'o zhes pa'i bar te/ khrus bum phyi'i bzlas pa'i skabs su/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐/ zhes bzla ba dang / rten sbyang ba'i bden brdar gyi skabs su bcom ldan 'das snying po kyai rdo rje zhes sogs kyi dod du/ bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po kun rig rnam par snang mdzad lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa zhes pa'am/

bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa'i lha tshogs zhes sogs gang bde bya ba dang / de bzhin du rol mo dang bstun aṣṭa bzla ba'i tshab tu/ badzra satwa dang / badzra yakṣa bzla ba ma gtogs gzhan khrus bum bsgrub pa sogs don tshan gsum po de gong rgyas pa'i sta gon gyi skabs ltar bya ba yin pas/ tshig don yang der bshad pa ltar yin no// ༈ //spyi don drug pa ring bsrel gzhug pa dang / spyi don bdun pa gsol ba gdab pa gnyis ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ dngos gzhi rgyas pa'i skabs ltar bya zhes gsungs pa ltar skabs der bkod pa ltar shes par bya'o// ༈ //spyi don brgyad pa rten bskyed pa ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ yakṣas bsang / swa bhā wa sogs kyis rten rnams mi dmigs te stong par gyur ces pa nas/ khang bzang rta babs sogs rgyas pa'i skabs su bstan pa thams cad la sku'i bskyed chog thun mong ba'i bskyed ltar gong ltar bya zhing / rgyud sde gong 'og gi rnam dbye shes par bya'o zhes pa'i bar te tsha tsha lta bu mchod rten gyi bskyed lugs sogs dkyus bzhin dang / gzhan thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rten bskyed tshul dang / rgyud sde gong 'og gi bskyed lugs mi 'dra ba ji ltar bya ba rnams gong rgyas pa'i rten bskyed kyi skabs su zhib par bkod pa ltar rtogs par bya'o// ༈ //spyi don dgu pa spyan drang zhing dgug gzhug bya ba dang / spyi don bcu pa rgyas btab pa gnyis ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ rgyas pa'i sta gon bzhin la/ dgug gzhug gnyis kyi dus zhes pa nas/ rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i kun rig gi sbyin sreg ro sreg tsha tsha gdams pa'i tsha tsha'i rab gnas skabs skabs kyang gsungs so zhes pa'i bar te/ de yang don tshan gnyis po 'di phal cher rgyas pa'i sta gon gyi skabs bzhin la/ dgug gzhug gi tshe gau ri sogs kyi sngags rgya'i dod du/ 'dir sgo ba bzhi'i dgug gzhug byed pa yin la/

'di dag gi sngags don ni/ oṃ 'dra/ badzra aṃ gu ni rdo rje lcags kyu zhes pa dang / badzra pā sha ho ni rdo rje zhags pa/ badzra spho ṭa ni rdo rje lcags sgrog badzra a we sha āḥni rdo rje 'bebs pa/ dza dang hūm̐ baṃ ā rnams ni gnyis su med pa'i don to/ /sngags de dag dang phyag rgya ni sbyong rgyud las/ gsang ba'i bcings bas bcings nas ni/ /mdzub gnyis lcags kyu'i tshul du bya/ /zhags pa bzhin du sbyar nas kyang / /de nyid lcags sgrog tshul du bya/ /mthe gnyis nang du bkug nas kyang / /bskyod par gyur na dbang du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bya ba yin zhing / rgyas gdab la rgyas bsdus gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rab gnas kyi lha'i thugs khar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa sor brgyad re bsam la/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i gung mo gnyis gshibs te bsgrengs la/ oṃ badzra dha tu badzra dha tu badzra dhu ru tri sha dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ sa ma ya satwaṃ a haṃ zhes kun la sbyar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mahā yo gi shwa ra hūm̐/ de nyid kyi tshigs dang po gnyis nang du bkugs la/ oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐/ de nyid rin po che 'dra ba dang / oṃ badzra ratna tram̐/ de nyid padma 'dra ba dang / oṃ badzra dharmā hri/ de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis gshibs te brkyangs pas ral gri 'dra bar byas la/ oṃ badzra karma kam̐ zhes pa dam tshig gi 'o/ /lha'i ljags padma 'dab bzhi 'dra bar rdo rje nas 'bras tsam la lha gang yin gyi snying pos bskor bar bsam la/ oṃ badzra dzñā na zhes pa chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /lha'i dpral bar sna tshogs rdo rje bsam la pad skor bya zhing / oṃ badzra sa twa su sam̐ gra ha/ badzra ratna ma nu ta ram̐/ badzra dharmā ka ya ni/ badzra karma ka ro da bha bai zhes pa kun la sbyar la/ byang chub mchog sa gnon/ mchog sbyin/ ting nge 'dzin/ skyabs sbyin dang lnga rim bzhin/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa na/ oṃ badzra a kṣo bhya/ oṃ badzra ratna sam̐ bha wa/

oṃ badzra a mṛ ta we/ oṃ badzra a mo gha siddhi zhes pa las kyi phyag rgya'o/ /lha sku me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar gsal bar bsam la/ oṃ badzra satwa su'i sngags dang gar mi byed par rigs lnga so so'i phyag rgya dang / sngags sngar bzhin brjod pa ni phyag rgya chen po ste tshul 'di bzhin gyi rgyas 'debs bya bar bla ma chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i gsung bzhin 'jag chen rgyan 'bum gyi rab gnas don gsal la mchan bu mdzad pa las 'byung ba yin la/ de ltar rigs lnga char gyi phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs bya ba'am/ yang gong rgyas pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar/ rten de rigs gang yin gyi lha de'i phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs dang / rigs gang yin yang rdo rje sems dpa'i rgyas 'debs kyang rung ba yin zhing / rgyas 'debs bsdus pa ltar na yo ga la brten pa'i rab gnas kyi tshe yang 'bru gsum gyi rgyas 'debs bya rung ste/ don gsal las/ yo ga'i lugs yin zhing phyag rgya bzhi mi shes na'ang 'dis btub bo zhes gsungs pa dang / mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog lhun grub kyi tsha tsha'i rab gnas kyi skabs su yang 'bru gsum gyi rgyas 'debs gsungs pas so/ /des na 'dir 'bru gsum gyi rgyas 'debs bya ba yin no// ༈ //spyi don bcu gcig pa dbang bskur ba ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ don gsal las bya spyod kyi lugs dang mthun par byed na/ chu dang / cod pan dang / phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur la rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab/ 'di ni rnal 'byor rgyud gtso bor byas pa yin pas/ rig pa'i dbang lnga dang / rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur la rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab/ rnal 'byor chen po'i lugs yin na dbang bzhi ka bskur bar bya'o zhes gsungs pas/ 'dir rig pa'i dbang lnga dang / rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba tsam brjod par bya'o zhes pa nas/ rigs bdag gi dbu brgyan nub gsum ma'i sta gon bzhin no/

/sngags kyi dbang bskur ba ni mi dgos te/ rigs lnga'i dbang gi nang du mi gtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /yang nges par bskur dgos na/ mtha' rten rgyal srid sna bdun dang / bka'i dbang bskur sogs thams cad bskur dgos par 'gyur bas ha cang thal ches so zhes pa'i bar te/ de yang bla med kyi mi bskyod pa chu dbang sogs rig pa'i dbang lnga dngos ni ma yin la/ yo ga rang gi chus dbang bla med kyi mi bskyod pa chu dbang gi dod lta bu zhig bya ba yin zhing / rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang yang yo ga rang lugs kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bsdus pa/ bla med kyi dam tshig gsum sbyin gyi dbang gi dod re bskur ba yin zhing / gzhan sngags kyi dbang sogs mi dgos te/ don gsal las/ rigs pa'i dbang lnga dang / rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur la rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab ces gsungs kyi sngags kyi dbang sogs bskur bar ma gsungs shing / de dag rigs pa'i dbang lnga dang / rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gang du yang mi gtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /'di dag gi sngags don sogs tshig don zhib par ni kun rig gi rnam bshad dag tu shes par bya'o// ༈ //spyi don bcu gnyis pa mchod bstod bya ba ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ mchod pa'i mar me rnams sbar zhes pa nas/ snang stong rdo rje sogs kyis bstod do zhes pa'i bar te mchod pa ni/ 'jig rten khams 'di dpag med na/ /zhes sogs bdag bskyed kyi skabs ltar te go sla zhing / bstod pa ni/ snang stong ma dang / 'gro ba rgyud lnga ma gnyis bya ba ste tshig don gong rgyas pa'i skabs su bshad zin to// ༈ //spyi don bcu gsum pa spyan dbye ba dang / spyi don bcu bzhi pa brtan par bzhugs su gsol zhing zhal bsgyur ba ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ phal cher rgyas pa bzhin la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ mchod pa'i skabs su mchod yon sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang /

bstod pa'i skabs su snang stong rdo rje brjod pa tsam mo zhes te/ gong rgyas pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar yin zhing / mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar ro// ༈ //spyi don bco lnga pa mnga' dbul rgyas par bya ba ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ bco lnga pa mnga' dbul rgyas par bya ba bzhi yang cho ga rgyas pa'i dngos gzhi'i skabs su bshad pa ltar bya'o/ /'on kyang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par zhes pa nas/ sngags kyi mnga' dbul zhing bkra shis kyi rjes kyi mchod pa la mchod yon sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pa ste/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro mi mdzad pa tsam khyad par ro/ /sa bcad ni legs bsham dang / bum bskyed gnyis bsnan pas bco lngar song ba ma gtogs cho ga la khyad par med do zhes pa'i bar te/ de yang ji ltar gsungs pa ltar phal cher rgyas pa'i dngos gzhi'i skabs ltar lag len yang byed cing tshig don yang gong bzhin nges par byas nas/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par mchod pa byin rlabs kun rig rang gi bdag bskyed kyi skabs bzhin dang / byin dbab kyi sngags kyang dharmā ra ṇi sogs byed pa dang / mchod pa dngos la/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma mdzad pa sogs te dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar yin la/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma 'di dang / bdag bskyed kyi skabs kyi mchod pa 'jig rten khams 'di ma gnyis char la yo ga rang gi lugs kyi mchod pa lnga char tshang bas skabs 'dir mchod pa de gnyis gang byas kyang khyad par chen po med kyang / phyag len la rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma 'dir mdzad pa ni tshig rgyas pas na rgyas pa mdzad pa'i dbang du byas so/ /mchod pa lnga ni/ rtse mo'i rgyud las/ mchod pa ji ltar yin zhe na/ /rigs sngags mngon par bzlas brjod dang / /phyag rgya bcings pa lhur len dang / /rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i mchod pa dang / /bsgrub pa dag gi mchod pa 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyi'i mchod pa/ rigs sngags bzlas pa'i mchod pa/

phyag rgya'i mchod pa/ rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i mchod pa/ bsgrub pa'i mchod pa dang lnga yin la/ de yang gcig la dper mtshon na/ mchod yon ni phyi'i mchod pa/ de 'bul ba'i sngags ni rigs sngags bzlas pa'i mchod pa/ mchod yon gyi phyag rgya 'ching ba ni phyag rgya'i mchod pa/ rang mchod pa'i lha mor bsgom pa'am/ snying kha nas mchod pa'i lha mo spro ba ni rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i mchod pa/ rang gzhan gyi don grub par bsam pa sgrub pa'i mchod pa'o/ /de bzhin du zhabs bsil dang me tog sogs gzhan rnams la'ang 'gre zhing / mchod pa 'di dag gang la 'bul na/ mchod yon ni sku khrus kyi don du sku la 'bul/ zhabs bsil zhabs la/ me tog dbu la/ bdug spos shangs la/ mar me spyan la/ dri mchog thugs khar/ zhal zas zhal la/ rol mo snyan la 'bul ba yin no/ /rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma'i tshig don ni go sla la/ 'bul ba'i sngags don ni gong rgyas pa'i skabs kyi mchod pa rgyas pa'i mnga' dbul gyi tshe bshad pa des rtogs nus so/ /kun rig la brten pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga 'di la dngos gzhi'i cho ga phal cher rgyas pa'i skabs bzhin byed pas dngos gzhi'i cho ga'i gtso bo rnams la gong dang khyad par cher med kyang / don tshan 'di la bco lnga dang / rgyas pa la bcu gsum las mi 'byung ba'i khyad par ni/ 'di la legs par bsham pa dang / bum bskyed kyi don tshan re re bzung bas yin tshul yang dkyus nas bshad pa ltar nges pa gal che'o/ /de rnams kyis kun rig la brten pa'i rab gnas 'bring po'i dngos gzhi'i cho ga'i don rnams bstan zin to/ /de nas mjug gi cho ga ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ mjug gi cho ga la sdom ni/ gtor ma sbyin dang chos skyong bsgo/ /bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol/ /yon bdag bsgo zhing shis par brjod/ /rten mchod bsod nams yongs su bsngo/ /slob dpon mchod de dga' ston bya/ /slar yang shis pa rgyas par brjod/

/rjes bsdu sbyin sreg mjug don no/ /zhes pa ltar don tshan bcu gnyis las zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gtor ma sbyin pa nas/ sbyin sreg gi bar don tshan bcu gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ gtor ma sbyin pa ni cha gsum gtor ma rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i deng sang yongs grags kyi cho ga ltar btang ba'o zhes pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa chos skyong bsgo ba ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ chos skyong bsgo ba ni/ chang gis sbyangs la gtor chog ltar byin gyis brlab/ gzhan gong rgyas pa'i skabs ltar ro zhes pa ste/ ji skad gsungs pa bzhin kyai rdor sogs la brten pa'i rab gnas kyi skabs yi dam chos skyong sogs la gtor bsngo rgyas pa byed pa'i tshe gtor ma byin rlabs kyi dus su chos skyong bsgo ba'i gtor ma yang byin rlabs byas nas/ slar chos skyong bsgo ba'i tshe gtor ma byin rlabs bsdus pas gong du byin rlabs rgyas pa dran par byas nas gtor ma phul te chos skyong bsgo ba'i gtor ma byin gyis brlab/ de nas 'bul ba dang chos skyong bsgo ba dngos ni gong du bshad pa ltar bya ba yin no/ /gsum pa bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol ba ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ sogs sngags dang phyag rgyas gong bdag bskyed bzhin rigs lngas dbu brgyan zhes pa nas/ cha gsum gyi gtor mgron ni so sor gshegs zin pas mi dgos so zhes pa'i bar te/ de yang bzod par gsol ba'i sngon du rigs lngas dbang bskur ba dang / rigs gsum spyi'i sngags rgyas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi sngags rgyas bdag dang / gnas dang / rnal 'byor bsrung ba bya ste/ rigs lnga'i dbang gi sngags dang / oṃ bhri ta sogs kyi sngags don dang bsgom don ni gong bum bskyed kyi skabs su bshad pa de nyid 'dir rang nyid la go bsgyur te bsam pa yin la/ oṃ badzra kro dha sogs kyi sngags ni/

oṃ dam bca' ba sogs mang po la 'jug pa sogs gong rgyas kyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin dang / badzra satwa ni rdo rje sems dpa'/ kro dha khro bo/ a na me/ larga nyi ma/ mahā chen po/ badzra kro dha ni rdo rje khro bo/ dra ba dra ba ni 'joms 'joms/ bi dra ba ni bi dra ba ni rnam par 'joms rnam par 'joms/ sarba a pa ya sgrib pa thams cad/ nā sha ya nā sha ya ni nyams nyams/ ha ra ha ra ni chod chod/ pra nan ni srog med par gyis/ hūm̐ ni thugs kyi sa bon/ phaṭ ni bde ba 'gugs pa dang / gdug pa dang sdug bsngal la sogs pa 'joms par byed pa'i sogs don du ma la 'jug ste/ rtse mor/ yi ge phaṭ ni ci yin brjod/ /nyon mongs gdug pa ltung byed cing / /bde ba 'gug pa yin par bshad/ /phaṭ ces bya ba ltung ba'i sgra/ /ngan 'gro'i 'gro ba ltung ba 'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de lta bu'i sngags lan gsum dang / khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal lam/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya lan gsum bya ba ni bdag gnas rnal 'byor gsum bsrung ba ste/ de yang phyag rgya 'di rang gi snying kha'i thad du lan gsum char 'cha' ba phyag len la yod kyang / bsgom don la phyi nang bar gsum du bcas par bsam ste/ bdag dang / gnas dang / rnal 'byor te ting nge 'dzin gyi bar du gcod pa bsrung ba yin no/ /de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba sogs kyis bzod par gsol ba yang dkyus bzhin no/ /gshegs gsol la cha gsum gtor mgron skabs 'dir gshegs mi dgos pa dkyus nas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin yin yang / gzhan gsal kha ma gsungs pas/ chos skyong bsgo ba'i rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang / med na ye shes pa gshegs gsol bya dgos sam snyam mo/ /bzhi pa yon bdag bsgo ba nas/ bcu gnyis pa sbyin sreg bya ba'i bar don tshan dgu po ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ bzhi pa yon bdag bsgo ba zhes pa nas/ sbyin sreg gi dod yig brgya la rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pa tsam mo zhes pa'i bar te/

de yang don tshan dgu po 'di dag phal cher gong rgyas pa'i skabs bzhin la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yang chu gnyis sngon 'gro mi mdzad pa sogs ni dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar yin zhing / dkyus su mi gsal ba la/ sbyin bdag shis pa brjod pa'i tshe/ sbyin bdag la bgegs bsang ba rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags rgyas byed pa dang sbyin bdag rdo rje sems dpar bsgom du bcug bden brdar gyi tshe 'di rang gi gong sbyang ba'i skabs su bshad pa ltar bya ba rnams gong rgyas pa'i skabs dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par du shes par bya'o/ /de rnams kyi sgo nas kun rig la brten pa'i rab gnas 'bring po'i cho ga'i don rnams bshad zin to/ /kun rig la brten nas rab gnas rgyas bsdus gnyis bya ba'i tshul ni/ don gsal las ji skad bshad pa bzhin yin pas de gnyis kyi cho ga ni don gsal ltar dang / tshig don gyi gong rgyas pa'i skabs dang / 'dir bshad pa'i 'bring po kun rig dang sbyar ba'i cho ga'i tshig don rnams kyis rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /skabs 'dir dngos grub 'byung ba las/ kun rig la brten pa'i rab gnas kyi phyag len 'khrul pa 'ga' zhig yod tshul dang / de dag don gsal dang 'gal bas spong dgos tshul dang / rab gnas 'bring po'i tshe bum pa gsum nges par dgos tshul gyi zhal gdams dang bcas gsungs pa 'di yang dpyod ldan bdag gzhan bde legs su 'dod pa dag gis snying gi dkyil du bcang bar bya'o/ /de nas skabs 'dir rten gyi gzungs gzhug dang / tsha tsha dang / sku gzugs phran tshegs lam lta bu glo bur du rab gnas shar tshe thun mtshams kyi lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa sogs kyi sgo nas bya ba'i rab gnas kyi cho ga nyer mkho byed tshul gsungs pa'i don ni/ gong du rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi cho ga'i don zhib tu bshad pa dag gis bde blag tu rtogs nus pas ma bris so/ /spyi don bdun pa rab tu gnas pa byas pa'i dgos pa ni/

dngos grub 'byung ba 'di gong rab gnas bsdus pa kha 'phangs mdzad pa'i rjes su gsungs kyang / 'dir blangs te bshad na/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ rtsa ba'i sa bcad bdun pa rab tu gnas par byas pa'i dgos pa ni/ ma byas pa'i nyes dmigs dang / byas pa'i phan yon no zhes sogs/ rab gnas ma byas pa'i nyes dmigs mi 'byung ba dang / legs par byas pa la phan yon ji ltar 'byung ba'i tshul gnyis kyi sgo nas rab gnas byas pa'i dgos pa mdor bsdus gsungs pa'i don ni/ 'o na rten bzhengs la phan yon mang du bshad pas rten gsum bzhengs pa tsam gyis chog gi rab gnas bya mi dgos so snyam na/ don dam par bya byed las grol bas rten gsum bzhengs pa dang / rab gnas la sogs pa'ang ma grub pas bya mi dgos mod/ tha snyad kun rdzob tu bsam pa dag pas rten bzhengs nas de la rab gnas tshul bzhin byas nas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad 'grub par gsungs te/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad rab tu mi gnas pa la/ ji ltar na rgyal ba rnams kyi rab tu gnas pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas kun nas rab tu zhugs/ /rab tu gnas pa gang yang med/ /kun tu mkha' ltar gnas pa la/ /cig shos kyis ni rab tu brtag /'jig rten kun rdzob la brten nas/ /rab tu gnas pa rab tu brtags/ /dam pa'i don du dpyad pa na/ /gang zhig gang gis rab tu gnas/ /gdod ma nas zhi skye med la/ /ci 'dras ji ltar rab tu gnas/ /dang po'i las can sems can rnams/ /rtogs pa'i rgyu ru gsungs par zad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar dang / sku gzungs sogs rten bzhengs pa'i phan yon ni/ gong du bshad pa ltar yin pas so/ /de yang rab gnas legs par byas pa las 'byung gi rab gnas ma byas pa'i sku gzugs bzhengs pa dang / de la mchod pa byas pa sogs la phan yon mi 'byung ba'i khar nyes dmigs 'byung bas na/

nyes dmigs mi 'byung zhing phan yon mang du 'byung ba'i phyir rten bzhengs pa la rab gnas byed pa ni dgos pa mchog dang ldan pa yin la/ 'o na rab gnas ma byas na nyes pa ji ltar 'byung la/ byas na phan yon gang 'byung snyam na/ 'di la ma byas pa'i nyes dmigs dang / byas pa'i phan yon gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ gang du sku gzugs rdzogs pa dang / byin ma brlabs par ring gnas na/ /de la bkra mi shis pa 'byung / /de srid mchod par de mi 'os/ /dper na skyes bu la la zhig /rig pa'i mtshan ma spangs pa na/ /'jig rten kun gyis mchod mi byed/ /de de bzhin du gzugs brnyan de/ /rab gnas ma byas gzugs brnyan la/ /gang zhig mchod cing phyag byed pa/ /dam tshig bral zhing sngags dman pas/ /sbyin sreg thal ba 'bras med mtshungs/ /zhes bya ba dang / cho ga dang yo byad dman pa la nyes pa yod de/ cho ga dman pas mi bya ste/ rab gnas rtag tu bkra mi shis/ /'jig rten 'dir yang sdug bsngal la/ /'jig rten pha rol 'jigs pa che/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /dngos grub 'dod pas nan tan bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /ci ste/ lung dang po'i don ni/ sa phyogs gang du dad pa chen pos kun nas bslangs te sku gzugs la sogs pa bzhengs nas de'i bya ba yongs su rdzogs pa na/ rab gnas kyi cho ga'i sgo nas gzugs sogs rten de la byin gyis ma rlabs pa ste ye shes pa 'jug par ma byas par yun ring du gnas na/ rten de la 'byung po stobs chen gnas nas yul khams su bkra mi shis pa 'byung la/ de la gnas pa'i 'byung po de bskrad nas rab gnas ma byas na/ rten de rgyu rin po che kho na las grub pa lta bu rgyu'i sgo nas shin tu bzang zhing / lha bzo mkhas pas phyag tshad dang mthun par bzhengs te mchog tu byon gtsang ba yin na yang / ji srid rab tu gnas pa ma byas pa de srid du dad pa can dag gi mchod par byed pa'i yul du rten de mi 'os te/

dper na chos kyi rgyal po chen po'i rigs su skyes pa'i skyes bu la la zhig rang gi rigs dang mthun par chos ldan gyi bya ba'i sgo nas chab 'bangs skyong ba sogs chos rgyal rang gi mtshan nyid bya 'os pa la/ de spangs te gang zag dman pa'i rigs dang mthun pa'i spyod pa byed pa na/ rigs chen po yin yang rang gi bsam sbyor dman pas na/ 'jig rten pa'i 'gro ba kun gyis kyang de la mchod pa mi byed par yal bar 'dor ba de bzhin no/ /des na skyes bu de ci ste mchod yul du byas na yang 'bras bu rnam dag mi 'byung ba bzhin du/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'i gzugs brnyan de rab gnas ma byas na gzugs brnyan bzang po yin yang de la mchod pa byed cing phyag 'tshal ba sogs byed pa ni/ dam tshig dang bral zhing sngags ma dag pa sogs dman pa bzlas pa'i sgo nas lha'i sbyin sreg byas pa las ma tshang ba kha skong nus pa sogs kyi 'bras bu rnam dag 'grub pa med pa dang mtshungs la/ des na nyes pa de dag mi 'byung ba'i phyir rab gnas bya dgos zhes pa'i don dang / lung gnyis pa'i don ni cho ga ma dag pa dang yo byad dman pa'i sgo nas rab gnas byas pa la yang / dge legs mi 'byung ba'i khar bkra mi shis pa 'byung ba dang / byed pa po la skye ba 'di phyir nyes pa chen po 'byung bas cho ga dag pa dang / yo byad bzang po la nan tan bya dgos so zhes pa'i don no/ /gnyis pa legs par byas pa'i phan yon ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ gnyis pa legs par byas pa'i phan yon ni/ cho ga bdag nyid nus pa yis/ /rtog pa las gsungs tshul legs pas/ /de byas bsod nams che ba ni/ /mthong dang ma mthong 'bras bu skye/ /de la byin rlabs 'jug par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / de bzhin du yang sngags gnas pas/ /mchod ldan mchod pa byed pa dang / /de yi las kyi rnam smin gyis/ /skye ba ru ni mchod par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so zhes te lung de'i don yang /

slob dpon rang nyid rab gnas kyi cho ga la mkhas pa'i bdag nyid du gyur pa/ rten la ye shes pa 'jug nus pa yis/ rtog pa ste rgyud las ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul legs par shes pa'i sgo nas rab gnas kyi cho ga de byas na/ de las ni bsod nams chen po thob ste/ mthong chos tshe 'dir bgegs zhi ba dang / tshe rgyas pa dang / gzhan dbang du 'du ba dang / gzhan gyi gnod pa bzlog pa sogs 'bras bu mang du 'byung zhing / ma mthong ba tshe phyi mar bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs nas mthar thug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob pa la sogs pa'i 'bras bu skye bar 'gyur bas so/ /zhes pa dang / yang 'ga' zhig las/ cho ga mkhas shing nus pa yi/ /brtag pa las gsungs shing 'byung ba ltar na/ rab gnas kyi cho ga la mkhas shing zhes pa dang / brtag pa ste rgyud las zhes pa ste don khyad par med do/ /lung gnyis pa'i don ni/ rab gnas byas pa la phan yon yod pa de bzhin du gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor la gnas pas/ mchod pa'i yul gyi yon tan dang ldan pa rab gnas can gyi rten la mchod pa rgya chen po 'bul bar byed pa dang / rab gnas byas pa de yi las kyi rnam smin gyi mthus/ rab gnas byas nas mchod pa po de skye ba nas skye ba ru yul khyad par can la mchod pa byed pa po dang / rang nyid la yang gzhan gyis mchod par 'gyur zhes pa'i don yin la/ de nas/ des na rab gnas legs par byas pas 'jig rten 'di dang / pha rol dang / sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu'i bar du ji ltar smon lam btab pa ltar 'grub pa yin no/ /rab tu gnas pa'i phan yon bstan zin to/ /zhes pa don gsal las gsungs pa ltar bkod pa zhes gsungs pa ni rje btsun rin po che'i don gsal las gsungs pa de bkod pa yin pas yid ches pas gyis shig ces pa'i don te/ de dag gis don gsal las rab gnas kyi phan yon mdor bsdus gsungs pa de dngos grub 'byung ba 'dir 'god par mdzad pa'i don bshad pa yin la/

gzhan yang rab gnas kyi rgyud nas gsungs pa bzhin gyi cho ga'i yan lag phra mo tshun chad ma tshang ba med par kun byas na/ de lta bu byas pa'i rten de ye shes pa gnas pa'i rten mchog tu 'gyur ba dang / rab gnas byed pa pos 'khor lo'i bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid thob pa dang / nag phyogs la dga' ba'i gza' dang rgyu skar gyi gnod pa med pa dang / bgegs dang log 'dren gyi bar chad kyang med par 'gyur zhing / dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i gza' skar sogs rang gang du gnas pa der sems zhi bas gnas nas sku gzugs dang mchod rten gyi dngos grub dag kyang ster bar mdzad cing / yid la 'dod pa de cung zad tsam re bsams pas kyang bsam pa'i don de skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan du yang 'grub par 'gyur ba sogs kyi phan yon dang ldan pa yin te/ rgyud de nyid las/ ji ltar gsungs bzhin kun byas na/ /rab tu gnas pa mchog tu 'gyur/ /'khor los bsgyur rgyal dbang phyug ni/ /thob 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /gza' dang rgyu skar gnod pa med/ /bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad med/ /gza' rnams thams cad rjes mthun zhing / /bgegs dang rgyu skar lha rnams kun/ /de ru zhi bas kun gnas la/ /sku gzugs mchod rten la sogs kyi/ /dngos grub dag ni ster bar mdzad/ /yid kyis cung zad gang bsams pa/ /skye dang skye bar 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gzhan yang rab gnas tshul bzhin byas pa'i rten rnams la phyag dang / bskor ba dang / mchod pa la sogs pa legs par byas na/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la mchod par 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel legs par bsgrigs pa yin pas bsod nams tshad med da ེ/ gsal rgyal gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ thub dbang mchod rten rdo thal byung ba yis/ /lha mi'i 'jig rten dag na tshe ring zhing / /lus sems nad dang mya ngan med pa dang / /rtag tu skyid cing nor gyis phyug par 'gyur/

/thub dbang mchod rten byi dor byas pa yis/ /shin tu blta na sdug cing mig tu mdzes/ /byad bzhin bzang la padma'i 'od dang ldan/ /srid pa'i skyon rnams kun dang bral bar 'gyur/ /su dag la las sangs rgyas mchod rten la/ /dad pa'i sems kyis bla bre 'bul byed pa/ /de dag sa steng rgya mtsho'i mtha' klas pa/ /ma lus gnod med rgyal cing dbang byed 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten me tog rnying bsal bas/ /'dod chags chags med zhe sdang sdang mi 'gyur/ /gti mug rmongs med lta ngan chags mi 'gyur/ /mi rnams rab tu dga' zhing skyid par 'gyur/ /rgyal po dge ba'i las rnams thams cad byed/ /'khor ba'i bde ba sna tshogs myangs gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni byang chub dam pa yi/ /'bras bu bde blag kho nar 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo las/ 'jig rten mgon gyi mchod rten la/ /mi gang skor ba byed pa yi/ /bsngags pa bskal pa bye bar yang / /brjod pa zad pa ma yin te/ /zhes sogs gsungs shing / de bzhin phyag 'tshal ba dang / phreng ba dang / yon chab dang / dar gyi cod pan dang / na bza' dang / dri zhim po'i byug pa dang / ba dan dang / mar me dang / gdugs dang / rol mo'i sgra dang / spos phul ba'i phan yon dang / phyag dar dang / ba rgya bsal ba dang / me tog rnying pa phyags pa'i phan yon la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs so/ /gzhan yang snying rje padma dkar po dang / dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa phyag rgya'i mdo dang / klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa che ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod dang / dkon mchog sprin dang / rin chen phung po'i mdo la sogs pa nas rten la mchod pa sogs byas pa'i phan yon rgyas par gsungs shing / rgyud sde dag las kyang gsungs mod/ 'dir yi ges 'jigs nas mtshon pa tsam bkod pa yin la zhib tu skal bzang rnam dpyod can dag gis mdo rgyud mang po la bltas na rang gzhan thams cad dad pa 'phel ba'i phyir skye bo du ma 'dus pa'i sar bsgrags pa dang /

yi ger 'bri ba la sogs pa byas te/ ma dad pa rnams dad pa dang / dad pa rnams gong nas gong du 'phel bar bya'o/ /de ltar rten mchod pa la sogs pa la phan yon bshad pa de dag kyang rten rab gnas can gyi dbang du mdzad gyis/ rab gnas ma byas pa'i rten la mchod pa sogs byas kyang de lta bu'i phan yon rgyas par bshad pa rnams mi 'byung bas/ yang dag par na rten la mchod pa sogs kyi phan yon mang du bshad pa de dag kyang rab tu gnas pa tshul bzhin du byas pa'i phan yon du shes par byas nas 'jig rten 'di dang 'jig rten pha rol dang / sangs rgyas kyi bar gyi bde legs 'dod pa rnams kyis rten gsum bzhengs te rab tu gnas pa tshul bzhin du byed pa'i cho ga la 'bad par bya'o/ /de dag gis ni rab tu gnas pa byas pa'i dgos pa legs par bshad pa ste/ de rnams kyi sgo nas rab gnas dngos grub 'byung ba'i brtsam par bya ba gzhung don dngos legs par bshad zin to/ /rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa rtsom pa mthar phyin pa mjug gi don la/ brtsams pa'i dge ba bsngo ba/ lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen dang bdag rkyen gyi sgo nas brtsams pa'i tshul bstan bcos brtsams pa'i dngos kyi dgos pa dang brgyud pa'i dgos pa bstan pa/ bstan bcos brtsams pa'i dus dang gnas bstan pa'i sgo nas mdzad byang smos pa/ bstan bcos brtsams pa la brten pa'i nyes tshogs bshags shing / slar yang dge tshogs gzhan don du bsngo ba sogs dang don tshan lnga las/ dang po ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ rab 'byams gzhung lugs ji snyed ma rtogs kyang / /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum ste/ de yang 'di ltar rtsom pa pos rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa sogs kyis rab 'byams te bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gzhung lugs mdzad pa'i nang nas ji snyed de mang po'i brjod don ma rtogs kyang bstan 'gro la phan pa'i rab tu dkar ba'i lhag pa'i bsam pa mchog tu dag pas kun nas bslangs te/

bstan 'gro'i don bshad sgrub kyi bar chad zhi zhing mthun rkyen 'grub pa dang / 'gro ba'i don mngon mtho dang nges legs kyis bsdus pa'i dge legs bsgrub pa'i thabs mchog tu gyur pa/ rten la rab tu gnas pa ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga don gsal sogs kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin 'chad byed kyi bstan bcos dngos grub 'byung ba bshad pa'i mthu la brten nas shes rgyud rab tu gtum pas chos byed la yun du bar chad byed pa'i bdud kyi tshogs kyi bar chad zhi bar shog ces chos bsgrub pa la 'gal rkyen zhi ba'i smon lam mo/ /'o na bstan bcos 'di don gsal bzhin bshad pa las bdud kyi bar chad zhi bar smon na/ don gsal gyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin rtogs sam zhe na/ rtsom pa po sngags 'chang bdag gis rab gnas kyi rgyud sogs kyi don gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos kyi mchog rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa 'di'i brjod don ma lus par rtogs sam snyam pa'i gdeng dang yang ldan pa yin te/ bla ma'i dus thabs bstan pa dang / /bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya/ /zhes pa dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ ri dbang rtse nas 'ga' zhig lhung gyur na/ /lhung bar mi 'gyur snyam yang lhung bar 'gyur/ /bla ma'i drin gyis phan pa'i lung thob na/ /grol bar mi 'gyur snyam yang grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bla ma'i byin gyi rlabs kyi dbang gis mtshon byed dpe dang / mtshon bya don gyi ye shes kyang skye bar gsungs pas na kho bos kyang bla ma'i thugs rje dang byin rlabs kyi stobs kyis chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pas so/ /des na bla ma'i thugs rje la brten rang gis don gsal gyi don rtogs shing / 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ngo bo sa lo chen po'i lag len rnam par dag pa dang / gsum rgyun dri ma med pa rnams kyis brgyan nas/ bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa yongs dang / khyad par sa lo chen po la mi phyed pa'i dad pa chen po'i sgo nas bstan bcos 'di sbyar ba yin pas/

'di la brten nas smon pa bzhin 'grub nges pas phan bde'i rtsa ba bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa dar bar shog ces phan bde'i mthun rkyen 'grub pa'i smon lam mo/ /des na bstan 'gro la phan pa'i lhag bsam dang / don gsal gyi dgongs don phyin ci ma log pa rtogs pa'i mkhyen rab ste mkhyen brtse'i yon tan khyad par can gnyis kyi sgo nas legs par sbyar ba'i bstan bcos 'di bris pa las byung ba'i rnam par dkar ba'i dge ba'i las de'i rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu la brten nas/ rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi shes rgyud kyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs te mthar thug gi 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa thob pa dang / de nas kyang pha mar gyur pa'i 'gro ba rigs drug gi sdug bsngal pa'i sems can ji snyed mchis pa thams cad kyang / srid pa 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las sgrol ba dang sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par shog ces mthar thug gi 'bras bu 'grub pa'i smon lam mo/ /gnyis pa lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen dang bdag rkyen gnyis kyi sgo nas ji ltar brtsams pa'i tshul ni/ rtsom pa po nyid kyi thugs rgyud la bstan 'gro'i don du bstan bcos 'di lta bu zhig mdzad dgos dgongs pa thog ma nas yod pa de nyid kyis bdag rkyen gyi rgyu byas/ mkhan chen sku mched sogs skul ba po rnams kyi lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen myur ba'i grogs byas nas brtsams pa yin zhes pa ni/ de ltar zhes pa nas/ gong gi skul ba po rnams kyis rkyen byas zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan la/ gsum pa bstan bcos brtsams pa'i dngos kyi dgos pa dang brgyud pa'i dgos pa bstan pa ni/ dngos kyi dgos pa bdag gi bla ma 'jam dbyangs sku mched sogs dngos kyi zhal slob mang po la phan par 'gyur ba dang / brgyud pa'i dgos pa bstan 'gro'i don 'grub par 'gyur ba ni rigs kyi bu ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po zhes pa nas/

ci ma rung snyam mi shes bzhin du spyi brtol bskyed de zhes pa'i bar ro/ /bzhi pa bstan bcos brtsams pa'i dus dang gnas bstan pa'i sgo nas mdzad byang smos pa ni/ dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje dang zhes pa nas/ dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba 'di yongs su rdzogs zhes pa'i bar ro/ /lnga pa bstan bcos brtsams pa la brten pa'i nyes tshogs bshags shing slar yang dge tshogs gzhan don du bsngo ba ni/ nyes pa rnams sa lo chen po la bzod par gsol zhing zhes sogs so/ /de ltar de dag gis ni rab gnas don gsal gyi gsal byed dngos grub 'byung ba'i bstan bcos chen po'i dgongs don rnam par bshad pa rab gnas bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba'i bstan bcos chen po ma tshang ba med par bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ gzhan las ches zab rdo rje theg pa yi/ /lam gyi gtso bo mngon rtogs bcu gcig las/ /bstan pa gnas shing 'gro la bde skyid kun/ /'byung ba'i thabs mchog rab gnas cho ga yin/ /dus ngan bstan pa 'jig la nye ba'i tshe/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i rnam sprul sngags 'chang rje/ /dus kun bstan 'gro'i don la gcig gzhol ba'i/ /dus gsum mkhyen pa de yi gsung rab tshogs/ /tshig nyung don mang 'jug pa bde ba'i tshul/ /mkhas rmongs kun la 'dod pa 'jo ba'i gnas/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung bsam yas bskrun pa las/ /gzhan las phul byung dngos grub 'byung ba yin/ /rab gnas cho ga rab gnas rgyud rgyal gyi/ /don gsal gsung rab don gsal mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /dngos grub gter chen dngos grub 'byung ba yi/ /rnam bshad mchog 'di rnam bshad kun gyi rgyan/ /'di ni sngags 'chang gsung rab rab gnas kyi/ /tshig don rnam par phye ba'i rgyas 'grel te/ /legs par brtags na shes bya'i gnas mang po'i/ /rnam dbye gsal bar ston pa'i glegs bam yin/ /'di la slob ma 'di don 'di yin zhes/ /mkhas mang dbus su mkhas pas mkhas nyams kyis/

/legs bshad gtam gyis legs par legs spel na/ /gsung rab mang po'i gsung don gsung bzhin rtogs/ /sngon tshe rngog lo chen pos rgyal yum gyi/ /'dres rkang phra mo tsam zhig ma tshang ba/ /de nyid kho na gsal phyir dka' spyad tshogs/ /dang du bzhes nas bal yul gshegs zhes grags/ /de sogs bstan la gcig tu dgongs pa yi/ /skyes chen rnams kyis bka' dang bstan bcos kyi/ /tshig don 'ga' tsam 'tshol la'ang dka' ba'i khur/ /brgya phrag bzod pa'i rnam thar bsam las 'das/ /deng sang zab mo'i chos tshul phal che ba'i/ /tshig don thams cad na bun bzhin yal yang / /ji snyam mi sems tshe 'di'i lto chos kyang / /phyag len phra mo tsam la'ang rmongs 'di skyo/ /sa skya'i 'jam dbyangs paṇa chen gsung rab la/ /mkhas pa'i nyan bshad gang na yod pa'i sa/ /de na sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba yin/ /'chad nyan med na po ti mang bzhugs kyang / /bstan pa zhig pa yin zhes gsal bar gsungs/ /nyan bshad med na mkhas pa rgyun 'chad cing / /gzhung lugs sbyangs pa'i bshes gnyen mkhas pa'i tshogs/ /med na bstan pa rnal ma su yis 'dzin/ /'di la soms la skal bzang blo gsal rnams/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya bas dus 'da' ba'i/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor stong log ma byed par/ /mkhas pa sten la shes bya'i gnas kun sbyongs/ /blang dor shes pa'i blo gros mig thob nas/ /gcig tu bstan pa spel ba'i thabs la 'bad/ /de ltar bgyis na bstan dang rang gzhan la/ /phan dang bde ba'i 'bras bu ci yang 'byung / /rab gnas cho ga'i don 'grel bshad pa las/ /las dkar bsags pa gang des bdag gzhan kun/ /kun gyis dus gsum bsags pa'i sdig sgrib tshogs/ /tshogs rnams ma lus byang zhing dag gyur cig /'dir 'bad la sogs rnam par dkar ba'i las/ /ma lus sdom pa kun bzang mchod sprin ltar/ /gyur nas 'khor ba ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /mchod yul rnams la 'bul gyi dges gyur cig /bsod nams 'di yis bdag cag dpon slob rnams/

/dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /phyi ma bde ba can du sangs rgyas kyi/ /zhal mthong gsung gi bdud rtsi thob gyur cig /gnas der rang don chos sku mngon gyur nas/ /gang 'dul sprul pas bstan pa rgyas byed cing / /'gro kun bde skyid dpal la spyod pa dang / /kun kyang dag pa'i zhing der 'dren gyur cig /ces rab gnas don gsal gyi gsal byed dngos grub 'byung ba'i bstan bcos chen po'i dgongs don rnam par bshad pa rab gnas bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba 'di yang snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi thugs sras rgyal tshab dam pa rigs ldan chos kyi rje grub pa'i slob dpon 'jam dpal dbang po'i mtshan can dang / yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas grags pa'i 'od dkar phyogs bcur 'phro ba 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan mchog ste sprul pa'i skyes mchog sku mched zhal rnam pa gnyis dang / rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'i khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' nyid gzhan ngor ngur smrig gi bla gos 'chang ba rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ 'gro kun dga' mdzad don gnyis lhun grub lo nas spyan snga rin po che/ sbyin pa la sogs phyin drug mthar phyin mtshan gyi grags pa srid pa gsum na gsal ba rje nags dgon pa chen po/ grub pa'i dbang phyug nyams dang rtogs pa rab tu brtan pa'i skyes bu rje btsun snyan brgyud gdams pa'i rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang 'jam pa'i rdo rje gzugs gzhan zlos pa'i gar gyis chos kun ma lus thams cad gzigs pa'i snyan pa lha'i rnga bo che sa gsum na yongs su grags pa snyigs ma'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis pa de nyid la sogs te/ yongs 'dzin bslu med dam pa du mas rjes su bzung zhing / zhabs kyi padma'i phreng ba rtag par cod pan du 'dzin pa'i dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇḍi ta mkhas pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/

snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi gsung rab ngo mtshar can rab gnas kyi bstan bcos dngos grub 'byung ba'i zhabs 'degs su 'gyur ba'i rnam bshad cig byung na ci ma rung snyam pa'i lhag bsam bzang po zhig snga mo'i dus nas yod mod kyang / le lo'i dbang gis yun ring du 'gyangs pa la/ dus phyis thub bstan lha khang chen mo'i mkhan rabs bcu gcig pa mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i gzhung lugs mtha' dag la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa dge ba can rigs lam smra ba kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan mchog dam pa bstan pa rin po che'i khur gyis mi ngal ba'i yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhan chen rin po che byams pa bsam gtan rgya mtsho ba'i bkas yang yang du bskul zhing / gsung rab tshad ldan rnams nas legs bshad kyi cha len pa'i grogs dan gyi rim pa yang 'bad rtsol gyis bgyis pa sogs kyis rkyen byas/ skul ba po nyid dang / rigs kyi bu ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug la sogs te rang dang skal ba mnyam pa'i slob ma'i tshogs rnams la phan pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs te/ rje btsun chen po'i gsung rab don gsal rje 'brangs dang bcas pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga rnam bshad de las 'phros pa'i yig cha phran du ma sogs mdor na rje btsun gong ma rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa'i rab gnas skor gyi gsung rab mtha' yas pa zhig la yun ring mo nas 'dris par byas nas/ mi shes bzhin du spyi brtol bskyed de 'phags pa'i yul na ta ra ṇaḥste nyi sgrol byed ces grags shing / rgya nag lugs la shing pho spre'u'i lo tha skar gyi zla ba'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi rdzogs pa gnyis pa'i tshes la bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i bzhi thog bla brang gi yang rtse ngo mtshar 'chi med rdo rje'i pho brang e waṃ byang chub 'byung ba'i gnas su legs par sbyar ba'i tshe/

de'i nyin kho na la thub bstan rin chen gling nas dge slong kun dga' rab brtan gyis/ rab gnas kyi mnga' dbul gyi tsa ka li cha tshang rgyal srid sna bdun dang bcas pa zhig nged rang gi lag tu rtsol med du byung ba sogs rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa 'grigs pa'i nyin grub par bgyis pa'i yi ge pa ni/ ā kṣa ra'i bya ba la shin tu mkhas pa'i phul du phyin zhing / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsis gzhung la legs par sbyangs pa'i blo gros can shab stod pa bkra shis don grub kyi sor mo'i 'phrul gyis mgyogs par bskrun pa'o/ /'dis kyang bdag cag dpon slob kyi bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig dge legs rtsa ba rab gnas rnam bshad 'di/ /bri dang klog dang thos bsam byed pa sogs/ /de dag rnams la bsrung zhing skyong ba dang / /chos 'di spel ba 'phrin las mgon pos pu tra chen po/ mdzod/ /sarba siddhi mme pra yatstshantu/ dngos grub thams cad bdag la stsal du gsol/ dharme u da ya mastu/ chos 'di dar bar gyur cig karma bista ra bha wa tu/ 'phrin las rgyas par gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ/ thams cad bkra shis// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 316 a myes zhabs/ rab gnas bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
